import type { Slide } from '../../domain/entities/Slide';

export interface SlideStore {

   */

  /**
   * Get active slide ID
   */
  getActiveSlideId(): string | null;

  /**
   * Set slides
   */
  setSlides(slides: Slide[]): void;

  /**
   * Set active slide
   */
  setActiveSlideId(id: string): void;

  /**
   * Add slide
   */
  addSlide(slide: Slide): void;

  /**
   * Remove slide
   */
  removeSlide(id: string): void;

  /**
   * Update slide
   */
  updateSlide(id: string, patch: Partial<Slide>): void;

  /**
   * Add element to slide
   */
  addElement(slideId: string, element: CanvasElement): void;

  /**
   * Update element in slide
   */
  updateElement(slideId: string, elementId: string, patch: Partial<CanvasElement>): void;

  /**
   * Remove element from slide
   */
  removeElement(slideId: string, elementId: string): void;

  /**
   * Subscribe to changes
   */
  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void;
}

/**
 * Slide Use Cases - Application Layer
 * Business logic orchestration
 */

import { Slide } from '../../domain/entities/Slide';
import type { SlideStore } from '../ports/SlideStore';
import type { DocFormat, Orientation, CanvasElement } from '../../shared/types';

export interface CreateSlideInput {
  name?: string;
  format?: DocFormat;
  orientation?: Orientation;
}

export interface UpdateElementInput {
  slideId: string;
  elementId: string;
  patch: Partial<CanvasElement>;
}

export class SlideUseCases {
  constructor(private readonly slideStore: SlideStore) {}

  /**
   * Create new slide
   */
  createSlide(input: CreateSlideInput = {}): Slide {
    const slide = new Slide({
      name: input.name,
      format: input.format,
      orientation: input.orientation,
    });

    this.slideStore.addSlide(slide);
    return slide;
  }

  /**
   * Remove slide
   */
  removeSlide(id: string): void {
    const slides = this.slideStore.getSlides();
    if (slides.length <= 1) {
      throw new Error('Cannot remove the last slide');
    }
    this.slideStore.removeSlide(id);
  }

  /**
   * Change slide format
   */
  changeFormat(slideId: string, format: DocFormat, customSize?: { w: number; h: number }): void {
    const slide = this.slideStore.getSlides().find((s) => s.id === slideId);
    if (!slide) {
      throw new Error(`Slide not found: ${slideId}`);
    }

    slide.changeFormat(format, customSize);
    this.slideStore.updateSlide(slideId, slide);
  }

  /**
   * Change slide orientation
   */
  changeOrientation(slideId: string, orientation: Orientation): void {
    const slide = this.slideStore.getSlides().find((s) => s.id === slideId);
    if (!slide) {
      throw new Error(`Slide not found: ${slideId}`);
    }

    slide.changeOrientation(orientation);
    this.slideStore.updateSlide(slideId, slide);
  }

  /**
   * Add element to slide
   */
  addElement(slideId: string, element: CanvasElement): void {
    this.slideStore.addElement(slideId, element);
  }

  /**
   * Update element
   */
  updateElement(input: UpdateElementInput): void {
    this.slideStore.updateElement(input.slideId, input.elementId, input.patch);
  }

  /**
   * Remove element
   */
  removeElement(slideId: string, elementId: string): void {
    this.slideStore.removeElement(slideId, elementId);
  }

  /**
   * Move element layer
   */
  moveElementLayer(slideId: string, elementId: string, direction: 1 | -1): void {
    const slide = this.slideStore.getSlides().find((s) => s.id === slideId);
    if (!slide) return;

    slide.moveElementLayer(elementId, direction);
    this.slideStore.updateSlide(slideId, slide);
  }

  /**
   * Duplicate slide
   */
  duplicateSlide(slideId: string): Slide | null {
    const slide = this.slideStore.getSlides().find((s) => s.id === slideId);
    if (!slide) return null;

    const clone = slide.clone();
    this.slideStore.addSlide(clone);
    return clone;
  }

  /**
   * Set active slide
   */
  setActiveSlide(id: string): void {
    this.slideStore.setActiveSlideId(id);
  }

  /**
   * Get slides
   */
  getSlides(): Slide[] {
    return this.slideStore.getSlides();
  }

  /**
   * Get active slide
   */
  getActiveSlide(): Slide | null {
    return this.slideStore.getActiveSlide();
  }
}

// Factory function
export function createSlideUseCases(slideStore: SlideStore): SlideUseCases {
  return new SlideUseCases(slideStore);
}

import React from 'react';
import { Group, Circle } from 'react-konva';
import type { CanvasElement, AnchorSide } from '../../types';
import { getAnchorPoint } from '../../lib/connectors';

interface Props {
  element: CanvasElement | null;
  zoom: number;
  onStartDraft: (side: AnchorSide, e: any) => void;
}

const SIDES: AnchorSide[] = ['top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left'];

const HIT_R = 12;   // screen-px: РЅРµРІРёРґРёРјР°СЏ Р·РѕРЅР° Р·Р°С…РІР°С‚Р°
const VIS_R = 6;    // screen-px: РІРёРґРёРјС‹Р№ РєСЂСѓР¶РѕРє

export const AnchorOverlay: React.FC<Props> = ({ element, zoom, onStartDraft }) => {
  if (!element) return null;
  if (element.type === 'connector' || element.type === 'line') return null;

  return (
    <Group>
      {SIDES.map((side) => {
        const p = getAnchorPoint(element, side);
        return (
          <Group key={side}>
            {/* РќРµРІРёРґРёРјР°СЏ hit-Р·РѕРЅР° вЂ” Р»РѕРІРёС‚ РєР»РёРєРё Рё РјС‹С€СЊ */}
            <Circle
              x={p.x}
              y={p.y}
              radius={HIT_R / zoom}
              fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.001)"
              listening={true}
              onMouseDown={(e) => {
                e.cancelBubble = true;
                onStartDraft(side, e);
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                const stage = e.target.getStage();
                if (stage) stage.container().style.cursor = 'crosshair';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                const stage = e.target.getStage();
                if (stage) stage.container().style.cursor = 'default';
              }}
            />
            {/* Р’РёРґРёРјС‹Р№ РєСЂСѓР¶РѕРє вЂ” РЅРµ СЃР»СѓС€Р°РµС‚ СЃРѕР±С‹С‚РёСЏ, С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ СЂРёСЃСѓРµС‚СЃСЏ */}
            <Circle
              x={p.x}
              y={p.y}
              radius={VIS_R / zoom}
              fill="#ffffff"
              stroke="#6366f1"
              strokeWidth={2 / zoom}
              listening={false}
            />
          </Group>
        );
      })}
    </Group>
  );
};

  useEffect(() => {
    const tr = editor.trRef.current;
    const stage = editor.stageRef.current;
    if (!tr || !stage) return;

    if (editor.connectorDraft) {
      tr.nodes([]);
      tr.getLayer()?.batchDraw();
      return;
    }
    if (!selectedIds.length) {
      tr.nodes([]);
      tr.getLayer()?.batchDraw();
      return;
    }

    const layers = stage.getLayers();
    const nodes = selectedIds
      .map((id) => {
        for (const l of layers) {
          const node = l.findOne('#' + id);
          if (node) return node;
        }
        return null;
      })
      .filter((n): n is any => !!n);

    tr.nodes(nodes);
    tr.getLayer()?.batchDraw();
  }, [selectedIds, activeSlide, editor.trRef, editor.stageRef, editor.connectorDraft]);

  /* ---------- Opacity fills-СЃР»РѕСЏ ---------- */
  useEffect(() => {
    const layer = fillsLayerRef.current;
    if (!layer) return;
    const canvas = layer.getCanvas?.()?._canvas as HTMLCanvasElement | undefined;
    if (canvas) canvas.style.opacity = '0.6';
  }, [activeSlide.id]);

  /* ---------- Stage events ---------- */

  const handleStageMouseDown = (e: any) => {
    const cur = editorRef.current;
    if (cur.fillMode) {
      cur.handleFillClick(() => {});
      return;
    }
    if (e.target !== e.target.getStage()) return;
    if (editing) { cur.commitEdit(); return; }

    cur.clearSelection();
    cur.setFloatingPos(null);
    cur.setShowTextToolbar(false);
    cur.rubberBandStart();
  };

  const handleStageMouseMove = (e: any) => {
    if (editorRef.current.isDraggingRef?.current) return;

    if (editor.isDragging) {
      if (editor.connectorDraft) {
        const stage = e.target.getStage();
        const pos = stage?.getPointerPosition();
        if (pos) editor.moveConnectorDraft(pos.x / zoom, pos.y / zoom);
      }
      return;
    }

    editor.rubberBandMove();

    const stage = e.target.getStage();
    if (!stage) return;
    const pos = stage.getPointerPosition();
    if (!pos) return;
    const worldX = pos.x / zoom;
    const worldY = pos.y / zoom;

    editor.setHoveredId(
      editor.findElementIdAtWithPad(
        worldX, worldY, hoverPad,
        [editor.connectorDraft?.fromId || ''],
      ) || null,
    );

    if (editor.connectorDraft) {
      editor.moveConnectorDraft(worldX, worldY);
    }
  };

  const handleStageMouseUp = () => {
    const cur = editorRef.current;
    cur.rubberBandEnd();
    if (cur.connectorDraft) cur.commitConnectorDraft();
  };

  const handleStageMouseLeave = () => {
    editorRef.current.setHoveredId(null);
  };

  const handleContextMenu = (e: any, elementId: string | null) => {
    e.evt.preventDefault();
    const cur = editorRef.current;
    if (elementId && !selectedIds.includes(elementId)) cur.setSelectedIds([elementId]);
    cur.setContextMenu({ x: e.evt.clientX, y: e.evt.clientY, elementId });
    cur.setFloatingPos(null);
  };

  /* ---------- РЎС‚Р°Р±РёР»СЊРЅС‹Р№ editorCtx (РїСѓСЃС‚С‹Рµ deps) ---------- */
  const editorCtx: EditorActionsContext = useMemo(
    () => ({
      openEditor: (el, field, clickPos) => editorRef.current.openEditor(el, field, clickPos),
      openCellEditor: (el, r, c) => editorRef.current.openCellEditor(el, r, c),
      openStampEditor: (id) => editorRef.current.openStampEditor(id),
      openDiagramEditor: (id) => editorRef.current.openDiagramEditor(id),
    }),
    [],
  );

  /* ---------- handlers СЃ РєСЌС€РµРј РїРѕ element.id ---------- */
  const handlersCacheRef = useRef<HandlerMap>({});

  const handlers = useMemo(() => {
    const cache = handlersCacheRef.current;
    const next: HandlerMap = {};

    const make = (el: CanvasElement): Omit<HandlerEntry, '__el' | '__isEditing' | '__isSelected'> => ({
      onSelect: (e?: any) => {
        const cur = editorRef.current;
        if (cur.fillMode) {
          if (el.type === 'shape' || el.type === 'fill') {
            cur.updateWithHistory(el.id, { fill: cur.fillColor });
          }
          return;
        }
        if (editing && editing.id !== el.id) cur.commitEdit();

        const shift = !!(e?.evt?.shiftKey || e?.evt?.metaKey || e?.evt?.ctrlKey);
        if (shift) {
          const ids = selectedIds.includes(el.id)
            ? selectedIds.filter((id) => id !== el.id)
            : [...selectedIds, el.id];
          cur.setSelectedIds(ids);
        } else if (!selectedIds.includes(el.id)) {
          cur.setSelectedIds([el.id]);
        }

        if (!editing || editing.id !== el.id) cur.setShowTextToolbar(false);

        const skipFloating = el.type === 'text' || el.type === 'footer';
        if (e?.evt && e.evt.button === 0 && !skipFloating) {
          cur.setFloatingPos({ x: e.evt.clientX, y: e.evt.clientY });
        } else if (skipFloating) {
          cur.setFloatingPos(null);
        }
      },
      onUpdate: (p: any) => editorRef.current.updateWithHistory(el.id, p),
      onDragStart: (e: any) => editorRef.current.handleElDragStart(el, e),
      onDragMove: (e: any) => editorRef.current.handleElDragMove(el, e),
      onDragEnd: (e: any) => editorRef.current.handleElDragEnd(el, e),
      onContextMenu: (e: any) => handleContextMenu(e, el.id),
      isSelected: selectedIds.includes(el.id),
    });

    for (const el of activeSlide.elements) {
      const isEditing = editing?.id === el.id;
      const isSelected = selectedIds.includes(el.id);
      const cached = cache[el.id];

      if (
        cached
        && cached.__el === el
        && cached.__isEditing === isEditing
        && cached.__isSelected === isSelected
      ) {
        next[el.id] = cached;
        continue;
      }

      next[el.id] = {
        ...make(el),
        __el: el,
        __isEditing: isEditing,
        __isSelected: isSelected,
      };
    }

    handlersCacheRef.current = next;
    return next;
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [activeSlide.elements, selectedIds, editing]);

  const handleStartDraft = (side: AnchorSide, e: any) => {
    const stage = e.target.getStage();
    if (!stage) return;
    const pos = stage.getPointerPosition();
    if (!pos) return;
    const el = activeSlide.elements.find((x) => x.id === editor.hoveredId);
    if (!el) return;
    editor.startConnectorDraft(el.id, side, pos.x / zoom, pos.y / zoom);
  };

  /* ---------- РџСЂРѕРёР·РІРѕРґРЅС‹Рµ ---------- */
  const draftPreview = editor.connectorDraft
    ? previewPoints(editor.connectorDraft, activeSlide.elements)
    : null;

  const hoveredElement = editor.hoveredId
    ? activeSlide.elements.find((e) => e.id === editor.hoveredId) || null
    : null;

  const draftTargetElement = editor.connectorDraft?.hoverTargetId
    ? activeSlide.elements.find((e) => e.id === editor.connectorDraft!.hoverTargetId) || null
    : null;

  const ghostRect = editor.connectorDraft
    ? ghostRectForDraft(editor.connectorDraft, activeSlide.elements)
    : null;

  return (
    <Stage
      ref={editor.stageRef as any}
      width={activeSlide.width * zoom}
      height={activeSlide.height * zoom}
      scaleX={zoom}
      scaleY={zoom}
      onMouseDown={handleStageMouseDown}
      onMouseMove={handleStageMouseMove}
      onMouseUp={handleStageMouseUp}
      onMouseLeave={handleStageMouseLeave}
      onDblClick={() => {
        if (editor.fillMode && editor.fillPoints.length >= 6) editor.closePolygon();
      }}
      onDblTap={() => {
        if (editor.fillMode && editor.fillPoints.length >= 6) editor.closePolygon();
      }}
      onContextMenu={(e) => handleContextMenu(e, null)}
    >
      {/* РЎР»РѕР№ 1: С„РѕРЅ */}
      <Layer listening={false}>
        <Rect
          x={0} y={0}
          width={activeSlide.width} height={activeSlide.height}
          fill={activeSlide.background}
          shadowColor="#000" shadowBlur={10} shadowOpacity={0.18} shadowOffsetY={2}
        />
        {activeSlide.backgroundImage && (
          <BgImage src={activeSlide.backgroundImage} w={activeSlide.width} h={activeSlide.height} />
        )}
        {editor.showGrid && <GridLayer w={activeSlide.width} h={activeSlide.height} />}
        {editor.showMargins && (
          <Rect
            x={activeSlide.padding.left} y={activeSlide.padding.top}
            width={Math.max(0, activeSlide.width - activeSlide.padding.left - activeSlide.padding.right)}
            height={Math.max(0, activeSlide.height - activeSlide.padding.top - activeSlide.padding.bottom)}
            stroke="#3b82f6" strokeWidth={1} dash={[6, 4]}
          />
        )}
        {editor.fillMode && editor.fillPoints.length >= 2 && (
          <KLine points={editor.fillPoints} stroke={editor.fillColor} strokeWidth={2} dash={[6, 4]} />
        )}
        {editor.fillMode && editor.fillPoints.map((_, i) => {
          if (i % 2 !== 0) return null;
          return (
            <Rect key={i} x={editor.fillPoints[i] - 3} y={editor.fillPoints[i + 1] - 3}
              width={6} height={6} fill="#6366f1" cornerRadius={3} />
          );
        })}
        {editor.rubberBand && (() => {
          const b = editor.rubberBand!;
          const x = Math.min(b.x1, b.x2);
          const y = Math.min(b.y1, b.y2);
          const w = Math.abs(b.x2 - b.x1);
          const h = Math.abs(b.y2 - b.y1);
          if (w < 2 && h < 2) return null;
          return (
            <Rect x={x} y={y} width={w} height={h}
              fill="rgba(99,102,241,0.12)" stroke="#6366f1" strokeWidth={1.5} dash={[6, 4]} />
          );
        })()}
      </Layer>

      {/* РЎР»РѕР№ 2: fills */}
      <Layer ref={fillsLayerRef}>
        {fillElements.map((el) => {
          const strategy = getStrategy('fill');
          if (!strategy) return null;
          const View = strategy.KonvaView;
          return (
            <View
              key={el.id}
              el={el}
              handlers={handlers[el.id]}
              elements={activeSlide.elements}
              editorCtx={editorCtx}
            />
          );
        })}
      </Layer>

      {/* РЎР»РѕР№ 3: РєРѕРЅРЅРµРєС‚РѕСЂС‹ */}
      <Layer>
        {connectorElements.map((el) => {
          const strategy = getStrategy('connector');
          if (!strategy) return null;
          const View = strategy.KonvaView;
          return (
            <View
              key={el.id}
              el={el}
              handlers={handlers[el.id]}
              elements={activeSlide.elements}
              editorCtx={editorCtx}
            />
          );
        })}
      </Layer>

      {/* РЎР»РѕР№ 4: СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚С‹ */}
      <Layer ref={editor.layerRef as any}>
        {regularElements.map((el) => {
          const strategy = getStrategy(el.type);
          if (!strategy) {
            console.warn('[EditorStage] no strategy for', el.type);
            return null;
          }
          const View = strategy.KonvaView;
          return (
            <View
              key={el.id}
              el={el}
              handlers={handlers[el.id]}
              elements={activeSlide.elements}
              editorCtx={editorCtx}
              isEditing={editing?.id === el.id}
            />
          );
        })}

        {editor.guides.v.map((x, i) => (
          <Rect key={`gv-${i}`} x={x} y={0} width={1} height={activeSlide.height}
            fill="#ef4444" opacity={0.7} listening={false} />
        ))}
        {editor.guides.h.map((y, i) => (
          <Rect key={`gh-${i}`} x={0} y={y} width={activeSlide.width} height={1}
            fill="#ef4444" opacity={0.7} listening={false} />
        ))}

        <Transformer
          ref={editor.trRef as any}
          rotateEnabled keepRatio={false}
          borderStroke="#f59e0b" anchorStroke="#f59e0b" anchorFill="#fbbf24"
          anchorSize={10} anchorCornerRadius={2}
          rotationSnaps={[0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, 90, 105, 120, 135, 150, 165, 180, 195, 210, 225, 240, 255, 270, 285, 300, 315, 330, 345]}
          rotationSnapTolerance={6}
          boundBoxFunc={(o, n) => (n.width < 20 || n.height < 20 ? o : n)}
        />
      </Layer>

      {/* РЎР»РѕР№ 5: anchor'С‹, РїСЂРµРІСЊСЋ */}
      <Layer>
        {!editor.connectorDraft && hoveredElement && !selectedIds.includes(hoveredElement.id) && (
          <AnchorOverlay element={hoveredElement} zoom={zoom} onStartDraft={handleStartDraft} />
        )}

        {draftPreview && (
          <KLine points={draftPreview} stroke="#6366f1" strokeWidth={2 / zoom}
            dash={[8 / zoom, 4 / zoom]} lineCap="round" listening={false} />
        )}

        {draftTargetElement && (
          <Rect
            x={draftTargetElement.x} y={draftTargetElement.y}
            width={draftTargetElement.width} height={draftTargetElement.height}
            stroke="#10b981" strokeWidth={2 / zoom} dash={[6 / zoom, 4 / zoom]}
            listening={false}
          />
        )}

        {ghostRect && (
          <Rect
            x={ghostRect.x} y={ghostRect.y}
            width={ghostRect.width} height={ghostRect.height}
            fill="rgba(238,242,255,0.55)" stroke="#6366f1"
            strokeWidth={2 / zoom} dash={[8 / zoom, 4 / zoom]}
            cornerRadius={8 / zoom} listening={false}
          />
        )}
      </Layer>
    </Stage>
  );
};

/* ---------- РљР°СЃС‚РѕРјРЅС‹Р№ compare вЂ” С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РїРѕР»СЏ, РІР»РёСЏСЋС‰РёРµ РЅР° СЂРµРЅРґРµСЂ ---------- */
const compareEditor = (prev: EditorApi, next: EditorApi): boolean => {
  return (
    prev.activeSlide === next.activeSlide &&
    prev.zoom === next.zoom &&
    prev.selectedIds === next.selectedIds &&
    prev.editing === next.editing &&
    prev.hoveredId === next.hoveredId &&
    prev.connectorDraft === next.connectorDraft &&
    prev.guides === next.guides &&
    prev.rubberBand === next.rubberBand &&
    prev.fillMode === next.fillMode &&
    prev.fillPoints === next.fillPoints &&
    prev.fillColor === next.fillColor &&
    prev.showGrid === next.showGrid &&
    prev.showMargins === next.showMargins &&
    prev.isDragging === next.isDragging
  );
};

export const EditorStage = React.memo(EditorStageInner, (prev, next) =>
  compareEditor(prev.editor, next.editor) && prev.wrapRef === next.wrapRef,
);

/* ---------- Р’РЅСѓС‚СЂРµРЅРЅРёРµ ---------- */

const BgImage: React.FC<{ src: string; w: number; h: number }> = ({ src, w, h }) => {
  const [img, setImg] = React.useState<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const i = new window.Image();
    i.src = src;
    i.onload = () => setImg(i);
  }, [src]);
  if (!img) return null;
  return <KImage x={0} y={0} width={w} height={h} image={img} listening={false} />;
};

const GridLayer: React.FC<{ w: number; h: number }> = React.memo(({ w, h }) => (
  <Shape
    listening={false}
    sceneFunc={(ctx, shape) => {
      const c = (ctx as any)._context as CanvasRenderingContext2D;
      c.beginPath();
      for (let x = 0; x <= w; x += GRID_SIZE) { c.moveTo(x, 0); c.lineTo(x, h); }
      for (let y = 0; y <= h; y += GRID_SIZE) { c.moveTo(0, y); c.lineTo(w, y); }
      c.strokeStyle = '#eef2f7';
      c.lineWidth = 1;
      c.stroke();
      ctx.strokeShape(shape);
    }}
  />
));
GridLayer.displayName = 'GridLayer';

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

const DRAWIO_URL = 'http://localhost:8080/?embed=1&proto=json&spin=1&ui=min&noSaveBtn=0&noExitBtn=0';

interface Props {
  initialXml?: string;
  onSave: (svg: string, xml: string) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export const DrawioModal: React.FC<Props> = ({ initialXml, onSave, onCancel }) => {
  const iframeRef = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement>(null);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const xmlRef = useRef<string>(initialXml || '');

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (evt: MessageEvent) => {
      if (evt.source !== iframeRef.current?.contentWindow) return;

      let msg: any;
      try {
        msg = typeof evt.data === 'string' ? JSON.parse(evt.data) : evt.data;
      } catch {
        return;
      }

      switch (msg.event) {
        case 'init':
          setReady(true);
          if (initialXml) {
            iframeRef.current?.contentWindow?.postMessage(
              JSON.stringify({ action: 'load', xml: initialXml, autosave: 1 }),
              '*',
            );
          }
          break;

        case 'save':
          xmlRef.current = msg.xml;
          iframeRef.current?.contentWindow?.postMessage(
            JSON.stringify({
              action: 'export',
              format: 'svg',
              xml: msg.xml,
              embedImages: true,
              border: 0,
            }),
            '*',
          );
          break;

        case 'export':
          if (msg.format === 'svg' && msg.data) {
            const svg = decodeURIComponent(msg.data);
            onSave(svg, xmlRef.current || msg.xml || '');
          }
          break;

        case 'exit':
          onCancel();
          break;
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('message', handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('message', handler);
  }, [initialXml, onSave, onCancel]);

  const handleSave = () => {
    iframeRef.current?.contentWindow?.postMessage(
      JSON.stringify({ action: 'save' }),
      '*',
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="rich-modal-backdrop" onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
      <div
        className="rich-modal"
        style={{ width: '92vw', height: '92vh', padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}
        onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, padding: '8px 12px', borderBottom: '1px solid #e5e7eb', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span style={{ flex: 1, fontWeight: 600 }}>Р РµРґР°РєС‚РѕСЂ РґРёР°РіСЂР°РјРј (draw.io)</span>
          <button className="stamp-btn primary" onClick={handleSave} disabled={!ready}>
            рџ’ѕ РЎРѕС…СЂР°РЅРёС‚СЊ
          </button>
          <button className="stamp-btn" onClick={onCancel}>РћС‚РјРµРЅР°</button>
        </div>

        <iframe
          ref={iframeRef}
          src={DRAWIO_URL}
          style={{ flex: 1, width: '100%', border: 'none' }}
          title="draw.io editor"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import { useActionsContext } from '../editor/contexts/ActionsContext';
import { useSelectionContext } from '../editor/contexts/SelectionContext';

export const EditorContextMenu: React.FC = () => {
  const modals = useModalsContext();
  const actions = useActionsContext();
  const selection = useSelectionContext();

  const items: ContextAction[] = useMemo(() => {
    const list: ContextAction[] = [];
    const sel = selection.selected;

    if (sel && sel.type === 'line') {
      list.push({
        label: 'вћ• Р”РѕР±Р°РІРёС‚СЊ РѕРїРѕСЂРЅСѓСЋ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ (РІ РєРѕРЅС†Рµ)',
        action: () => {
          const el = sel as any;
          const pts = el.points && el.points.length >= 4
            ? el.points
            : [0, el.height / 2, el.width, el.height / 2];
          const lastX = pts[pts.length - 2];
          const lastY = pts[pts.length - 1];
          const prevX = pts[pts.length - 4];
          const prevY = pts[pts.length - 3];
          actions.updateWithHistory(el.id, {
            points: [...pts, lastX + (lastX - prevX), lastY + (lastY - prevY)],
          });
        },
      });
      const pts = (sel as any).points || [];
      if (pts.length > 4) {
        list.push({
          label: 'вћ– РЈРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅСЋСЋ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ',
          action: () => {
            const el = sel as any;
            actions.updateWithHistory(el.id, {
              points: el.points.slice(0, el.points.length - 2),
            });
          },
        });
      }
    }

    list.push(
      { label: 'вњ‚ Р’С‹СЂРµР·Р°С‚СЊ', shortcut: 'Ctrl+X', action: actions.cut },
      { label: 'рџ“‹ РљРѕРїРёСЂРѕРІР°С‚СЊ', shortcut: 'Ctrl+C', action: actions.copy },
      { label: 'рџ“Њ Р’СЃС‚Р°РІРёС‚СЊ', shortcut: 'Ctrl+V', action: actions.paste },
      { label: 'рџ“„ Р”СѓР±Р»РёСЂРѕРІР°С‚СЊ', shortcut: 'Ctrl+D', action: actions.duplicate },
      { label: 'рџ–Њ РљРѕРїРёСЂРѕРІР°С‚СЊ СЃС‚РёР»СЊ', shortcut: 'Ctrl+Alt+C', action: actions.copyStyle },
      { label: 'рџ–Ќ РџСЂРёРјРµРЅРёС‚СЊ СЃС‚РёР»СЊ', shortcut: 'Ctrl+Alt+V', action: actions.applyStyle },
      { label: 'в¬† Р’РІРµСЂС… РЅР° СЃР»РѕР№', action: () => actions.moveLayer(1) },
      { label: 'в¬‡ Р’РЅРёР· РЅР° СЃР»РѕР№', action: () => actions.moveLayer(-1) },
      { label: 'рџ—‘ РЈРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ', shortcut: 'Delete', action: actions.removeSelected, danger: true },
    );

    return list;
  }, [selection.selected, actions]);

  if (!modals.contextMenu) return null;

  return (
    <ContextMenu
      x={modals.contextMenu.x}
      y={modals.contextMenu.y}
      actions={items}
      onClose={() => modals.setContextMenu(null)}
    />
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { StampEditor } from './stamps/StampEditor';
import { DrawioModal } from './diagram/DrawioModal';
import { useModalsContext } from '../editor/contexts/ModalsContext';
import { useSlidesContext } from '../editor/contexts/SlidesContext';

export const EditorModals: React.FC = () => {
  const modals = useModalsContext();
  const slides = useSlidesContext();

  return (
    <>
      {modals.stampEditorTarget && (() => {
        const el = slides.activeSlide.elements.find(
          (e) => e.id === modals.stampEditorTarget,
        );
        if (!el || el.type !== 'stamp') return null;
        const s = el as any;
        return (
          <StampEditor
            initialWidth={s.width}
            initialHeight={s.height}
            initialShapes={s.shapes || []}
            initialTexts={s.texts || []}
            initialImages={s.images || []}

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Group, Line, Text as KonvaText } from 'react-konva';
import type { ConnectorElement, CanvasElement } from '../../types';
import { DASH_MAP } from './dashMap';
import {
  routeConnector,
  midpointOfPath,
  resolveConnectorEnds,
} from '../../lib/connectors';
import type { CommonProps } from './types';

interface Props extends CommonProps {
  el: ConnectorElement;
  elements: CanvasElement[];
  onUpdate: (p: Partial<ConnectorElement>) => void;
}

const ConnectorElInner: React.FC<Props> = ({
  el, elements, onSelect, onUpdate, onContextMenu, isSelected,
}) => {
  const { from, to } = useMemo(
    () => resolveConnectorEnds(el, elements),
    [el.fromId, el.toId, elements],
  );

  const points = useMemo(() => {
    if (!from || !to) return null;
    return routeConnector(from, el.fromAnchor, to, el.toAnchor, el.routing);
  }, [
    from, to, el.routing, el.fromAnchor, el.toAnchor,
    from?.x, from?.y, from?.width, from?.height, from?.rotation,
    to?.x, to?.y, to?.width, to?.height, to?.rotation,
  ]);

  if (!points || !from || !to) return null;

  const dashArr = DASH_MAP[el.dash];

  const arrowHead = useMemo(() => {
    if (!el.isArrow) return null;
    const n = points.length;
    const x1 = points[n - 4], y1 = points[n - 3];
    const x2 = points[n - 2], y2 = points[n - 1];
    const angle = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
    const len = 12;
    const spread = 0.45;
    return [
      x2 + len * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI - spread),
      y2 + len * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI - spread),
      x2, y2,
      x2 + len * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI + spread),
      y2 + len * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI + spread),
    ];
  }, [el.isArrow, points]);

  const labelPos = useMemo(() => {
    if (!el.label) return null;
    const m = midpointOfPath(points);
    return {
      x: m.x + (el.labelOffsetX || 0),
      y: m.y + (el.labelOffsetY || 0),
    };
  }, [el.label, el.labelOffsetX, el.labelOffsetY, points]);

  const handleClick = (e: any) => {
    e.cancelBubble = true;
    onSelect(e);
  };

  return (
    <Group
      id={el.id}
      name="element"
      onMouseDown={handleClick}
      onTap={handleClick}
      onContextMenu={onContextMenu}
    >
      <Line
        points={points}
        stroke="rgba(0,0,0,0.001)"
        strokeWidth={14}
        lineCap="round"
        lineJoin="round"
        listening
      />
      <Line
        points={points}
        stroke={el.stroke}
        strokeWidth={el.strokeWidth}
        dash={dashArr}
        lineCap="round"
        lineJoin="round"
        listening={false}
      />
      {arrowHead && (
        <Line
          points={arrowHead}
          stroke={el.stroke}
          strokeWidth={el.strokeWidth}
          lineCap="round"
          lineJoin="round"
          listening={false}
        />
      )}
      {labelPos && el.label && (
        <KonvaText
          x={labelPos.x}
          y={labelPos.y}
          text={el.label}
          fontSize={el.labelFontSize || 12}
          fontFamily="Arial"
          fill={el.labelFill || el.stroke}
          offsetX={el.label.length * (el.labelFontSize || 12) * 0.3}
          offsetY={(el.labelFontSize || 12) / 2}
          listening={false}
        />
      )}
      {isSelected && (
        <>
          <Line
            points={[points[0], points[1], points[0], points[1]]}
            stroke="#fbbf24"
            strokeWidth={10}
            lineCap="round"
            listening={false}
          />
          <Line
            points={[points[points.length - 2], points[points.length - 1], points[points.length - 2], points[points.length - 1]]}
            stroke="#fbbf24"
            strokeWidth={10}
            lineCap="round"
            listening={false}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </Group>
  );
};

export const ConnectorEl = React.memo(ConnectorElInner, (prev, next) =>
  prev.el === next.el &&
  prev.elements === next.elements &&
  prev.isSelected === next.isSelected &&
  prev.onSelect === next.onSelect &&
  prev.onUpdate === next.onUpdate,
);

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Group, Rect, Image as KImage } from 'react-konva';
import type { DiagramElement } from '../../types';
import type { CommonProps } from './types';

interface Props extends CommonProps {
  el: DiagramElement;
  onUpdate: (p: Partial<DiagramElement>) => void;
  onDblClick: () => void;
}

const DiagramElInner: React.FC<Props> = ({
  el, onSelect, onUpdate, onDblClick,
  onDragStart, onDragMove, onDragEnd, onContextMenu, isSelected,
}) => {
  const [img, setImg] = useState<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!el.svg) { setImg(null); return; }
    const blob = new Blob([el.svg], { type: 'image/svg+xml' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const image = new window.Image();
    image.onload = () => { setImg(image); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); };
    image.onerror = () => { setImg(null); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); };
    image.src = url;
  }, [el.svg]);

  return (
    <Group
      id={el.id}
      name="element"
      x={el.x} y={el.y} rotation={el.rotation}
      draggable
      onMouseDown={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onSelect(e); }}
      onTap={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onSelect(e); }}
      onDblClick={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onDblClick(); }}
      onDblTap={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onDblClick(); }}
      onDragStart={onDragStart}
      onDragMove={onDragMove}
      onDragEnd={(e) => { onUpdate({ x: e.target.x(), y: e.target.y() }); onDragEnd?.(e); }}
      onContextMenu={onContextMenu}
      onTransformEnd={(e) => {
        const n = e.target;
        const sx = n.scaleX(); const sy = n.scaleY();
        n.scaleX(1); n.scaleY(1);
        onUpdate({
          x: n.x(), y: n.y(), rotation: n.rotation(),
          width: Math.max(40, el.width * sx),
          height: Math.max(40, el.height * sy),
        });
      }}
    >
      <Rect width={el.width} height={el.height} fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.001)" />
      {img
        ? <KImage x={0} y={0} width={el.width} height={el.height} image={img} listening={false} />
        : (
          <Rect
            width={el.width} height={el.height}
            fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" strokeWidth={1} dash={[6, 4]}
          />
        )}
      {isSelected && (
        <Rect
          width={el.width} height={el.height}
          stroke="#6366f1" strokeWidth={1.5} dash={[6, 4]} listening={false}
        />
      )}
    </Group>
  );
};

export const DiagramEl = React.memo(DiagramElInner, (prev, next) =>
  prev.el === next.el &&
  prev.isSelected === next.isSelected &&
  prev.onSelect === next.onSelect &&
  prev.onUpdate === next.onUpdate,
);

import React from 'react';
import { Group, Circle, Line } from 'react-konva';
import type { FillElement } from '../../types';
import type { CommonProps } from './types';

interface Props extends CommonProps {
  el: FillElement;
  onUpdate: (p: Partial<FillElement>) => void;
}

export const FillEl: React.FC<Props> = ({
  el, onSelect, onUpdate,
  onDragStart, onDragMove, onDragEnd, onContextMenu, isSelected,
}) => {
  const points = el.points || [];
  if (points.length < 6) return null;

  const updatePoint = (idx: number, x: number, y: number) => {
    const np = [...points];
    np[idx * 2] = x;
    np[idx * 2 + 1] = y;
    onUpdate({ points: np });
  };

  return (
    <Group
      id={el.id}
      name="element"
      x={el.x} y={el.y} rotation={el.rotation}
      draggable
      onMouseDown={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onSelect(e); }}
      onTap={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onSelect(e); }}
      onDragStart={onDragStart}
      onDragMove={onDragMove}
      onDragEnd={(e) => { onUpdate({ x: e.target.x(), y: e.target.y() }); onDragEnd?.(e); }}
      onContextMenu={onContextMenu}
    >
      <Line
        points={points}
        closed
        fill={el.fill}
        opacity={1}
        stroke={el.stroke || undefined}
        strokeWidth={el.strokeWidth || 0}
        listening={true}
      />

      {isSelected && points.map((_, i) => {
        if (i % 2 !== 0) return null;
        return (
          <Circle
            key={i}
            x={points[i]} y={points[i + 1]}
            radius={5}
            fill="#fbbf24"
            stroke="#f59e0b"
            strokeWidth={1.5}
            draggable
            onMouseDown={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; }}
            onDragMove={(e) => {
              e.cancelBubble = true;
              updatePoint(i / 2, e.target.x(), e.target.y());
            }}
            onDragEnd={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; }}
          />
        );
      })}
    </Group>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { Group } from 'react-konva';
import type { LineElement } from '../../types';
import type { CommonProps } from './types';
import { PolylineRenderer } from '../shapes/PolylineRenderer';
import { ensureMinimalPoints } from '../../lib/polyline';

interface Props extends CommonProps {
  el: LineElement;
  onUpdate: (p: Partial<LineElement>) => void;
  onDblClick?: (stageX: number, stageY: number) => void;
}

export const LineEl: React.FC<Props> = ({
  el, onSelect, onUpdate, onDblClick,
  onDragStart, onDragMove, onDragEnd, onContextMenu, isSelected,
}) => {
  const points = ensureMinimalPoints(el.points, el.width, el.height);

  const handleDblClick = (e: any) => {
    e.cancelBubble = true;
    if (!onDblClick) return;
    const stage = e.target.getStage();
    const p = stage?.getPointerPosition();
    if (!p || !stage) return;
    onDblClick(p.x / stage.scaleX(), p.y / stage.scaleY());
  };

  const handlePointMove = (index: number, x: number, y: number) => {
    const np = [...points];
    np[index * 2] = x;
    np[index * 2 + 1] = y;
    onUpdate({ points: np });
  };

  const handleTransformEnd = (e: any) => {
    const n = e.target;
    const sx = n.scaleX();
    const sy = n.scaleY();
    n.scaleX(1);
    n.scaleY(1);

    const scaledPoints = points.map((v, i) => (i % 2 === 0 ? v * sx : v * sy));

    let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < scaledPoints.length; i += 2) {
      const px = scaledPoints[i], py = scaledPoints[i + 1];
      if (px < minX) minX = px;
      if (py < minY) minY = py;
      if (px > maxX) maxX = px;
      if (py > maxY) maxY = py;
    }
    const newW = Math.max(10, maxX - minX);
    const newH = Math.max(10, maxY - minY);

    onUpdate({
      x: n.x(),
      y: n.y(),
      rotation: n.rotation(),
      width: newW,
      height: newH,
      points: scaledPoints,
    });
  };

  return (
    <Group
      id={el.id}
      name="element"
      x={el.x} y={el.y} rotation={el.rotation}
      draggable
      onMouseDown={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onSelect(e); }}
      onTap={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onSelect(e); }}
      onDragStart={onDragStart}
      onDragMove={onDragMove}
      onDragEnd={(e) => { onUpdate({ x: e.target.x(), y: e.target.y() }); onDragEnd?.(e); }}
      onContextMenu={onContextMenu}
      onDblClick={handleDblClick}
      onDblTap={handleDblClick}
      onTransformEnd={handleTransformEnd}
    >
      <PolylineRenderer
        points={points}
        stroke={el.stroke}
        strokeWidth={el.strokeWidth}
        dash={el.dash}
        isArrow={el.isArrow}
        isSelected={!!isSelected}
        onPointMove={handlePointMove}
      />
    </Group>
  );
};

            />
          )}

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Group, Rect, Text as KonvaText } from 'react-konva';
import type {
  RichTableData,
  RichTableCell,
  PositionedRun,
} from '../../lib/richText/types';
import {
  computeTableLayout,
  cellPad,
  measureTableHeight,
  lineWidth,
  CELL_BLOCK_MARGIN,
  MAX_NEST_DEPTH,
  type CellBlockItem,
} from './tableLayout';

export { measureTableHeight };

/* ============================================================
   РљРѕРјРїРѕРЅРµРЅС‚
   ============================================================ */

interface Props {
  data: RichTableData;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  fontFamily: string;
  fallbackFontSize: number;
  fallbackFill: string;
  lineHeightCoef?: number;
  depth?: number;
}

export const RichTable: React.FC<Props> = ({
  data, x, y, width, fontFamily, fallbackFontSize, fallbackFill,
  lineHeightCoef = 1.5,
  depth = 0,
}) => {
  const layout = useMemo(
    () => computeTableLayout(data, width, fallbackFontSize, lineHeightCoef, depth),
    [data, width, fallbackFontSize, lineHeightCoef, depth],
  );

  if (!data.cells.length) return null;

  const { colOffsets, rowOffsets, cellItems, totalWidth, totalHeight } = layout;

  return (
    <Group x={x} y={y} listening={false}>

      {data.cells.map((cell, i) => (
        <CellBackground
          key={`bg-${i}`}
          cell={cell}
          colOffsets={colOffsets}
          rowOffsets={rowOffsets}
        />
      ))}

      {data.cells.map((cell, i) => (
        <CellContent
          key={`ct-${i}`}
          cell={cell}
          items={cellItems.get(cell)}
          colOffsets={colOffsets}
          rowOffsets={rowOffsets}
          fontFamily={fontFamily}
          fallbackFontSize={fallbackFontSize}
          fallbackFill={fallbackFill}
          lineHeightCoef={lineHeightCoef}
          depth={depth}
        />
      ))}

      <Rect
        x={0} y={0}
        width={totalWidth} height={totalHeight}
        stroke="#94a3b8" strokeWidth={1}
        listening={false}
      />
    </Group>
  );
};

   Р¤РѕРЅ СЏС‡РµР№РєРё

const CellBackground: React.FC<{
  cell: RichTableCell;
  colOffsets: number[];
  rowOffsets: number[];
}> = ({ cell, colOffsets, rowOffsets }) => {
  const cx = colOffsets[cell.colIndex];
  const cy = rowOffsets[cell.rowIndex];
  const cw = colOffsets[Math.min(cell.colIndex + cell.colspan, colOffsets.length - 1)] - cx;
  const ch = rowOffsets[Math.min(cell.rowIndex + cell.rowspan, rowOffsets.length - 1)] - cy;

  const fill = cell.bgColor || (cell.isHeader ? '#f1f5f9' : '#ffffff');
  const borderColor = cell.borderColor || '#cbd5e1';
  const borderWidth = cell.borderWidth ?? 1;
  const dash =
    cell.borderStyle === 'dashed' ? [4, 4]
    : cell.borderStyle === 'dotted' ? [2, 3]
    : undefined;

  return (
    <Rect
      x={cx} y={cy}
      width={cw} height={ch}
      fill={fill}
      stroke={borderWidth > 0 ? borderColor : undefined}
      strokeWidth={borderWidth}
      dash={dash}
      listening={false}
    />
  );
};

   РЎРѕРґРµСЂР¶РёРјРѕРµ СЏС‡РµР№РєРё

interface CellContentProps {
  cell: RichTableCell;
  items: CellBlockItem[] | undefined;
  colOffsets: number[];
  rowOffsets: number[];
  fontFamily: string;
  fallbackFontSize: number;
  fallbackFill: string;
  lineHeightCoef: number;
  depth: number;
}

const CellContent: React.FC<CellContentProps> = ({
  cell, items, colOffsets, rowOffsets,
  fontFamily, fallbackFontSize, fallbackFill, lineHeightCoef, depth,
}) => {
  if (!items || !items.length) return null;

  const p = cellPad(cell);
  const cellLeft = colOffsets[cell.colIndex];
  const cellTop = rowOffsets[cell.rowIndex];
  const cellRight = colOffsets[Math.min(cell.colIndex + cell.colspan, colOffsets.length - 1)];
  const cellBottom = rowOffsets[Math.min(cell.rowIndex + cell.rowspan, rowOffsets.length - 1)];

  const innerLeft = cellLeft + p.left;
  const innerRight = cellRight - p.right;
  const innerTop = cellTop + p.top;
  const innerBottom = cellBottom - p.bottom;
  const innerWidth = Math.max(10, innerRight - innerLeft);
  const innerHeight = Math.max(10, innerBottom - innerTop);

  const totalContentHeight =
    items.reduce((sum, it) => sum + it.height, 0) +
    Math.max(0, items.length - 1) * CELL_BLOCK_MARGIN;

  const va = cell.verticalAlign ?? 'top';
  let topY: number;
  if (va === 'middle') {
    topY = innerTop + Math.max(0, (innerHeight - totalContentHeight) / 2);
  } else if (va === 'bottom') {
    topY = innerTop + Math.max(0, innerHeight - totalContentHeight);
  } else {
    topY = innerTop;
  }

  const align = cell.align ?? 'left';

  let cursorY = topY;

  return (
    <>
      {items.map((item, bi) => {
        const blockTop = cursorY;
        cursorY += item.height + CELL_BLOCK_MARGIN;

        if (item.kind === 'text') {
          return (
            <TextLayoutRuns
              key={`t-${bi}`}
              lines={item.layout.lines}
              innerLeft={innerLeft}
              innerWidth={innerWidth}
              y={blockTop}
              align={align}
              bold={cell.isHeader}
              fontFamily={fontFamily}
              fallbackFontSize={fallbackFontSize}
              fallbackFill={fallbackFill}
            />
          );
        }

        if (depth + 1 > MAX_NEST_DEPTH) return null;

        return (
          <RichTable
            key={`nt-${bi}`}
            data={item.data}
            x={innerLeft}
            y={blockTop}
            width={innerWidth}
            fontFamily={fontFamily}
            fallbackFontSize={fallbackFontSize}
            fallbackFill={fallbackFill}
            lineHeightCoef={lineHeightCoef}
            depth={depth + 1}
          />
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
};

/* ============================================================
   Р РµРЅРґРµСЂ С‚РµРєСЃС‚Р° СЃ СѓС‡С‘С‚РѕРј РІС‹С‡РёСЃР»РµРЅРЅС‹С… РєРѕРѕСЂРґРёРЅР°С‚ runs.

   Р’РђР–РќРћ: y = blockTop + run.y. run.y вЂ” top СЃС‚СЂРѕРєРё, РІС‹С‡РёСЃР»РµРЅРЅС‹Р№
   per-line РІ layoutRuns. Baseline-РєРѕСЂСЂРµРєС†РёСЏ Р±РѕР»СЊС€Рµ РЅРµ РЅСѓР¶РЅР°:
   Konva.Text СЂРёСЃСѓРµС‚ РѕС‚ top, Рё run.y СѓР¶Рµ СѓС‡РёС‚С‹РІР°РµС‚ РІС‹СЃРѕС‚Сѓ
   РєРѕРЅРєСЂРµС‚РЅРѕР№ СЃС‚СЂРѕРєРё (РјРѕР¶РµС‚ РѕС‚Р»РёС‡Р°С‚СЊСЃСЏ РґР»СЏ СЂР°Р·РЅС‹С… Р°Р±Р·Р°С†РµРІ).
   ============================================================ */

interface TextRunsProps {
  lines: PositionedRun[][];
  innerLeft: number;
  innerWidth: number;
  y: number;
  align: 'left' | 'center' | 'right' | 'justify';
  bold: boolean;
  fontFamily: string;
  fallbackFontSize: number;
  fallbackFill: string;
}

const TextLayoutRuns: React.FC<TextRunsProps> = ({
  lines, innerLeft, innerWidth, y, align,
  bold, fontFamily, fallbackFontSize, fallbackFill,
}) => (
  <>
    {lines.map((line, ri) => {
      const lw = lineWidth(line);
      let lineOffsetX = 0;
      if (align === 'center') {
        lineOffsetX = Math.max(0, (innerWidth - lw) / 2);
      } else if (align === 'right') {
        lineOffsetX = Math.max(0, innerWidth - lw);
      }

      return line.map((run, rj) => {
        const fs = run.actualFontSize || fallbackFontSize;
        const isBold = bold || run.bold;
        const fontStyle =
          isBold && run.italic ? 'italic bold'
          : isBold ? 'bold'
          : run.italic ? 'italic'
          : 'normal';
        const textDecoration =
          run.underline && run.strike ? 'underline line-through'
          : run.underline ? 'underline'
          : run.strike ? 'line-through'
          : '';

        return (
          <KonvaText
            key={`${ri}-${rj}`}
            x={innerLeft + lineOffsetX + run.x}
            y={y + run.y}
            text={run.text}
            fontSize={fs}
            fontFamily={run.fontFamily || fontFamily}
            fontStyle={fontStyle}
            textDecoration={textDecoration}
            fill={run.color || fallbackFill}
            listening={false}
          />
        );
      });
    })}
  </>
);

/* ============================================================
   Р Р°СЃС‡С‘С‚ РіРµРѕРјРµС‚СЂРёРё С‚Р°Р±Р»РёС†С‹. РўРѕР»СЊРєРѕ РјР°С‚РµРјР°С‚РёРєР° вЂ” РЅРёРєР°РєРѕРіРѕ React.

import type {
  RichTableData,
  RichTableCell,
  RichTableCellPadding,
  RichBlock,
} from '../../lib/richText/types';
import { layoutRuns } from '../../lib/richText/layout';

/* РЎРёРЅС…СЂРѕРЅРёР·РёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРѕ СЃ CSS `.rt-content .ProseMirror td/th { padding: 8px 10px }` */
export const CELL_PADDING_DEFAULT: RichTableCellPadding =
  { top: 8, right: 10, bottom: 8, left: 10 };

/* РўРµС…РЅРёС‡РµСЃРєРёР№ РјРёРЅРёРјСѓРј СЃС‚СЂРѕРєРё (РЅР° СЃР»СѓС‡Р°Р№ РїСѓСЃС‚РѕР№ С‚Р°Р±Р»РёС†С‹ СЃ 0 padding). */
const MIN_ROW_HEIGHT = 12;

/* РЎРёРЅС…СЂРѕРЅРёР·РёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРѕ СЃ CSS `.rt-content .ProseMirror p + p { margin-top: 8px }` */
export const CELL_BLOCK_MARGIN = 8;

export const MAX_NEST_DEPTH = 4;

export type CellBlockItem =
  | { kind: 'text'; layout: ReturnType<typeof layoutRuns>; height: number }
  | { kind: 'table'; data: RichTableData; height: number };

export interface TableLayout {
  colOffsets: number[];
  rowOffsets: number[];
  cellItems: Map<RichTableCell, CellBlockItem[]>;
  totalHeight: number;
  totalWidth: number;
}

export function cellPad(cell: RichTableCell): RichTableCellPadding {
  return cell.padding ?? CELL_PADDING_DEFAULT;
}

export function lineWidth(line: { width: number }[]): number {
  let w = 0;
  for (const r of line) w += r.width;
  return w;
}

export function computeTableLayout(
  data: RichTableData,
  width: number,
  fallbackFontSize: number,
  lineHeightCoef: number,
  depth: number,
): TableLayout {
  const { cells, rowCount, colCount } = data;

  const colPixelWidths = resolveColPixelWidths(data, width, colCount);
  const colOffsets = buildOffsets(colPixelWidths);

  const { cellItems, cellNaturalHeights } = measureCells(
    cells, colOffsets, colCount, fallbackFontSize, lineHeightCoef,
  );

  const rowHeights = resolveRowHeights(cells, rowCount, cellNaturalHeights);
  const rowOffsets = buildOffsets(rowHeights);

  return {
    colOffsets,
    rowOffsets,
    cellItems,
    totalHeight: rowOffsets[rowOffsets.length - 1] ?? 0,
    totalWidth: colOffsets[colOffsets.length - 1] ?? 0,
  };
}

export function measureTableHeight(
  data: RichTableData,
  width: number,
  fallbackFontSize: number,
  lineHeightCoef: number,
  depth = 0,
): number {
  if (!data.cells.length) return 0;
  return computeTableLayout(data, width, fallbackFontSize, lineHeightCoef, depth).totalHeight;
}

/* ============================================================
   Р’РЅСѓС‚СЂРµРЅРЅРµРµ
   ============================================================ */

/**
 * РџРѕРІС‚РѕСЂСЏРµРј РїРѕРІРµРґРµРЅРёРµ Р±СЂР°СѓР·РµСЂР° РІ `table-layout: fixed`:
 *   вЂў РєРѕР»РѕРЅРєРё СЃ СЏРІРЅРѕР№ С€РёСЂРёРЅРѕР№ (> 0) вЂ” С„РёРєСЃРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРЅС‹Рµ;
 *   вЂў РєРѕР»РѕРЅРєРё СЃ 0 (auto) вЂ” РґРµР»СЏС‚ РѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РѕРє РїРѕСЂРѕРІРЅСѓ РјРµР¶РґСѓ СЃРѕР±РѕР№.
 */
function resolveColPixelWidths(
  data: RichTableData,
  totalWidth: number,
  colCount: number,
): number[] {
  const { colWidths } = data;

  if (!colWidths || colWidths.length !== colCount) {
    return Array(colCount).fill(totalWidth / colCount);
  }

  const explicit = colWidths.map((w) => (typeof w === 'number' && w > 0 ? w : 0));
  const totalExplicit = explicit.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const autoCount = explicit.filter((w) => w === 0).length;

  if (totalExplicit === 0) {
    return Array(colCount).fill(totalWidth / colCount);
  }

  if (autoCount === 0) {
    /* Р’СЃРµ РєРѕР»РѕРЅРєРё С„РёРєСЃРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅС‹. Р•СЃР»Рё СЃСѓРјРјР°СЂРЅРѕ Р±РѕР»СЊС€Рµ С€РёСЂРёРЅС‹ вЂ” СѓР¶РјС‘Рј РїСЂРѕРїРѕСЂС†РёРѕРЅР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ. */
    return explicit.map((w) => (w / totalExplicit) * totalWidth);
  }

  const remaining = Math.max(0, totalWidth - totalExplicit);
  const autoWidth = remaining / autoCount;
  return explicit.map((w) => (w > 0 ? w : autoWidth));
}

function buildOffsets(widths: number[]): number[] {
  const offsets = [0];
  for (let i = 0; i < widths.length; i++) {
    offsets.push(offsets[i] + widths[i]);
  }
  return offsets;
}

function measureCells(
  cells: RichTableCell[],
  colOffsets: number[],
  colCount: number,
  fallbackFontSize: number,
  lineHeightCoef: number,
): {
  cellItems: Map<RichTableCell, CellBlockItem[]>;
  cellNaturalHeights: Map<RichTableCell, number>;
} {
  const cellItems = new Map<RichTableCell, CellBlockItem[]>();
  const cellNaturalHeights = new Map<RichTableCell, number>();

  for (const cell of cells) {
    const p = cellPad(cell);
    const cw = colOffsets[Math.min(cell.colIndex + cell.colspan, colCount)]
             - colOffsets[cell.colIndex];
    const innerW = Math.max(10, cw - p.left - p.right);

    const items = measureCellContent(cell, innerW, fallbackFontSize, lineHeightCoef);
    const contentHeight = items.reduce((sum, it) => sum + it.height, 0)
      + Math.max(0, items.length - 1) * CELL_BLOCK_MARGIN;

    /*
     * РџСѓСЃС‚Р°СЏ СЏС‡РµР№РєР° РІ Р±СЂР°СѓР·РµСЂРµ РІСЃС‘ СЂР°РІРЅРѕ СЃРѕРґРµСЂР¶РёС‚ РѕРґРёРЅ line-box вЂ”
     * `<p></p>` РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРё `<td>` Р·Р°РЅРёРјР°РµС‚ `fontSize * lineHeight`.
     * РЎРѕРІРїР°РґР°РµРј СЃ СЌС‚РёРј: РјРёРЅРёРјСѓРј РІС‹СЃРѕС‚С‹ = РѕРґРЅР° СЃС‚СЂРѕРєР° + padding.
     */
    const minCellHeight = fallbackFontSize * lineHeightCoef + p.top + p.bottom;

    cellItems.set(cell, items);
    cellNaturalHeights.set(
      cell,
      Math.max(MIN_ROW_HEIGHT, minCellHeight, contentHeight + p.top + p.bottom),
    );
  }

  return { cellItems, cellNaturalHeights };
}

function measureCellContent(
  cell: RichTableCell,
  innerWidth: number,
  fallbackFontSize: number,
  lineHeightCoef: number,
): CellBlockItem[] {
  const items: CellBlockItem[] = [];
  for (const block of cell.blocks as RichBlock[]) {
    if (block.kind === 'text') {
      const layout = layoutRuns(block.runs, innerWidth, lineHeightCoef);
      items.push({ kind: 'text', layout, height: layout.totalHeight });
    } else {
      const h = measureTableHeight(
        block.data, innerWidth, fallbackFontSize, lineHeightCoef, 1,
      );
      items.push({ kind: 'table', data: block.data, height: h });
    }
  }
  return items;
}

function resolveRowHeights(
  cells: RichTableCell[],
  rowCount: number,
  cellNaturalHeights: Map<RichTableCell, number>,
): number[] {
  const rowHeights: number[] = new Array(rowCount).fill(MIN_ROW_HEIGHT);

  for (const cell of cells) {
    if (cell.rowspan !== 1) continue;
    const h = cellNaturalHeights.get(cell) ?? 0;
    if (h > rowHeights[cell.rowIndex]) rowHeights[cell.rowIndex] = h;
  }

  for (let iter = 0; iter < 10; iter++) {
    let changed = false;
    for (const cell of cells) {
      if (cell.rowspan <= 1) continue;
      const need = cellNaturalHeights.get(cell) ?? 0;
      let have = 0;
      for (let r = cell.rowIndex; r < cell.rowIndex + cell.rowspan; r++) {
        have += rowHeights[r] ?? 0;
      }
      if (have + 0.5 < need) {
        const delta = (need - have) / cell.rowspan;
        for (let r = cell.rowIndex; r < cell.rowIndex + cell.rowspan; r++) {
          rowHeights[r] = (rowHeights[r] ?? 0) + delta;
        }
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (!changed) break;
  }

  return rowHeights;
}

import React, { useMemo, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

const BLOCK_MARGIN = 0;

interface Props extends CommonProps {
  el: TextElement;

  isEditing?: boolean;

type PreparedBlock =
  | { kind: 'text'; layout: ReturnType<typeof layoutRuns>; height: number }
  | { kind: 'table'; data: RichTableData; height: number };

/* Р–С‘СЃС‚РєРѕ С„РёРєСЃРёСЂСѓРµС‚ bbox Konva.Group СЂР°РІРЅС‹Рј el.width Г— el.height.
   Р‘РµР· СЌС‚РѕРіРѕ Transformer РЅРµ РґР°С‘С‚ СѓРјРµРЅСЊС€РёС‚СЊ РѕР±Р»Р°СЃС‚СЊ: bbox РіСЂСѓРїРїС‹
   СЃС‡РёС‚Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ РєР°Рє РѕР±СЉРµРґРёРЅРµРЅРёРµ bbox'РѕРІ РґРµС‚РµР№, Рё РІС‹СЃРѕС‚Р° В«РїСЂРёР»РёРїР°РµС‚В»
   Рє РІС‹СЃРѕС‚Рµ РєРѕРЅС‚РµРЅС‚Р°. */
function useFixedBBox(
  groupRef: React.RefObject<Konva.Group>,
  width: number,
  height: number,
) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const node = groupRef.current;
    if (!node) return;
    const fixed = () => ({ x: 0, y: 0, width, height });
    (node as any).getClientRect = fixed;
    (node as any).getSelfRect = fixed;
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [width, height]);
}

                    : isPlaceholder ? 'italic'

      <button style={{ margin: 0 }} onClick={() => onChange(0)}>0В°</button>

const StampZoneEditor: React.FC<{
  label: string;
  prefix: 'top' | 'center' | 'bottom';
  text: string;
  fontSize: number;
  fontFamily: string;
  fontStyle: string;
  textDecoration: string;
  color: string;
  fallbackColor: string;
  onChange: (patch: Record<string, any>) => void;
}> = ({
  label, prefix, text, fontSize, fontFamily, fontStyle, textDecoration, color, fallbackColor, onChange,
}) => {
  const hasBold = (fontStyle || '').includes('bold');
  const hasItalic = (fontStyle || '').includes('italic');
  const hasUnderline = (textDecoration || '').includes('underline');

  const toggleStyle = (flag: 'bold' | 'italic') => {
    const parts = (fontStyle || '').split(' ').filter(Boolean);
    const has = parts.includes(flag);
    const next = has ? parts.filter((p) => p !== flag) : [...parts, flag];
    onChange({ [`${prefix}FontStyle`]: next.join(' ') || 'normal' });
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 8, padding: 8, border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 6 }}>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: '#374151', marginBottom: 6 }}>{label}</div>

      <label>РўРµРєСЃС‚
        <input value={text} onChange={(e) => onChange({ [`${prefix}Text`]: e.target.value })} />
      </label>

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 6 }}>
        <label>Р Р°Р·РјРµСЂ
          <input type="number" min="6" max="200" value={fontSize}
            onChange={(e) => onChange({ [`${prefix}FontSize`]: +e.target.value })} />
        </label>
        <label>РЁСЂРёС„С‚
          <select value={fontFamily} onChange={(e) => onChange({ [`${prefix}FontFamily`]: e.target.value })}>
            <option value="Arial">Arial</option>
            <option value="Times New Roman">Times New Roman</option>
            <option value="Courier New">Courier New</option>
            <option value="Georgia">Georgia</option>
            <option value="Verdana">Verdana</option>
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, marginTop: 6 }}>
        <button type="button" className={hasBold ? 'active' : ''} style={{ flex: 1, fontWeight: 700 }}
          onClick={() => toggleStyle('bold')}>B</button>
        <button type="button" className={hasItalic ? 'active' : ''} style={{ flex: 1, fontStyle: 'italic' }}
          onClick={() => toggleStyle('italic')}>I</button>
        <button type="button" className={hasUnderline ? 'active' : ''} style={{ flex: 1, textDecoration: 'underline' }}
          onClick={() => onChange({ [`${prefix}TextDecoration`]: hasUnderline ? '' : 'underline' })}>U</button>
      </div>

      <label>Р¦РІРµС‚ С‚РµРєСЃС‚Р°
        <input type="color" value={color || fallbackColor}
          onChange={(e) => onChange({ [`${prefix}Color`]: e.target.value })} />
      </label>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { DataPanel } from '../../DataPanel';
import { PropertiesPanel } from './PropertiesPanel';
import { useSelectionContext } from '../../editor/contexts/SelectionContext';

type TabKey = 'data' | 'props';

export const RightPanel: React.FC = () => {
  const selection = useSelectionContext();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<TabKey>('data');

  return (
    <aside className="right-panel">
      <div className="rp-tabs">
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`rp-tab ${tab === 'data' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setTab('data')}
        >
          рџ“Љ Р”Р°РЅРЅС‹Рµ
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`rp-tab ${tab === 'props' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setTab('props')}
        >
          вљ™пёЏ РЎРІРѕР№СЃС‚РІР°
          {selection.selectedIds.length > 0 && (
            <span className="rp-tab-badge">{selection.selectedIds.length}</span>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="rp-body">
        {tab === 'data' && <DataPanel />}
        {tab === 'props' && <PropertiesPanel />}
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { useSlidesContext } from '../../editor/contexts/SlidesContext';
import { useSelectionContext } from '../../editor/contexts/SelectionContext';
import { useViewContext } from '../../editor/contexts/ViewContext';
import { SlideThumb } from '../../SlideThumb';

const SlidesBarInner: React.FC = () => {
  const slides = useSlidesContext();
  const selection = useSelectionContext();
  const view = useViewContext();

  return (
    <footer className="slides">
      {slides.slides.map((s, i) => (
        <SlideThumb
          key={s.id}
          slide={s}
          index={i}
          active={s.id === slides.activeId}
          onClick={() => {
            slides.setActiveId(s.id);
            selection.clearSelection();
            view.setGuides({ v: [], h: [] });
          }}
          onDelete={() => slides.removeSlide(s.id)}
        />
      ))}
      <button className="add-slide" onClick={slides.addSlide}>
        + РЎР»Р°Р№Рґ
      </button>
    </footer>
  );
};

export const SlidesBar = React.memo(SlidesBarInner);

import React from 'react';

interface Props {
  title: string;
  colors: string[];
  onPick: (color: string) => void;
  onReset?: () => void;
  resetLabel?: string;
}

  title, colors, onPick, onReset, resetLabel = 'РЎР±СЂРѕСЃРёС‚СЊ',

    <div className="rt-popover-title">{title}</div>

        <button
          key={c}
          type="button"
          className="rt-color-cell"

    {onReset && (

import { Extension } from '@tiptap/core';
import TableCell from '@tiptap/extension-table-cell';
import TableHeader from '@tiptap/extension-table-header';

/* ---------- FontSize ---------- */
export const FontSize = Extension.create({
  name: 'fontSize',
  addOptions() {
    return { types: ['textStyle'] };
  },
  addGlobalAttributes() {
    return [{
      types: this.options.types,
      attributes: {
        fontSize: {
          default: null,
          parseHTML: (el) => el.style.fontSize?.replace(/['"]+/g, '') || null,
          renderHTML: (attrs) =>
            attrs.fontSize ? { style: `font-size: ${attrs.fontSize}` } : {},
        },
      },
    }];
  },
  addCommands() {
    return {
      setFontSize: (fontSize: string) => ({ chain }: any) =>
        chain().setMark('textStyle', { fontSize }).run(),
      unsetFontSize: () => ({ chain }: any) =>
        chain().setMark('textStyle', { fontSize: null }).removeEmptyTextStyle().run(),
    } as any;
  },
});

/* ---------- РђС‚СЂРёР±СѓС‚С‹ СЏС‡РµРµРє С‚Р°Р±Р»РёС†С‹ ---------- */
const CELL_ATTRIBUTES = {
  bgColor: {
    default: null,
    parseHTML: (el: HTMLElement) => el.style.backgroundColor || null,
    renderHTML: (attrs: any) =>
      attrs.bgColor ? { style: `background-color: ${attrs.bgColor}` } : {},
  },
  borderColor: {
    default: null,
    parseHTML: (el: HTMLElement) => el.style.borderColor || null,
    renderHTML: (attrs: any) =>
      attrs.borderColor ? { style: `border-color: ${attrs.borderColor}` } : {},
  },
  borderWidth: {
    default: null,
    parseHTML: (el: HTMLElement) => el.style.borderWidth || null,
    renderHTML: (attrs: any) =>
      attrs.borderWidth ? { style: `border-width: ${attrs.borderWidth}` } : {},
  },
  borderStyle: {
    default: null,
    parseHTML: (el: HTMLElement) => el.style.borderStyle || null,
    renderHTML: (attrs: any) =>
      attrs.borderStyle ? { style: `border-style: ${attrs.borderStyle}` } : {},
  },
  cellPadding: {
    default: null,
    parseHTML: (el: HTMLElement) => el.style.padding || null,
    renderHTML: (attrs: any) =>
      attrs.cellPadding ? { style: `padding: ${attrs.cellPadding}` } : {},
  },
};

export const CustomTableCell = TableCell.extend({
  addAttributes() {
    return { ...this.parent?.(), ...CELL_ATTRIBUTES };
  },
});

export const CustomTableHeader = TableHeader.extend({
  addAttributes() {
    return { ...this.parent?.(), ...CELL_ATTRIBUTES };
  },
});

import StarterKit from '@tiptap/starter-kit';
import Underline from '@tiptap/extension-underline';
import { TextStyle } from '@tiptap/extension-text-style';
import { Color } from '@tiptap/extension-color';
import { FontFamily } from '@tiptap/extension-font-family';
import TextAlign from '@tiptap/extension-text-align';
import Link from '@tiptap/extension-link';
import Highlight from '@tiptap/extension-highlight';
import Table from '@tiptap/extension-table';
import TableRow from '@tiptap/extension-table-row';

export function buildEditorExtensions(align: string) {
  return [
    StarterKit.configure({ heading: { levels: [1, 2, 3] } }),
    Underline,
    TextStyle,
    Color,
    FontFamily,
    FontSize,
    Highlight.configure({ multicolor: true }),
    TextAlign.configure({
      types: ['heading', 'paragraph'],
      defaultAlignment: (align as any) || 'left',
    }),
    Link.configure({ openOnClick: false, autolink: true }),
    Table.configure({ resizable: true }),
    TableRow,
    CustomTableHeader,
    CustomTableCell,
  ];
}

import React from 'react';
import { Line, Circle } from 'react-konva';
import { DASH_MAP } from '../elements/dashMap';
import type { DashType } from '../../types';

export interface PolylineRendererProps {
  /** РџР»РѕСЃРєРёР№ РјР°СЃСЃРёРІ [x1, y1, x2, y2, ...] РІ Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅРѕР№ СЃРёСЃС‚РµРјРµ СЂРѕРґРёС‚РµР»СЏ. */
  points: number[];
  stroke: string;
  strokeWidth: number;
  dash?: DashType;
  isArrow?: boolean;
  /** РџРѕРєР°Р·С‹РІР°С‚СЊ РјР°СЂРєРµСЂС‹ С‚РѕС‡РµРє. РћР±С‹С‡РЅРѕ true РґР»СЏ РІС‹РґРµР»РµРЅРЅРѕР№ Р»РёРЅРёРё. */
  isSelected?: boolean;
  /** РўРѕР»С‰РёРЅР° РЅРµРІРёРґРёРјРѕР№ В«РіРѕСЂСЏС‡РµР№В» Р·РѕРЅС‹ РґР»СЏ Р»РѕРІР»Рё РєР»РёРєРѕРІ. */
  hitStrokeWidth?: number;
  /** Р Р°РґРёСѓСЃ РјР°СЂРєРµСЂРѕРІ. */
  handleRadius?: number;
  /** Р’С‹Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РїСЂРё РїРµСЂРµС‚Р°СЃРєРёРІР°РЅРёРё РјР°СЂРєРµСЂР° (РєР°Р¶РґРѕРµ РґРІРёР¶РµРЅРёРµ). */
  onPointMove?: (index: number, x: number, y: number) => void;
  /** Р’С‹Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РїРѕ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РµРЅРёРё РїРµСЂРµС‚Р°СЃРєРёРІР°РЅРёСЏ РјР°СЂРєРµСЂР°. */
  onPointMoveEnd?: (index: number, x: number, y: number) => void;
  /** Р’С‹Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РїСЂРё РїСЂР°РІРѕРј РєР»РёРєРµ РїРѕ РјР°СЂРєРµСЂСѓ вЂ” РґР»СЏ СѓРґР°Р»РµРЅРёСЏ С‚РѕС‡РєРё. */
  onPointContextMenu?: (index: number, e: any) => void;
}

export const PolylineRenderer: React.FC<PolylineRendererProps> = ({
  points,
  stroke,
  strokeWidth,
  dash = 'solid',
  isArrow = false,
  isSelected = false,
  hitStrokeWidth = 20,
  handleRadius = 6,
  onPointMove,
  onPointMoveEnd,
  onPointContextMenu,
}) => {
  if (!points || points.length < 4) return null;

  const dashArr = DASH_MAP[dash];

  /* РЎС‚СЂРµР»РєР° РЅР° РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅРµРј СЃРµРіРјРµРЅС‚Рµ */
  const arrowNode = (() => {
    if (!isArrow || points.length < 4) return null;
    const n = points.length;
    const x1 = points[n - 4], y1 = points[n - 3];
    const x2 = points[n - 2], y2 = points[n - 1];
    const angle = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
    const len = 14;
    const a1 = angle + Math.PI - 0.35;
    const a2 = angle + Math.PI + 0.35;
    return (
      <Line
        points={[
          x2 + len * Math.cos(a1), y2 + len * Math.sin(a1),
          x2, y2,
          x2 + len * Math.cos(a2), y2 + len * Math.sin(a2),
        ]}
        stroke={stroke}
        strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
        lineCap="round"
        lineJoin="round"
        listening={false}
      />
    );
  })();

  const pointCount = points.length / 2;

  return (
    <>
      {/* РќРµРІРёРґРёРјР°СЏ Р¶РёСЂРЅР°СЏ Р»РёРЅРёСЏ вЂ” РґР»СЏ Р·Р°С…РІР°С‚Р° РєР»РёРєРѕРІ Рё drag */}
      <Line
        points={points}
        stroke="rgba(0,0,0,0.001)"
        strokeWidth={hitStrokeWidth}
        lineCap="round"
        lineJoin="round"
        listening={true}
      />

      {/* Р’РёРґРёРјР°СЏ Р»РёРЅРёСЏ */}
      <Line
        points={points}
        stroke={stroke}
        strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
        dash={dashArr}
        lineCap="round"
        lineJoin="round"
        listening={false}
      />

      {arrowNode}

      {/* РњР°СЂРєРµСЂС‹ С‚РѕС‡РµРє */}
      {isSelected && Array.from({ length: pointCount }).map((_, i) => {
        const px = points[i * 2];
        const py = points[i * 2 + 1];
        return (
          <Circle
            key={i}
            x={px}
            y={py}
            radius={handleRadius}
            fill="#fbbf24"
            stroke="#f59e0b"
            strokeWidth={1.5}
            draggable
            onMouseDown={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; }}
            onDragMove={(e) => {
              e.cancelBubble = true;
              onPointMove?.(i, e.target.x(), e.target.y());
            }}
            onDragEnd={(e) => {
              e.cancelBubble = true;
              onPointMoveEnd?.(i, e.target.x(), e.target.y());
            }}
            onContextMenu={(e) => {
              if (!onPointContextMenu) return;
              e.evt.preventDefault();
              e.cancelBubble = true;
              onPointContextMenu(i, e);
            }}
          />
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Image as KImage } from 'react-konva';
import type { StampShapeItem } from '../../../types';
import type { FillSpec } from '../../../lib/stamps/rasterFill';
import { useFillWorker } from '../../../hooks/useFillWorker';

interface Props {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  enabled?: boolean;
}

function anchorToWorld(
  target: StampShapeItem,
  local: { x: number; y: number },
): { x: number; y: number } {
  const lx = target.x + local.x * target.width;
  const ly = target.y + local.y * target.height;
  const cx = target.x + target.width / 2;
  const cy = target.y + target.height / 2;
  const rot = ((target.rotation || 0) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dx = lx - cx;
  const dy = ly - cy;
  return {
    x: cx + dx * Math.cos(rot) - dy * Math.sin(rot),
    y: cy + dx * Math.sin(rot) + dy * Math.cos(rot),
  };
}

export const CompositeFillLayer: React.FC<Props> = ({
  width,
  height,
  shapes,
  enabled = true,
}) => {
  const { result, rasterize } = useFillWorker();
  const [img, setImg] = useState<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);
  const debounceRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const fills: FillSpec[] = useMemo(() => {
    const out: FillSpec[] = [];
    for (const s of shapes) {
      if (s.kind !== 'fill') continue;
      if (s.hidden) continue;
      if (!s.fillTargetShapeId) continue;

      const target = shapes.find((t) => t.id === s.fillTargetShapeId);
      if (!target) continue;

      const local = s.fillAnchorLocal ?? { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 };
      const { x, y } = anchorToWorld(target, local);

      out.push({
        px: x,
        py: y,
        color: s.fill || '#fbbf24',
        target,
      });
    }
    return out;
  }, [shapes]);

  const signature = useMemo(() => {
    const geo = shapes
      .filter((s) => s.kind !== 'fill' && !s.hidden)
      .map(
        (s) =>
          `${s.kind}:${Math.round(s.x)}|${Math.round(s.y)}|${Math.round(s.width)}|${Math.round(s.height)}|${Math.round(s.rotation || 0)}|${(s.points || []).map((v) => Math.round(v)).join(',')}|${s.strokeWidth}`,
      )
      .join('||');
    const f = fills
      .map((x) => `${Math.round(x.px)},${Math.round(x.py)},${x.color},${x.target?.id ?? '-'}`)
      .join(';');
    return geo + '###' + f;
  }, [shapes, fills]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled || !fills.length) {
      setImg(null);
      return;
    }
    if (debounceRef.current) window.clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);

    debounceRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      rasterize(signature, width, height, shapes, fills);
    }, 80);

    return () => {
      if (debounceRef.current) window.clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    };
  }, [signature, width, height, enabled, fills, shapes, rasterize]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!result || result.key !== signature) return;
    if (!result.url) { setImg(null); return; }
    const next = new window.Image();
    next.onload = () => setImg(next);
    next.onerror = () => setImg(null);
    next.src = result.url;
  }, [result, signature]);

  if (!img) return null;

  return (
    <KImage
      x={0}
      y={0}
      width={width}
      height={height}
      image={img}
      listening={false}
    />
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { Layer, Rect, Line, Shape } from 'react-konva';
import { GRID_SIZE } from '../../../types';

interface Props {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  zoom: number;
  showGrid: boolean;
}

export const StampBackgroundLayer: React.FC<Props> = ({
  width, height, zoom, showGrid,
}) => (
  <Layer>
    <Rect
      x={0} y={0} width={width} height={height}
      fill="#ffffff"
      shadowColor="#000" shadowBlur={14} shadowOpacity={0.12}
      listening={false}
    />

    {showGrid && (
      <Shape listening={false} sceneFunc={(ctx) => {
        const c = (ctx as any)._context as CanvasRenderingContext2D;
        c.beginPath();
        for (let x = 0; x <= width; x += GRID_SIZE) { c.moveTo(x, 0); c.lineTo(x, height); }
        for (let y = 0; y <= height; y += GRID_SIZE) { c.moveTo(0, y); c.lineTo(width, y); }
        c.strokeStyle = '#eef2f7';
        c.lineWidth = 1 / zoom;
        c.stroke();
      }} />
    )}

    <Line
      points={[width / 2, 0, width / 2, height]}
      stroke="#dbeafe" strokeWidth={1 / zoom}
      dash={[4 / zoom, 4 / zoom]} listening={false}
    />
    <Line
      points={[0, height / 2, width, height / 2]}
      stroke="#dbeafe" strokeWidth={1 / zoom}
      dash={[4 / zoom, 4 / zoom]} listening={false}
    />

    <Rect
      x={0} y={0} width={width} height={height}
      stroke="#cbd5e1" strokeWidth={1 / zoom} listening={false}
    />
  </Layer>
);

import React from 'react';
import { Layer, Image as KImage } from 'react-konva';
import type Konva from 'konva';
import type { StampShapeItem, StampTextItem, StampImageItem } from '../../../types';
import { StampShapeView } from '../StampShapeView';
import { StampStraightTextView } from '../StampStraightTextView';
import { StampArcTextView } from '../StampArcTextView';
import { StampTransformer } from './StampTransformer';
import { CompositeFillLayer } from './CompositeFillLayer';

type SelectionType = 'shape' | 'text' | 'image' | null;

interface Props {
  layerRef: React.RefObject<Konva.Layer>;
  trRef: React.RefObject<Konva.Transformer>;

  stampW: number;
  stampH: number;

  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  texts: StampTextItem[];
  images: StampImageItem[];
  imageCache: Record<string, HTMLImageElement>;

  selectedId: string | null;
  selectedType: SelectionType;
  selectedShape: StampShapeItem | null;

  snap: boolean;
  listening?: boolean;

  onSelect: (id: string, type: Exclude<SelectionType, null>) => void;
  onShapeDragEnd: (id: string, e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<DragEvent>) => void;
  onTextDragEnd: (id: string, e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<DragEvent>, text: StampTextItem) => void;
  onImageDragEnd: (id: string, e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<DragEvent>, image: StampImageItem) => void;
  onTransformEnd: (e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<Event>) => void;
  onOpenTextEditor: (id: string) => void;
  onUpdateText: (id: string, patch: Partial<StampTextItem>) => void;
  /** РР·РјРµРЅРµРЅРёРµ С‚РѕС‡РµРє Р»РёРЅРёРё РёР· РІСЊСЋ. */
  onPointsChange?: (id: string, points: number[]) => void;
}

export const StampElementsLayer: React.FC<Props> = ({
  layerRef, trRef,
  stampW, stampH,
  shapes, texts, images, imageCache,
  selectedId, selectedType, selectedShape,
  snap, listening = true,
  onSelect, onShapeDragEnd, onTextDragEnd, onImageDragEnd,
  onTransformEnd, onOpenTextEditor, onUpdateText,
  onPointsChange,
}) => {
  const regularShapes = React.useMemo(
    () => shapes.filter((s) => s.kind !== 'fill'),
    [shapes],
  );

  const legacyFills = React.useMemo(
    () => shapes.filter((s) => s.kind === 'fill' && !s.fillTargetShapeId),
    [shapes],
  );

  return (
    <Layer ref={layerRef as any} listening={listening}>
      {/* 1. РљРѕРјРїРѕР·РёС‚ anchor-Р·Р°Р»РёРІРѕРє вЂ” РІ СЃР°РјРѕРј РЅРёР·Сѓ */}
      <CompositeFillLayer
        width={stampW}
        height={stampH}
        shapes={shapes}
      />

      {/* 2. Legacy path-fill'С‹ */}
      {legacyFills.map((s) =>
        s.hidden ? null : (
          <StampShapeView
            key={s.id}
            shape={s}
            allShapes={shapes}
            draggable={false}
            onSelect={() => onSelect(s.id, 'shape')}
            onDragEnd={() => { /* legacy: noop */ }}
          />
        )
      )}

      {/* 3. РћР±С‹С‡РЅС‹Рµ С„РёРіСѓСЂС‹ */}
      {regularShapes.map((s) =>
        s.hidden ? null : (
          <StampShapeView
            key={s.id}
            shape={s}
            allShapes={shapes}
            draggable={!s.locked}
            isSelected={selectedId === s.id && selectedType === 'shape'}
            onSelect={() => onSelect(s.id, 'shape')}
            onDragEnd={(e) => onShapeDragEnd(s.id, e)}
            onPointsChange={
              onPointsChange
                ? (points) => onPointsChange(s.id, points)
                : undefined
            }
          />
        )
      )}

      {/* 4. РР·РѕР±СЂР°Р¶РµРЅРёСЏ */}
      {images.map((im) => {
        if (im.hidden) return null;
        const img = imageCache[im.src];
        if (!img) return null;
        return (
          <KImage
            key={im.id}
            id={im.id}
            name="image"
            x={im.x} y={im.y}
            width={im.width} height={im.height}
            image={img}
            draggable={!im.locked}
            onClick={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onSelect(im.id, 'image'); }}
            onTap={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onSelect(im.id, 'image'); }}
            onDragEnd={(e) => onImageDragEnd(im.id, e, im)}
          />
        );
      })}

      {/* 5. РўРµРєСЃС‚С‹ */}
      {texts.map((t) => t.hidden ? null : t.mode === 'straight' ? (
        <StampStraightTextView
          key={t.id}
          text={t}
          draggable={!t.locked}
          onSelect={() => onSelect(t.id, 'text')}
          onDblClick={() => { onSelect(t.id, 'text'); onOpenTextEditor(t.id); }}
          onDragEnd={(e) => onTextDragEnd(t.id, e, t)}
        />
      ) : (
        <StampArcTextView
          key={t.id}
          text={t}
          shapes={shapes}
          snapEnabled={snap}
          draggable={!t.locked}
          onSelect={() => onSelect(t.id, 'text')}
          onDblClick={() => { onSelect(t.id, 'text'); onOpenTextEditor(t.id); }}
          onUpdate={(patch) => onUpdateText(t.id, patch)}
        />
      ))}

      {/* 6. Transformer */}
      {listening && (
        <StampTransformer
          trRef={trRef}
          selectedShape={selectedShape}
          onTransformEnd={onTransformEnd}
        />
      )}
    </Layer>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { Transformer } from 'react-konva';
import type Konva from 'konva';
import type { StampShapeItem } from '../../../types';

interface Props {
  trRef: React.RefObject<Konva.Transformer>;
  selectedShape: StampShapeItem | null;
  onTransformEnd: (e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<Event>) => void;

export const StampTransformer: React.FC<Props> = ({
  trRef, selectedShape, onTransformEnd,
