import React from 'react';
import type { StampTextItem } from '../../../types';
import { arcTextBBox } from '../../../lib/stamps/geometry';

interface Props {
  text: StampTextItem;
  zoom: number;
  pan: { x: number; y: number };
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const StampInlineTextEditor: React.FC<Props> = ({
  text, zoom, pan, onChange, onClose,
}) => {
  let left = 0, top = 0, width = 200, height = 30;

  if (text.mode === 'straight') {
    left = text.x * zoom + pan.x;
    top = text.y * zoom + pan.y;
    width = Math.max(80, text.width * zoom);
    height = Math.max(20, text.fontSize * 1.5 * zoom);
  } else {
    /* Р”Р»СЏ СЌР»Р»РёРїС‚РёС‡РµСЃРєРѕР№ РґСѓРіРё РёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµРј Р°РєС‚СѓР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Рµ rx/ry */
    const rx = text.arcRx ?? text.arcRadius;
    const ry = text.arcRy ?? text.arcRadius;

    const bb = arcTextBBox({
      text: text.text,
      arcCx: text.arcCx, arcCy: text.arcCy,
      arcRadius: text.arcRadius,
      arcRx: rx, arcRy: ry,
      arcStartDeg: text.arcStartDeg, arcEndDeg: text.arcEndDeg,
      fontSize: text.fontSize,
    });
    const cx = bb.x + bb.width / 2;
    const cy = bb.y + bb.height / 2;
    width = Math.max(140, Math.min(280, bb.width * zoom));
    height = Math.max(24, text.fontSize * 1.6 * zoom);
    left = cx * zoom + pan.x - width / 2;
    top = cy * zoom + pan.y - height / 2;
  }

  return (
    <textarea
      autoFocus
      value={text.text}
      onFocus={(e) => e.currentTarget.select()}
      onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
      onBlur={onClose}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); onClose(); }
        else if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
          e.preventDefault();
          (e.target as HTMLTextAreaElement).blur();
        }
      }}
      onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      style={{
        position: 'absolute', left, top, width, minHeight: height, zIndex: 50,
        boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: '2px 6px',
        border: '2px solid #6366f1', borderRadius: 4, outline: 'none', resize: 'none',
        background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.98)',
        boxShadow: '0 0 0 4px rgba(99,102,241,0.15)',
        fontSize: Math.max(10, text.fontSize * zoom),
        fontFamily: text.fontFamily,
        fontWeight: text.fontStyle.includes('bold') ? 700 : 400,
        fontStyle: text.fontStyle.includes('italic') ? 'italic' : 'normal',
        textDecoration: text.textDecoration,
        color: text.fill,
        textAlign: text.align as any,
        lineHeight: 1.3, whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', wordBreak: 'break-word',
      }}
    />
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import type { StampShapeKind } from '../../../types';
import type { ShapeViewStrategy, ShapePanelContext } from './types';
import {
  RectView, CircleView, EllipseView,
  TriangleView, LineView, FillView,
} from './ShapeViews';
import { ClosedShapePanel, LinePanel, FillPanel } from './ShapePanels';

/* РћР±С‘СЂС‚РєР° РґР»СЏ rect вЂ” РїРµСЂРµРґР°С‘Рј showCornerRadius */
const RectPanel: React.FC<ShapePanelContext> = (props) =>
  React.createElement(ClosedShapePanel, { ...props, showCornerRadius: true });

export const shapeViews: Record<StampShapeKind, ShapeViewStrategy> = {
  rect:     { kind: 'rect',     View: RectView,     Panel: RectPanel },
  circle:   { kind: 'circle',   View: CircleView,   Panel: ClosedShapePanel },
  ellipse:  { kind: 'ellipse',  View: EllipseView,  Panel: ClosedShapePanel },
  triangle: { kind: 'triangle', View: TriangleView, Panel: ClosedShapePanel },
  line:     { kind: 'line',     View: LineView,     Panel: LinePanel },
  fill:     { kind: 'fill',     View: FillView,     Panel: FillPanel },
};

export function getShapeView(kind: StampShapeKind): ShapeViewStrategy {
  return shapeViews[kind];
}

const LinePanel: React.FC<ShapePanelContext> = ({ shape, onChange }) => {
  const points = shape.points && shape.points.length >= 4
    ? shape.points
    : [0, shape.height / 2, shape.width, shape.height / 2];

  const pointCount = points.length / 2;

  const setPoint = (index: number, x: number, y: number) => {
    const next = [...points];
    next[index * 2] = x;
    next[index * 2 + 1] = y;
    onChange({ points: next });
  };

  const addPointAtEnd = () => {
    const lastX = points[points.length - 2];
    const lastY = points[points.length - 1];
    const prevX = points[points.length - 4];
    const prevY = points[points.length - 3];
    const dx = lastX - prevX;
    const dy = lastY - prevY;
    onChange({ points: [...points, lastX + dx, lastY + dy] });
  };

  const removePointAt = (index: number) => {
    if (pointCount <= 2) return;
    const next = points.slice();
    next.splice(index * 2, 2);
    onChange({ points: next });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <h4>РЎРІРѕР№СЃС‚РІР°</h4>
      <label>РРјСЏ
        <input value={shape.name || ''} placeholder="Р›РёРЅРёСЏ"
          onChange={(e) => onChange({ name: e.target.value })} />
      </label>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, marginTop: 6 }}>
        <label className="check" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <input type="checkbox" checked={!!shape.locked}
            onChange={(e) => onChange({ locked: e.target.checked })} />
          Р—Р°РјРѕРє
        </label>
        <label className="check" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <input type="checkbox" checked={!!shape.hidden}
            onChange={(e) => onChange({ hidden: e.target.checked })} />
          РЎРєСЂС‹С‚СЊ
        </label>
      </div>

      <h4>РўРѕС‡РєРё ({pointCount})</h4>
      <p className="hint-sm" style={{ margin: '4px 0 8px' }}>
        Р”РІРѕР№РЅРѕР№ РєР»РёРє РїРѕ Р»РёРЅРёРё РЅР° С…РѕР»СЃС‚Рµ вЂ” РґРѕР±Р°РІРёС‚СЊ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ.<br />
        РџСЂР°РІС‹Р№ РєР»РёРє РїРѕ РјР°СЂРєРµСЂСѓ вЂ” СѓРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ.
      </p>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4, marginBottom: 8 }}>
        {Array.from({ length: pointCount }).map((_, i) => (
          <div key={i} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#6b7280', width: 20 }}>#{i + 1}</span>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={Math.round(points[i * 2])}
              onChange={(e) => setPoint(i, +e.target.value, points[i * 2 + 1])}
              style={{ width: 60, padding: '4px 6px', fontSize: 11 }}
            />
            <input
              type="number"
              value={Math.round(points[i * 2 + 1])}
              onChange={(e) => setPoint(i, points[i * 2], +e.target.value)}
              style={{ width: 60, padding: '4px 6px', fontSize: 11 }}
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={pointCount <= 2}
              onClick={() => removePointAt(i)}
              style={{
                padding: '4px 8px',
                fontSize: 11,
                color: pointCount <= 2 ? '#9ca3af' : '#dc2626',
                border: '1px solid #e5e7eb',
                borderRadius: 4,
                background: '#fff',
                cursor: pointCount <= 2 ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
              }}
              title={pointCount <= 2 ? 'РќРµР»СЊР·СЏ СѓРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ вЂ” РјРёРЅРёРјСѓРј 2 С‚РѕС‡РєРё' : 'РЈРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ'}
            >
              вњ•
            </button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <button type="button" className="tool-btn" onClick={addPointAtEnd}>
        + Р”РѕР±Р°РІРёС‚СЊ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ РІ РєРѕРЅРµС†
      </button>

      <h4>РћР±РІРѕРґРєР°</h4>
      <label>Р¦РІРµС‚
        <input type="color" value={shape.stroke || '#000000'}
          onChange={(e) => onChange({ stroke: e.target.value })} />
      </label>
      <label>РўРѕР»С‰РёРЅР°
        <input type="number" min="0.25" max="40" step="0.25" value={shape.strokeWidth}
          onChange={(e) => onChange({ strokeWidth: +e.target.value })} />
      </label>

/* ============================================================
   Line
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   РСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµС‚ РѕР±С‰РёР№ PolylineRenderer: РјР°СЂРєРµСЂС‹ С‚РѕС‡РµРє, СЃС‚СЂРµР»РєР°,
   drag С‚РѕС‡РµРє вЂ” РІСЃС‘ РєР°Рє РЅР° РєР°РЅРІР°СЃРµ.

   Р”РІРѕР№РЅРѕР№ РєР»РёРє РїРѕ Р»РёРЅРёРё РґРѕР±Р°РІР»СЏРµС‚ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ РІ Р±Р»РёР¶Р°Р№С€РёР№ СЃРµРіРјРµРЅС‚.
   ============================================================ */

export const LineView: React.FC<ShapeViewContext> = (ctx) => {
  const { group, w, h } = useGroupProps(ctx);
  const s = ctx.shape;
  const points = ensureMinimalPoints(s.points, w, h);

  /* Р”РІРѕР№РЅРѕР№ РєР»РёРє вЂ” РІСЃС‚Р°РІРёС‚СЊ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ РІ Р±Р»РёР¶Р°Р№С€РёР№ СЃРµРіРјРµРЅС‚.
     Р›РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Рµ РєРѕРѕСЂРґРёРЅР°С‚С‹ РїРѕР»СѓС‡Р°РµРј С‡РµСЂРµР· РѕР±СЂР°С‚РЅС‹Р№ С‚СЂР°РЅСЃС„РѕСЂРј Group. */
  const handleDblClick = (e: any) => {
    if (!ctx.onPointsChange) return;
    e.cancelBubble = true;

    const stage = e.target.getStage();
    const pointer = stage?.getPointerPosition();
    if (!stage || !pointer) return;

    /* РќР°Р№С‚Рё Group СЃ name 'shape' вЂ” СЌС‚Рѕ РЅР°С€ РєРѕРЅС‚РµР№РЅРµСЂ */
    let node: any = e.target;
    while (node && typeof node.name === 'function' && node.name() !== 'shape') {
      node = node.getParent?.();
    }
    if (!node) return;

    const inv = node.getAbsoluteTransform().copy().invert();
    const local = inv.point(pointer);

    const zoom = stage.scaleX() || 1;
    const snapRadius = 5 / zoom;

    const pts = parsePoints(points);
    const next = insertPoint(pts, local.x, local.y, snapRadius);
    if (next === pts) return;

    ctx.onPointsChange(serializePoints(next));
  };

  const handlePointMove = (index: number, x: number, y: number) => {
    if (!ctx.onPointsChange) return;
    const next = [...points];
    next[index * 2] = x;
    next[index * 2 + 1] = y;
    ctx.onPointsChange(next);
  };

  const handlePointContextMenu = (index: number) => {
    if (!ctx.onPointsChange) return;
    const pts = parsePoints(points);
    if (pts.length <= 2) return;
    const next = pts.slice();
    next.splice(index, 1);
    ctx.onPointsChange(serializePoints(next));
  };

  return (
    <Group {...group} onDblClick={handleDblClick} onDblTap={handleDblClick}>
      <PolylineRenderer
        points={points}
        stroke={s.stroke}
        strokeWidth={s.strokeWidth}
        dash={s.dash}
        isArrow={!!s.points && (s as any).isArrow}
        isSelected={!!ctx.isSelected}
        onPointMove={handlePointMove}
        onPointContextMenu={handlePointContextMenu}
      />
    </Group>
  );
};

/* ============================================================
   Legacy Path-fill (fillOuterId / fillHoleIds)
   ============================================================ */

const PathFill: React.FC<ShapeViewContext> = ({ shape: s, allShapes, onSelect }) => {
  const outer = s.fillOuterId
    ? allShapes.find((x) => x.id === s.fillOuterId) || null
    : null;
  if (!outer) return null;

  const holes = (s.fillHoleIds || [])
    .map((id) => allShapes.find((x) => x.id === id))
    .filter((x): x is StampShapeItem => !!x && !x.hidden && x.kind !== 'fill');

  const mode = s.fillMode || 'subtract';

  return (
    <Shape
      id={s.id}
      name="shape"
      listening
      draggable={false}
      onClick={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onSelect(); }}
      onTap={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onSelect(); }}
      sceneFunc={(c) => {
        const raw = (c as any)._context as CanvasRenderingContext2D;
        paintFill(raw, { outer, holes, mode }, s.fill || '#bfdbfe');
      }}
      hitFunc={(c) => {
        const raw = (c as any)._context as CanvasRenderingContext2D;
        paintFill(raw, { outer, holes, mode }, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.001)');
      }}
    />
  );
};

/* ============================================================
   FillView вЂ” anchor-fills РѕР±СЂР°Р±Р°С‚С‹РІР°СЋС‚СЃСЏ СЃРЅР°СЂСѓР¶Рё
   ============================================================ */

export const FillView: React.FC<ShapeViewContext> = (ctx) => {
  if (ctx.shape.fillTargetShapeId) return null;
  return <PathFill {...ctx} />;
};

import React, { useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Group, Rect, Line, Shape } from 'react-konva';
import type Konva from 'konva';
import type { StampTextItem, StampShapeItem } from '../../types';
import { canvasFont, drawArcText } from '../../lib/stamps/render';
import {
  arcTextBBox,
  findNearestShapeByCursor,
  computeArcParamsForAngle,
  closestPointOnHostPerimeter,
  drawPerimeterText,
  DEFAULT_ARC_OFFSET,
  DEFAULT_ARC_SPAN_DEG,
} from './stampSnap';

interface Props {
  text: StampTextItem;
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  snapEnabled: boolean;
  draggable: boolean;
  onSelect: () => void;
  onDblClick: () => void;
  onUpdate: (patch: Partial<StampTextItem>) => void;

/* ============================================================
   РћРїСЂРµРґРµР»РµРЅРёРµ СЌС„С„РµРєС‚РёРІРЅС‹С… СЂР°РґРёСѓСЃРѕРІ РґСѓРіРё
   ============================================================
   1. Р•СЃР»Рё РЅР° С‚РµРєСЃС‚Рµ СЏРІРЅРѕ Р·Р°РґР°РЅС‹ arcRx/arcRy вЂ” РёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµРј РёС….
   2. РРЅР°С‡Рµ, РµСЃР»Рё host вЂ” СЌР»Р»РёРїСЃ Рё rx != ry, Р±РµСЂС‘Рј СЂР°РґРёСѓСЃС‹ host
      СЃ СѓС‡С‘С‚РѕРј Р·РЅР°РєР° В«СЃРЅР°СЂСѓР¶Рё/РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРёВ».
   3. РРЅР°С‡Рµ вЂ” РєСЂСѓРіРѕРІРѕР№ arcRadius.
*/
function resolveArcRadii(
  text: StampTextItem,
  host: StampShapeItem | null,
  arcOffset: number,
): { rx: number; ry: number } {
  if (text.arcRx != null || text.arcRy != null) {
    return {
      rx: text.arcRx ?? text.arcRadius,
      ry: text.arcRy ?? text.arcRadius,
    };
  }
  if (host && host.kind === 'ellipse' && host.width !== host.height) {
    const sign = text.arcOutside ? 1 : -1;
    const minR = text.fontSize * 0.8;
    return {
      rx: Math.max(minR, host.width / 2 + sign * arcOffset),
      ry: Math.max(minR, host.height / 2 + sign * arcOffset),
    };
  }
  return { rx: text.arcRadius, ry: text.arcRadius };
}

export const StampArcTextView: React.FC<Props> = ({
  text, shapes, snapEnabled, draggable,
  onSelect, onDblClick, onUpdate,
}) => {
  const groupRef = useRef<Konva.Group>(null);

  const host = text.arcHostId
    ? shapes.find((s) => s.id === text.arcHostId) || null
    : shapes.find((s) => {
        if (s.hidden || s.kind === 'line' || s.kind === 'fill') return false;
        const cx = s.x + s.width / 2;
        const cy = s.y + s.height / 2;
        return Math.abs(cx - text.arcCx) < 1 && Math.abs(cy - text.arcCy) < 1;
      }) || null;

  const arcOffset = text.arcOffset ?? DEFAULT_ARC_OFFSET;
  const isOutside = !!text.arcOutside;
  const spanDeg = text.arcSpanDeg
    ?? Math.abs(text.arcEndDeg - text.arcStartDeg)
    ?? DEFAULT_ARC_SPAN_DEG;
  const centerDeg = (text.arcStartDeg + text.arcEndDeg) / 2;

  const onPerimeter = !!host && (host.kind === 'rect' || host.kind === 'triangle');

  /* Р­С„С„РµРєС‚РёРІРЅС‹Рµ СЂР°РґРёСѓСЃС‹ РґСѓРіРё */
  const { rx, ry } = resolveArcRadii(text, host, arcOffset);

  const bbox = arcTextBBox({
    text: text.text,
    arcCx: text.arcCx, arcCy: text.arcCy,
    arcRadius: text.arcRadius,
    arcRx: rx, arcRy: ry,
    arcStartDeg: text.arcStartDeg, arcEndDeg: text.arcEndDeg,
    fontSize: text.fontSize,
  });

  const arcHitPoints = useMemo(() => {
    if (onPerimeter) return [] as number[];
    const steps = 64;
    const start = (text.arcStartDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
    const end = (text.arcEndDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
    const out: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const a = start + (end - start) * (i / steps);
      out.push(
        text.arcCx + Math.cos(a) * rx,
        text.arcCy + Math.sin(a) * ry,
      );
    }
    return out;
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [onPerimeter, text.arcCx, text.arcCy, rx, ry, text.arcStartDeg, text.arcEndDeg]);

  const handlers = {
    onClick: (e: any) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onSelect(); },
    onTap: (e: any) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onSelect(); },
    onDblClick: (e: any) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onDblClick(); },
    onDblTap: (e: any) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onDblClick(); },
  };

  const handleDragEnd = (e: any) => {
    const g = groupRef.current;
    if (!g) return;

    const dx = g.x();
    const dy = g.y();
    g.x(0);
    g.y(0);

    const nx = text.arcCx + dx;
    const ny = text.arcCy + dy;

    if (snapEnabled) {
      const stage = e.target.getStage();
      const pos = stage?.getRelativePointerPosition?.();

      if (pos) {
        const target = findNearestShapeByCursor(pos.x, pos.y, shapes, 260);

        if (target) {
          const signed = target.isOutside ? -arcOffset : arcOffset;
          const [cpx, cpy] = closestPointOnHostPerimeter(
            target.host, signed, pos.x, pos.y,
          );
          const hostCx = target.host.x + target.host.width / 2;
          const hostCy = target.host.y + target.host.height / 2;
          const angleRad = Math.atan2(cpy - hostCy, cpx - hostCx);

          const params = computeArcParamsForAngle(
            target.host, angleRad, text.fontSize,
            target.isOutside, spanDeg, arcOffset,
          );

          onUpdate({
            ...params,
            arcHostId: target.host.id,
            arcOutside: target.isOutside,
          });
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    onUpdate({ arcCx: Math.round(nx), arcCy: Math.round(ny) });
  };

  let hitPoints: number[] = [];
  if (host) {
    if (host.kind === 'rect') {
      hitPoints = [
        host.x, host.y,
        host.x + host.width, host.y,
        host.x + host.width, host.y + host.height,
        host.x, host.y + host.height,
      ];
    } else if (host.kind === 'triangle') {
      hitPoints = [
        host.x + host.width / 2, host.y,
        host.x + host.width, host.y + host.height,
        host.x, host.y + host.height,
      ];
    }
  }

  return (
    <Group
      ref={groupRef}
      id={text.id}
      name="text-arc"
      x={0}
      y={0}
      draggable={draggable}
      onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
      {...handlers}
    >
      {onPerimeter && host ? (
        <>
          <Group x={host.x} y={host.y} listening={false}>
            <Shape
              listening={false}
              sceneFunc={(ctx) => {
                const c = (ctx as any)._context as CanvasRenderingContext2D;
                drawPerimeterText(c, {
                  host, arcOffset, isOutside, centerDeg,
                  text: text.text,
                  fontSize: text.fontSize,
                  fontFamily: text.fontFamily,
                  fontStyle: text.fontStyle,
                  fill: text.fill,
                });
              }}
            />
          </Group>

          <Line
            points={hitPoints}
            closed
            stroke="rgba(0,0,0,0.001)"
            strokeWidth={1}
            hitStrokeWidth={Math.max(12, text.fontSize * 1.2)}
            lineJoin="round"
            lineCap="round"
            listening={true}
          />
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <Shape
            listening={false}
            sceneFunc={(ctx) => {
              const c = (ctx as any)._context as CanvasRenderingContext2D;
              drawArcText(c, {
                text: text.text,
                cx: text.arcCx, cy: text.arcCy,
                radius: text.arcRadius,
                radiusX: rx,
                radiusY: ry,
                startDeg: text.arcStartDeg,
                endDeg: text.arcEndDeg,
                flip: text.arcFlip,
                font: canvasFont(text.fontFamily, text.fontStyle, text.fontSize),
                fill: text.fill,
              });
            }}
          />

          <Line
            points={arcHitPoints}
            stroke="rgba(0,0,0,0.001)"
            strokeWidth={1}
            hitStrokeWidth={Math.max(14, text.fontSize * 1.5)}
            lineCap="round"
            lineJoin="round"
            listening={true}
          />

          <Rect
            x={bbox.x + bbox.width / 2 - 8}
            y={bbox.y + bbox.height / 2 - 8}
            width={16}
            height={16}
            fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.001)"
            listening={true}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </Group>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Stage } from 'react-konva';
import type Konva from 'konva';
import type { StampShapeItem, StampTextItem, StampImageItem } from '../../types';
import { StampBackgroundLayer } from './canvas/StampBackgroundLayer';
import { StampElementsLayer } from './canvas/StampElementsLayer';

type SelectionType = 'shape' | 'text' | 'image' | null;

interface Props {
  wrapRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>;
  stageRef: React.RefObject<Konva.Stage>;
  trRef: React.RefObject<Konva.Transformer>;
  layerRef: React.RefObject<Konva.Layer>;

  wrapSize: { w: number; h: number };
  width: number;
  height: number;
  zoom: number;
  pan: { x: number; y: number };
  onWheel: (e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<WheelEvent>) => void;
  onStageMouseDown: () => void;

  showGrid: boolean;

  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  texts: StampTextItem[];
  images: StampImageItem[];
  imageCache: Record<string, HTMLImageElement>;

  selectedId: string | null;
  selectedType: SelectionType;
  selectedShape: StampShapeItem | null;

  snap: boolean;

  fillMode: boolean;
  onFillClick: (px: number, py: number) => void;

  onSelect: (id: string, type: Exclude<SelectionType, null>) => void;
  onShapeDragEnd: (id: string, e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<DragEvent>) => void;
  onTextDragEnd: (id: string, e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<DragEvent>, text: StampTextItem) => void;
  onImageDragEnd: (id: string, e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<DragEvent>, image: StampImageItem) => void;
  onTransformEnd: (e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<Event>) => void;
  onOpenTextEditor: (id: string) => void;
  onUpdateText: (id: string, patch: Partial<StampTextItem>) => void;
  /** РР·РјРµРЅРµРЅРёРµ С‚РѕС‡РµРє Р»РёРЅРёРё вЂ” РїСЂРѕР±СЂР°СЃС‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РЅР°СЂСѓР¶Сѓ РІ StampEditor. */
  onPointsChange?: (id: string, points: number[]) => void;

  children?: React.ReactNode;
}

export const StampCanvas: React.FC<Props> = ({
  wrapRef, stageRef, trRef, layerRef,
  wrapSize, width, height, zoom, pan,
  onWheel, onStageMouseDown,
  showGrid,
  shapes, texts, images, imageCache,
  selectedId, selectedType, selectedShape,
  snap,
  fillMode, onFillClick,
  onSelect, onShapeDragEnd, onTextDragEnd, onImageDragEnd,
  onTransformEnd, onOpenTextEditor, onUpdateText,
  onPointsChange,
  children,
}) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = wrapRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const prev = el.style.cursor;
    el.style.cursor = fillMode ? 'crosshair' : '';
    return () => { el.style.cursor = prev; };
  }, [fillMode, wrapRef]);

  return (
    <div className="stamp-editor-canvas" ref={wrapRef}>
      <Stage
        ref={stageRef as any}
        width={wrapSize.w}
        height={wrapSize.h}
        x={pan.x} y={pan.y}
        scaleX={zoom} scaleY={zoom}
        onWheel={onWheel}
        onMouseDown={(e) => {
          if (e.target !== e.target.getStage()) return;
          if (fillMode) {
            const pos = e.target.getStage()?.getRelativePointerPosition();
            if (pos) onFillClick(pos.x, pos.y);
            return;
          }
          onStageMouseDown();
        }}
      >
        <StampBackgroundLayer
          width={width}
          height={height}
          zoom={zoom}
          showGrid={showGrid}
        />
        <StampElementsLayer
          layerRef={layerRef}
          trRef={trRef}
          stampW={width}
          stampH={height}
          shapes={shapes}
          texts={texts}
          images={images}
          imageCache={imageCache}
          selectedId={selectedId}
          selectedType={selectedType}
          selectedShape={selectedShape}
          snap={snap}
          listening={!fillMode}
          onSelect={onSelect}
          onShapeDragEnd={onShapeDragEnd}
          onTextDragEnd={onTextDragEnd}
          onImageDragEnd={onImageDragEnd}
          onTransformEnd={onTransformEnd}
          onOpenTextEditor={onOpenTextEditor}
          onUpdateText={onUpdateText}
          onPointsChange={onPointsChange}
        />
      </Stage>

      {children}
    </div>
  );
};

  const [name, setName] = useState(initialName || 'РњРѕР№ С€С‚Р°РјРї');
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(initialWidth);

  const [placementMode, setPlacementMode] = useState<PlacementMode>('inside');
  const [showGrid, setShowGrid] = useState(true);

  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState<SelectionType>(null);

  const select = useCallback((id: string | null, type: SelectionType) => {
    setSelectedId(id);
    setSelectedType(type);
  }, []);

  const clearSelection = useCallback(() => {
    setSelectedId(null);
    setSelectedType(null);
  }, []);

  /* ============================================================
     Refs
     ============================================================ */
  const stageWrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const stageRef = useRef<Konva.Stage>(null);

  const layerRef = useRef<Konva.Layer>(null);

  const history = useStampHistory({

  });
  const { shapes, texts, images } = history.state;

  /* ============================================================
     Zoom / Pan
     ============================================================ */
  const zp = useStampZoomPan(stageRef);

    zp.zoomFit(wrapSize.w, wrapSize.h, width, height);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [width, height, wrapSize.w, wrapSize.h]);

  const withFillOff = useCallback(

        />

          <div className="stamp-editor-left">
            <StampLayersPanel
              shapes={shapes} texts={texts} images={images}
              selectedId={selectedId}
              selectedType={selectedType}
              onSelect={select}
              onToggleHidden={layerActions.toggleHidden}
              onToggleLocked={layerActions.toggleLocked}
              onDelete={layerActions.removeLayer}
              onReorder={layerActions.reorder}
            />
          </div>

          <StampCanvas
  wrapRef={stageWrapRef}

  trRef={trRef}

  wrapSize={wrapSize}

  zoom={zp.zoom}
  pan={zp.pan}
  onWheel={zp.onWheel}
  onStageMouseDown={() => {
    if (textEditor.editingTextId) textEditor.closeTextEditor();
    clearSelection();
  }}
  showGrid={showGrid}
  shapes={shapes}
  texts={texts}
  images={images}
  imageCache={imageCache}

  selectedShape={selectedShape}

  fillMode={fill.fillMode}

  onSelect={(id, type) => select(id, type)}

>
  {editingText && (

    {width}Г—{height} В· {Math.round(zp.zoom * 100)}% В· Р­Р»РµРјРµРЅС‚РѕРІ: {shapes.length + texts.length + images.length}
    {selectedShape && ` В· ${selectedShape.name || selectedShape.kind}`}

import React from 'react';
import type { StampShapeItem, StampTextItem, StampImageItem } from '../../types';

type LayerKind = 'shape' | 'text' | 'image';

interface LayerItem {
  id: string;
  type: LayerKind;
  name: string;
  icon: string;
  hidden?: boolean;
  locked?: boolean;
}

interface Props {
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  texts: StampTextItem[];
  images?: StampImageItem[];
  selectedId: string | null;
  selectedType: LayerKind | null;
  onSelect: (id: string, type: LayerKind) => void;
  onToggleHidden: (id: string, type: LayerKind) => void;
  onToggleLocked: (id: string, type: LayerKind) => void;
  onDelete: (id: string, type: LayerKind) => void;
  onReorder: (id: string, type: LayerKind, dir: 1 | -1) => void;
}

export const StampLayersPanel: React.FC<Props> = ({
  shapes, texts, images = [], selectedId, selectedType,
  onSelect, onToggleHidden, onToggleLocked, onDelete, onReorder,
}) => {
  const items: LayerItem[] = [
    ...texts.map((t) => ({
      id: t.id, type: 'text' as const,
      name: t.name || (t.mode === 'arc' ? 'РўРµРєСЃС‚ (РґСѓРіР°)' : 'РўРµРєСЃС‚'),
      icon: t.mode === 'arc' ? 'вЊ’' : 'T',
      hidden: t.hidden, locked: t.locked,
    })),
    ...images.map((im) => ({
      id: im.id, type: 'image' as const,
      name: im.name || 'РљР°СЂС‚РёРЅРєР°',
      icon: 'рџ–ј',
      hidden: im.hidden, locked: im.locked,
    })),
    ...shapes.map((s) => ({
      id: s.id, type: 'shape' as const,
      name: s.name || ({
        ellipse: 'Р­Р»Р»РёРїСЃ',
        rect: 'РџСЂСЏРјРѕСѓРіРѕР»СЊРЅРёРє',

        circle: 'РљСЂСѓРі',

      icon: s.kind === 'ellipse' || s.kind === 'circle' ? 'в—Ї'

        : s.kind === 'triangle' ? 'в–і'
        : 'вЂ”',
      hidden: s.hidden, locked: s.locked,
    })),
  ];

  return (
    <div className="stamp-layers">

import React from 'react';
import { Group, Circle, Ellipse, Rect, Line, Text, Shape, Image as KImage } from 'react-konva';
import type { StampElement } from '../../types';
import { STAMP_DASH_MAP, konvaStyle, canvasFont, drawArcText } from '../../lib/stamps/render';

type Zone = 'top' | 'center' | 'bottom';

interface Props {
  el: StampElement;
  onSelect: (e?: any) => void;
  onUpdate: (patch: Partial<StampElement>) => void;
  onDblClick?: (zone: Zone, e?: any) => void;
  onDragStart?: (e: any) => void;
  onDragMove?: (e: any) => void;
  onDragEnd?: (e: any) => void;
  onContextMenu?: (e: any) => void;
  isEditingZone?: Zone | null;
}

export const StampLegacy: React.FC<Props> = ({
  el, onSelect, onUpdate, onDblClick,
  onDragStart, onDragMove, onDragEnd, onContextMenu,
  isEditingZone = null,
}) => {
  const [img, setImg] = React.useState<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!el.centerImage) { setImg(null); return; }
    const i = new window.Image();
    i.src = el.centerImage;
    i.onload = () => setImg(i);
  }, [el.centerImage]);

  const w = el.width, h = el.height, cx = w / 2, cy = h / 2;
  const color = el.stampColor || '#1a1a1a';
  const shape = el.shape || 'circle';
  const dashOuter = STAMP_DASH_MAP[el.strokeDash || 'solid'];
  const dashInner = STAMP_DASH_MAP[el.innerStrokeDash || 'solid'];

  const topSize = el.topFontSize || 14;
  const centerSize = el.centerFontSize || 20;
  const bottomSize = el.bottomFontSize || 12;

  const topColor = el.topColor || color;
  const botColor = el.bottomColor || color;

  const showTop = isEditingZone !== 'top';
  const showCenter = isEditingZone !== 'center';
  const showBottom = isEditingZone !== 'bottom';

  const minR = Math.min(w, h) / 2;

  const zoneHandler = (zone: Zone) => (e: any) => {
    e.cancelBubble = true;
    onDblClick?.(zone, e);
  };

  const renderArc = (
    text: string, radius: number,
    startDeg: number, endDeg: number, flip: boolean,
    fontFamily: string, fontStyle: string, size: number, fill: string,
    key: string,
  ) => (
    <Shape
      key={key}
      listening={false}
      sceneFunc={(ctx) => {
        const c = (ctx as any)._context as CanvasRenderingContext2D;
        drawArcText(c, {
          text, cx, cy, radius,
          radiusX: radius,
          radiusY: radius,
          startDeg, endDeg, flip,
          font: canvasFont(fontFamily, fontStyle, size),
          fill,
        });
      }}
    />
  );

  return (
    <Group
      id={el.id}
      name="element"
      x={el.x} y={el.y} rotation={el.rotation}
      draggable
      onMouseDown={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onSelect(e); }}
      onTap={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; onSelect(e); }}
      onDragStart={onDragStart}
      onDragMove={onDragMove}
      onDragEnd={(e) => { onUpdate({ x: e.target.x(), y: e.target.y() }); onDragEnd?.(e); }}
      onContextMenu={onContextMenu}
      onTransformEnd={(e) => {
        const n = e.target;
        const sx = n.scaleX(), sy = n.scaleY();
        n.scaleX(1); n.scaleY(1);
        onUpdate({
          x: n.x(), y: n.y(), rotation: n.rotation(),
          width: Math.max(40, el.width * sx),
          height: Math.max(40, el.height * sy),
        });
      }}
    >
      {shape === 'circle' && (<>
        <Circle x={cx} y={cy} radius={minR - 4}
          stroke={color} strokeWidth={el.strokeWidth || 3} dash={dashOuter} />
        {el.showInner && <Circle x={cx} y={cy} radius={minR - 20}
          stroke={color} strokeWidth={el.innerStrokeWidth || 1} dash={dashInner} />}
      </>)}

      {shape === 'oval' && (<>
        <Ellipse x={cx} y={cy} radiusX={w / 2 - 4} radiusY={h / 2 - 4}
          stroke={color} strokeWidth={el.strokeWidth || 3} dash={dashOuter} />
        {el.showInner && <Ellipse x={cx} y={cy} radiusX={w / 2 - 20} radiusY={h / 2 - 20}
          stroke={color} strokeWidth={el.innerStrokeWidth || 1} dash={dashInner} />}
      </>)}

      {shape === 'rect' && (<>
        <Rect x={4} y={4} width={w - 8} height={h - 8} cornerRadius={6}
          stroke={color} strokeWidth={el.strokeWidth || 3} dash={dashOuter} />
        {el.showInner && <Rect x={16} y={16} width={w - 32} height={h - 32} cornerRadius={4}
          stroke={color} strokeWidth={el.innerStrokeWidth || 1} dash={dashInner} />}
      </>)}

      {shape === 'triangle' && (<>
        <Line points={[cx, 4, w - 4, h - 4, 4, h - 4, cx, 4]} closed
          stroke={color} strokeWidth={el.strokeWidth || 3} lineJoin="round" dash={dashOuter} />
        {el.showInner && <Line points={[cx, 20, w - 20, h - 20, 20, h - 20, cx, 20]} closed
          stroke={color} strokeWidth={el.innerStrokeWidth || 1} lineJoin="round" dash={dashInner} />}
      </>)}

      {(shape === 'circle' || shape === 'oval') && (<>
        {showTop && el.topText && renderArc(
          el.topText, minR - 32, -153, -27, false,
          el.topFontFamily || 'Arial', el.topFontStyle || '', topSize, topColor,
          'legacy-top',
        )}
        {showBottom && el.bottomText && renderArc(
          el.bottomText, minR - 32, 153, 27, true,
          el.bottomFontFamily || 'Arial', el.bottomFontStyle || '', bottomSize, botColor,
          'legacy-bot',
        )}
      </>)}

      {(shape === 'rect' || shape === 'triangle') && (<>
        {showTop && (
          <Text x={0} y={18} width={w} align="center" text={el.topText}
            fontSize={topSize} fontFamily={el.topFontFamily || 'Arial'}
            fontStyle={konvaStyle(el.topFontStyle || '')}
            textDecoration={el.topTextDecoration || ''}
            fill={topColor} listening={false} />
        )}
        {showBottom && (
          <Text x={0} y={h - 32} width={w} align="center" text={el.bottomText}
            fontSize={bottomSize} fontFamily={el.bottomFontFamily || 'Arial'}
            fontStyle={konvaStyle(el.bottomFontStyle || '')}
            textDecoration={el.bottomTextDecoration || ''}
            fill={botColor} listening={false} />
        )}
      </>)}

      {showCenter && (
        <Text x={0} y={cy - centerSize / 2 - 2} width={w} align="center"
          text={el.centerText} fontSize={centerSize}
          fontFamily={el.centerFontFamily || 'Arial'}
          fontStyle={konvaStyle(el.centerFontStyle || 'bold')}
          textDecoration={el.centerTextDecoration || ''}
          fill={el.centerColor || color} listening={false} />
      )}

      {img && <KImage x={cx - 35} y={cy - 35} width={70} height={70} image={img} listening={false} />}

      <Rect x={0} y={0} width={w} height={h * 0.33}
        fill="transparent"
        onDblClick={zoneHandler('top')} onDblTap={zoneHandler('top')} />
      <Rect x={0} y={h * 0.33} width={w} height={h * 0.34}
        fill="transparent"
        onDblClick={zoneHandler('center')} onDblTap={zoneHandler('center')} />
      <Rect x={0} y={h * 0.67} width={w} height={h * 0.33}
        fill="transparent"
        onDblClick={zoneHandler('bottom')} onDblTap={zoneHandler('bottom')} />
    </Group>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import type {
  StampShape, StampShapeItem, StampTextItem, StampImageItem,
} from '../../types';
import {
  getAllStamps, addCustomStamp, updateCustomStamp, removeCustomStamp,
  isBuiltinStamp, forkStampAsCustom,
  type StampTemplate,
} from '../../lib/stamps/library';
import { newStampFromTemplate, newLegacyStamp } from '../../lib/stamps/factories';
import { StampEditor } from './StampEditor';
import { useActionsContext } from '../../editor/contexts/ActionsContext';

const LEGACY_QUICK: { shape: StampShape; label: string; icon: string }[] = [
  { shape: 'circle',   label: 'РљСЂСѓРіР»Р°СЏ',       icon: 'в­•' },
  { shape: 'oval',     label: 'РћРІР°Р»',          icon: 'в¬­' },
  { shape: 'rect',     label: 'РџСЂСЏРјРѕСѓРіРѕР»СЊРЅР°СЏ', icon: 'в–­' },
  { shape: 'triangle', label: 'РўСЂРµСѓРіРѕР»СЊРЅР°СЏ',   icon: 'в–і' },
];

interface EditorState {
  mode: 'create' | 'edit';
  sourceId?: string;
  sourceIsBuiltin?: boolean;
  customId?: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  texts: StampTextItem[];
  images: StampImageItem[];
  name?: string;
}

function toDragPayload(tpl: StampTemplate) {
  return JSON.stringify({
    kind: 'stamp-template',
    template: {
      id: tpl.id, name: tpl.name, description: tpl.description, icon: tpl.icon,
      width: tpl.width, height: tpl.height,
      shapes: tpl.shapes, texts: tpl.texts, images: tpl.images || [],
    },
  });
}

export const StampLibraryPanel: React.FC = () => {
  const actions = useActionsContext();
  const [version, setVersion] = useState(0);
  const [editorState, setEditorState] = useState<EditorState | null>(null);

  const stamps = useMemo(() => getAllStamps(), [version]);

  const generalStamps = useMemo(() => stamps.filter((s) => !s.custom && !s.banking), [stamps]);
  const bankingStamps = useMemo(() => stamps.filter((s) => !s.custom && s.banking), [stamps]);
  const customStamps  = useMemo(() => stamps.filter((s) => s.custom), [stamps]);

  const applyStamp = (tpl: StampTemplate) =>
    actions.addElementWithHistory(newStampFromTemplate(tpl, 200, 200));

  const addLegacy = (shape: StampShape) =>
    actions.addElementWithHistory(newLegacyStamp(shape, 200, 200));

  const openNew = () => {
    setEditorState({
      mode: 'create',
      width: 200, height: 200,
      shapes: [], texts: [], images: [],
      name: 'РњРѕР№ С€С‚Р°РјРї',
    });
  };

  const openEdit = (tpl: StampTemplate) => {
    const builtin = isBuiltinStamp(tpl.id);
    setEditorState({
      mode: 'edit',
      sourceId: tpl.id,
      sourceIsBuiltin: builtin,
      customId: builtin ? undefined : tpl.id,
      width: tpl.width, height: tpl.height,
      shapes: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(tpl.shapes)),
      texts: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(tpl.texts)),
      images: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(tpl.images || [])),
      name: tpl.name,
    });
  };

  const handleSave = (data: {
    name: string; width: number; height: number;
    shapes: StampShapeItem[]; texts: StampTextItem[]; images: StampImageItem[];
  }) => {
    if (!editorState) return;

    if (editorState.mode === 'edit') {
      if (editorState.sourceIsBuiltin) {
        const source = stamps.find((s) => s.id === editorState.sourceId);
        if (source) {
          const copy = forkStampAsCustom({
            ...source,
            name: data.name, width: data.width, height: data.height,
            shapes: data.shapes, texts: data.texts, images: data.images,
          });
          addCustomStamp(copy);
        }
      } else if (editorState.customId) {
        updateCustomStamp(editorState.customId, {
          name: data.name, width: data.width, height: data.height,
          shapes: data.shapes, texts: data.texts, images: data.images,
        });
      }
      setVersion((v) => v + 1);
      setEditorState(null);
      return;
    }

    const tpl: StampTemplate = {
      id: `custom-${Date.now()}`,
      name: data.name, icon: 'рџ–ј',
      width: data.width, height: data.height,
      shapes: data.shapes, texts: data.texts, images: data.images,
      custom: true,
    };
    addCustomStamp(tpl);
    setVersion((v) => v + 1);
    setEditorState(null);
    actions.addElementWithHistory(newStampFromTemplate(tpl, 200, 200));
  };

  const deleteStamp = (tpl: StampTemplate) => {
    if (!tpl.custom) return;
    if (!window.confirm(`РЈРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ С€С‚Р°РјРї В«${tpl.name}В» РёР· Р±РёР±Р»РёРѕС‚РµРєРё?`)) return;
    removeCustomStamp(tpl.id);
    setVersion((v) => v + 1);
  };

  const renderItem = (s: StampTemplate, opts: { editable: boolean; deletable: boolean }) => (
    <div key={s.id} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
      <button
        className="tool-tile"
        title={s.description || s.name}
        draggable
        onDragStart={(e) => {
          e.dataTransfer.setData('application/json', toDragPayload(s));
          e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'copy';
        }}
        onClick={() => applyStamp(s)}
        style={{ width: '100%' }}
      >
        <span className="tile-ico">{s.icon || 'рџ–ј'}</span>
        <span>{s.name}</span>
      </button>

      {opts.editable && (
        <button
          title="Р РµРґР°РєС‚РёСЂРѕРІР°С‚СЊ"
          onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); openEdit(s); }}
          style={{
            position: 'absolute', top: 2, right: 2,
            width: 18, height: 18, padding: 0, fontSize: 10,
            lineHeight: '16px',
            border: '1px solid var(--border)',
            borderRadius: 3,
            background: 'var(--panel)',
            color: 'var(--text)',
            cursor: 'pointer',
          }}
        >вњЋ</button>
      )}

      {opts.deletable && (
        <button
          title="РЈРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ РёР· Р±РёР±Р»РёРѕС‚РµРєРё"
          onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); deleteStamp(s); }}
          style={{
            position: 'absolute', top: 2, right: 22,
            width: 18, height: 18, padding: 0, fontSize: 11,
            lineHeight: '16px',
            border: '1px solid var(--border)',
            borderRadius: 3,
            background: 'var(--panel)',
            color: 'var(--danger, #ef4444)',
            cursor: 'pointer',
          }}
        >вњ•</button>
      )}
    </div>
  );

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Group, Text as KonvaText, Image as KImage, Shape as KonvaShape } from 'react-konva';
import type { StampShapeItem, StampTextItem, StampImageItem } from '../../types';
import { konvaStyle, canvasFont, drawArcText } from '../../lib/stamps/render';
import { getShapeView } from './shapes';
import { CompositeFillLayer } from './canvas/CompositeFillLayer';

interface Props {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  texts: StampTextItem[];
  images?: StampImageItem[];
  isEditingZone?: 'top' | 'center' | 'bottom' | null;
}

const DEFAULT_ARC_OFFSET = 6;

function resolveArcRadii(
  t: StampTextItem,
  host: StampShapeItem | null,
): { rx: number; ry: number } {
  if (t.arcRx != null || t.arcRy != null) {
    return {
      rx: t.arcRx ?? t.arcRadius,
      ry: t.arcRy ?? t.arcRadius,
    };
  }
  if (host && host.kind === 'ellipse' && host.width !== host.height) {
    const arcOffset = t.arcOffset ?? DEFAULT_ARC_OFFSET;
    const sign = t.arcOutside ? 1 : -1;
    const minR = t.fontSize * 0.8;
    return {
      rx: Math.max(minR, host.width / 2 + sign * arcOffset),
      ry: Math.max(minR, host.height / 2 + sign * arcOffset),
    };
  }
  return { rx: t.arcRadius, ry: t.arcRadius };
}

export const StampRenderer: React.FC<Props> = ({
  width, height, shapes, texts, images = [],
  isEditingZone = null,
}) => {
  const [imageCache, setImageCache] = useState<Record<string, HTMLImageElement>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    let changed = false;
    const next = { ...imageCache };
    for (const im of images) {
      if (im.hidden) continue;
      if (next[im.src]) continue;
      const img = new window.Image();
      img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
      img.src = im.src;
      img.onload = () => setImageCache((prev) => ({ ...prev, [im.src]: img }));
      changed = true;
    }
    if (changed) setImageCache(next);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [images.map((i) => i.src).join('|')]);

  const legacyFills = useMemo(
    () => shapes.filter((s) => s.kind === 'fill' && !s.fillTargetShapeId),
    [shapes],
  );

  const regularShapes = useMemo(
    () => shapes.filter((s) => s.kind !== 'fill'),
    [shapes],
  );

  const renderText = (t: StampTextItem) => {
    if (t.hidden) return null;

    if (t.mode === 'arc') {
      const host = t.arcHostId
        ? shapes.find((s) => s.id === t.arcHostId) || null
        : shapes.find((s) => {
            if (s.hidden || s.kind === 'line' || s.kind === 'fill') return false;
            const cx = s.x + s.width / 2;
            const cy = s.y + s.height / 2;
            return Math.abs(cx - t.arcCx) < 1 && Math.abs(cy - t.arcCy) < 1;
          }) || null;

      const { rx, ry } = resolveArcRadii(t, host);

      return (
        <KonvaShape
          key={t.id}
          listening={false}
          sceneFunc={(ctx) => {
            const c = (ctx as any)._context as CanvasRenderingContext2D;
            drawArcText(c, {
              text: t.text,
              cx: t.arcCx,
              cy: t.arcCy,
              radius: t.arcRadius,
              radiusX: rx,
              radiusY: ry,
              startDeg: t.arcStartDeg,
              endDeg: t.arcEndDeg,
              flip: t.arcFlip,
              font: canvasFont(t.fontFamily, t.fontStyle, t.fontSize),
              fill: t.fill,
            });
          }}
        />
      );
    }

    return (
      <KonvaText
        key={t.id}
        x={t.x} y={t.y} width={t.width}
        text={t.text}
        fontSize={t.fontSize}
        fontFamily={t.fontFamily}
        fontStyle={konvaStyle(t.fontStyle)}
        textDecoration={t.textDecoration}
        fill={t.fill}
        align={t.align}
        listening={false}
      />
    );
  };

  return (
    <Group width={width} height={height}>
      <CompositeFillLayer
        width={width}
        height={height}
        shapes={shapes}
      />

      {legacyFills.map((s) => {
        if (s.hidden) return null;
        const view = getShapeView(s.kind);
        const View = view.View;
        return (
          <View
            key={s.id}
            shape={s}
            allShapes={shapes}
            draggable={false}
            onSelect={() => { /* noop */ }}
            onDragEnd={() => { /* noop */ }}
          />
        );
      })}

      {regularShapes.map((s) => {
        if (s.hidden) return null;
        const view = getShapeView(s.kind);
        const View = view.View;
        return (
          <View
            key={s.id}
            shape={s}
            allShapes={shapes}
            draggable={false}
            onSelect={() => { /* noop */ }}
            onDragEnd={() => { /* noop */ }}
          />
        );
      })}

      {images.map((im) => {
        if (im.hidden) return null;
        const img = imageCache[im.src];
        if (!img) return null;
        return (
          <KImage
            key={im.id}
            x={im.x} y={im.y}
            width={im.width} height={im.height}
            image={img}
            listening={false}
          />
        );
      })}

      {!isEditingZone && texts.map(renderText)}
    </Group>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

export interface ContextAction {
  label: string;
  shortcut?: string;
  action: () => void;
  danger?: boolean;
}

interface Props {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  actions: ContextAction[];
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const ContextMenu: React.FC<Props> = ({ x, y, actions, onClose }) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) onClose();
    };
    const onEsc = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose(); };
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', onClick);
      document.addEventListener('keydown', onEsc);
    }, 0);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onClick);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onEsc);
    };
  }, [onClose]);

  const menuW = 240;
  const menuH = actions.length * 32 + 8;
  const left = Math.min(x, window.innerWidth - menuW - 8);
  const top = Math.min(y, window.innerHeight - menuH - 8);

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="context-menu" style={{ left, top }}>
      {actions.map((a, i) => (
        <div
          key={i}
          className={`context-menu-item ${a.danger ? 'danger' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => { a.action(); onClose(); }}
        >
          <span>{a.label}</span>
          {a.shortcut && <span className="shortcut">{a.shortcut}</span>}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * Element Entity - Domain Layer
 * Core business logic for canvas elements
 */

import type { CanvasElement, Position, Size, Bounds } from '../../shared/types';
import { generateId } from '../../shared/utils/id';

export type ElementType = CanvasElement['type'];

export interface ElementProps {
  readonly id?: string;
  readonly x: number;
  readonly y: number;
  readonly width: number;
  readonly height: number;
  readonly rotation?: number;
  readonly locked?: boolean;
}

export abstract class Element {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly type: ElementType;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  rotation: number;
  locked: boolean;

  protected constructor(type: ElementType, props: ElementProps) {
    this.id = props.id ?? generateId();
    this.type = type;
    this.x = props.x;
    this.y = props.y;
    this.width = props.width;
    this.height = props.height;
    this.rotation = props.rotation ?? 0;
    this.locked = props.locked ?? false;
  }

  get bounds(): Bounds {
    return {
      x: this.x,
      y: this.y,
      width: this.width,
      height: this.height,
    };
  }

  get center(): Position {
    return {
      x: this.x + this.width / 2,
      y: this.y + this.height / 2,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Check if point is inside element bounds
   */
  containsPoint(point: Position): boolean {
    return (
      point.x >= this.x &&
      point.x <= this.x + this.width &&
      point.y >= this.y &&
      point.y <= this.y + this.height
    );
  }

  /**
   * Check intersection with another bounds
   */
  intersectsBounds(other: Bounds): boolean {
    return !(
      this.x + this.width < other.x ||
      other.x + other.width < this.x ||
      this.y + this.height < other.y ||
      other.y + other.height < this.y
    );
  }

  /**
   * Move element by delta
   */
  move(deltaX: number, deltaY: number): void {
    if (this.locked) return;
    this.x += deltaX;
    this.y += deltaY;
  }

  /**
   * Resize element with constraints
   */
  resize(newWidth: number, newHeight: number, minSize: Size = { width: 20, height: 20 }): void {
    if (this.locked) return;
    this.width = Math.max(newWidth, minSize.width);
    this.height = Math.max(newHeight, minSize.height);
  }

  /**
   * Rotate element
   */
  rotate(degrees: number): void {
    if (this.locked) return;
    this.rotation = (this.rotation + degrees) % 360;
  }

  /**
   * Toggle locked state
   */
  toggleLock(): void {
    this.locked = !this.locked;
  }

  /**
   * Clone element with new ID
   */
  abstract clone(): Element;

  /**
   * Convert to plain object for serialization
   */
  abstract toPlainObject(): CanvasElement;

  /**
   * Create from plain object
   */
  static fromPlainObject(obj: CanvasElement): Element {
    // Factory method - implemented in concrete classes
    throw new Error('Not implemented');
  }
}

/**
 * Element factory registry
 */
export type ElementFactory = (props: Record<string, unknown>) => Element;

const factories = new Map<ElementType, ElementFactory>();

export function registerElementFactory(type: ElementType, factory: ElementFactory): void {
  factories.set(type, factory);
}

export function createElement(type: ElementType, props: Record<string, unknown>): Element {
  const factory = factories.get(type);
  if (!factory) {
    throw new Error(`No factory registered for element type: ${type}`);
  }
  return factory(props);
}

/**
 * Slide Entity - Domain Layer
 * Core business logic for slides
 */

import type { Slide as SlideType, CanvasElement, Padding, DocFormat, Orientation } from '../../shared/types';
import { FORMATS, DEFAULT_PADDING } from '../../shared/constants';
import { Element } from './Element';

export interface SlideProps {
  readonly id?: string;
  readonly name?: string;
  readonly format?: DocFormat;
  readonly orientation?: Orientation;
  readonly width?: number;
  readonly height?: number;
  readonly background?: string;
  readonly backgroundImage?: string;
  readonly padding?: Padding;
  readonly elements?: readonly CanvasElement[];
}

export class Slide {
  readonly id: string;
  name: string;
  format: DocFormat;
  orientation: Orientation;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  background: string;
  backgroundImage?: string;
  padding: Padding;
  elements: CanvasElement[];

  constructor(props: SlideProps = {}) {
    const format = props.format ?? 'a4';
    const orientation = props.orientation ?? 'portrait';
    const formatSize = FORMATS[format].portrait;
    
    this.id = props.id ?? generateId();
    this.name = props.name ?? 'Slide';
    this.format = format;
    this.orientation = orientation;
    this.width = props.width ?? (orientation === 'portrait' ? formatSize.w : formatSize.h);
    this.height = props.height ?? (orientation === 'portrait' ? formatSize.h : formatSize.w);
    this.background = props.background ?? '#ffffff';
    this.backgroundImage = props.backgroundImage;
    this.padding = props.padding ?? { ...DEFAULT_PADDING };
    this.elements = props.elements ? [...props.elements] : [];
  }

  /**
   * Get printable area dimensions
   */
  get printableArea(): { width: number; height: number } {
    return {
      width: Math.max(0, this.width - this.padding.left - this.padding.right),
      height: Math.max(0, this.height - this.padding.top - this.padding.bottom),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Add element to slide
   */
  addElement(element: CanvasElement): void {
    this.elements = [...this.elements, element];
  }

  /**
   * Remove element by ID
   */
  removeElement(elementId: string): void {
    this.elements = this.elements.filter(el => el.id !== elementId);
  }

  /**
   * Update element by ID
   */
  updateElement(elementId: string, patch: Partial<CanvasElement>): void {
    this.elements = this.elements.map(el =>
      el.id === elementId ? { ...el, ...patch } as CanvasElement : el
    );
  }

  /**
   * Get element by ID
   */
  getElementById(elementId: string): CanvasElement | undefined {
    return this.elements.find(el => el.id === elementId);
  }

  /**
   * Move element in z-order
   */
  moveElementLayer(elementId: string, direction: 1 | -1): void {
    const index = this.elements.findIndex(el => el.id === elementId);
    if (index < 0) return;
    
    const newIndex = index + direction;
    if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex >= this.elements.length) return;
    
    const newElements = [...this.elements];
    [newElements[index], newElements[newIndex]] = [newElements[newIndex], newElements[index]];
    this.elements = newElements;
  }

  /**
   * Change format and recalculate dimensions
   */
  changeFormat(format: DocFormat, customSize?: { w: number; h: number }): void {
    const formatSize = FORMATS[format].portrait;
    const baseSize = format === 'custom' && customSize ? customSize : formatSize;
    
    const newWidth = this.orientation === 'portrait' ? baseSize.w : baseSize.h;
    const newHeight = this.orientation === 'portrait' ? baseSize.h : baseSize.w;
    
    this.reflowElements(newWidth, newHeight);
    
    this.format = format;
    this.width = newWidth;
    this.height = newHeight;
  }

  /**
   * Change orientation and swap dimensions
   */
  changeOrientation(orientation: Orientation): void {
    if (this.orientation === orientation) return;
    
    const formatSize = FORMATS[this.format].portrait;
    const baseSize = this.format === 'custom' 
      ? { w: this.height, h: this.width } // Swap current
      : formatSize;
    
    const newWidth = orientation === 'portrait' ? baseSize.w : baseSize.h;
    const newHeight = orientation === 'portrait' ? baseSize.h : baseSize.w;
    
    this.reflowElements(newWidth, newHeight);
    
    this.orientation = orientation;
    this.width = newWidth;
    this.height = newHeight;
  }

  /**
   * Reflow elements when slide dimensions change
   */
  private reflowElements(newWidth: number, newHeight: number): void {
    const printableWidth = Math.max(0, newWidth - this.padding.left - this.padding.right);
    const printableHeight = Math.max(0, newHeight - this.padding.top - this.padding.bottom);

    this.elements = this.elements.map(el => {
      // Footer: stick to bottom
      if (el.type === 'footer') {
        return {
          ...el,
          x: this.padding.left,
          y: newHeight - this.padding.bottom - el.height,
          width: printableWidth,
        };
      }

      // Placeholder: fill printable area
      if (el.type === 'placeholder') {
        return {
          ...el,
          x: this.padding.left,
          y: this.padding.top,
          width: printableWidth,
          height: printableHeight,
        };
      }

      // Other elements: clamp to new bounds
      const maxX = Math.max(0, newWidth - el.width);
      const maxY = Math.max(0, newHeight - el.height);

      return {
        ...el,
        x: Math.min(el.x, maxX),
        y: Math.min(el.y, maxY),
        width: Math.min(el.width, printableWidth),
      };
    });
  }

  /**
   * Clone slide with new ID
   */
  clone(): Slide {
    return new Slide({
      name: `${this.name} (Copy)`,
      format: this.format,
      orientation: this.orientation,
      width: this.width,
      height: this.height,
      background: this.background,
      backgroundImage: this.backgroundImage,
      padding: { ...this.padding },
      elements: this.elements.map(el => ({ ...el, id: generateId() })),
    });
  }

  /**
   * Convert to plain object
   */
  toPlainObject(): SlideType {
    return {
      id: this.id,
      name: this.name,
      format: this.format,
      orientation: this.orientation,
      width: this.width,
      height: this.height,
      background: this.background,
      backgroundImage: this.backgroundImage,
      padding: { ...this.padding },
      elements: [...this.elements],
    };
  }

  /**
   * Create from plain object
   */
  static fromPlainObject(obj: SlideType): Slide {
    return new Slide({
      id: obj.id,
      name: obj.name,
      format: obj.format,
      orientation: obj.orientation,
      width: obj.width,
      height: obj.height,
      background: obj.background,
      backgroundImage: obj.backgroundImage,
      padding: obj.padding,
      elements: obj.elements,
    });
  }
}

// Import at the end to avoid circular dependency
import { generateId } from '../../shared/utils/id';

/**
 * Event Bus - Domain Layer
 * Decoupled event communication
 */

import type { DomainEvent } from '../../shared/types';

export type EventHandler<T extends DomainEvent = DomainEvent> = (event: T) => void;

export class EventBus {
  private handlers = new Map<string, Set<EventHandler>>();

  /**
   * Subscribe to event type
   */
  subscribe<T extends DomainEvent>(
    eventType: T['type'],
    handler: EventHandler<T>
  ): () => void {
    const handlers = this.handlers.get(eventType) ?? new Set();
    handlers.add(handler as EventHandler);
    this.handlers.set(eventType, handlers);

    // Return unsubscribe function
    return () => {
      handlers.delete(handler as EventHandler);
    };
  }

  /**
   * Publish event
   */
  publish<T extends DomainEvent>(event: T): void {
    const handlers = this.handlers.get(event.type);
    if (!handlers) return;

    for (const handler of handlers) {
      try {
        handler(event);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(`Event handler failed for ${event.type}:`, error);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Clear all handlers
   */
  clear(): void {
    this.handlers.clear();
  }
}

// Global event bus instance
export const eventBus = new EventBus();

/**
 * Slide Repository Interface - Domain Layer
 * Abstract interface for slide persistence
 */

import type { Slide } from '../entities/Slide';

export interface SlideRepository {
  /**
   * Get all slides
   */
  getAll(): Promise<Slide[]>;

  /**
   * Get slide by ID
   */
  getById(id: string): Promise<Slide | null>;

  /**
   * Save slide
   */
  save(slide: Slide): Promise<void>;

  /**
   * Delete slide
   */
  delete(id: string): Promise<void>;

  /**
   * Save all slides
   */
  saveAll(slides: Slide[]): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * In-memory implementation for testing
 */
export class InMemorySlideRepository implements SlideRepository {
  private slides = new Map<string, Slide>();

  async getAll(): Promise<Slide[]> {
    return Array.from(this.slides.values());
  }

  async getById(id: string): Promise<Slide | null> {
    return this.slides.get(id) ?? null;
  }

  async save(slide: Slide): Promise<void> {
    this.slides.set(slide.id, slide);
  }

  async delete(id: string): Promise<void> {
    this.slides.delete(id);
  }

  async saveAll(slides: Slide[]): Promise<void> {
    for (const slide of slides) {
      this.slides.set(slide.id, slide);
    }
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.slides.clear();
  }
}

import type { Slide, CanvasElement } from '../../types';

export function addElementsToSlide(
  slides: Slide[],
  activeId: string,
  elements: CanvasElement[],
): Slide[] {
  if (!elements.length) return slides;
  return slides.map((s) =>
    s.id !== activeId ? s : { ...s, elements: [...s.elements, ...elements] },
  );
}

export function insertElementsAt(
  slides: Slide[],
  activeId: string,
  elements: CanvasElement[],
  index: number,
): Slide[] {
  if (!elements.length) return slides;
  return slides.map((s) => {
    if (s.id !== activeId) return s;
    const arr = s.elements.slice();
    arr.splice(index, 0, ...elements);
    return { ...s, elements: arr };
  });
}

import type { CanvasElement } from '../../types';
import { uid } from '../../lib/uid';

export interface CloneOptions {
  offsetX?: number;
  offsetY?: number;
  newIds?: boolean;
  skipConnectors?: boolean;
}

export function cloneElements(
  elements: CanvasElement[],
  opts: CloneOptions = {},
): CanvasElement[] {
  const { offsetX = 0, offsetY = 0, newIds = true, skipConnectors = true } = opts;
  const out: CanvasElement[] = [];

  for (const el of elements) {
    if (skipConnectors && el.type === 'connector') continue;
    const copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(el)) as CanvasElement;
    if (newIds) copy.id = uid();
    copy.x = el.x + offsetX;
    copy.y = el.y + offsetY;
    out.push(copy);
  }
  return out;
}

import type { Slide } from '../../types';

export function moveLayerInSlide(
  slides: Slide[],
  activeId: string,
  elementId: string,
  dir: 1 | -1,
): Slide[] {
  return slides.map((s) => {
    if (s.id !== activeId) return s;
    const idx = s.elements.findIndex((e) => e.id === elementId);
    if (idx < 0) return s;
    const target = idx + dir;
    if (target < 0 || target >= s.elements.length) return s;
    const arr = s.elements.slice();
    [arr[idx], arr[target]] = [arr[target], arr[idx]];
    return { ...s, elements: arr };
  });
}

import type { Slide, CanvasElement } from '../../types';

/**
 * РЈРґР°Р»СЏРµС‚ СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚С‹ + РєР°СЃРєР°РґРЅРѕ СЃРІСЏР·Р°РЅРЅС‹Рµ РєРѕРЅРЅРµРєС‚РѕСЂС‹.
 * РљРѕРЅРЅРµРєС‚РѕСЂ СѓРґР°Р»СЏРµС‚СЃСЏ, РµСЃР»Рё СѓРґР°Р»С‘РЅ С…РѕС‚СЏ Р±С‹ РѕРґРёРЅ РёР· РµРіРѕ РєРѕРЅС†РѕРІ.
 */
export function removeElementsFromSlide(
  slides: Slide[],
  activeId: string,
  ids: string[],
): Slide[] {
  if (!ids.length) return slides;
  const removed = new Set(ids);

  return slides.map((s) => {
    if (s.id !== activeId) return s;
    const next = s.elements
      .filter((el) => !removed.has(el.id))
      .filter((el) => {
        if (el.type !== 'connector') return true;
        return !removed.has(el.fromId) && !removed.has(el.toId);
      });
    return { ...s, elements: next };
  });
}

import type { Slide, CanvasElement } from '../../types';

export interface UpdateResult {
  slides: Slide[];
  changed: boolean;
}

/**
 * Р§РёСЃС‚Р°СЏ С„СѓРЅРєС†РёСЏ: РїСЂРёРјРµРЅСЏРµС‚ patch Рє СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚Сѓ.
 * РџСЂРѕРІРµСЂСЏРµС‚, С‡С‚Рѕ patch СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ РјРµРЅСЏРµС‚ С…РѕС‚СЏ Р±С‹ РѕРґРЅРѕ РїРѕР»Рµ.
 */
export function updateElementInSlides(
  slides: Slide[],
  activeId: string,
  elementId: string,
  patch: Partial<CanvasElement>,
): UpdateResult {
  const sIdx = slides.findIndex((s) => s.id === activeId);
  if (sIdx < 0) return { slides, changed: false };

  const slide = slides[sIdx];
  const eIdx = slide.elements.findIndex((el) => el.id === elementId);
  if (eIdx < 0) return { slides, changed: false };

  const target = slide.elements[eIdx];
  let changed = false;
  for (const key in patch) {
    if ((target as any)[key] !== (patch as any)[key]) {
      changed = true;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!changed) return { slides, changed: false };

  const next = slides.slice();
  next[sIdx] = {
    ...slide,
    elements: slide.elements.map((el, i) =>
      i === eIdx ? ({ ...el, ...patch } as CanvasElement) : el,
    ),
  };
  return { slides: next, changed: true };
}

import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { CanvasElement, Slide } from '../../types';
import { cloneElements, addElementsToSlide } from '../../editor/operations';

interface Args {
  activeSlide: Slide;
  activeId: string;
  selectedIds: string[];
  selected: CanvasElement | null;
  setSlides: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Slide[]>>;
  setSelectedIds: (ids: string[]) => void;
  removeSelected: () => void;
  updateWithHistory: (id: string, patch: Partial<CanvasElement>) => void;
  copiedStyle: Partial<CanvasElement> | null;
  setCopiedStyle: (v: Partial<CanvasElement> | null) => void;
}

export function useEditorClipboard({
  activeSlide,
  activeId,
  selectedIds,
  selected,
  setSlides,
  setSelectedIds,
  removeSelected,
  updateWithHistory,
  copiedStyle,
  setCopiedStyle,
}: Args) {
  const [clipboard, setClipboard] = useState<CanvasElement[]>([]);

  const copy = useCallback(() => {
    const els = activeSlide.elements.filter(
      (el) => selectedIds.includes(el.id) && el.type !== 'connector',
    );
    if (els.length) setClipboard(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(els)));
  }, [activeSlide, selectedIds]);

  const cut = useCallback(() => {
    const els = activeSlide.elements.filter(
      (el) => selectedIds.includes(el.id) && el.type !== 'connector',
    );
    if (!els.length) return;
    setClipboard(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(els)));
    removeSelected();
  }, [activeSlide, selectedIds, removeSelected]);

  const paste = useCallback(() => {
    if (!clipboard.length) return;
    const cloned = cloneElements(clipboard, { offsetX: 20, offsetY: 20 });
    setSlides((prev) => addElementsToSlide(prev, activeId, cloned));
    setSelectedIds(cloned.map((e) => e.id));
  }, [clipboard, activeId, setSlides, setSelectedIds]);

  const duplicate = useCallback(() => {
    const els = activeSlide.elements.filter(
      (el) => selectedIds.includes(el.id) && el.type !== 'connector',
    );
    if (!els.length) return;
    const cloned = cloneElements(els, { offsetX: 20, offsetY: 20 });
    setSlides((prev) => addElementsToSlide(prev, activeId, cloned));
    setSelectedIds(cloned.map((e) => e.id));
  }, [activeSlide, selectedIds, activeId, setSlides, setSelectedIds]);

  const copyStyle = useCallback(() => {
    if (!selected) return;
    const { id, x, y, rotation, type, ...style } = selected as any;
    setCopiedStyle(style);
  }, [selected, setCopiedStyle]);

  const applyStyle = useCallback(() => {
    if (!selected || !copiedStyle) return;
    updateWithHistory(selected.id, copiedStyle);
    setCopiedStyle(null);
  }, [selected, copiedStyle, updateWithHistory, setCopiedStyle]);

  return { copy, cut, paste, duplicate, copyStyle, applyStyle };
}

import { useCallback } from 'react';
import type { CanvasElement, Slide } from '../../types';
import { useConnectorDraft } from '../useConnectorDraft';
import {
  findElementAt,
  findElementWithPadding,
  cloneForConnector,
} from '../../lib/connectors';

interface Args {
  activeSlide: Slide;
  addElementsSilently: (els: CanvasElement[]) => void;
  setFloatingPos: (p: { x: number; y: number } | null) => void;
}

export function useEditorConnectors({
  activeSlide,
  addElementsSilently,
  setFloatingPos,
}: Args) {
  const api = useConnectorDraft({
    elements: activeSlide.elements,
    addElementsSilently,
    makeNewElement: (rect, source) => cloneForConnector(rect, source),
  });

  const findElementIdAt = useCallback(
    (worldX: number, worldY: number, exclude: string[] = []): string | null => {
      const el = findElementAt(activeSlide.elements, worldX, worldY, exclude);
      return el ? el.id : null;
    },
    [activeSlide.elements],
  );

  const findElementIdAtWithPad = useCallback(
    (worldX: number, worldY: number, pad: number, exclude: string[] = []): string | null => {
      const el = findElementWithPadding(activeSlide.elements, worldX, worldY, pad, exclude);
      return el ? el.id : null;
    },
    [activeSlide.elements],
  );

  const startDraft = useCallback(
    (fromId: string, fromAnchor: any, wx: number, wy: number) => {
      setFloatingPos(null);
      api.startDraft(fromId, fromAnchor, wx, wy);
    },
    [api, setFloatingPos],
  );

  return {
    connectorDraft: api.draft,
    startConnectorDraft: startDraft,
    moveConnectorDraft: api.moveDraft,
    commitConnectorDraft: api.commitDraft,
    cancelConnectorDraft: api.cancelDraft,
    findElementIdAt,
    findElementIdAtWithPad,
  };
}

              el.id === state.diagramEditorTarget && el.type === 'diagram'
                ? { ...el, svg, xml }

            ),
          };
        }),
      );
      state.setDiagramEditorTarget(null);
    },

import { useCallback } from 'react';

interface Args {
  setFloatingPos: (p: { x: number; y: number } | null) => void;
  setContextMenu: (m: any) => void;
  setEditing: (e: any) => void;
  setShowToolbar: (v: boolean) => void;

  setDiagramEditorTarget: (id: string | null) => void;
}

export function useEditorModals({
  setFloatingPos,
  setContextMenu,
  setEditing,
  setShowToolbar,
  setStampEditorTarget,
  setDiagramEditorTarget,
}: Args) {
  const openStampEditor = useCallback(
    (elementId: string) => {
      setFloatingPos(null);
      setContextMenu(null);
      setEditing(null);
      setShowToolbar(false);
      setStampEditorTarget(elementId);
    },
    [setFloatingPos, setContextMenu, setEditing, setShowToolbar, setStampEditorTarget],
  );

  const closeStampEditor = useCallback(() => setStampEditorTarget(null), [setStampEditorTarget]);

  const openDiagramEditor = useCallback(
    (elementId: string) => {
      setFloatingPos(null);
      setContextMenu(null);
      setEditing(null);
      setShowToolbar(false);
      setDiagramEditorTarget(elementId);
    },
    [setFloatingPos, setContextMenu, setEditing, setShowToolbar, setDiagramEditorTarget],
  );

  const closeDiagramEditor = useCallback(
    () => setDiagramEditorTarget(null),
    [setDiagramEditorTarget],
  );

  return { openStampEditor, closeStampEditor, openDiagramEditor, closeDiagramEditor };

import { useCallback } from 'react';
import type { CanvasElement, Slide } from '../../types';
import {
  updateElementInSlides,
  addElementsToSlide,
  removeElementsFromSlide,
  moveLayerInSlide,
} from '../../editor/operations';

interface Args {
  slides: Slide[];
  activeId: string;
  setSlides: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Slide[]>>;
  setSelectedIds: (ids: string[]) => void;
  clearSelection: () => void;
}

export function useEditorOps({
  slides,
  activeId,
  setSlides,
  setSelectedIds,
  clearSelection,
}: Args) {
  const updateWithHistory = useCallback(
    (id: string, patch: Partial<CanvasElement>) => {
      setSlides((prev) => {
        const r = updateElementInSlides(prev, activeId, id, patch);
        return r.changed ? r.slides : prev;
      });
    },
    [activeId, setSlides],
  );

  const addElementWithHistory = useCallback(
    (el: CanvasElement) => {
      setSlides((prev) => addElementsToSlide(prev, activeId, [el]));
      setSelectedIds([el.id]);
    },
    [activeId, setSlides, setSelectedIds],
  );

  const addElementsSilently = useCallback(
    (els: CanvasElement[]) => {
      if (!els.length) return;
      setSlides((prev) => addElementsToSlide(prev, activeId, els));
    },
    [activeId, setSlides],
  );

  const removeSelectedByIds = useCallback(
    (ids: string[]) => {
      if (!ids.length) return;
      setSlides((prev) => removeElementsFromSlide(prev, activeId, ids));
      clearSelection();
    },
    [activeId, setSlides, clearSelection],
  );

  const moveLayer = useCallback(
    (elementId: string, dir: 1 | -1) => {
      setSlides((prev) => moveLayerInSlide(prev, activeId, elementId, dir));
    },
    [activeId, setSlides],
  );

  return {
    updateWithHistory,
    addElementWithHistory,
    addElementsSilently,
    removeSelectedByIds,
    moveLayer,
  };
}

import type { CanvasElement, Padding, StampElement } from '../../types';
import type { OverlayGeometry, Zone } from './types';

export interface StageOffset {
  offsetX: number;
  offsetY: number;
}

/**
 * РђР±СЃРѕР»СЋС‚РЅС‹Рµ РєРѕРѕСЂРґРёРЅР°С‚С‹ stage РІ viewport.
 * Overlay СЂРµРЅРґРµСЂРёС‚СЃСЏ СЃ position: fixed вЂ” Р·РЅР°С‡РёС‚ РєРѕРѕСЂРґРёРЅР°С‚С‹ РѕС‚ viewport.
 */
export function getStageOffset(
  wrap: HTMLDivElement,
  stage: { container: () => HTMLDivElement },
): StageOffset {
  const stageRect = stage.container().getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    offsetX: stageRect.left,
    offsetY: stageRect.top,
  };
}

const EMPTY_PAD: Padding = { top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0 };

export function calcElementGeometry(
  el: CanvasElement,
  offset: StageOffset,
  zoom: number,
  contentHeight: number,
  kind: 'text' | 'shape' | 'footer' | 'stamp',
  zone?: Zone,
): OverlayGeometry {
  /* Р¤РёРіСѓСЂР°: text-area РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРё РЅРµС‘ */
  if (kind === 'shape' && el.type === 'shape') {
    return calcShapeTextArea(el, offset, zoom);
  }

  /* Stamp: РѕРІРµСЂР»РµР№ РїРѕ Р·РѕРЅРµ (top/center/bottom) */
  if (kind === 'stamp' && el.type === 'stamp') {
    return calcStampTextArea(el, zone || 'center', offset, zoom);
  }

  /* Text / Footer: РєРѕРѕСЂРґРёРЅР°С‚С‹ text-area РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРё СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚Р° */
  const pad = ('padding' in el && el.padding) ? el.padding : EMPTY_PAD;
  const innerW = Math.max(1, el.width - pad.left - pad.right);
  const innerH = Math.max(1, contentHeight - pad.top - pad.bottom);

  return {
    x: offset.offsetX + (el.x + pad.left) * zoom,
    y: offset.offsetY + (el.y + pad.top) * zoom,
    width: innerW * zoom,
    height: innerH * zoom,
  };
}

/** Text-area РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРё С„РёРіСѓСЂС‹ вЂ” СЃРѕРІРїР°РґР°РµС‚ СЃ ShapeEl.tsx. */
function calcShapeTextArea(
  el: Extract<CanvasElement, { type: 'shape' }>,
  offset: StageOffset,
  zoom: number,
): OverlayGeometry {
  const w = el.width;
  const h = el.height;
  const pad = el.textPadding || { top: 8, right: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8 };

  let tx = 0, ty = 0, tw = w, th = h;

  if (el.shape === 'circle') {
    const d = Math.min(w, h);
    tw = d * 0.7; th = d * 0.7;
    tx = (w - tw) / 2; ty = (h - th) / 2;
  } else if (el.shape === 'triangle') {
    tw = w * 0.55; th = h * 0.45;
    tx = (w - tw) / 2; ty = h * 0.5;
  } else if (el.shape === 'star') {
    tw = w * 0.5; th = h * 0.5;
    tx = (w - tw) / 2; ty = (h - th) / 2;
  }

  tx += pad.left;
  ty += pad.top;
  tw = Math.max(1, tw - pad.left - pad.right);
  th = Math.max(1, th - pad.top - pad.bottom);

  return {
    x: offset.offsetX + (el.x + tx) * zoom,
    y: offset.offsetY + (el.y + ty) * zoom,
    width: Math.max(1, tw * zoom),
    height: Math.max(1, th * zoom),
  };
}

/**
 * Text-area РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРё stamp.
 *  вЂў top: РїРѕР»РѕСЃР° РІ РІРµСЂС…РЅРµР№ С‡Р°СЃС‚Рё (С‚Р°Рј, РіРґРµ РёРґС‘С‚ РІРµСЂС…РЅСЏСЏ РґСѓРіР°)
 *  вЂў center: С†РµРЅС‚СЂ stamp
 *  вЂў bottom: РїРѕР»РѕСЃР° РІ РЅРёР¶РЅРµР№ С‡Р°СЃС‚Рё
 * Р РµР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Рµ РїСЂРѕРїРѕСЂС†РёРё СЃРѕРІРїР°РґР°СЋС‚ СЃ РѕС‚СЂРёСЃРѕРІРєРѕР№ РІ Stamp.tsx.
 */
function calcStampTextArea(
  el: StampElement,
  zone: Zone,
  offset: StageOffset,
  zoom: number,
): OverlayGeometry {
  const w = el.width;
  const h = el.height;

  let tx = 0, ty = 0, tw = w, th = 40;

  if (el.shape === 'circle' || el.shape === 'oval') {
    /* Р’РЅСѓС‚СЂРµРЅРЅСЏСЏ Р·РѕРЅР°, РЅРµ РІС‹С…РѕРґСЏС‰Р°СЏ Р·Р° РєРѕРЅС‚СѓСЂ */
    const innerD = Math.min(w, h) * 0.65;

    if (zone === 'top') {
      tw = innerD; th = 32;
      tx = (w - tw) / 2;
      ty = (h - innerD) / 2 + 4;
    } else if (zone === 'bottom') {
      tw = innerD; th = 32;
      tx = (w - tw) / 2;
      ty = (h + innerD) / 2 - th - 4;
    } else {
      tw = innerD; th = 40;
      tx = (w - tw) / 2;
      ty = h / 2 - th / 2;
    }
  } else if (el.shape === 'rect') {
    if (zone === 'top') {
      tw = w - 24; th = 30;
      tx = 12; ty = 12;
    } else if (zone === 'bottom') {
      tw = w - 24; th = 30;
      tx = 12; ty = h - 42;
    } else {
      tw = w - 24; th = 40;
      tx = 12; ty = h / 2 - 20;
    }
  } else {
    /* triangle */
    const innerD = Math.min(w, h) * 0.5;

    if (zone === 'top') {
      tw = innerD; th = 26;
      tx = (w - tw) / 2;
      ty = h * 0.35;
    } else if (zone === 'bottom') {
      tw = innerD; th = 26;
      tx = (w - tw) / 2;
      ty = h * 0.72;
    } else {
      tw = innerD; th = 40;
      tx = (w - tw) / 2;
      ty = h / 2 - 20;
    }
  }

  return {
    x: offset.offsetX + (el.x + tx) * zoom,
    y: offset.offsetY + (el.y + ty) * zoom,
    width: Math.max(30, tw * zoom),
    height: Math.max(20, th * zoom),
  };
}

export function calcCellGeometry(
  el: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; cols: number; rows: number },
  offset: StageOffset,
  zoom: number,
  cell: { rowIndex: number; colIndex: number },
): OverlayGeometry {
  const cw = el.width / el.cols;
  const ch = el.height / el.rows;
  return {
    x: offset.offsetX + (el.x + cell.colIndex * cw) * zoom,
    y: offset.offsetY + (el.y + cell.rowIndex * ch) * zoom,
    width: Math.max(1, cw * zoom),
    height: Math.max(1, ch * zoom),
  };
}

import { useEffect } from 'react';

interface Args {
  enabled: boolean;
  onOutside: () => void;
  ignoreSelectors: string[];
}

/**
 * Р—Р°РєСЂС‹РІР°РµС‚ СЂРµРґР°РєС‚РѕСЂ РїСЂРё РєР»РёРєРµ РІРЅРµ СѓРєР°Р·Р°РЅРЅС‹С… СЃРµР»РµРєС‚РѕСЂРѕРІ.
 *
 * РћСЃРѕР±РµРЅРЅРѕСЃС‚Рё:
 *   вЂў РЎР»СѓС€Р°РµРј 'mousedown' РЅР° С„Р°Р·Рµ capture вЂ” СЂР°РЅСЊС€Рµ РѕСЃС‚Р°Р»СЊРЅС‹С….
 *   вЂў РќР• РІС‹Р·С‹РІР°РµРј onOutside СЃСЂР°Р·Сѓ, Р° С‡РµСЂРµР· setTimeout(0), С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РґР°С‚СЊ
 *     TipTap-СЂРµРґР°РєС‚РѕСЂСѓ С€Р°РЅСЃ РѕР±СЂР°Р±РѕС‚Р°С‚СЊ blur Рё Р·Р°С„РёРєСЃРёСЂРѕРІР°С‚СЊ С€РёСЂРёРЅС‹
 *     РєРѕР»РѕРЅРѕРє С‡РµСЂРµР· С‚СЂР°РЅР·Р°РєС†РёСЋ.
 */
export function useClickOutside({ enabled, onOutside, ignoreSelectors }: Args) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;

    const handler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node | null;
      if (!target) return;

      const inside = ignoreSelectors.some((sel) => {
        const el = document.querySelector(sel);
        return el?.contains(target);
      });
      if (inside) return;

      // РћС‚РєР»Р°РґС‹РІР°РµРј, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ TipTap.onBlur СѓСЃРїРµР» РїСЂРёРјРµРЅРёС‚СЊ columnResizing
      setTimeout(() => onOutside(), 0);
    };

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handler, true);
    }, 0);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handler, true);
    };
  }, [enabled, onOutside, ignoreSelectors]);
}

export interface CanvasWrapSize {
