  h: number;
}

export function useStampCanvasWrap(
  ref: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>,
  fallback: CanvasWrapSize = { w: 800, h: 600 },
): CanvasWrapSize {
  const [size, setSize] = useState<CanvasWrapSize>(fallback);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const update = () => {
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      setSize({ w: r.width, h: r.height });
    };
    update();
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(update);
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [ref]);

  return size;
}

import { useCallback } from 'react';
import type { StampShapeItem, StampTextItem, StampImageItem } from '../../types';
import { uid } from '../../lib/uid';

type SelectionType = 'shape' | 'text' | 'image' | null;

interface Args {
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  texts: StampTextItem[];
  images: StampImageItem[];
  selectedId: string | null;
  selectedType: SelectionType;
  commit: (s: StampShapeItem[], t: StampTextItem[], i: StampImageItem[]) => void;
  select: (id: string | null, type: SelectionType) => void;
  clearSelection: () => void;
}

const PASTE_OFFSET = 12;

export function useStampCRUD({
  shapes, texts, images,
  selectedId, selectedType,
  commit, select, clearSelection,
}: Args) {
  const deleteSelected = useCallback(() => {
    if (!selectedId || !selectedType) return;
    if (selectedType === 'shape') {
      commit(shapes.filter((s) => s.id !== selectedId), texts, images);
    } else if (selectedType === 'text') {
      commit(shapes, texts.filter((t) => t.id !== selectedId), images);
    } else {
      commit(shapes, texts, images.filter((im) => im.id !== selectedId));
    }
    clearSelection();
  }, [selectedId, selectedType, shapes, texts, images, commit, clearSelection]);

  const duplicateSelected = useCallback(() => {
    if (!selectedId || !selectedType) return;
    const off = PASTE_OFFSET;

    if (selectedType === 'shape') {
      const s = shapes.find((x) => x.id === selectedId);
      if (!s) return;
      const c: StampShapeItem = {
        ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s)),
        id: uid(),
        x: s.x + off, y: s.y + off,
      };
      commit([...shapes, c], texts, images);
      select(c.id, 'shape');
    } else if (selectedType === 'text') {
      const t = texts.find((x) => x.id === selectedId);
      if (!t) return;
      const c: StampTextItem = { ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(t)), id: uid() };
      if (c.mode === 'straight') { c.x += off; c.y += off; }
      else { c.arcCx += off; c.arcCy += off; }
      commit(shapes, [...texts, c], images);
      select(c.id, 'text');
    } else {
      const im = images.find((x) => x.id === selectedId);
      if (!im) return;
      const c: StampImageItem = {
        ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(im)),
        id: uid(),
        x: im.x + off, y: im.y + off,
      };
      commit(shapes, texts, [...images, c]);
      select(c.id, 'image');
    }
  }, [selectedId, selectedType, shapes, texts, images, commit, select]);

  return { deleteSelected, duplicateSelected };
}

import { useCallback } from 'react';
import type Konva from 'konva';
import type { StampShapeItem, StampTextItem, StampImageItem } from '../../types';
import {
  snapPosition,
  snapToHostCenter,
  findContainingShape,
} from '../../lib/stamps/geometry';

interface Args {
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  width: number;
  height: number;
  snapEnabled: boolean;
  updateShape: (id: string, patch: Partial<StampShapeItem>) => void;
  updateText: (id: string, patch: Partial<StampTextItem>) => void;
  updateImage: (id: string, patch: Partial<StampImageItem>) => void;
}

function isCtrlPressed(e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<any>): boolean {
  const evt = e.evt as MouseEvent | undefined;
  return !!(evt && (evt.ctrlKey || evt.metaKey));
}

export function useStampDragHandlers({
  shapes, width, height, snapEnabled,
  updateShape, updateText, updateImage,
}: Args) {

  const handleShapeDragEnd = useCallback((id: string, e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<DragEvent>) => {
    const s = shapes.find((x) => x.id === id);
    if (!s || s.kind === 'fill') return;

    const node = e.target;
    const rawX = node.x() - s.width / 2;
    const rawY = node.y() - s.height / 2;

    if (isCtrlPressed(e)) {
      node.x(Math.round(rawX) + s.width / 2);
      node.y(Math.round(rawY) + s.height / 2);
      updateShape(id, { x: Math.round(rawX), y: Math.round(rawY) });
      return;
    }

    const host = findContainingShape(rawX + s.width / 2, rawY + s.height / 2, id, shapes);
    const cs = snapToHostCenter(rawX, rawY, s.width, s.height, host);

    let nx = cs.x, ny = cs.y;
    if (!cs.snappedX || !cs.snappedY) {
      const general = snapPosition(nx, ny, s.width, s.height, id, shapes, width, height, snapEnabled);
      if (!cs.snappedX) nx = general.x;
      if (!cs.snappedY) ny = general.y;
    }

    node.x(nx + s.width / 2);
    node.y(ny + s.height / 2);
    updateShape(id, { x: Math.round(nx), y: Math.round(ny) });
  }, [shapes, snapEnabled, width, height, updateShape]);

  const handleTextDragEnd = useCallback((
    id: string,
    e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<DragEvent>,
    text: StampTextItem,
  ) => {
    const node = e.target;
    if (isCtrlPressed(e)) {
      node.x(Math.round(node.x()));
      node.y(Math.round(node.y()));
      updateText(id, { x: Math.round(node.x()), y: Math.round(node.y()) });
      return;
    }
    const snapped = snapPosition(
      node.x(), node.y(), text.width, text.fontSize * 1.4,
      id, shapes, width, height, snapEnabled,
    );
    node.x(snapped.x);
    node.y(snapped.y);
    updateText(id, { x: snapped.x, y: snapped.y });
  }, [shapes, snapEnabled, width, height, updateText]);

  const handleImageDragEnd = useCallback((
    id: string,
    e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<DragEvent>,
    image: StampImageItem,
  ) => {
    const node = e.target;
    if (isCtrlPressed(e)) {
      node.x(Math.round(node.x()));
      node.y(Math.round(node.y()));
      updateImage(id, { x: Math.round(node.x()), y: Math.round(node.y()) });
      return;
    }
    const snapped = snapPosition(
      node.x(), node.y(), image.width, image.height,
      id, shapes, width, height, snapEnabled,
    );
    node.x(snapped.x);
    node.y(snapped.y);
    updateImage(id, { x: snapped.x, y: snapped.y });
  }, [shapes, snapEnabled, width, height, updateImage]);

  return { handleShapeDragEnd, handleTextDragEnd, handleImageDragEnd };
}

export function useStampFillMode({
  shapes, texts, images, width, height,
  commit, select,

  const [fillColor, setFillColor] = useState('#fbbf24');

  const handleCanvasClick = useCallback((px: number, py: number) => {

    fillColor, setFillColor,

FILE: hooks\stamps\useStampHistory.ts
SIZE: 1641 bytes

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { StampShapeItem, StampTextItem, StampImageItem } from '../../types';

export interface StampSnapshot {
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  texts: StampTextItem[];
  images: StampImageItem[];
}

const MAX_HISTORY = 60;

export function useStampHistory(initial: StampSnapshot) {
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState<StampSnapshot>(initial);
  const historyRef = useRef<StampSnapshot[]>([initial]);
  const indexRef = useRef(0);
  const [version, setVersion] = useState(0);

  const push = useCallback((next: StampSnapshot) => {
    const trimmed = historyRef.current.slice(0, indexRef.current + 1);
    trimmed.push(next);
    while (trimmed.length > MAX_HISTORY) trimmed.shift();
    historyRef.current = trimmed;
    indexRef.current = trimmed.length - 1;
    setCurrent(next);
    setVersion((v) => v + 1);
  }, []);

  const replace = useCallback((next: StampSnapshot) => {
    setCurrent(next);
  }, []);

  const undo = useCallback(() => {
    if (indexRef.current <= 0) return;
    indexRef.current -= 1;
    setCurrent(historyRef.current[indexRef.current]);
    setVersion((v) => v + 1);
  }, []);

  const redo = useCallback(() => {
    if (indexRef.current >= historyRef.current.length - 1) return;
    indexRef.current += 1;
    setCurrent(historyRef.current[indexRef.current]);
    setVersion((v) => v + 1);
  }, []);

  return {
    state: current,
    push,
    replace,
    undo,
    redo,
    canUndo: indexRef.current > 0,
    canRedo: indexRef.current < historyRef.current.length - 1,
    version,
  };
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { StampImageItem } from '../../types';

export function useStampImageCache(
  images: StampImageItem[],
): Record<string, HTMLImageElement> {
  const [cache, setCache] = useState<Record<string, HTMLImageElement>>({});

  /* eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps */
  const key = images.map((i) => i.src).join('|');

  useEffect(() => {
    let changed = false;
    const next = { ...cache };
    for (const im of images) {
      if (im.hidden) continue;
      if (next[im.src]) continue;
      const img = new window.Image();
      img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
      img.src = im.src;
      img.onload = () => setCache((prev) => ({ ...prev, [im.src]: img }));
      changed = true;
    }
    if (changed) setCache(next);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [key]);

  return cache;
}

    input.accept = 'image/*';

          updateImage(id, { src });
        }
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    };
    input.click();

 * РѕРїС†РёРѕРЅР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ СѓР±РёСЂР°РµС‚ С„РѕРЅ, РїРѕРґРіРѕРЅСЏРµС‚ СЂР°Р·РјРµСЂ, РґРѕР±Р°РІР»СЏРµС‚ РІ СЃС†РµРЅСѓ.

export function useStampImageUpload({
  shapes, texts, images, width, height, commit, select,
}: Args) {

    const input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'file';
    input.accept = 'image/*';
    input.onchange = () => {
      const file = input.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = async () => {
        let src = reader.result as string;
        if (transparent) {
          try {
            src = await makeImageTransparent(src, { keyColor: 'auto', tolerance: 30 });
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[stamps] transparent conversion failed', e);
          }
        }
        let nw = 100, nh = 100;
        try {
          const img = await loadImage(src);
          nw = img.naturalWidth || 100;
          nh = img.naturalHeight || 100;
        } catch { /* ignore */ }
        const { width: iw, height: ih } = fitImageSize(nw, nh, width, height, 0.5);
        const im = createImage(src, iw, ih, width, height);
        commit(shapes, texts, [...images, im]);
        select(im.id, 'image');
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    };
    input.click();
  }, [shapes, texts, images, width, height, commit, select]);
}

import { useCallback } from 'react';
import type { StampShapeItem, StampTextItem, StampImageItem } from '../../types';

type LayerKind = 'shape' | 'text' | 'image';

interface Args {
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  texts: StampTextItem[];
  images: StampImageItem[];
  selectedId: string | null;
  commit: (s: StampShapeItem[], t: StampTextItem[], i: StampImageItem[]) => void;
  clearSelection: () => void;
}

/**
 * Р”РµР№СЃС‚РІРёСЏ РїР°РЅРµР»Рё СЃР»РѕС‘РІ: СЃРєСЂС‹С‚СЊ/Р·Р°Р±Р»РѕРєРёСЂРѕРІР°С‚СЊ/СѓРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ/РїРµСЂРµСЃС‚Р°РІРёС‚СЊ.
 * РЈР±РёСЂР°РµС‚ 4 Р±РѕР»СЊС€РёС… inline-Р·Р°РјС‹РєР°РЅРёСЏ РёР· StampEditor.
 */
export function useStampLayerActions({
  shapes, texts, images, selectedId, commit, clearSelection,
}: Args) {
  const toggleHidden = useCallback((id: string, type: LayerKind) => {
    if (type === 'shape') {
      commit(shapes.map((s) => (s.id === id ? { ...s, hidden: !s.hidden } : s)), texts, images);
    } else if (type === 'text') {
      commit(shapes, texts.map((t) => (t.id === id ? { ...t, hidden: !t.hidden } : t)), images);
    } else {
      commit(shapes, texts, images.map((im) => (im.id === id ? { ...im, hidden: !im.hidden } : im)));
    }
  }, [shapes, texts, images, commit]);

  const toggleLocked = useCallback((id: string, type: LayerKind) => {
    if (type === 'shape') {
      commit(shapes.map((s) => (s.id === id ? { ...s, locked: !s.locked } : s)), texts, images);
    } else if (type === 'text') {
      commit(shapes, texts.map((t) => (t.id === id ? { ...t, locked: !t.locked } : t)), images);
    } else {
      commit(shapes, texts, images.map((im) => (im.id === id ? { ...im, locked: !im.locked } : im)));
    }
  }, [shapes, texts, images, commit]);

  const removeLayer = useCallback((id: string, type: LayerKind) => {
    if (type === 'shape') commit(shapes.filter((s) => s.id !== id), texts, images);
    else if (type === 'text') commit(shapes, texts.filter((t) => t.id !== id), images);
    else commit(shapes, texts, images.filter((im) => im.id !== id));
    if (selectedId === id) clearSelection();
  }, [shapes, texts, images, selectedId, commit, clearSelection]);

  const reorder = useCallback((id: string, type: LayerKind, dir: 1 | -1) => {
    const swap = <T extends { id: string }>(arr: T[]): T[] => {
      const i = arr.findIndex((x) => x.id === id);
      const j = i + dir;
      if (i < 0 || j < 0 || j >= arr.length) return arr;
      const copy = [...arr];
      [copy[i], copy[j]] = [copy[j], copy[i]];
      return copy;
    };
    if (type === 'shape') commit(swap(shapes), texts, images);
    else if (type === 'text') commit(shapes, swap(texts), images);
    else commit(shapes, texts, swap(images));
  }, [shapes, texts, images, commit]);

  return { toggleHidden, toggleLocked, removeLayer, reorder };
}

import { useEffect } from 'react';

export interface StampShortcutsConfig {
  editingTextId: string | null;
  selectedId: string | null;
  onCloseTextEditor: () => void;
  onClearSelection: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onDuplicate: () => void;
  onUndo: () => void;
  onRedo: () => void;
  onCloseEditor: () => void;
}

export function useStampShortcuts(config: StampShortcutsConfig) {
  const {
    editingTextId, selectedId,
    onCloseTextEditor, onClearSelection,
    onDelete, onDuplicate,
    onUndo, onRedo, onCloseEditor,
  } = config;

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const t = e.target as HTMLElement;
      const isField =
        t.tagName === 'INPUT' || t.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ||
        t.tagName === 'SELECT' || t.isContentEditable;
      const ctrl = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey;

      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (editingTextId) { onCloseTextEditor(); return; }
        if (selectedId) { onClearSelection(); return; }
        onCloseEditor();
        return;
      }
      if (isField) return;

      if ((e.key === 'Delete' || e.key === 'Backspace') && selectedId) {
        e.preventDefault(); onDelete();
      } else if (ctrl && e.code === 'KeyD' && selectedId) {
        e.preventDefault(); onDuplicate();
      } else if (ctrl && e.code === 'KeyZ' && !e.shiftKey) {
        e.preventDefault(); onUndo();
      } else if (ctrl && (e.code === 'KeyY' || (e.code === 'KeyZ' && e.shiftKey))) {
        e.preventDefault(); onRedo();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [
    editingTextId, selectedId,
    onCloseTextEditor, onClearSelection,
    onDelete, onDuplicate, onUndo, onRedo, onCloseEditor,
  ]);
}

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import type { StampShapeItem, StampTextItem, StampImageItem } from '../../types';

interface Snapshot {
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  texts: StampTextItem[];
  images: StampImageItem[];
}

interface Args {
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  texts: StampTextItem[];
  images: StampImageItem[];
  commit: (s: StampShapeItem[], t: StampTextItem[], i: StampImageItem[]) => void;
  replace: (next: Snapshot) => void;
}

export function useStampTextEditor({
  shapes, texts, images, commit, replace,
}: Args) {
  const [editingTextId, setEditingTextId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const openTextEditor = useCallback((id: string) => {
    if (editingTextId === id) return;
    commit(shapes, texts, images);
    setEditingTextId(id);
  }, [editingTextId, shapes, texts, images, commit]);

  const changeEditingText = useCallback((value: string) => {
    if (!editingTextId) return;
    replace({
      shapes,
      texts: texts.map((t) => (t.id === editingTextId ? { ...t, text: value } : t)),
      images,
    });
  }, [editingTextId, shapes, texts, images, replace]);

  const closeTextEditor = useCallback(() => {
    if (!editingTextId) return;
    commit(shapes, texts, images);
    setEditingTextId(null);
  }, [editingTextId, shapes, texts, images, commit]);

  return { editingTextId, openTextEditor, changeEditingText, closeTextEditor };
}

import { useCallback } from 'react';
import type { StampShapeItem, StampTextItem, StampImageItem } from '../../types';
import {
  MIN_ARC_SPAN_DEG,
  MAX_ARC_SPAN_DEG,

interface Args {

}

export function useStampTextUpdate({ shapes, texts, images, commit }: Args) {
  return useCallback((id: string, patch: Partial<StampTextItem>) => {
    const t = texts.find((x) => x.id === id);
    if (!t) {
      commit(shapes, texts.map((x) => (x.id === id ? { ...x, ...patch } : x)), images);
      return;
    }

    const merged: StampTextItem = { ...t, ...patch };

    if (merged.mode === 'arc') {
      /* ---------- Host lookup ---------- */
      let host: StampShapeItem | null = null;
      if (t.arcHostId) {
        host = shapes.find((s) => s.id === t.arcHostId) || null;
      }
      if (!host) {
        host = shapes.find((s) => {
          if (s.hidden || s.kind === 'line' || s.kind === 'fill') return false;
          return Math.abs(s.x + s.width / 2 - t.arcCx) < 1
              && Math.abs(s.y + s.height / 2 - t.arcCy) < 1;
        }) || null;
      }

      if (host) {
        const hostId = host.id;
        const baseR = Math.min(host.width, host.height) / 2;
        const arcOffset = Math.max(0, merged.arcOffset ?? DEFAULT_ARC_OFFSET);

        /* ---------- 1) arcOutside в†’ РїРµСЂРµСЃС‡РёС‚С‹РІР°РµРј СЂР°РґРёСѓСЃ ---------- */
        if ('arcOutside' in patch && Object.keys(patch).length === 1) {
          const isOutsideNew = !!merged.arcOutside;
          const newRadius =
            host.kind === 'rect' || host.kind === 'triangle'
              ? baseR
              : isOutsideNew
                ? baseR + arcOffset
                : Math.max(merged.fontSize * 0.8, baseR - arcOffset);

          commit(
            shapes,
            texts.map((x) => (x.id === id
              ? { ...x, ...patch, arcRadius: newRadius, arcHostId: hostId }
              : x)),
            images,
          );
          return;
        }

        /* ---------- 2) arcOffset / fontSize в†’ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ СЂР°РґРёСѓСЃ ---------- */
        if ('arcOffset' in patch || 'fontSize' in patch) {
          const isOutside = !!merged.arcOutside;
          const newRadius =
            host.kind === 'rect' || host.kind === 'triangle'
              ? baseR
              : isOutside
                ? baseR + arcOffset
                : Math.max(merged.fontSize * 0.8, baseR - arcOffset);

          commit(
            shapes,
            texts.map((x) => (x.id === id
              ? { ...x, ...patch, arcRadius: newRadius, arcHostId: hostId }
              : x)),
            images,
          );
          return;
        }

        /* ---------- 3) arcSpanDeg в†’ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ СѓРіР»С‹ ---------- */
        if ('arcSpanDeg' in patch) {
          const spanDeg = Math.min(
            MAX_ARC_SPAN_DEG,
            Math.max(MIN_ARC_SPAN_DEG, merged.arcSpanDeg ?? DEFAULT_ARC_SPAN_DEG),
          );
          const centerDeg = (t.arcStartDeg + t.arcEndDeg) / 2;
          const isTop = Math.sin((centerDeg * Math.PI) / 180) < 0;
          const half = spanDeg / 2;
          const startDeg = isTop ? centerDeg - half : centerDeg + half;
          const endDeg   = isTop ? centerDeg + half : centerDeg - half;

          commit(
            shapes,
            texts.map((x) => (x.id === id
              ? {
                  ...x,
                  ...patch,
                  arcSpanDeg: spanDeg,
                  arcStartDeg: startDeg,
                  arcEndDeg: endDeg,
                  arcHostId: hostId,
                  /* arcFlip РЅРµ С‚СЂРѕРіР°РµРј вЂ” СЃС‚РѕСЂРѕРЅР° РґСѓРіРё РЅРµ РјРµРЅСЏРµС‚СЃСЏ */
                }
              : x)),
            images,
          );
          return;
        }

        /* ---------- 4) СЂСѓС‡РЅР°СЏ РїСЂР°РІРєР° СѓРіР»РѕРІ ---------- */
        if ('arcStartDeg' in patch || 'arcEndDeg' in patch) {
          const span = Math.abs(merged.arcEndDeg - merged.arcStartDeg);
          commit(
            shapes,
            texts.map((x) => (x.id === id
              ? { ...x, ...patch, arcSpanDeg: span }
              : x)),
            images,
          );
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    /* ---------- Р’СЃС‘ РѕСЃС‚Р°Р»СЊРЅРѕРµ вЂ” РїСЂСЏРјР°СЏ Р·Р°РїРёСЃСЊ ---------- */
    commit(shapes, texts.map((x) => (x.id === id ? { ...x, ...patch } : x)), images);
  }, [shapes, texts, images, commit]);
}

import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import type {
  StampShapeItem, StampTextItem, StampShapeKind, StampImageItem,

import {
  createShape, createStraightText, createArcText,
  type FactoryContext,
} from '../../lib/stamps/factories';
import type { PlacementMode } from '../../lib/stamps/geometry';

type SelectionType = 'shape' | 'text' | 'image' | null;

interface Args {
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  texts: StampTextItem[];
  images: StampImageItem[];
  width: number;
  height: number;
  placementMode: PlacementMode;
  selectedId: string | null;
  selectedType: SelectionType;
  commit: (s: StampShapeItem[], t: StampTextItem[], i: StampImageItem[]) => void;
  select: (id: string | null, type: SelectionType) => void;
}

export function useStampToolbarActions({
  shapes, texts, images, width, height, placementMode,
  selectedId, selectedType,
  commit, select,
}: Args) {
  const ctx: FactoryContext = useMemo(() => ({
    shapes, selectedId, selectedType,
    stampW: width, stampH: height, placementMode,
  }), [shapes, selectedId, selectedType, width, height, placementMode]);

  const addShape = useCallback((kind: StampShapeKind) => {
    const s = createShape(kind, ctx);
    commit([...shapes, s], texts, images);
    select(s.id, 'shape');
  }, [ctx, shapes, texts, images, commit, select]);

  const addStraightText = useCallback(() => {
    const t = createStraightText(ctx);
    commit(shapes, [...texts, t], images);
    select(t.id, 'text');
  }, [ctx, shapes, texts, images, commit, select]);

  const addArcText = useCallback(() => {
    const t = createArcText(ctx);
    commit(shapes, [...texts, t], images);
    select(t.id, 'text');
  }, [ctx, shapes, texts, images, commit, select]);

  return { addShape, addStraightText, addArcText };
}

import { useCallback } from 'react';
import type Konva from 'konva';
import type { StampShapeItem, StampImageItem } from '../../types';
import { getShapeStrategy } from '../../lib/stamps/shapes';

type SelectionType = 'shape' | 'text' | 'image' | null;

interface Args {
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  images: StampImageItem[];
  selectedType: SelectionType;
  updateShape: (id: string, patch: Partial<StampShapeItem>) => void;
  updateImage: (id: string, patch: Partial<StampImageItem>) => void;
}

/**
 * Р›РѕРіРёРєР° onTransformEnd РґР»СЏ Konva.Transformer.
 * Р”Р»СЏ С„РёРіСѓСЂ РґРµР»РµРіРёСЂСѓРµС‚ РІ shape-strategy; РґР»СЏ РёР·РѕР±СЂР°Р¶РµРЅРёР№ вЂ” РїСЂРѕСЃС‚РѕР№ СЂРµСЃР°Р№Р·.
 */
export function useStampTransform({
  shapes, images, selectedType, updateShape, updateImage,
}: Args) {
  return useCallback((e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<Event>) => {
    const node = e.target;
    const id = node.id();
    const evt = e.evt as MouseEvent | undefined;
    const ctrl = !!(evt && (evt.ctrlKey || evt.metaKey));

    if (selectedType === 'shape') {
      const s = shapes.find((x) => x.id === id);
      if (!s || s.kind === 'fill') return;

      const strategy = getShapeStrategy(s.kind);
      const result = strategy.applyTransform({
        shape: s,
        nodeX: node.x(),
        nodeY: node.y(),
        nodeRotation: node.rotation(),
        scaleX: node.scaleX(),
        scaleY: node.scaleY(),
        ctrl,
        shapes,
      });

      if (result.resetScale) {
        node.scaleX(1);
        node.scaleY(1);
      }
      updateShape(id, result.patch);
      return;
    }

    if (selectedType === 'image') {
      const im = images.find((x) => x.id === id);
      if (!im) return;
      const nw = Math.max(8, im.width * node.scaleX());
      const nh = Math.max(8, im.height * node.scaleY());
      node.scaleX(1);
      node.scaleY(1);
      updateImage(id, {
        x: Math.round(node.x()),
        y: Math.round(node.y()),
        width: Math.round(nw),
        height: Math.round(nh),
      });
    }
  }, [shapes, images, selectedType, updateShape, updateImage]);
}

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import type Konva from 'konva';

const MIN_ZOOM = 0.4;
const MAX_ZOOM = 6;

export function useStampZoomPan(stageRef: React.RefObject<Konva.Stage>) {
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);
  const [pan, setPan] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  const onWheel = useCallback((e: Konva.KonvaEventObject<WheelEvent>) => {
    e.evt.preventDefault();
    const dir = e.evt.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1;
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (!stage) return;
    const oldZoom = zoom;
    const next = Math.max(MIN_ZOOM, Math.min(MAX_ZOOM, +(oldZoom + dir * 0.08).toFixed(3)));
    if (next === oldZoom) return;
    const pointer = stage.getPointerPosition();
    if (!pointer) { setZoom(next); return; }
    const mx = (pointer.x - pan.x) / oldZoom;
    const my = (pointer.y - pan.y) / oldZoom;
    setPan({ x: pointer.x - mx * next, y: pointer.y - my * next });
    setZoom(next);
  }, [stageRef, zoom, pan]);

  const zoomIn = useCallback(
    () => setZoom((z) => Math.min(MAX_ZOOM, +(z + 0.1).toFixed(2))),
    [],
  );
  const zoomOut = useCallback(
    () => setZoom((z) => Math.max(MIN_ZOOM, +(z - 0.1).toFixed(2))),
    [],
  );
  const zoomFit = useCallback(
    (wrapW: number, wrapH: number, stampW: number, stampH: number) => {
      const fitX = (wrapW - 60) / stampW;
      const fitY = (wrapH - 60) / stampH;
      setZoom(Math.min(MAX_ZOOM, Math.max(MIN_ZOOM, Math.min(fitX, fitY))));
      setPan({ x: 0, y: 0 });
    },
    [],
  );

  return { zoom, pan, setZoom, setPan, onWheel, zoomIn, zoomOut, zoomFit, MIN_ZOOM, MAX_ZOOM };
}

import { useEffect } from 'react';

interface Args {
  /** Ref РЅР° РєРѕРЅС‚РµР№РЅРµСЂ С…РѕР»СЃС‚Р° */
  wrapRef: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>;
  /** Р Р°Р·РјРµСЂ Р°РєС‚РёРІРЅРѕРіРѕ СЃР»Р°Р№РґР° */
  slideWidth: number;
  slideHeight: number;
  /** РўРµРєСѓС‰Р°СЏ С„СѓРЅРєС†РёСЏ СѓСЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІРєРё Р·СѓРјР° */
  setZoom: (z: number | ((prev: number) => number)) => void;
  /** РћС‚СЃС‚СѓРїС‹ РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРё wrap (СЃРѕРІРїР°РґР°СЋС‚ СЃ padding РІ CSS) */

  /** Р РµР·РµСЂРІ РїРѕРґ sticky zoom-bar */
  topReserve?: number;
  /** РњРёРЅРёРјР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ Рё РјР°РєСЃРёРјР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ Р·СѓРј */
  minZoom?: number;
  maxZoom?: number;
  /** РЎСЂР°Р±Р°С‚С‹РІР°РµС‚ Р»Рё Р°РІС‚Рѕ-С„РёС‚ РїСЂРё resize РѕРєРЅР° */

/**
 * РџРѕРґРіРѕРЅСЏРµС‚ zoom С‚Р°Рє, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ СЃР»Р°Р№Рґ С†РµР»РёРєРѕРј РІР»РµР·Р°Р» РІ РІРёРґРёРјСѓСЋ РѕР±Р»Р°СЃС‚СЊ С…РѕР»СЃС‚Р°.
 * Р Р°Р±РѕС‚Р°РµС‚:
 *  - РЅР° РјР°СѓРЅС‚
 *  - РїСЂРё СЃРјРµРЅРµ СЂР°Р·РјРµСЂР°/РѕСЂРёРµРЅС‚Р°С†РёРё СЃР»Р°Р№РґР°
 *  - РїСЂРё resize РѕРєРЅР° (РµСЃР»Рё refitOnResize = true)
 */
export function useAutoFitZoom({
  wrapRef,
  slideWidth,
  slideHeight,
  setZoom,
  padding = 40,
  topReserve = 60,
  minZoom = 0.2,
  maxZoom = 2,
  refitOnResize = true,
}: Args) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const wrap = wrapRef.current;
    if (!wrap || !slideWidth || !slideHeight) return;

    const fit = () => {
      const rect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
      const availableW = Math.max(100, rect.width - padding * 2);
      const availableH = Math.max(100, rect.height - padding * 2 - topReserve);

      const zoomX = availableW / slideWidth;
      const zoomY = availableH / slideHeight;
      const next = Math.max(minZoom, Math.min(maxZoom, Math.min(zoomX, zoomY)));

      setZoom(+next.toFixed(3));
    };

    // РџРµСЂРІС‹Р№ СЂР°СЃС‡С‘С‚ вЂ” СЃСЂР°Р·Сѓ
    fit();

    if (!refitOnResize) return;

    // РќР° resize вЂ” СЃ РЅРµР±РѕР»СЊС€РѕР№ Р·Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєРѕР№, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РЅРµ РґС‘СЂРіР°Р»РѕСЃСЊ
    let raf = 0;
    const onResize = () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(fit);
    };

    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize);
    };
  }, [wrapRef, slideWidth, slideHeight, setZoom, padding, topReserve, minZoom, maxZoom, refitOnResize]);
}

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import type { Slide, DataRoot } from '../types';

const KEY_SLIDES = 'ticket-editor:autosave:slides';
const KEY_DATA = 'ticket-editor:autosave:data';
const KEY_AT = 'ticket-editor:autosave:at';

const MAX_AGE_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

export function useAutoSave(
  slides: Slide[],
  data: DataRoot[],
  enabled = true,
) {
  const timerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;

    if (timerRef.current) window.clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    timerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY_SLIDES, JSON.stringify(slides));
        localStorage.setItem(KEY_DATA, JSON.stringify(data));
        localStorage.setItem(KEY_AT, Date.now().toString());
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[autosave] failed', e);
      }
    }, 2000);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) window.clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [slides, data, enabled]);
}

export interface RestoredSession {
  slides: Slide[];
  data: DataRoot[];
  savedAt: number;
}

export function loadAutoSave(): RestoredSession | null {
  try {
    const rawSlides = localStorage.getItem(KEY_SLIDES);
    const rawData = localStorage.getItem(KEY_DATA);
    const rawAt = localStorage.getItem(KEY_AT);
    if (!rawSlides || !rawAt) return null;

    const savedAt = parseInt(rawAt, 10);
    if (Number.isNaN(savedAt) || Date.now() - savedAt > MAX_AGE_MS) return null;

    return {
      slides: JSON.parse(rawSlides),
      data: rawData ? JSON.parse(rawData) : [],
      savedAt,
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function clearAutoSave(): void {
  try {
    localStorage.removeItem(KEY_SLIDES);
    localStorage.removeItem(KEY_DATA);
    localStorage.removeItem(KEY_AT);
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
}

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';

interface Args {
  wrapRef: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>;
  zoom: number;
  setZoom: (z: number | ((prev: number) => number)) => void;
  minZoom?: number;
  maxZoom?: number;
}

const STEP = 0.05;

interface PendingScroll {
  mx: number;
  my: number;
  oldScrollLeft: number;
  oldScrollTop: number;
  oldZoom: number;
}

/**
 * Ctrl+Wheel в†’ zoom Рє С‚РѕС‡РєРµ РїРѕРґ РєСѓСЂСЃРѕСЂРѕРј Р±РµР· РґС‘СЂРіР°РЅСЊСЏ.
 *
 *   вЂў wheel-handler С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ Р—РђРџРћРњРРќРђР•Рў СЃРѕСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёРµ Рё РїР»Р°РЅРёСЂСѓРµС‚ flush С‡РµСЂРµР· rAF;
 *   вЂў setZoom РІС‹Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РјР°РєСЃРёРјСѓРј СЂР°Р· РІ РєР°РґСЂ (throttle);
 *   вЂў scroll РїСЂРёРјРµРЅСЏРµС‚СЃСЏ РІ useLayoutEffect РґРѕ browser paint;
 *   вЂў force reflow РїРµСЂРµРґ СЂР°СЃС‡С‘С‚РѕРј вЂ” scrollWidth/Height Р°РєС‚СѓР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Рµ.
 */
export function useCanvasWheelZoom({
  wrapRef,
  zoom,
  setZoom,
  minZoom = 0.2,
  maxZoom = 2,
}: Args) {
  const zoomRef = useRef(zoom);
  zoomRef.current = zoom;

  const pendingRef = useRef<PendingScroll | null>(null);

  /* ---------- РќР°РєРѕРїР»РµРЅРёРµ wheel-СЃРѕР±С‹С‚РёР№ ---------- */
  const pendingDeltaRef = useRef(0);      // РЅР°РєРѕРїР»РµРЅРЅС‹Р№ deltaY
  const pendingMouseRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const rafRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  /* ---------- РџСЂРёРјРµРЅРµРЅРёРµ scroll РїРѕСЃР»Рµ setZoom ---------- */
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const pending = pendingRef.current;
    if (!pending) return;
    pendingRef.current = null;

    const wrap = wrapRef.current;
    if (!wrap) return;

    /* Force reflow вЂ” С‡РёС‚Р°РµРј СЂР°Р·РјРµСЂС‹ РїРѕСЃР»Рµ СЃРјРµРЅС‹ zoom */
    void wrap.scrollWidth;
    void wrap.clientWidth;

    const ratio = zoomRef.current / pending.oldZoom;
    const maxX = Math.max(0, wrap.scrollWidth - wrap.clientWidth);
    const maxY = Math.max(0, wrap.scrollHeight - wrap.clientHeight);
    if (maxX === 0 && maxY === 0) return;

    const contentX = pending.oldScrollLeft + pending.mx;
    const contentY = pending.oldScrollTop + pending.my;

    let newScrollLeft = contentX * ratio - pending.mx;
    let newScrollTop = contentY * ratio - pending.my;

    newScrollLeft = Math.max(0, Math.min(newScrollLeft, maxX));
    newScrollTop = Math.max(0, Math.min(newScrollTop, maxY));

    const fx = Math.round(newScrollLeft);
    const fy = Math.round(newScrollTop);

    if (wrap.scrollLeft !== fx) wrap.scrollLeft = fx;
    if (wrap.scrollTop !== fy) wrap.scrollTop = fy;
  }, [zoom, wrapRef]);

  /* ---------- Wheel-handler + rAF flush ---------- */
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = wrapRef.current;
    if (!el) return;

    const flush = () => {
      rafRef.current = null;
      const delta = pendingDeltaRef.current;
      if (delta === 0) return;
      pendingDeltaRef.current = 0;

      const oldZoom = zoomRef.current;
      const direction = delta < 0 ? 1 : -1;

      /* РЎРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ СЃС‚СѓРїРµРЅРµР№ РїСЂРёРјРµРЅРёС‚СЊ Р·Р° РєР°РґСЂ вЂ” РїСЂРѕРїРѕСЂС†РёРѕРЅР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ СЃРёР»Рµ wheel */
      const steps = Math.max(1, Math.min(4, Math.round(Math.abs(delta) / 100)));
      const raw = oldZoom + direction * STEP * steps;
      const next = Math.max(minZoom, Math.min(maxZoom, +raw.toFixed(3)));
      if (next === oldZoom) return;

      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();

      pendingRef.current = {
        mx: pendingMouseRef.current.x - rect.left,
        my: pendingMouseRef.current.y - rect.top,
        oldScrollLeft: el.scrollLeft,
        oldScrollTop: el.scrollTop,
        oldZoom,
      };

      setZoom(next);
    };

    const onWheel = (e: WheelEvent) => {
      if (!e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();

      pendingDeltaRef.current += e.deltaY;
      pendingMouseRef.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };

      if (rafRef.current === null) {
        rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(flush);
      }
    };

    const onGesture = (e: Event) => e.preventDefault();

    el.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false, capture: true });
    el.addEventListener('gesturestart', onGesture, { passive: false } as any);
    el.addEventListener('gesturechange', onGesture, { passive: false } as any);

    return () => {
      if (rafRef.current !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
      rafRef.current = null;
      el.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { capture: true } as any);
      el.removeEventListener('gesturestart', onGesture as any);
      el.removeEventListener('gesturechange', onGesture as any);
    };
  }, [wrapRef, setZoom, minZoom, maxZoom]);
}

import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { CanvasElement, AnchorSide, ConnectorElement } from '../types';
import {
  findElementAt,
  findNearestAnchor,
  getAnchorPoint,
  computeGhostRect,
  nearestAnchorForSource,
  cloneForConnector,
  type Rect,
} from '../lib/connectors';
import { uid } from '../lib/uid';

export interface ConnectorDraft {
  fromId: string;
  fromAnchor: AnchorSide;
  mouseX: number;
  mouseY: number;
  hoverTargetId: string | null;
  hoverTargetAnchor: AnchorSide | null;
}

interface Args {
  elements: CanvasElement[];
  /** Р”РѕР±Р°РІРёС‚СЊ РѕРґРёРЅ РёР»Рё РЅРµСЃРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚РѕРІ Р±РµР· РІС‹РґРµР»РµРЅРёСЏ (РѕРґРёРЅ setSlides). */
  addElementsSilently: (els: CanvasElement[]) => void;
  /** РљР°СЃС‚РѕРјРЅР°СЏ С„Р°Р±СЂРёРєР° РЅРѕРІРѕРіРѕ СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚Р°. РџРѕ СѓРјРѕР»С‡Р°РЅРёСЋ вЂ” cloneForConnector. */
  makeNewElement?: (rect: Rect, source: CanvasElement) => CanvasElement;
}

export function useConnectorDraft({
  elements,
  addElementsSilently,
  makeNewElement,
}: Args) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<ConnectorDraft | null>(null);

  const startDraft = useCallback(
    (fromId: string, fromAnchor: AnchorSide, worldX: number, worldY: number) => {
      setDraft({
        fromId,
        fromAnchor,
        mouseX: worldX,
        mouseY: worldY,
        hoverTargetId: null,
        hoverTargetAnchor: null,
      });
    },
    [],
  );

  const moveDraft = useCallback(
    (worldX: number, worldY: number) => {
      setDraft((d) => {
        if (!d) return d;
        const target = findElementAt(elements, worldX, worldY, [d.fromId]);
        if (!target) {
          return {
            ...d,
            mouseX: worldX, mouseY: worldY,
            hoverTargetId: null,
            hoverTargetAnchor: null,
          };
        }
        const near = findNearestAnchor(target, worldX, worldY);
        return {
          ...d,
          mouseX: worldX, mouseY: worldY,
          hoverTargetId: target.id,
          hoverTargetAnchor: near.side,
        };
      });
    },
    [elements],
  );

  const commitDraft = useCallback(() => {
    setDraft((d) => {
      if (!d) return null;

      // ---- Р’РµС‚РєР° 1: СЃРІСЏР·СЊ СЃ СЃСѓС‰РµСЃС‚РІСѓСЋС‰РёРј СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚РѕРј ----
      if (d.hoverTargetId && d.hoverTargetAnchor) {
        const conn: ConnectorElement = {
          id: uid(),
          type: 'connector',
          x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0, rotation: 0,
          fromId: d.fromId,
          fromAnchor: d.fromAnchor,
          toId: d.hoverTargetId,
          toAnchor: d.hoverTargetAnchor,
          stroke: '#1e40af',
          strokeWidth: 2,
          dash: 'solid',
          isArrow: true,
          routing: 'orthogonal',
        };
        addElementsSilently([conn]);
        return null;
      }

      // ---- Р’РµС‚РєР° 2: pull-to-create ----
      const source = elements.find((e) => e.id === d.fromId);
      if (!source) return null;

      const rect = computeGhostRect(source, d.fromAnchor, d.mouseX, d.mouseY);
      const newEl = makeNewElement
        ? makeNewElement(rect, source)
        : cloneForConnector(rect, source);

      const newSide = nearestAnchorForSource(rect, source);

      const conn: ConnectorElement = {
        id: uid(),
        type: 'connector',
        x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0, rotation: 0,
        fromId: d.fromId,
        fromAnchor: d.fromAnchor,
        toId: newEl.id,
        toAnchor: newSide,
        stroke: '#1e40af',
        strokeWidth: 2,
        dash: 'solid',
        isArrow: true,
        routing: 'orthogonal',
      };

      // РћРґРёРЅ Р±Р°С‚С‡ вЂ” РѕРґРёРЅ setSlides в†’ РѕРґРЅР° Р·Р°РїРёСЃСЊ РІ РёСЃС‚РѕСЂРёРё.
      addElementsSilently([newEl, conn]);
      return null;
    });
  }, [elements, addElementsSilently, makeNewElement]);

  const cancelDraft = useCallback(() => setDraft(null), []);

  return { draft, startDraft, moveDraft, commitDraft, cancelDraft };
}

/* ============================================================
   РҐРµР»РїРµСЂС‹ РґР»СЏ СЂРµРЅРґРµСЂР° РїСЂРµРІСЊСЋ
   ============================================================ */

export function previewPoints(
  draft: ConnectorDraft,
  elements: CanvasElement[],
): number[] | null {
  const from = elements.find((e) => e.id === draft.fromId);
  if (!from) return null;

  const a = getAnchorPoint(from, draft.fromAnchor);

  let bx = draft.mouseX;
  let by = draft.mouseY;

  if (draft.hoverTargetId && draft.hoverTargetAnchor) {
    const target = elements.find((e) => e.id === draft.hoverTargetId);
    if (target) {
      const p = getAnchorPoint(target, draft.hoverTargetAnchor);
      bx = p.x;
      by = p.y;
    }
  }

  return [a.x, a.y, bx, by];
}

export function ghostRectForDraft(
  draft: ConnectorDraft,
  elements: CanvasElement[],
): Rect | null {
  if (draft.hoverTargetId) return null;
  const source = elements.find((e) => e.id === draft.fromId);
  if (!source) return null;
  return computeGhostRect(source, draft.fromAnchor, draft.mouseX, draft.mouseY);
}

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import type { DataRoot, Slide } from '../types';
import { resolveSample } from '../lib/resolveSample';

export function useDataModel(
  slides: Slide[],
  setSlides: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Slide[]>>,
) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<DataRoot[]>([]);
  const initialised = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!data.length) return;
    setSlides((prev) => {
      let anyChanged = false;
      const next = prev.map((s) => {
        let changed = false;
        const elements = s.elements.map((el) => {
          if (el.type === 'placeholder' && el.fieldPath) {
            const resolved = resolveSample(data, el.fieldPath);
            if (resolved !== null && resolved !== el.sample) {
              changed = true;
              return { ...el, sample: resolved };
            }
          }
          return el;
        });
        if (!changed) return s;
        anyChanged = true;
        return { ...s, elements };
      });
      return anyChanged ? next : prev;
    });
  }, [data, setSlides]);

  useEffect(() => { initialised.current = true; }, []);

  return { data, setData };
}

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import type { EditorApi } from './useEditor';
import type { CanvasElement, DataFieldType } from '../types';
import { findElementAt } from '../lib/geometry';
import {
  newText, newSimpleText, newFooter, newTable, newLine, newShape, newStamp,
  makePlaceholder, makeArrayTable,
} from '../lib/factories';
import { newStampFromTemplate } from '../lib/stamps/factories';

export function useDropHandler(editor: EditorApi) {
  const [dragOver, setDragOver] = useState(false);

  const onDragOver = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'copy';
    setDragOver(true);
  }, []);

  const onDragLeave = useCallback(() => setDragOver(false), []);

  const onDrop = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setDragOver(false);

    const raw = e.dataTransfer.getData('application/json');
    if (!raw) return;

    try {
      const payload = JSON.parse(raw);
      const stage = editor.stageRef.current;
      if (!stage) return;

      const rect = stage.container().getBoundingClientRect();
      const zoom = editor.zoom;
      const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) / zoom;
      const y = (e.clientY - rect.top) / zoom;

      /* ---------- РЁС‚Р°РјРї РёР· Р±РёР±Р»РёРѕС‚РµРєРё ---------- */
      if (payload.kind === 'stamp-template' && payload.template) {
        const tpl = payload.template;
        const el = newStampFromTemplate(
          tpl,
          Math.max(0, x - tpl.width / 2),
          Math.max(0, y - tpl.height / 2),
        );
        editor.addElementWithHistory(el);
        return;
      }

      /* ---------- РЁС‚Р°РјРї РёР· РјР°СЃСЃРёРІР° РґР°РЅРЅС‹С… ---------- */
      if (payload.kind === 'array') {
        editor.addElementWithHistory(makeArrayTable(x, y, payload));
        return;
      }

      /* ---------- РџРѕР»Рµ РёР· РґР°РЅРЅС‹С… ---------- */
      if (payload.kind === 'field') {
        const target = findElementAt(editor.activeSlide, x, y);
        if (target && target.type === 'text') {
          const path = `{{${payload.path}}}`;
          const oldText = target.text || '';
          const sep = oldText.length && !/[\s\n]$/.test(oldText) ? ' ' : '';
          editor.updateWithHistory(target.id, { text: oldText + sep + path });
          editor.setSelectedIds([target.id]);
          return;
        }
        editor.addElementWithHistory(
          makePlaceholder(x, y, payload.path, payload.fieldType as DataFieldType, payload.sample),
        );
        return;
      }

      /* ---------- РќРѕРІС‹Р№ СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚ СЃ Р»РµРІРѕР№ РїР°РЅРµР»Рё ---------- */
      if (payload.kind === 'new-element') {
        const t = payload.elementType as string;
        const cx = Math.max(0, x - 100);
        const cy = Math.max(0, y - 60);
        let el: CanvasElement | null = null;

        if (t === 'text') el = newText(cx, cy);
        else if (t === 'simple-text') el = newSimpleText(cx, cy);

        else if (t === 'footer') {
          const slide = editor.activeSlide;
          const f = newFooter(slide);
          const minY = slide.padding.top;
          const maxY = slide.height - slide.padding.bottom - f.height;
          f.y = Math.min(maxY, Math.max(minY, y));
          el = f;
        }

        else if (t === 'table') el = newTable(cx, cy);
        else if (t === 'line') el = newLine(cx, cy);
        else if (t === 'line-arrow') { const l = newLine(cx, cy); l.isArrow = true; el = l; }
        else if (t === 'rect') el = newShape('rect', cx, cy);
        else if (t === 'roundRect') el = newShape('roundRect', cx, cy);
        else if (t === 'circle') el = newShape('circle', cx, cy);
        else if (t === 'triangle') el = newShape('triangle', cx, cy);
        else if (t === 'star') el = newShape('star', cx, cy);
        else if (t === 'stamp-circle') el = newStamp('circle', cx, cy);
        else if (t === 'stamp-oval') el = newStamp('oval', cx, cy);
        else if (t === 'stamp-rect') el = newStamp('rect', cx, cy);
        else if (t === 'stamp-triangle') el = newStamp('triangle', cx, cy);

        if (el) editor.addElementWithHistory(el);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Drop parse error', err);
    }
  }, [editor]);

  return { dragOver, onDragOver, onDragLeave, onDrop };
}

import { useCallback } from 'react';
import type { CanvasElement, LineElement } from '../types';
import type { useHistory } from './useHistory';
import type { EditorViewApi } from './useEditorView';

interface SlidesApi {
  slides: any[];
  activeId: string;
  activeSlide: any;
  setSlides: (s: any[]) => void;
  moveLayer: (id: string, dir: 1 | -1) => void;
}

interface SelectionApi {
  selectedIds: string[];
  selectedId: string | null;
  setSelectedIds: (ids: string[]) => void;
  clear: () => void;
}

interface Args {
  slides: SlidesApi;
  selection: SelectionApi;
  history: ReturnType<typeof useHistory>;
  view: EditorViewApi;
}

/**
 * РћРїРµСЂР°С†РёРё СЃ СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚Р°РјРё Р°РєС‚РёРІРЅРѕРіРѕ СЃР»Р°Р№РґР°:
 * update, add, remove, moveLayer, anchors.
 */
export function useEditorActions({ slides, selection, history, view }: Args) {
  const removeSelected = useCallback(() => {
    if (!selection.selectedIds.length) return;
    const newSlides = slides.slides.map((s) =>
      s.id !== slides.activeId
        ? s
        : { ...s, elements: s.elements.filter((e: CanvasElement) => !selection.selectedIds.includes(e.id)) },
    );
    slides.setSlides(newSlides);
    history.push(newSlides, slides.activeId);
    selection.clear();
    view.setFloatingPos(null);
  }, [selection, slides, history, view]);

  const updateWithHistory = useCallback((id: string, patch: Partial<CanvasElement>) => {
    const newSlides = slides.slides.map((s) =>
      s.id !== slides.activeId
        ? s
        : {
            ...s,
            elements: s.elements.map((el: CanvasElement) =>
              el.id === id ? ({ ...el, ...patch } as CanvasElement) : el,
            ),
          },
    );
    slides.setSlides(newSlides);
    history.push(newSlides, slides.activeId);
  }, [slides, history]);

  const addElementWithHistory = useCallback((el: CanvasElement) => {
    const newSlides = slides.slides.map((s) =>
      s.id !== slides.activeId ? s : { ...s, elements: [...s.elements, el] },
    );
    slides.setSlides(newSlides);
    selection.setSelectedIds([el.id]);
    history.push(newSlides, slides.activeId);
  }, [slides, selection, history]);

  const moveLayer = useCallback((dir: 1 | -1) => {
    if (!selection.selectedId) return;
    slides.moveLayer(selection.selectedId, dir);
  }, [selection.selectedId, slides]);

  const updateSelected = useCallback((patch: Partial<CanvasElement>) => {
    if (!selection.selectedId) return;
    updateWithHistory(selection.selectedId, patch);
  }, [selection.selectedId, updateWithHistory]);

  const appendAnchor = useCallback((el: LineElement) => {
    const pts = el.points && el.points.length >= 4
      ? el.points
      : [0, el.height / 2, el.width, el.height / 2];
    const lastX = pts[pts.length - 2];
    const lastY = pts[pts.length - 1];
    const prevX = pts[pts.length - 4];
    const prevY = pts[pts.length - 3];
    const dx = lastX - prevX;
    const dy = lastY - prevY;
    updateWithHistory(el.id, { points: [...pts, lastX + dx, lastY + dy] });
  }, [updateWithHistory]);

  const removeLastAnchor = useCallback((el: LineElement) => {
    const pts = el.points && el.points.length >= 4 ? el.points : [];
    if (pts.length <= 4) return;
    updateWithHistory(el.id, { points: pts.slice(0, pts.length - 2) });
  }, [updateWithHistory]);

  return {
    removeSelected,
    updateWithHistory,
    addElementWithHistory,
    moveLayer,
    updateSelected,
    appendAnchor,
    removeLastAnchor,
  };
}

export type EditorActionsApi = ReturnType<typeof useEditorActions>;

import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { CanvasElement } from '../types';
import { uid } from '../lib/uid';
import type { useHistory } from './useHistory';
import type { EditorViewApi } from './useEditorView';
import type { EditorActionsApi } from './useEditorActions';

interface SlidesApi {
  slides: any[];
  activeId: string;
  activeSlide: any;
  setSlides: (s: any[]) => void;
}

interface SelectionApi {
  selectedIds: string[];
  selectedId: string | null;
  selected: CanvasElement | null;
  setSelectedIds: (ids: string[]) => void;
}

interface Args {
  slides: SlidesApi;
  selection: SelectionApi;
  history: ReturnType<typeof useHistory>;
  view: EditorViewApi;
  actions: EditorActionsApi;
}

const PASTE_OFFSET = 20;

/**
 * Р‘СѓС„РµСЂ РѕР±РјРµРЅР° Рё СЃС‚РёР»СЊ: copy / cut / paste / duplicate / copyStyle / applyStyle.
 */
export function useEditorClipboard({ slides, selection, history, view, actions }: Args) {
  const [clipboard, setClipboard] = useState<CanvasElement[]>([]);

  const copy = useCallback(() => {
    const els = slides.activeSlide.elements.filter((el: CanvasElement) =>
      selection.selectedIds.includes(el.id),
    );
    if (els.length) setClipboard(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(els)));
  }, [slides.activeSlide, selection.selectedIds]);

  const cut = useCallback(() => {
    const els = slides.activeSlide.elements.filter((el: CanvasElement) =>
      selection.selectedIds.includes(el.id),
    );
    if (els.length) {
      setClipboard(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(els)));
      actions.removeSelected();
    }
  }, [slides.activeSlide, selection.selectedIds, actions]);

  const paste = useCallback(() => {
    if (!clipboard.length) return;
    const pasted = clipboard.map((el) => ({
      ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(el)),
      id: uid(),
      x: el.x + PASTE_OFFSET,
      y: el.y + PASTE_OFFSET,
    }));
    const newSlides = slides.slides.map((s) =>
      s.id !== slides.activeId ? s : { ...s, elements: [...s.elements, ...pasted] },
    );
    slides.setSlides(newSlides);
    selection.setSelectedIds(pasted.map((el) => el.id));
    history.push(newSlides, slides.activeId);
  }, [clipboard, slides, selection, history]);

  const duplicate = useCallback(() => {
    const els = slides.activeSlide.elements.filter((el: CanvasElement) =>
      selection.selectedIds.includes(el.id),
    );
    if (!els.length) return;
    const pasted = els.map((el: CanvasElement) => ({
      ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(el)),
      id: uid(),
      x: el.x + PASTE_OFFSET,
      y: el.y + PASTE_OFFSET,
    }));
    const newSlides = slides.slides.map((s) =>
      s.id !== slides.activeId ? s : { ...s, elements: [...s.elements, ...pasted] },
    );
    slides.setSlides(newSlides);
    selection.setSelectedIds(pasted.map((el) => el.id));
    history.push(newSlides, slides.activeId);
  }, [slides, selection, history]);

  const copyStyle = useCallback(() => {
    const el = selection.selected;
    if (!el) return;
    const { id, x, y, rotation, type, ...style } = el as any;
    view.setCopiedStyle(style);
  }, [selection.selected, view]);

  const applyStyle = useCallback(() => {
    if (!selection.selectedId || !view.copiedStyle) return;
    actions.updateWithHistory(selection.selectedId, view.copiedStyle);
    view.setCopiedStyle(null);
  }, [selection.selectedId, view, actions]);

  return { copy, cut, paste, duplicate, copyStyle, applyStyle };
}

export type EditorClipboardApi = ReturnType<typeof useEditorClipboard>;

import { useCallback } from 'react';
import type { Slide } from '../types';
import type { useHistory } from './useHistory';
import type { EditorViewApi } from './useEditorView';

interface SlidesApi {
  slides: Slide[];
  activeId: string;
  setSlides: (s: Slide[]) => void;
  setActiveId: (id: string) => void;
}

interface SelectionApi {
  clear: () => void;
}

interface Args {
  slides: SlidesApi;
  selection: SelectionApi;
  history: ReturnType<typeof useHistory>;
  view: EditorViewApi;
}

/**
 * Undo / redo. РћС‚РґРµР»РµРЅРѕ, РїРѕС‚РѕРјСѓ С‡С‚Рѕ СЌС‚Рѕ РѕС‚РґРµР»СЊРЅР°СЏ РѕРїРµСЂР°С†РёСЏ,
 * РєРѕС‚РѕСЂР°СЏ РѕС‡РёС‰Р°РµС‚ РІС‹РґРµР»РµРЅРёРµ Рё СЃР±СЂР°СЃС‹РІР°РµС‚ РЅР°РїСЂР°РІР»СЏСЋС‰РёРµ.
 */
export function useEditorHistory({ slides, selection, history, view }: Args) {
  const undo = useCallback(() => {
    const prev = history.undo();
    if (!prev) return;
    slides.setSlides(prev.slides);
    slides.setActiveId(prev.activeId);
    selection.clear();
    view.clearGuides();
  }, [history, slides, selection, view]);

  const redo = useCallback(() => {
    const next = history.redo();
    if (!next) return;
    slides.setSlides(next.slides);
    slides.setActiveId(next.activeId);
    selection.clear();
    view.clearGuides();
  }, [history, slides, selection, view]);

  return {
    undo,
    redo,
    canUndo: history.canUndo,
    canRedo: history.canRedo,
  };
}

import { useCallback } from 'react';
import type { Slide, CanvasElement, DataRoot } from '../types';

import { buildSvg } from '../services/svgExport';

import { download } from '../lib/download';
import { loadImage, makeImageTransparent, fitImageSize } from '../lib/imageTools';
import { embedImagesInSlide } from '../services/embedImages';
import { clearAutoSave } from './useAutoSave';

const EXPORT_API = 'http://localhost:8080/api/export';

interface Args {
  slides: Slide[];
  setSlides: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Slide[]>>;
  activeId: string;
  setActiveId: (id: string) => void;
  activeSlide: Slide;
  data: DataRoot[];
  setData: (d: DataRoot[]) => void;
  addElementWithHistory: (el: CanvasElement) => void;
  onImported?: () => void;
}

export interface AddImageOptions {
  centered?: boolean;
  transparent?: boolean;
  keyColor?: string | 'auto';
  tolerance?: number;
}

function downloadBlob(blob: Blob, filename: string): void {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

export function useFileIO({
  slides, setSlides, activeId, setActiveId, activeSlide,
  data, setData, addElementWithHistory, onImported,
}: Args) {

  /* ---------- JSON ---------- */

  const exportJson = useCallback(() => {
    const payload = {
      version: '1.5',
      exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      data,
      slides,
    };
    download(JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2), 'template.json', 'application/json');
    clearAutoSave();
  }, [slides, data]);

  const importJson = useCallback(() => {
    const input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'file';
    input.accept = '.json,application/json';
    input.onchange = () => {
      const file = input.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = () => {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(reader.result as string);
          let importedSlides: Slide[];
          if (Array.isArray(parsed)) importedSlides = parsed;
          else if (parsed && Array.isArray(parsed.slides)) importedSlides = parsed.slides;
          else throw new Error('РќРµ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅС‹ slides');
          if (!importedSlides.length) throw new Error('Р¤Р°Р№Р» РїСѓСЃС‚РѕР№');

          importedSlides = importedSlides.map((s: any) => ({
            id: s.id || uid(),
            name: s.name || 'РЎС‚СЂР°РЅРёС†Р°',
            format: s.format || 'a4',
            orientation: s.orientation || 'portrait',
            width: s.width || A4.width,
            height: s.height || A4.height,
            background: s.background || '#ffffff',
            backgroundImage: s.backgroundImage,
            padding: s.padding || { ...DEFAULT_PADDING },
            elements: Array.isArray(s.elements)
              ? s.elements.map((el: any) => {
                  if (el.type === 'stamp') {
                    return {
                      ...el,
                      topFontSize: el.topFontSize ?? 14,
                      centerFontSize: el.centerFontSize ?? 20,
                      bottomFontSize: el.bottomFontSize ?? 12,
                    };
                  }
                  if (el.type === 'text' || el.type === 'placeholder') {
                    return {
                      ...el,
                      verticalAlign: el.verticalAlign || 'top',
                      lineHeight: el.lineHeight || 1.2,
                      padding: el.padding || { top: 4, right: 4, bottom: 4, left: 4 },
                      background: el.background || 'transparent',
                    };
                  }
                  return el;
                })
              : [],
          }));

          setSlides(importedSlides);
          setActiveId(importedSlides[0].id);
          if (parsed.data && Array.isArray(parsed.data)) setData(parsed.data);
          onImported?.();
        } catch (e: any) {
          alert('РћС€РёР±РєР° РёРјРїРѕСЂС‚Р°: ' + (e?.message || e));
        }
      };
      reader.readAsText(file);
    };
    input.click();
  }, [setSlides, setActiveId, setData, onImported]);

  /* ---------- SVG Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ (fallback) ---------- */

  const exportSvg = useCallback(() => {
    const svg = buildSvg(activeSlide);
    download(svg, `${activeSlide.name || 'page'}.svg`, 'image/svg+xml');
  }, [activeSlide]);

  /* ---------- SVG С‡РµСЂРµР· СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂ ---------- */

  const exportSvgServer = useCallback(async () => {
    const preparedSlide = await embedImagesInSlide(activeSlide);

    const payload = {
      slides: [preparedSlide],
      options: {
        embedImages: true,
        prettyPrint: false,
      },
    };

    const res = await fetch(`${EXPORT_API}/svg`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const errText = await res.text().catch(() => '');
      throw new Error(`SVG export failed: ${res.status}. ${errText}`);
    }

    const blob = await res.blob();
    downloadBlob(blob, `${activeSlide.name || 'page'}.svg`);
  }, [activeSlide]);

  /* ---------- PDF/A С‡РµСЂРµР· СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂ ---------- */

  const exportPdfaServer = useCallback(async () => {
    const preparedSlide = await embedImagesInSlide(activeSlide);

    const payload = {
      slides: [preparedSlide],
      options: {
        embedImages: true,
        pdfVersion: 'pdf/a-2b',
      },
    };

    const res = await fetch(`${EXPORT_API}/pdf?mode=pdfa`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const errText = await res.text().catch(() => '');
      throw new Error(`PDF/A export failed: ${res.status}. ${errText}`);
    }

    const blob = await res.blob();
    downloadBlob(blob, `${activeSlide.name || 'page'}.pdf`);
  }, [activeSlide]);

  /* ---------- РР·РѕР±СЂР°Р¶РµРЅРёСЏ ---------- */

  const addImage = useCallback((opts: AddImageOptions = {}) => {
    const input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'file';
    input.accept = 'image/*';
    input.onchange = () => {
      const file = input.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = async () => {
        let src = reader.result as string;

        if (opts.transparent) {
          try {
            src = await makeImageTransparent(src, {
              keyColor: opts.keyColor ?? 'auto',
              tolerance: opts.tolerance ?? 30,
            });
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Transparent conversion failed, inserting original.', e);
          }
        }

        let nw = 200;
        let nh = 200;
        try {
          const img = await loadImage(src);
          nw = img.naturalWidth || 200;
          nh = img.naturalHeight || 200;
        } catch { /* ignore */ }

        const { width, height } = fitImageSize(
          nw, nh,
          activeSlide.width, activeSlide.height,
          opts.centered ? 0.7 : 1,
        );

        const x = opts.centered
          ? Math.round((activeSlide.width - width) / 2)
          : 100;
        const y = opts.centered
          ? Math.round((activeSlide.height - height) / 2)
          : 100;

        addElementWithHistory({
          id: uid(),
          type: 'image',
          x, y,
          width, height,
          rotation: 0,
          src,
        });
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    };
    input.click();
  }, [addElementWithHistory, activeSlide]);

  const setBackgroundImage = useCallback(() => {
    const input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'file';
    input.accept = 'image/*';
    input.onchange = () => {
      const file = input.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = () => {
        setSlides((prev) =>
          prev.map((s) =>
            s.id !== activeId ? s : { ...s, backgroundImage: reader.result as string },
          ),
        );
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    };
    input.click();
  }, [activeId, setSlides]);

  const removeBackgroundImage = useCallback(() => {
    if (!activeSlide.backgroundImage) return;
    setSlides((prev) =>
      prev.map((s) =>
        s.id !== activeId ? s : { ...s, backgroundImage: undefined },
      ),
    );
  }, [activeId, activeSlide.backgroundImage, setSlides]);

  return {
    exportJson,
    importJson,
    exportSvg,
    exportSvgServer,
    exportPdfaServer,
    addImage,
    setBackgroundImage,
    removeBackgroundImage,
  };
}

import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { Slide, CanvasElement, FillElement } from '../types';
import { hitShapeEl } from '../lib/geometry';
import { uid } from '../lib/uid';

interface Args {
  activeSlide: Slide;
  updateElement: (id: string, patch: Partial<CanvasElement>) => void;
  addElement: (el: CanvasElement) => void;
  pointerPos: () => { x: number; y: number };
  onElementSelected?: (id: string) => void;
}

export function useFillMode({ activeSlide, updateElement, addElement, pointerPos, onElementSelected }: Args) {
  const [fillMode, setFillMode] = useState(false);
  const [fillColor, setFillColor] = useState('#fbbf24');
  const [points, setPoints] = useState<number[]>([]);

  const findShapeAt = useCallback((x: number, y: number): CanvasElement | null => {
    for (let i = activeSlide.elements.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const el = activeSlide.elements[i];
      if (hitShapeEl(el, x, y)) return el;
    }
    return null;
  }, [activeSlide]);

  const handleClick = useCallback((onEmpty: () => void): boolean => {
    if (!fillMode) return false;
    const pos = pointerPos();
    const target = findShapeAt(pos.x, pos.y);
    if (target && (target.type === 'shape' || target.type === 'fill')) {
      updateElement(target.id, { fill: fillColor });
      onElementSelected?.(target.id);
      return true;
    }
    onEmpty();
    setPoints((prev) => [...prev, pos.x, pos.y]);
    return true;
  }, [fillMode, fillColor, findShapeAt, updateElement, pointerPos, onElementSelected]);

  const closePolygon = useCallback(() => {
    if (points.length < 6) { setPoints([]); return; }
    const xs: number[] = [];
    const ys: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i += 2) {
      xs.push(points[i]);
      ys.push(points[i + 1]);
    }
    const minX = Math.min(...xs);
    const minY = Math.min(...ys);
    const maxX = Math.max(...xs);
    const maxY = Math.max(...ys);
    const rel = points.map((v, i) => (i % 2 === 0 ? v - minX : v - minY));

    const el: FillElement = {
      id: uid(), type: 'fill',
      x: minX, y: minY,
      width: Math.max(1, maxX - minX),
      height: Math.max(1, maxY - minY),
      rotation: 0,
      points: rel,
      fill: fillColor,
      stroke: '',
      strokeWidth: 0,
      opacity: 1,
    };
    addElement(el);
    setPoints([]);
  }, [points, fillColor, addElement]);

  const cancel = useCallback(() => setPoints([]), []);

  return { fillMode, setFillMode, fillColor, setFillColor, points, handleClick, closePolygon, cancel };
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { StampShapeItem } from '../types';
import type { FillSpec } from '../lib/stamps/rasterFill';

interface WorkerResult {
  key: string;
  url: string | null;
}

export function useFillWorker() {
  const workerRef = useRef<Worker | null>(null);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<WorkerResult | null>(null);
  const pendingKeyRef = useRef<string>('');
  const seqRef = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const worker = new Worker(
      new URL('../workers/fillWorker.ts', import.meta.url),
      { type: 'module' },
    );

    worker.onmessage = (e: MessageEvent<{ seq: number; url: string | null }>) => {
      if (e.data.seq !== seqRef.current) return;
      setResult({ key: pendingKeyRef.current, url: e.data.url });
    };

    worker.onerror = (err) => {
      console.error('[fillWorker] error', err);
    };

    workerRef.current = worker;
    return () => {
      worker.terminate();
      workerRef.current = null;
    };
  }, []);

  const rasterize = useCallback(
    (
      key: string,
      width: number,
      height: number,
      shapes: StampShapeItem[],
      fills: FillSpec[],
    ) => {
      const worker = workerRef.current;
      if (!worker) return;

      const seq = ++seqRef.current;
      pendingKeyRef.current = key;

      worker.postMessage({ seq, width, height, shapes, fills });
    },
    [],
  );

  return { result, rasterize };
}

import { useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import type { CanvasElement, Slide } from '../types';

interface GroupDragState {
  id: string;
  startX: number;
  startY: number;
  orig: Record<string, { x: number; y: number }>;
  moved: boolean;
  /* РђРєС‚СѓР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Рµ РєРѕРѕСЂРґРёРЅР°С‚С‹ РІРµРґСѓС‰РµРіРѕ вЂ” РѕР±РЅРѕРІР»СЏСЋС‚СЃСЏ РІ onDragMove */
  pendingX: number;
  pendingY: number;
  /* Р—Р°РїР»Р°РЅРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРЅС‹Р№ rAF-flush */
  rafId: number | null;
}

interface Args {
  activeSlide: Slide;
  selectedIds: string[];
  setSelectedIds: (ids: string[]) => void;
  setSlides: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Slide[]>>;
  activeId: string;
  handleSnap: (e: any, el: CanvasElement) => void;
  setFloatingPos: (p: { x: number; y: number } | null) => void;
}

/**
 * Р“СЂСѓРїРїРѕРІРѕР№ drag СЃ rAF-throttling.
 *
 * onDragMove:
 *   вЂў РѕР±РЅРѕРІР»СЏРµС‚ pendingX/pendingY СЃРёРЅС…СЂРѕРЅРЅРѕ (Р±С‹СЃС‚СЂРѕ);
 *   вЂў РїР»Р°РЅРёСЂСѓРµС‚ РѕРґРёРЅ rAF-flush Р·Р° РєР°РґСЂ;
 *
 * rAF-flush:
 *   вЂў setSlides СЃ Р°РєС‚СѓР°Р»СЊРЅС‹РјРё РєРѕРѕСЂРґРёРЅР°С‚Р°РјРё в†’ React reconciler
 *     РїРµСЂРµСЂРёСЃРѕРІС‹РІР°РµС‚ Konva-РЅРѕРґС‹, РєРѕРЅРЅРµРєС‚РѕСЂ, anchor'С‹ Рё С‚.Рґ.
 *
 * РС‚РѕРі: РІРёР·СѓР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ РѕС‚РєР»РёРє РјРіРЅРѕРІРµРЅРЅС‹Р№, React state РѕР±РЅРѕРІР»СЏРµС‚СЃСЏ в‰¤60 СЂР°Р·/СЃРµРє.
 */
export function useGroupDrag({
  activeSlide,
  selectedIds,
  setSelectedIds,
  setSlides,
  activeId,
  handleSnap,
  setFloatingPos,
}: Args) {
  const ref = useRef<GroupDragState | null>(null);

  /* РћС‚РјРµРЅСЏРµРј pending rAF РїСЂРё СЂР°Р·РјРѕРЅС‚РёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРёРё */
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      const g = ref.current;
      if (g?.rafId != null) cancelAnimationFrame(g.rafId);
    };
  }, []);

  const onDragStart = useCallback(
    (el: CanvasElement, e: any) => {
      setFloatingPos(null);

      const ids = selectedIds.includes(el.id) ? selectedIds : [el.id];
      if (!selectedIds.includes(el.id)) setSelectedIds([el.id]);

      const orig: Record<string, { x: number; y: number }> = {};
      for (const ee of activeSlide.elements) {
        if (!ids.includes(ee.id)) continue;
        orig[ee.id] = { x: ee.x, y: ee.y };
      }

      const nodeX = e.target.x();
      const nodeY = e.target.y();

      ref.current = {
        id: el.id,
        startX: nodeX,
        startY: nodeY,
        orig,
        moved: false,
        pendingX: nodeX,
        pendingY: nodeY,
        rafId: null,
      };
    },
    [activeSlide, selectedIds, setSelectedIds, setFloatingPos],
  );

  const flush = useCallback(() => {
    const g = ref.current;
    if (!g) return;
    g.rafId = null;

    const dx = g.pendingX - g.startX;
    const dy = g.pendingY - g.startY;

    setSlides((prev) =>
      prev.map((s) => {
        if (s.id !== activeId) return s;
        return {
          ...s,
          elements: s.elements.map((ee) => {
            if (!g.orig[ee.id]) return ee;
            if (ee.id === g.id) {
              return { ...ee, x: g.pendingX, y: g.pendingY };
            }
            return { ...ee, x: g.orig[ee.id].x + dx, y: g.orig[ee.id].y + dy };
          }),
        };
      }),
    );
  }, [activeId, setSlides]);

  const onDragMove = useCallback(
    (el: CanvasElement, e: any) => {
      const g = ref.current;
      if (!g) return;

      g.pendingX = e.target.x();
      g.pendingY = e.target.y();
      g.moved = true;

      /* РћРґРёРЅ rAF-flush РЅР° РєР°РґСЂ вЂ” throttle */
      if (g.rafId == null) {
        g.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(flush);
      }
    },
    [flush],
  );

  const onDragEnd = useCallback(
    (el: CanvasElement, e: any) => {
      const g = ref.current;
      if (!g) return;

      /* РћС‚РјРµРЅСЏРµРј pending flush вЂ” СЃРµР№С‡Р°СЃ СЃРґРµР»Р°РµРј С„РёРЅР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ */
      if (g.rafId != null) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(g.rafId);
        g.rafId = null;
      }
      ref.current = null;

      if (!g.moved) return;

      /* Snap С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РґР»СЏ РѕРґРёРЅРѕС‡РЅРѕРіРѕ вЂ” РёРЅР°С‡Рµ РіСЂСѓРїРїР° СЂР°Р·СЉРµР·Р¶Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ */
      const isSingle = Object.keys(g.orig).length === 1;
      if (isSingle) {
        handleSnap(e, el);
      }

      const endX = e.target.x();
      const endY = e.target.y();
      const dx = endX - g.startX;
      const dy = endY - g.startY;

      setSlides((prev) =>
        prev.map((s) => {
          if (s.id !== activeId) return s;
          return {
            ...s,
            elements: s.elements.map((ee) => {
              const o = g.orig[ee.id];
              if (!o) return ee;
              if (ee.id === el.id) {
                return { ...ee, x: endX, y: endY };
              }
              return { ...ee, x: o.x + dx, y: o.y + dy };
            }),
          };
        }),
      );
    },
    [activeId, setSlides, handleSnap],
  );

  return { onDragStart, onDragMove, onDragEnd };
}

// src/hooks/useHistory.ts
import { useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { produce } from 'immer';
import type { Slide } from '../types';

export interface HistoryEntry {
  slides: Slide[];
  activeId: string;
}

const MAX_HISTORY = 100;

/**
 * РСЃС‚РѕСЂРёСЏ СЃ structural sharing С‡РµСЂРµР· immer.
 *
 * РљР»СЋС‡РµРІР°СЏ РёРґРµСЏ: РµСЃР»Рё РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЊ РїРѕРґРЅСЏР» СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚ РЅР° 1px, РјРµРЅСЏРµС‚СЃСЏ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ
 * РѕРґРёРЅ CanvasElement РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРё РѕРґРЅРѕРіРѕ Slide. Immer РїРµСЂРµРёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµС‚ РІСЃС‘ РѕСЃС‚Р°Р»СЊРЅРѕРµ
 * РґРµСЂРµРІРѕ вЂ” РІРјРµСЃС‚Рѕ РіР»СѓР±РѕРєРѕР№ РєРѕРїРёРё РІСЃРµРіРѕ РґРѕРєСѓРјРµРЅС‚Р° РјС‹ РєРѕРїРёСЂСѓРµРј С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РїСѓС‚СЊ
 * РґРѕ РёР·РјРµРЅС‘РЅРЅРѕРіРѕ СѓР·Р»Р° (O(log n) РІРјРµСЃС‚Рѕ O(n)).
 *
 * Р”РѕРїРѕР»РЅРёС‚РµР»СЊРЅРѕ: push РЅРµ РІС‹Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ, РµСЃР»Рё РЅРѕРІС‹Р№ СЃРЅР°РїС€РѕС‚ === СЃС‚Р°СЂС‹Р№
 * (referential equality).
 */
export function useHistory() {
  const [entries, setEntries] = useState<HistoryEntry[]>([]);
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(-1);

  // lastCommitted вЂ” С‡С‚Рѕ СѓР¶Рµ Р»РµР¶РёС‚ РІ entries[index]. РСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµС‚СЃСЏ РґР»СЏ
  // Р±С‹СЃС‚СЂРѕР№ РїСЂРѕРІРµСЂРєРё В«Р° РёР·РјРµРЅРёР»РѕСЃСЊ Р»Рё С‡С‚Рѕ-С‚Рѕ РІРѕРѕР±С‰РµВ».
  const lastCommittedRef = useRef<Slide[] | null>(null);

  const push = useCallback(
    (slides: Slide[], activeId: string) => {
      const last = lastCommittedRef.current;

      // Р‘С‹СЃС‚СЂР°СЏ РѕС‚СЃРµС‡РєР°: С‚РѕС‚ Р¶Рµ РјР°СЃСЃРёРІ вЂ” РЅРёС‡РµРіРѕ РЅРµ РґРµР»Р°РµРј.
      if (last === slides) return;

      // Structural sharing: РµСЃР»Рё Сѓ РЅР°СЃ СѓР¶Рµ РµСЃС‚СЊ РїСЂРµРґС‹РґСѓС‰РёР№ СЃРЅР°РїС€РѕС‚,
      // В«СЃРїР»Р°РІР»СЏРµРјВ» РЅРѕРІС‹Р№ СЃ РЅРёРј С‡РµСЂРµР· immer, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РЅРµРёР·РјРµРЅС‘РЅРЅС‹Рµ РІРµС‚РєРё
      // РїРµСЂРµРёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°Р»РёСЃСЊ РїРѕ СЃСЃС‹Р»РєРµ.
      const snapshot = last
        ? produce(last, (draft) => {
            // РљРѕРїРёСЂСѓРµРј РІРµСЂС…РЅРёР№ СѓСЂРѕРІРµРЅСЊ РІСЂСѓС‡РЅСѓСЋ, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ immer Р·РЅР°Р»,
            // С‡С‚Рѕ РјР°СЃСЃРёРІ slides РёР·РјРµРЅРёР»СЃСЏ, РЅРѕ РЅРµ РїС‹С‚Р°Р»СЃСЏ РєР»РѕРЅРёСЂРѕРІР°С‚СЊ
            // РЅРµРёР·РјРµРЅРЅС‹Рµ slide-РѕР±СЉРµРєС‚С‹.
            if (draft.length !== slides.length) {
              draft.length = slides.length;
            }
            for (let i = 0; i < slides.length; i++) {
              if (draft[i] !== slides[i]) draft[i] = slides[i];
            }
          })
        : slides;

      lastCommittedRef.current = snapshot;

      setEntries((prev) => {
        const trimmed = prev.slice(0, index + 1);
        trimmed.push({ slides: snapshot, activeId });
        while (trimmed.length > MAX_HISTORY) trimmed.shift();
        return trimmed;
      });
      setIndex((prev) => {
        const next = prev + 1;
        return next >= MAX_HISTORY ? MAX_HISTORY - 1 : next;
      });
    },
    [index],
  );

  const undo = useCallback((): HistoryEntry | null => {
    if (index <= 0) return null;
    const prev = entries[index - 1];
    lastCommittedRef.current = prev.slides;
    setIndex(index - 1);
    return prev;
  }, [entries, index]);

  const redo = useCallback((): HistoryEntry | null => {
    if (index >= entries.length - 1) return null;
    const next = entries[index + 1];
    lastCommittedRef.current = next.slides;
    setIndex(index + 1);
    return next;
  }, [entries, index]);

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    setEntries([]);
    setIndex(-1);
    lastCommittedRef.current = null;
  }, []);

  return {
    push, undo, redo, reset,
    canUndo: index > 0,
    canRedo: index < entries.length - 1,
  };
}
