import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { CanvasElement, TableElement } from '../types';
import type { EditState, EditField, EditKind, Zone, InlineEditorArgs } from './inlineEditor/types';
import { getStageOffset, calcElementGeometry, calcCellGeometry } from './inlineEditor/position';
import { useClickOutside } from './inlineEditor/useClickOutside';
import { TEXT_PLACEHOLDER } from '../lib/constants';

export type { EditField, EditKind, EditState } from './inlineEditor/types';

const OVERLAY_SELECTORS = [
  '.inline-editor-wrap',
  '.inline-text-editor',
  '.plain-contenteditable',
  '.rt-editor',
  '.rt-toolbar',
  '.rt-popover',
  '.rt-popover-wrap',
  '.text-toolbar',
];

function isEmptyText(text: string | undefined, html: string | undefined): boolean {
  const t = (text ?? '').trim();
  if (!t || t === TEXT_PLACEHOLDER) return true;
  if (html !== undefined) {
    const h = html.trim();
    if (!h || h === '<p></p>' || h === '<p><br></p>') return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function useInlineEditor({
  wrapRef, stageRef, zoom, activeSlide, updateElement, onBeforeOpen,
}: InlineEditorArgs) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<EditState | null>(null);
  const [showToolbar, setShowToolbar] = useState(false);

  const commit = useCallback((valueOverride?: string, htmlOverride?: string) => {
    if (!editing) return;

    const v = valueOverride !== undefined ? valueOverride : editing.value;
    const h = htmlOverride !== undefined ? htmlOverride : editing.html;

    if (editing.field === 'tableCell') {
      commitCell(editing, v, activeSlide, updateElement);
    } else if (editing.field === 'text') {
      const empty = !v.trim();
      updateElement(editing.id, {
        text: empty ? TEXT_PLACEHOLDER : v,
        html: empty ? undefined : (h ?? undefined),
      } as any);
    } else if (editing.field === 'footerText') {
      const patch: any = { text: v };
      if (h !== undefined) patch.html = h;
      updateElement(editing.id, patch);
    } else if (editing.field === 'shapeText') {
      updateElement(editing.id, { text: v });
    } else {
      updateElement(editing.id, { [editing.field]: v } as any);
    }

    setShowToolbar(false);
    setEditing(null);
  }, [editing, activeSlide, updateElement]);

  const open = useCallback((
    el: CanvasElement,
    field: EditField,
    clickPos?: { x: number; y: number },
  ) => {
    onBeforeOpen?.();
    if (editing) commit();

    const wrap = wrapRef.current;
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (!wrap || !stage) return;

    const offset = getStageOffset(wrap, stage as any);
    const info = describeElement(el, field);
    if (!info) return;

    /* вњ… РџРµСЂРµРґР°С‘Рј zone вЂ” РІР°Р¶РЅРѕ РґР»СЏ stamp (top/center/bottom) */
    const geom = calcElementGeometry(
      el, offset, zoom, info.contentHeight, info.kind as any, info.zone,
    );

    setEditing({
      id: el.id,
      field,
      kind: info.kind,
      zone: info.zone,
      value: info.value,
      html: info.html,
      x: geom.x,
      y: geom.y,
      width: geom.width,
      height: geom.height,
      fontSize: info.fontSize * zoom,
      fontFamily: info.fontFamily,
      fontStyle: info.fontStyle,
      textDecoration: info.textDecoration,
      align: info.align,
      fill: info.fill,
      lineHeight: info.lineHeight,
      verticalAlign: info.verticalAlign,
      padding: info.padding,
      clickX: clickPos?.x,
      clickY: clickPos?.y,
    });

    /* Rich (text/footer) вЂ” СЃРІРѕР№ С‚СѓР»Р±Р°СЂ Сѓ TipTap.
       Shape / stamp / table вЂ” СЂРµРґР°РєС‚РёСЂСѓСЋС‚СЃСЏ inline, Р±РµР· РІРЅРµС€РЅРµРіРѕ С‚СѓР»Р±Р°СЂР°. */
    const isRich = info.kind === 'text' || info.kind === 'footer';
    setShowToolbar(!isRich && info.kind !== 'shape' && info.kind !== 'stamp');
  }, [editing, commit, wrapRef, stageRef, zoom, onBeforeOpen]);

  const openCell = useCallback((el: TableElement, rowIndex: number, colIndex: number) => {
    onBeforeOpen?.();
    if (editing) commit();

    const wrap = wrapRef.current;
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (!wrap || !stage) return;

    const offset = getStageOffset(wrap, stage as any);
    const geom = calcCellGeometry(el, offset, zoom, { rowIndex, colIndex });

    setEditing({
      id: el.id, field: 'tableCell', kind: 'table',
      tableRow: rowIndex, tableCol: colIndex,
      value: el.data[rowIndex]?.[colIndex] ?? '',
      x: geom.x, y: geom.y, width: geom.width, height: geom.height,
      fontSize: el.fontSize * zoom,
      fontFamily: 'Arial', fontStyle: 'normal', textDecoration: '',
      align: 'left', fill: '#111',
      verticalAlign: 'top',
      padding: { top: 4, right: 4, bottom: 4, left: 4 },
    });
    setShowToolbar(false);
  }, [editing, commit, wrapRef, stageRef, zoom, onBeforeOpen]);

  useClickOutside({
    enabled: !!editing,
    onOutside: () => commit(),
    ignoreSelectors: OVERLAY_SELECTORS,
  });

  const onToolbarChange = useCallback((patch: any) => {
    setEditing((cur) => {
      if (!cur) return null;
      const next = { ...cur };
      if (patch.fontSize !== undefined) next.fontSize = patch.fontSize * zoom;
      if (patch.fontFamily !== undefined) next.fontFamily = patch.fontFamily;
      if (patch.fontStyle !== undefined) next.fontStyle = patch.fontStyle;
      if (patch.textDecoration !== undefined) next.textDecoration = patch.textDecoration;
      if (patch.fill !== undefined) next.fill = patch.fill;
      if (patch.align !== undefined) next.align = patch.align;

      const realPatch = buildRealPatch(cur, patch);
      updateElement(cur.id, realPatch);
      return next;
    });
  }, [zoom, updateElement]);

  return {
    editing,
    setEditing,
    showToolbar,
    setShowToolbar,
    open,
    openCell,
    commit,
    onToolbarChange,
  };
}

interface ElementDescription {
  kind: EditKind;
  zone?: Zone;
  value: string;
  html?: string;
  fontSize: number;
  fontFamily: string;
  fontStyle: string;
  textDecoration: string;
  align: 'left' | 'center' | 'right' | 'justify';
  fill: string;
  contentHeight: number;
  lineHeight?: number;
  verticalAlign?: 'top' | 'middle' | 'bottom';
  padding?: { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number };
}

function describeElement(el: CanvasElement, field: EditField): ElementDescription | null {
  if (el.type === 'text') {
    const empty = isEmptyText(el.text, el.html);
    return {
      kind: 'text',
      value: empty ? '' : el.text,
      html: empty ? undefined : el.html,
      fontSize: el.fontSize,
      fontFamily: el.fontFamily,
      fontStyle: el.fontStyle,
      textDecoration: el.textDecoration,
      align: el.align,
      fill: el.fill,
      lineHeight: el.lineHeight,
      verticalAlign: el.verticalAlign,
      padding: el.padding,
      contentHeight: el.height,
    };
  }
  if (el.type === 'footer') {
    return {
      kind: 'footer',
      value: el.text,
      html: el.html,
      fontSize: el.fontSize,
      fontFamily: 'Arial',
      fontStyle: 'normal',
      textDecoration: '',
      align: 'center',
      fill: el.fill,
      contentHeight: el.height,
    };
  }
  if (el.type === 'shape') {
    return {
      kind: 'shape',
      value: el.text,
      fontSize: el.fontSize,
      fontFamily: el.textFontFamily || 'Arial',
      fontStyle: el.textFontStyle || 'normal',
      textDecoration: el.textDecoration || '',
      align: el.textAlign || 'center',
      fill: el.textFill,
      lineHeight: el.textLineHeight || 1.3,
      verticalAlign: el.textVerticalAlign || 'middle',
      padding: el.textPadding || { top: 8, right: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8 },
      contentHeight: el.height,
    };
  }
  if (el.type === 'stamp') {
    return describeStamp(el, field);
  }
  return null;
}

function describeStamp(
  el: Extract<CanvasElement, { type: 'stamp' }>,
  field: EditField,
): ElementDescription {
  const zone: Zone =
    field === 'topText' ? 'top'
    : field === 'bottomText' ? 'bottom'
    : 'center';

  if (zone === 'top') {
    return {
      kind: 'stamp', zone, value: el.topText,
      fontSize: el.topFontSize || 14,
      fontFamily: el.topFontFamily || 'Arial',
      fontStyle: el.topFontStyle || 'normal',
      textDecoration: el.topTextDecoration || '',
      align: 'center',
      fill: el.topColor || el.stampColor,
      contentHeight: 32,
    };
  }
  if (zone === 'bottom') {
    return {
      kind: 'stamp', zone, value: el.bottomText,
      fontSize: el.bottomFontSize || 12,
      fontFamily: el.bottomFontFamily || 'Arial',
      fontStyle: el.bottomFontStyle || 'normal',
      textDecoration: el.bottomTextDecoration || '',
      align: 'center',
      fill: el.bottomColor || el.stampColor,
      contentHeight: 32,
    };
  }
  return {
    kind: 'stamp', zone, value: el.centerText,
    fontSize: el.centerFontSize || 20,
    fontFamily: el.centerFontFamily || 'Arial',
    fontStyle: el.centerFontStyle || 'normal',
    textDecoration: el.centerTextDecoration || '',
    align: 'center',
    fill: el.centerColor || el.stampColor,
    contentHeight: 40,
  };
}

function buildRealPatch(cur: EditState, patch: any): Record<string, any> {
  const real: Record<string, any> = {};

  if (cur.kind === 'stamp' && cur.zone) {
    const prefix = cur.zone === 'top' ? 'top' : cur.zone === 'bottom' ? 'bottom' : 'center';
    if (patch.fontSize !== undefined) real[`${prefix}FontSize`] = patch.fontSize;
    if (patch.fontFamily !== undefined) real[`${prefix}FontFamily`] = patch.fontFamily;
    if (patch.fontStyle !== undefined) real[`${prefix}FontStyle`] = patch.fontStyle;
    if (patch.textDecoration !== undefined) real[`${prefix}TextDecoration`] = patch.textDecoration;
    if (patch.fill !== undefined) real[`${prefix}Color`] = patch.fill;
    return real;
  }

  if (cur.kind === 'text') {
    if (patch.fontSize !== undefined) real.fontSize = patch.fontSize;
    if (patch.fontFamily !== undefined) real.fontFamily = patch.fontFamily;
    if (patch.fontStyle !== undefined) real.fontStyle = patch.fontStyle;
    if (patch.textDecoration !== undefined) real.textDecoration = patch.textDecoration;
    if (patch.fill !== undefined) real.fill = patch.fill;
    if (patch.align !== undefined) real.align = patch.align;
    return real;
  }

  if (patch.fontSize !== undefined) real.fontSize = patch.fontSize;
  if (patch.fill !== undefined) {
    if (cur.kind === 'shape') real.textFill = patch.fill;
    else real.fill = patch.fill;
  }
  return real;
}

function commitCell(
  editing: EditState,
  value: string,
  activeSlide: { elements: CanvasElement[] },
  updateElement: (id: string, patch: Partial<CanvasElement>) => void,
): void {
  const el = activeSlide.elements.find((e) => e.id === editing.id) as TableElement | undefined;
  if (!el || el.type !== 'table') return;
  const dataArr = el.data.map((row) => [...row]);
  const r = editing.tableRow!;
  const c = editing.tableCol!;
  if (dataArr[r] && c < dataArr[r].length) {
    dataArr[r][c] = value;
    updateElement(editing.id, { data: dataArr });
  }
}

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

export interface ShortcutHandlers {
  onUndo: () => void;
  onRedo: () => void;
  onCopy: () => void;
  onPaste: () => void;
  onDuplicate: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onEscape?: () => void;
  onEnter?: () => void;
  onCopyStyle?: () => void;
  onApplyStyle?: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function useKeyboardShortcuts(h: ShortcutHandlers) {
  const hRef = useRef(h);
  hRef.current = h;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hRef.current.disabled) return;

    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const handlers = hRef.current;
      if (handlers.disabled) return;

      const t = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      const tag = t?.tagName;
      const isField =
        tag === 'INPUT' ||
        tag === 'TEXTAREA' ||
        tag === 'SELECT' ||
        (t != null && (t as HTMLElement).isContentEditable === true);

      const ctrl = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey;
      const code = e.code;

      /* Ctrl+A вЂ” РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµС…РІР°С‚С‹РІР°РµРј */
      if (ctrl && code === 'KeyA') return;

      /* Ctrl+Alt+C / Ctrl+Alt+V вЂ” СЃС‚РёР»СЊ */
      if (ctrl && e.altKey && code === 'KeyC') {
        e.preventDefault();
        handlers.onCopyStyle?.();
        return;
      }
      if (ctrl && e.altKey && code === 'KeyV') {
        e.preventDefault();
        handlers.onApplyStyle?.();
        return;
      }

      /* Undo / Redo */
      if (ctrl && code === 'KeyZ' && !e.shiftKey) {
        if (isField) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        handlers.onUndo();
        return;
      }
      if (ctrl && code === 'KeyZ' && e.shiftKey) {
        if (isField) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        handlers.onRedo();
        return;
      }
      if (ctrl && code === 'KeyY') {
        if (isField) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        handlers.onRedo();
        return;
      }

      if (isField) return;

      if (ctrl && code === 'KeyC') { e.preventDefault(); handlers.onCopy(); return; }
      if (ctrl && code === 'KeyV') { e.preventDefault(); handlers.onPaste(); return; }
      if (ctrl && code === 'KeyD') { e.preventDefault(); handlers.onDuplicate(); return; }

      if (e.key === 'Delete' || e.key === 'Backspace') {
        e.preventDefault();
        handlers.onDelete();
        return;
      }

      if (e.key === 'Escape') { handlers.onEscape?.(); return; }
      if (e.key === 'Enter') { handlers.onEnter?.(); }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
  }, [h.disabled]);
}

import { useEffect } from 'react';

export function usePanMode(wrapRef: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = wrapRef.current;
    if (!el) return;

    let spaceDown = false;
    let panning = false;
    let start = { x: 0, y: 0, sl: 0, st: 0 };

    const isEditable = (t: EventTarget | null): boolean => {
      const h = t as HTMLElement | null;
      if (!h) return false;
      return (
        h.isContentEditable ||
        h.tagName === 'INPUT' ||
        h.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ||
        h.tagName === 'SELECT'
      );
    };

    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.code !== 'Space' || e.repeat) return;
      if (isEditable(e.target)) return;
      spaceDown = true;
      el.classList.add('pan-ready');
      e.preventDefault();
    };

    const onKeyUp = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.code !== 'Space') return;
      spaceDown = false;
      el.classList.remove('pan-ready');
      el.classList.remove('panning');
    };

    const onMouseDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!spaceDown || e.button !== 0) return;
      panning = true;
      start = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, sl: el.scrollLeft, st: el.scrollTop };
      el.classList.add('panning');
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
    };

    const onMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!panning) return;
      el.scrollLeft = start.sl - (e.clientX - start.x);
      el.scrollTop = start.st - (e.clientY - start.y);
      e.preventDefault();
    };

    const onMouseUp = () => {
      if (!panning) return;
      panning = false;
      el.classList.remove('panning');
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
    el.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown, true);
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
      el.removeEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown, true);
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
    };
  }, [wrapRef]);
}

import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { Slide } from '../types';
import { getBBox } from '../lib/geometry';
import type Konva from 'konva';
import { RefObject } from 'react';

export interface RubberBand {
  x1: number;
  y1: number;
  x2: number;
  y2: number;
}

interface Args {
  stageRef: RefObject<Konva.Stage>;
  zoom: number;
  activeSlide: Slide;
  setSelectedIds: (ids: string[]) => void;
}

/** РџСЂСЏРјРѕСѓРіРѕР»СЊРЅРёРєРё РїРµСЂРµСЃРµРєР°СЋС‚СЃСЏ? (РёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµС‚ loose-РіСЂР°РЅРёС†С‹). */
function rectsIntersect(
  a: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number },
  b: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number },
): boolean {
  return !(
    a.x + a.w < b.x ||
    b.x + b.w < a.x ||
    a.y + a.h < b.y ||
    b.y + b.h < a.y
  );
}

export function useRubberBand({ stageRef, zoom, activeSlide, setSelectedIds }: Args) {
  const [band, setBand] = useState<RubberBand | null>(null);
  const startRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);

  const pointerPos = () => {
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (!stage) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const p = stage.getPointerPosition();
    if (!p) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
    return { x: p.x / zoom, y: p.y / zoom };
  };

  const start = useCallback(() => {
    const pos = pointerPos();
    startRef.current = pos;
    setBand({ x1: pos.x, y1: pos.y, x2: pos.x, y2: pos.y });
  }, [zoom, stageRef]);

  const move = useCallback(() => {
    if (!startRef.current) return;
    const pos = pointerPos();
    const s = startRef.current;
    setBand({ x1: s.x, y1: s.y, x2: pos.x, y2: pos.y });
  }, [zoom, stageRef]);

  const end = useCallback(() => {
    if (!band || !startRef.current) {
      startRef.current = null;
      setBand(null);
      return;
    }
    const x1 = Math.min(band.x1, band.x2);
    const x2 = Math.max(band.x1, band.x2);
    const y1 = Math.min(band.y1, band.y2);
    const y2 = Math.max(band.y1, band.y2);

    /* РЎРѕРІСЃРµРј РјР°Р»РµРЅСЊРєР°СЏ СЂР°РјРєР° вЂ” СЃС‡РёС‚Р°РµРј РєР»РёРєРѕРј, РЅРµ РІС‹РґРµР»СЏРµРј */
    if (Math.abs(x2 - x1) < 4 && Math.abs(y2 - y1) < 4) {
      startRef.current = null;
      setBand(null);
      return;
    }

    const rect = { x: x1, y: y1, w: x2 - x1, h: y2 - y1 };

    /* РџРµСЂРµСЃРµС‡РµРЅРёРµ, РЅРµ РїРѕР»РЅРѕРµ РІРєР»СЋС‡РµРЅРёРµ: СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚ РІС‹РґРµР»СЏРµС‚СЃСЏ,
       РµСЃР»Рё С…РѕС‚СЏ Р±С‹ С‡Р°СЃС‚СЊ РµРіРѕ bbox РїРѕРїР°Р»Р° РІ СЂР°РјРєСѓ. */
    const inside = activeSlide.elements.filter((el) => {
      if (el.type === 'connector') return false;
      if (el.type === 'fill') return false;
      if (el.locked) return false;
      const bb = getBBox(el);
      return rectsIntersect(rect, bb);
    });

    setSelectedIds(inside.map((e) => e.id));
    startRef.current = null;
    setBand(null);
  }, [band, activeSlide, setSelectedIds]);

  return { band, start, move, end };
}

import { useState, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import type { CanvasElement, Slide } from '../types';

export function useSelection(activeSlide: Slide) {
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const selectedId = selectedIds[0] ?? null;
  const selected = useMemo(
    () => activeSlide.elements.find((e) => e.id === selectedId) ?? null,
    [activeSlide, selectedId],
  );

  const select = useCallback((id: string, multi = false) => {
    setSelectedIds((prev) => {
      if (!multi) return [id];
      return prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...prev, id];
    });
  }, []);

  const clear = useCallback(() => setSelectedIds([]), []);
  const selectMany = useCallback((ids: string[]) => setSelectedIds(ids), []);
  const isSelected = useCallback(
    (el: CanvasElement) => selectedIds.includes(el.id),
    [selectedIds],
  );

  return { selectedIds, selectedId, selected, select, clear, selectMany, isSelected, setSelectedIds };
}

import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { Slide, CanvasElement, DocFormat, Orientation } from '../types';
import { getFormatSize } from '../types';
import { newSlide } from '../lib/factories';

/* ---------- РҐРµР»РїРµСЂ: РїРµСЂРµСЃС‡С‘С‚ СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚РѕРІ РїСЂРё СЃРјРµРЅРµ СЂР°Р·РјРµСЂРѕРІ СЃР»Р°Р№РґР° ---------- */
function reflowElements(
  elements: CanvasElement[],
  slide: Slide,
  newWidth: number,
  newHeight: number,
): CanvasElement[] {
  const printableWidth = Math.max(
    0,
    newWidth - slide.padding.left - slide.padding.right,
  );
  const printableHeight = Math.max(
    0,
    newHeight - slide.padding.top - slide.padding.bottom,
  );

  return elements.map((el) => {
    if (el.type === 'footer') {
      return {
        ...el,
        x: slide.padding.left,
        y: newHeight - slide.padding.bottom - el.height,
        width: printableWidth,
      };
    }

    if (el.type === 'placeholder') {
      return {
        ...el,
        x: slide.padding.left,
        y: slide.padding.top,
        width: printableWidth,
        height: printableHeight,
      };
    }

    // РћСЃС‚Р°Р»СЊРЅС‹Рµ СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚С‹ вЂ” РїСЂРѕСЃС‚Рѕ РѕРіСЂР°РЅРёС‡РёРІР°РµРј, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РЅРµ РІС‹Р»РµР·Р°Р»Рё Р·Р° Р»РёСЃС‚
    const maxX = Math.max(0, newWidth - el.width);
    const maxY = Math.max(0, newHeight - el.height);

    return {
      ...el,
      x: Math.min(el.x, maxX),
      y: Math.min(el.y, maxY),
      width: Math.min(el.width, printableWidth),
    };
  });
}

export function useSlides() {
  const [slides, setSlides] = useState<Slide[]>(() => [newSlide(1)]);
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState(() => slides[0].id);
  const [customSize, setCustomSize] = useState({ w: 794, h: 1123 });

  const activeSlide = slides.find((s) => s.id === activeId)!;

  const updateElement = useCallback((id: string, patch: Partial<CanvasElement>) => {
    setSlides((prev) =>
      prev.map((s) =>
        s.id !== activeId
          ? s
          : {
              ...s,
              elements: s.elements.map((el) =>
                el.id === id ? ({ ...el, ...patch } as CanvasElement) : el,
              ),
            },
      ),
    );
  }, [activeId]);

  const updateSlide = useCallback((patch: Partial<Slide>, _history = false) => {
    setSlides((prev) =>
      prev.map((s) => (s.id === activeId ? { ...s, ...patch } : s)),
    );
  }, [activeId]);

  const addElement = useCallback((el: CanvasElement) => {
    setSlides((prev) =>
      prev.map((s) =>
        s.id !== activeId ? s : { ...s, elements: [...s.elements, el] },
      ),
    );
  }, [activeId]);

  const removeElements = useCallback((ids: string[]) => {
    setSlides((prev) =>
      prev.map((s) =>
        s.id !== activeId
          ? s
          : { ...s, elements: s.elements.filter((e) => !ids.includes(e.id)) },
      ),
    );
  }, [activeId]);

  const moveLayer = useCallback((id: string, dir: 1 | -1) => {
    setSlides((prev) =>
      prev.map((s) => {
        if (s.id !== activeId) return s;
        const idx = s.elements.findIndex((e) => e.id === id);
        if (idx < 0) return s;
        const target = idx + dir;
        if (target < 0 || target >= s.elements.length) return s;
        const arr = [...s.elements];
        [arr[idx], arr[target]] = [arr[target], arr[idx]];
        return { ...s, elements: arr };
      }),
    );
  }, [activeId]);

  const addSlide = useCallback(() => {
    setSlides((prev) => {
      const s = newSlide(prev.length + 1, activeSlide.format, activeSlide.orientation);
      s.padding = { ...activeSlide.padding };
      setActiveId(s.id);
      return [...prev, s];
    });
  }, [activeSlide]);

  const removeSlide = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setSlides((prev) => {
      if (prev.length === 1) return prev;
      const next = prev.filter((s) => s.id !== id);
      if (activeId === id) setActiveId(next[0].id);
      return next;
    });
  }, [activeId]);

  /* ---------------- Р¤РѕСЂРјР°С‚ ---------------- */

  const changeFormat = useCallback((format: DocFormat) => {
    const { w, h } = getFormatSize(
      format,
      activeSlide.orientation,
      format === 'custom' ? customSize : undefined,
    );

    setSlides((prev) =>
      prev.map((s) => {
        if (s.id !== activeId) return s;
        const elements = reflowElements(s.elements, s, w, h);
        return { ...s, format, width: w, height: h, elements };
      }),
    );
  }, [activeId, activeSlide.orientation, customSize]);

  /* ---------------- РћСЂРёРµРЅС‚Р°С†РёСЏ ---------------- */

  const changeOrientation = useCallback((orientation: Orientation) => {
    const { w, h } = getFormatSize(
      activeSlide.format,
      orientation,
      activeSlide.format === 'custom' ? customSize : undefined,
    );

    setSlides((prev) =>
      prev.map((s) => {
        if (s.id !== activeId) return s;
        const elements = reflowElements(s.elements, s, w, h);
        return { ...s, orientation, width: w, height: h, elements };
      }),
    );
  }, [activeId, activeSlide.format, customSize]);

  /* ---------------- РљР°СЃС‚РѕРјРЅС‹Р№ СЂР°Р·РјРµСЂ ---------------- */

  const changeCustomSize = useCallback((w: number, h: number) => {
    setCustomSize({ w, h });
    if (activeSlide.format !== 'custom') return;

    setSlides((prev) =>
      prev.map((s) => {
        if (s.id !== activeId) return s;

        const newWidth = s.orientation === 'portrait' ? w : h;
        const newHeight = s.orientation === 'portrait' ? h : w;
        const elements = reflowElements(s.elements, s, newWidth, newHeight);

        return { ...s, width: newWidth, height: newHeight, elements };
      }),
    );
  }, [activeId, activeSlide.format]);

  return {
    slides, setSlides,
    activeId, setActiveId,
    activeSlide,
    customSize, changeCustomSize,
    updateElement, updateSlide,
    addElement, removeElements, moveLayer,
    addSlide, removeSlide,
    changeFormat, changeOrientation,
  };
}

/**

import { Slide } from '../../domain/entities/Slide';
import type { CanvasElement } from '../../shared/types';
import type { SlideStore } from '../../application/ports/SlideStore';
import { createStore } from './Store';

interface SlideStoreState {
  slides: Slide[];
  activeSlideId: string | null;
}

const initialState: SlideStoreState = {
  slides: [new Slide({ name: 'Slide 1' })],
  activeSlideId: '',
};

// Initialize with first slide
initialState.activeSlideId = initialState.slides[0].id;

const store = createStore({ initialState });

/**
 * Concrete implementation of SlideStore
 */
export class SlideStoreImpl implements SlideStore {
  getSlides(): Slide[] {
    return store.select((s) => s.slides);
  }

  getActiveSlide(): Slide | null {
    const { slides, activeSlideId } = store.getState();
    return slides.find((s) => s.id === activeSlideId) ?? null;
  }

  getActiveSlideId(): string | null {
    return store.select((s) => s.activeSlideId);
  }

  setSlides(slides: Slide[]): void {
    store.setStatePartial({ slides });
  }

  setActiveSlideId(id: string): void {
    store.setStatePartial({ activeSlideId: id });
  }

  addSlide(slide: Slide): void {
    store.updateState((state) => ({
      ...state,
      slides: [...state.slides, slide],
      activeSlideId: slide.id,
    }));
  }

  removeSlide(id: string): void {
    store.updateState((state) => {
      const newSlides = state.slides.filter((s) => s.id !== id);
      const newActiveId =
        state.activeSlideId === id
          ? newSlides.length > 0
            ? newSlides[0].id
            : null
          : state.activeSlideId;

      return {
        ...state,
        slides: newSlides,
        activeSlideId: newActiveId,
      };
    });
  }

  updateSlide(id: string, patch: Partial<Slide>): void {
    store.updateState((state) => ({
      ...state,
      slides: state.slides.map((s) => (s.id === id ? { ...s, ...patch } : s)),
    }));
  }

  addElement(slideId: string, element: CanvasElement): void {
    store.updateState((state) => ({
      ...state,
      slides: state.slides.map((s) =>
        s.id === slideId
          ? { ...s, elements: [...s.elements, element] }
          : s
      ),
    }));
  }

  updateElement(slideId: string, elementId: string, patch: Partial<CanvasElement>): void {
    store.updateState((state) => ({
      ...state,
      slides: state.slides.map((s) =>
        s.id === slideId
          ? {
              ...s,
              elements: s.elements.map((e) =>
                e.id === elementId ? { ...e, ...patch } as CanvasElement : e
              ),
            }
          : s
      ),
    }));
  }

  removeElement(slideId: string, elementId: string): void {
    store.updateState((state) => ({
      ...state,
      slides: state.slides.map((s) =>
        s.id === slideId
          ? {
              ...s,
              elements: s.elements.filter((e) => e.id !== elementId),
            }
          : s
      ),
    }));
  }

  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
    return store.subscribe(callback);
  }
}

/**
 * Simple reactive store - Infrastructure Layer
 * Lightweight alternative to external state management
 */

export type Listener<T> = (state: T) => void;
export type Selector<T, R> = (state: T) => R;

export interface StoreConfig<T> {
  initialState: T;
}

export class Store<T extends Record<string, unknown>> {
  private state: T;
  private listeners = new Set<Listener<T>>();

  constructor(config: StoreConfig<T>) {
    this.state = config.initialState;
  }

  /**
   * Get current state
   */
  getState(): T {
    return this.state;
  }

  /**
   * Get derived value via selector
   */
  select<R>(selector: Selector<T, R>): R {
    return selector(this.state);
  }

  /**
   * Subscribe to state changes
   */
  subscribe(listener: Listener<T>): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(listener);
  }

  /**
   * Subscribe to specific value changes
   */
  subscribeTo<R>(selector: Selector<T, R>, listener: (value: R, prevValue: R) => void): () => void {
    let prevValue = selector(this.state);
    
    return this.subscribe((state) => {
      const newValue = selector(state);
      if (newValue !== prevValue) {
        listener(newValue, prevValue);
        prevValue = newValue;
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * Set state (full replacement)
   */
  setState(newState: T): void {
    this.state = newState;
    this.notify();
  }

  /**
   * Update state (partial merge)
   */
  setStatePartial(partial: Partial<T>): void {
    this.state = { ...this.state, ...partial } as T;
    this.notify();
  }

  /**
   * Update state with function
   */
  updateState(updater: (state: T) => T): void {
    this.state = updater(this.state);
    this.notify();
  }

  /**
   * Notify all listeners
   */
  private notify(): void {
    for (const listener of this.listeners) {
      try {
        listener(this.state);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Store listener error:', error);
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Create store factory
 */
export function createStore<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(config: StoreConfig<T>): Store<T> {
  return new Store(config);
}

/**
 * Zustand-based Slide Store - Infrastructure Layer
 * Concrete implementation using Zustand
 */

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { immer } from 'zustand/middleware/immer';
import type { Slide } from '../../domain/entities/Slide';
import type { CanvasElement } from '../../shared/types';
import type { SlideStore } from '../../application/ports/SlideStore';

interface SlideState {
  slides: Slide[];
  activeSlideId: string | null;
}

interface SlideActions {
  setSlides: (slides: Slide[]) => void;
  setActiveSlideId: (id: string | null) => void;
  addSlide: (slide: Slide) => void;
  removeSlide: (id: string) => void;
  updateSlide: (id: string, patch: Partial<Slide>) => void;
  addElement: (slideId: string, element: CanvasElement) => void;
  updateElement: (slideId: string, elementId: string, patch: Partial<CanvasElement>) => void;
  removeElement: (slideId: string, elementId: string) => void;
}

const useSlideStore = create<SlideState & SlideActions>()(
  immer((set) => ({
    slides: [],
    activeSlideId: null,

    setSlides: (slides) => set({ slides }),

    setActiveSlideId: (id) => set({ activeSlideId: id }),

    addSlide: (slide) =>
      set((state) => {
        state.slides.push(slide);
        state.activeSlideId = slide.id;
      }),

    removeSlide: (id) =>
      set((state) => {
        const index = state.slides.findIndex((s) => s.id === id);
        if (index === -1) return;

        state.slides.splice(index, 1);

        // Update active slide if needed
        if (state.activeSlideId === id) {
          state.activeSlideId = state.slides.length > 0 ? state.slides[0].id : null;
        }
      }),

    updateSlide: (id, patch) =>
      set((state) => {
        const slide = state.slides.find((s) => s.id === id);
        if (!slide) return;

        Object.assign(slide, patch);
      }),

    addElement: (slideId, element) =>
      set((state) => {
        const slide = state.slides.find((s) => s.id === slideId);
        if (!slide) return;

        slide.elements.push(element);
      }),

    updateElement: (slideId, elementId, patch) =>
      set((state) => {
        const slide = state.slides.find((s) => s.id === slideId);
        if (!slide) return;

        const element = slide.elements.find((e) => e.id === elementId);
        if (!element) return;

        Object.assign(element, patch);
      }),

    removeElement: (slideId, elementId) =>
      set((state) => {
        const slide = state.slides.find((s) => s.id === slideId);
        if (!slide) return;

        const index = slide.elements.findIndex((e) => e.id === elementId);
        if (index !== -1) {
          slide.elements.splice(index, 1);
        }
      }),
  }))
);

/**
 * Adapter to implement SlideStore interface
 */
export class ZustandSlideStore implements SlideStore {
  private store = useSlideStore;

  getSlides(): Slide[] {
    return this.store.getState().slides;
  }

  getActiveSlide(): Slide | null {
    const { slides, activeSlideId } = this.store.getState();
    return slides.find((s) => s.id === activeSlideId) ?? null;
  }

  getActiveSlideId(): string | null {
    return this.store.getState().activeSlideId;
  }

  setSlides(slides: Slide[]): void {
    this.store.getState().setSlides(slides);
  }

  setActiveSlideId(id: string): void {
    this.store.getState().setActiveSlideId(id);
  }

  addSlide(slide: Slide): void {
    this.store.getState().addSlide(slide);
  }

  removeSlide(id: string): void {
    this.store.getState().removeSlide(id);
  }

  updateSlide(id: string, patch: Partial<Slide>): void {
    this.store.getState().updateSlide(id, patch);
  }

  addElement(slideId: string, element: CanvasElement): void {
    this.store.getState().addElement(slideId, element);
  }

  updateElement(slideId: string, elementId: string, patch: Partial<CanvasElement>): void {
    this.store.getState().updateElement(slideId, elementId, patch);
  }

  removeElement(slideId: string, elementId: string): void {
    this.store.getState().removeElement(slideId, elementId);
  }

  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
    return this.store.subscribe(callback);
  }
}

// Singleton instance
export const slideStore = new ZustandSlideStore();

// React hook for components
export const useSlides = () => useSlideStore();

export const InlineTextEditor: React.FC<Props> = ({
  x, y, width, height, value, fontSize, fontFamily,
  fontStyle, textDecoration, align, fill,
  onChange, onCommit, onCancel,
}) => {

        left: x,
        top: y,
        width,
        minHeight: height,
        fontSize,
        fontFamily,
        fontWeight: fontStyle.includes('bold') ? 'bold' : 'normal',

          return; // textarea СЃР°Рј РѕР±СЂР°Р±РѕС‚Р°РµС‚
        }
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.shiftKey) {
          e.preventDefault();
          onCommit();
        }
      }}
      onBlur={onCommit}
      autoFocus
      spellCheck={false}
    />
  );
};

export const InlineTextEditor: React.FC<Props> = ({
  x, y, width, height, value, html, kind,
  richText,
  fontSize, fontFamily, fontStyle = 'normal', textDecoration = '',
  fill, align, verticalAlign = 'top',
  padding = { top: 8, right: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8 },
  lineHeight,
  clickX, clickY,
  onChange, onCommit, onCancel,
}) => {
  const isRich = (kind === 'text' || kind === 'footer') && richText !== false;

  if (isRich) {
    const winW = window.innerWidth;

            fontFamily={fontFamily}
            fill={fill}
            align={align}
            lineHeight={lineHeight ?? 1.5}
            blockGap={8}
            width={w}
            minHeight={h}
            onChange={(h2, t) => onChange({ html: h2, text: t })}
            onCommit={onCommit}
            onCancel={onCancel}
          />
        </div>
      </>
    );
  }

  /* вњ… Inline вЂ” РґР»СЏ РїСЂРѕСЃС‚РѕРіРѕ С‚РµРєСЃС‚Р°, С‚РµРєСЃС‚Р° РІ С„РёРіСѓСЂРµ Рё С‚РµРєСЃС‚Р° РІ stamp.

  const isStampLike = kind === 'stamp';

      x={x}

/* ============================================================
   PlainOverlay вЂ” contenteditable РїРѕРІРµСЂС… СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚Р°
   ============================================================ */

interface PlainProps {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  value: string;
  fontSize: number;
  fontFamily: string;
  fontStyle: string;
  textDecoration: string;
  fill: string;
  align: string;
  verticalAlign: 'top' | 'middle' | 'bottom';
  padding: { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number };
  lineHeight: number;
  clickX?: number;
  clickY?: number;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  onCommit: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

const PlainOverlay: React.FC<PlainProps> = ({
  x, y, width, height, value,
  fontSize, fontFamily, fontStyle, textDecoration, fill,
  align, verticalAlign, padding, lineHeight,
  clickX, clickY,
  onChange, onCommit, onCancel,
}) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    el.innerText = value;

    const sel = window.getSelection();

    /* РџС‹С‚Р°РµРјСЃСЏ РїРѕСЃС‚Р°РІРёС‚СЊ РєР°СЂРµС‚РєСѓ РІ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ РєР»РёРєР° */
    let placed = false;
    if (clickX !== undefined && clickY !== undefined) {
      const doc = document as Document & {
        caretRangeFromPoint?: (x: number, y: number) => Range | null;
        caretPositionFromPoint?: (x: number, y: number) => { offsetNode: Node; offset: number } | null;
      };
      let range: Range | null = null;
      if (typeof doc.caretRangeFromPoint === 'function') {
        range = doc.caretRangeFromPoint(clickX, clickY);
      } else if (typeof doc.caretPositionFromPoint === 'function') {
        const pos = doc.caretPositionFromPoint(clickX, clickY);
        if (pos) {
          range = document.createRange();
          range.setStart(pos.offsetNode, pos.offset);
          range.collapse(true);
        }
      }
      if (range && el.contains(range.startContainer)) {
        sel?.removeAllRanges();
        sel?.addRange(range);
        placed = true;
      }
    }

    if (!placed) {
      const range = document.createRange();
      range.setStart(el, 0);
      range.collapse(true);
      sel?.removeAllRanges();
      sel?.addRange(range);
    }

    el.focus();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleInput = () => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    onChange(el.innerText);
  };

  const justify =
    verticalAlign === 'middle' ? 'center'
    : verticalAlign === 'bottom' ? 'flex-end'
    : 'flex-start';

  return (
    <div
      className="inline-editor-wrap plain-overlay"
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        left: x,
        top: y,
        width,
        height,
        zIndex: 1000,
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        justifyContent: justify,
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        padding: `${padding.top}px ${padding.right}px ${padding.bottom}px ${padding.left}px`,
        background: 'transparent',
        border: 'none',
        outline: '1.5px dashed #6366f1',
        outlineOffset: 1,
        boxShadow: 'none',
        overflow: 'visible',
      }}
      onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
    >
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className="plain-contenteditable"
        contentEditable
        suppressContentEditableWarning
        onInput={handleInput}
        onBlur={onCommit}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); onCancel(); }
          if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) {
            e.preventDefault();
            onCommit();
          }
        }}
        style={{
          outline: 'none',
          minHeight: '1em',
          width: '100%',
          fontSize,
          fontFamily,
          fontStyle: fontStyle.includes('italic') ? 'italic' : 'normal',
          fontWeight: fontStyle.includes('bold') ? 700 : 400,
          textDecoration,
          color: fill,
          lineHeight,
          textAlign: align as any,
          whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap',
          wordBreak: 'break-word',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

import type { CanvasElement, AnchorSide, ConnectorRouting } from '../types';
import { uid } from './uid';

export const ANCHOR_OFFSET = 8;
/** РћС‚СЃС‚СѓРї, РєРѕС‚РѕСЂС‹Р№ РїСЂРёР±Р°РІР»СЏРµС‚СЃСЏ Рє bbox РёСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРєР° РїСЂРё РѕС‚С‚Р°Р»РєРёРІР°РЅРёРё ghost. */
export const GHOST_MIN_GAP = 40;

export const GHOST_MIN_W = 80;
export const GHOST_MIN_H = 40;
export const GHOST_MAX_W = 320;
export const GHOST_MAX_H = 240;

export function getAnchorPoint(
  el: CanvasElement,
  side: AnchorSide,
): { x: number; y: number } {
  const cx = el.x + el.width / 2;
  const cy = el.y + el.height / 2;
  const rot = ((el.rotation || 0) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const cos = Math.cos(rot);
  const sin = Math.sin(rot);

  let lx = 0, ly = 0;
  if (side === 'top') { lx = 0; ly = -el.height / 2 - ANCHOR_OFFSET; }
  else if (side === 'right') { lx = el.width / 2 + ANCHOR_OFFSET; ly = 0; }
  else if (side === 'bottom') { lx = 0; ly = el.height / 2 + ANCHOR_OFFSET; }
  else { lx = -el.width / 2 - ANCHOR_OFFSET; ly = 0; }

  return {
    x: cx + lx * cos - ly * sin,
    y: cy + lx * sin + ly * cos,
  };
}

export function getAnchorDirection(side: AnchorSide): { dx: number; dy: number } {
  if (side === 'top') return { dx: 0, dy: -1 };
  if (side === 'right') return { dx: 1, dy: 0 };
  if (side === 'bottom') return { dx: 0, dy: 1 };
  return { dx: -1, dy: 0 };
}

/* ============================================================
   РњР°СЂС€СЂСѓС‚РёР·Р°С†РёСЏ
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Р‘РµР· ROUTE_PADDING: СЃРЅР°С‡Р°Р»Р° Р»РѕРјР°Р»Р°СЃСЊ РіРµРѕРјРµС‚СЂРёСЏ, РєРѕРіРґР° СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚С‹
   СЃС‚РѕСЏС‚ Р±Р»РёР·РєРѕ. РўРµРїРµСЂСЊ РјР°СЂС€СЂСѓС‚ РёРґС‘С‚ СЂРѕРІРЅРѕ РѕС‚ anchor Рє anchor,
   Р° В«РєСЂСЋС‡РѕРєВ» РІ Z-РѕР±СЂР°Р·РЅРѕР№ С„РѕСЂРјРµ РґРµР»Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ РІ СЃРµСЂРµРґРёРЅРµ.
   ============================================================ */

function routeStraight(
  from: CanvasElement, fromAnchor: AnchorSide,
  to: CanvasElement, toAnchor: AnchorSide,
): number[] {
  const a = getAnchorPoint(from, fromAnchor);
  const b = getAnchorPoint(to, toAnchor);
  return [a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y];
}

function routeOrthogonal(
  from: CanvasElement, fromAnchor: AnchorSide,
  to: CanvasElement, toAnchor: AnchorSide,
): number[] {
  const a = getAnchorPoint(from, fromAnchor);
  const b = getAnchorPoint(to, toAnchor);

  const isFromHoriz = fromAnchor === 'left' || fromAnchor === 'right';
  const isToHoriz = toAnchor === 'left' || toAnchor === 'right';

  if (isFromHoriz && isToHoriz) {
    const midX = (a.x + b.x) / 2;
    return [a.x, a.y, midX, a.y, midX, b.y, b.x, b.y];
  }
  if (!isFromHoriz && !isToHoriz) {
    const midY = (a.y + b.y) / 2;
    return [a.x, a.y, a.x, midY, b.x, midY, b.x, b.y];
  }
  if (isFromHoriz && !isToHoriz) {
    return [a.x, a.y, b.x, a.y, b.x, b.y];
  }
  return [a.x, a.y, a.x, b.y, b.x, b.y];
}

export function routeConnector(
  from: CanvasElement, fromAnchor: AnchorSide,
  to: CanvasElement, toAnchor: AnchorSide,
  routing: ConnectorRouting,
): number[] {
  if (routing === 'straight') return routeStraight(from, fromAnchor, to, toAnchor);
  return routeOrthogonal(from, fromAnchor, to, toAnchor);
}

export function findNearestAnchor(
  el: CanvasElement,
  px: number,
  py: number,
): { side: AnchorSide; distance: number } {
  const sides: AnchorSide[] = ['top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left'];
  let best: { side: AnchorSide; distance: number } = { side: 'top', distance: Infinity };
  for (const side of sides) {
    const p = getAnchorPoint(el, side);
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x - px, p.y - py);
    if (d < best.distance) best = { side, distance: d };
  }
  return best;
}

export function findElementAt(
  elements: CanvasElement[],
  px: number,
  py: number,
  excludeIds: string[] = [],
): CanvasElement | null {
  for (let i = elements.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const el = elements[i];
    if (el.type === 'connector') continue;
    if (el.type === 'line') continue;
    if (excludeIds.includes(el.id)) continue;
    if (el.locked) continue;
    if (px >= el.x && px <= el.x + el.width && py >= el.y && py <= el.y + el.height) {
      return el;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

export function findElementWithPadding(
  elements: CanvasElement[],
  px: number,
  py: number,
  padding: number,
  excludeIds: string[] = [],
): CanvasElement | null {
  for (let i = elements.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const el = elements[i];
    if (el.type === 'connector') continue;
    if (el.type === 'line') continue;
    if (excludeIds.includes(el.id)) continue;
    if (el.locked) continue;
    if (
      px >= el.x - padding && px <= el.x + el.width + padding &&
      py >= el.y - padding && py <= el.y + el.height + padding
    ) {
      return el;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

export function resolveConnectorEnds(
  conn: { fromId: string; toId: string },
  elements: CanvasElement[],
): { from: CanvasElement | null; to: CanvasElement | null } {
  let from: CanvasElement | null = null;
  let to: CanvasElement | null = null;
  for (const el of elements) {
    if (el.id === conn.fromId) from = el;
    if (el.id === conn.toId) to = el;
    if (from && to) break;
  }
  return { from, to };
}

export function midpointOfPath(points: number[]): { x: number; y: number } {
  let totalLen = 0;
  const segs: { x1: number; y1: number; x2: number; y2: number; len: number }[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < points.length - 2; i += 2) {
    const x1 = points[i], y1 = points[i + 1];
    const x2 = points[i + 2], y2 = points[i + 3];
    const len = Math.hypot(x2 - x1, y2 - y1);
    segs.push({ x1, y1, x2, y2, len });
    totalLen += len;
  }
  let target = totalLen / 2;
  for (const s of segs) {
    if (target <= s.len) {
      const t = s.len === 0 ? 0 : target / s.len;
      return { x: s.x1 + (s.x2 - s.x1) * t, y: s.y1 + (s.y2 - s.y1) * t };
    }
    target -= s.len;
  }
  return { x: points[0], y: points[1] };
}

export interface Rect {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;

/** Р Р°Р·РјРµСЂ ghost-РїСЂСЏРјРѕСѓРіРѕР»СЊРЅРёРєР°: РєР°Рє Сѓ source, РЅРѕ РІ СЂР°Р·СѓРјРЅС‹С… РїСЂРµРґРµР»Р°С…. */
export function ghostSizeFor(source: CanvasElement): { w: number; h: number } {
  return {
    w: Math.max(GHOST_MIN_W, Math.min(GHOST_MAX_W, source.width)),
    h: Math.max(GHOST_MIN_H, Math.min(GHOST_MAX_H, source.height)),
  };
}

/**
 * РџРѕР·РёС†РёСЏ ghost-РїСЂСЏРјРѕСѓРіРѕР»СЊРЅРёРєР° pull-to-create.
 * РЎС‚Р°СЂС‚СѓРµС‚ РѕС‚ РєСѓСЂСЃРѕСЂР°, РЅРѕ РµСЃР»Рё РїРµСЂРµСЃРµРєР°РµС‚СЃСЏ СЃ bbox РёСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРєР°
 * (РїР»СЋСЃ GHOST_MIN_GAP), РІС‹С‚Р°Р»РєРёРІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РїРѕ РѕСЃРё anchor-РЅР°РїСЂР°РІР»РµРЅРёСЏ.
 */
export function computeGhostRect(
  source: CanvasElement,
  fromAnchor: AnchorSide,
  mouseX: number,
  mouseY: number,
): Rect {
  const { w, h } = ghostSizeFor(source);

  let left = mouseX - w / 2;
  let top = mouseY - h / 2;

  const srcLeft = source.x - GHOST_MIN_GAP;
  const srcRight = source.x + source.width + GHOST_MIN_GAP;
  const srcTop = source.y - GHOST_MIN_GAP;
  const srcBottom = source.y + source.height + GHOST_MIN_GAP;

  const overlapsX = left < srcRight && left + w > srcLeft;
  const overlapsY = top < srcBottom && top + h > srcTop;

  if (overlapsX && overlapsY) {
    const dir = getAnchorDirection(fromAnchor);
    if (dir.dx > 0) {
      left = srcRight;
    } else if (dir.dx < 0) {
      left = srcLeft - w;
    } else if (dir.dy > 0) {
      top = srcBottom;
    } else {
      top = srcTop - h;
    }
  }

  return {
    x: Math.round(left),
    y: Math.round(top),
    width: w,
    height: h,
  };
}

/**
 * Р‘Р»РёР¶Р°Р№С€Р°СЏ СЃС‚РѕСЂРѕРЅР° РЅРѕРІРѕРіРѕ РїСЂСЏРјРѕСѓРіРѕР»СЊРЅРёРєР°, РєРѕС‚РѕСЂР°СЏ В«СЃРјРѕС‚СЂРёС‚В» РЅР° РёСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРє.

 */
export function nearestAnchorForSource(
  rect: Rect,
  source: CanvasElement,
): AnchorSide {
  const cx = rect.x + rect.width / 2;
  const cy = rect.y + rect.height / 2;
  const srcCx = source.x + source.width / 2;
  const srcCy = source.y + source.height / 2;

  // Р’РµРєС‚РѕСЂ РѕС‚ С†РµРЅС‚СЂР° РЅРѕРІРѕРіРѕ СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚Р° Рє С†РµРЅС‚СЂСѓ РёСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРєР°.
  const dx = srcCx - cx;
  const dy = srcCy - cy;

  if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
    // РСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРє СЃРїСЂР°РІР° в†’ Р±Р»РёР¶Р°Р№С€Р°СЏ СЃС‚РѕСЂРѕРЅР° РЅРѕРІРѕРіРѕ СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚Р° вЂ” РїСЂР°РІР°СЏ.
    return dx > 0 ? 'right' : 'left';
  }
  // РСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРє СЃРЅРёР·Сѓ в†’ Р±Р»РёР¶Р°Р№С€Р°СЏ СЃС‚РѕСЂРѕРЅР° вЂ” РЅРёР¶РЅСЏСЏ.
  return dy > 0 ? 'bottom' : 'top';
}

/* ============================================================
   РљР»РѕРЅРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРёРµ СЃС‚РёР»СЏ РёСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРєР° РґР»СЏ РЅРѕРІРѕРіРѕ СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚Р°

export function cloneForConnector(
  rect: Rect,
  source: CanvasElement,
): CanvasElement {
  const newId = uid();
  const base = {
    id: newId,
    x: rect.x,
    y: rect.y,
    width: rect.width,
    height: rect.height,
    rotation: 0,
  };

  switch (source.type) {
    case 'shape':
      return { ...source, ...base, text: '' };

    case 'text':
      return { ...source, ...base, text: '', html: undefined };

    case 'image':
      return { ...source, ...base };

    case 'stamp':
      return { ...source, ...base };

    case 'table':
      return {
        ...source,
        ...base,
        data: source.data.map((row) => row.map(() => '')),
      };

    case 'footer':
      return { ...source, ...base, text: '' };

    case 'placeholder':
      return { ...source, ...base, sample: '' };

    default:
      // Fallback вЂ” РѕР±С‹С‡РЅС‹Р№ СЃРєСЂСѓРіР»С‘РЅРЅС‹Р№ РїСЂСЏРјРѕСѓРіРѕР»СЊРЅРёРє
      return {
        id: newId,
        type: 'shape',
        shape: 'roundRect',
        ...base,
        fill: '#eef2ff',
        stroke: '#6366f1',
        strokeWidth: 2,
        text: '',
        fontSize: 14,
        textFill: '#1e293b',
        radius: 8,
        textAlign: 'center',
        textVerticalAlign: 'middle',
        textPadding: { top: 8, right: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8 },
        textFontFamily: 'Arial',
        textLineHeight: 1.3,
        textFontStyle: 'normal',
        textDecoration: '',
      };
  }
}

export function download(content: string, name: string, mime: string): void {
  const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mime });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = name;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

FILE: lib\elements\registry.ts
SIZE: 1981 bytes
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
import type React from 'react';
import type { CanvasElement } from '../../types';

export interface CommonHandlers {
  onSelect: (e?: any) => void;
  onUpdate: (patch: any) => void;
  onDragStart: (e: any) => void;
  onDragMove: (e: any) => void;
  onDragEnd: (e: any) => void;
  onContextMenu: (e: any) => void;
  isSelected: boolean;
}

export interface EditorActionsContext {
  openEditor: (el: CanvasElement, field: any, clickPos?: { x: number; y: number }) => void;
  openCellEditor: (el: CanvasElement, r: number, c: number) => void;
  openStampEditor: (elId: string) => void;
  openDiagramEditor: (elId: string) => void;
}

export interface ElementViewProps {
  el: CanvasElement;
  handlers: CommonHandlers;
  elements: CanvasElement[];
  editorCtx: EditorActionsContext;
  isEditing?: boolean;
}

export interface SvgContext {
  allElements: CanvasElement[];
}

export interface CreateContext {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  payload?: any;
  slide?: { width: number; height: number; padding: any };
}

export interface ElementStrategy<T extends CanvasElement = CanvasElement> {
  type: T['type'];
  KonvaView: React.FC<ElementViewProps>;
  toSvg: (el: T, ctx: SvgContext) => string;
  create?: (ctx: CreateContext) => T;
  connectable?: boolean;
  selectableByBand?: boolean;
  zIndex?: number;
}

const registry = new Map<string, ElementStrategy>();

export function registerElement<T extends CanvasElement>(strategy: ElementStrategy<T>): void {
  registry.set(strategy.type, strategy as ElementStrategy);
}

export function getStrategy(type: string): ElementStrategy | null {
  return registry.get(type) ?? null;
}

export function getAllStrategies(): ElementStrategy[] {
  return Array.from(registry.values());
}

export function getSvgSerializers(): Array<{ type: string; toSvg: (el: any, ctx: SvgContext) => string }> {
  return getAllStrategies().map((s) => ({ type: s.type, toSvg: s.toSvg as any }));
}

FILE: lib\elements\strategies\line.tsx
SIZE: 2083 bytes
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
import React from 'react';
import type { LineElement } from '../../../types';
import { LineEl } from '../../../components/elements/LineEl';
import { registerElement, type ElementViewProps } from '../registry';
import { lineToSvg } from '../../../services/svg/lineToSvg';
import { newLine } from '../../factories';

const LineViewImpl: React.FC<ElementViewProps> = ({ el, handlers }) => (
  <LineEl
    el={el as LineElement}
    onSelect={handlers.onSelect}
    onUpdate={handlers.onUpdate}
    onDragStart={handlers.onDragStart}
    onDragMove={handlers.onDragMove}
    onDragEnd={handlers.onDragEnd}
    onContextMenu={handlers.onContextMenu}
    isSelected={handlers.isSelected}
    onDblClick={(sx, sy) => {
      const line = el as LineElement;
      const localX = sx - line.x;
      const localY = sy - line.y;
      const pts = line.points && line.points.length >= 4
        ? line.points
        : [0, line.height / 2, line.width, line.height / 2];
      let bestIdx = 2, bestDist = Infinity;
      for (let i = 0; i + 3 < pts.length; i += 2) {
        const x1 = pts[i], y1 = pts[i + 1];
        const x2 = pts[i + 2], y2 = pts[i + 3];
        const dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1;
        const len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy || 1;
        const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((localX - x1) * dx + (localY - y1) * dy) / len2));
        const px = x1 + t * dx, py = y1 + t * dy;
        const d = Math.hypot(localX - px, localY - py);
        if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; bestIdx = i + 2; }
      }
      handlers.onUpdate({ points: [...pts.slice(0, bestIdx), localX, localY, ...pts.slice(bestIdx)] });
    }}
  />
);

const MemoLineView = React.memo(LineViewImpl, (prev, next) =>
  prev.el === next.el && prev.handlers === next.handlers,
);

registerElement<LineElement>({
  type: 'line',
  connectable: false,
  selectableByBand: true,
  KonvaView: MemoLineView,
  toSvg: (el) => lineToSvg(el),
  create: (ctx) => {
    const l = newLine(ctx.x, ctx.y);
    if (ctx.payload?.isArrow) l.isArrow = true;
    return l;
  },
});

export function makeArrayTable(
  x: number, y: number,
  payload: {
    path: string;
    arrayName: string;
    sampleCount?: number;
    arrayChildren: { name: string; type: string }[];
  },
): TableElement {
  const children = payload.arrayChildren || [];
  const count = Math.max(1, payload.sampleCount ?? 3);
  const header: string[] = ['РђС‚СЂРёР±СѓС‚'];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) header.push(`#${i + 1}`);
  const data: string[][] = [header];
  children.forEach((child) => {
    const row: string[] = [child.name];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) row.push(`{{${payload.path}[${i}].${child.name}}}`);
    data.push(row);
  });
  const rows = data.length;
  const cols = 1 + count;
  return {
    id: uid(), type: 'table',
    x: Math.max(0, x - 100), y: Math.max(0, y - 20),
    width: 40 + cols * 120, height: 20 + rows * 32, rotation: 0,
    rows, cols, data,
    borderColor: '#cbd5e1', headerBg: '#eef2ff', fontSize: 13,
  };
}

import type { CanvasElement, Slide } from '../types';
import { GRID_SIZE } from '../types';

export interface BBox { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number; }

export function getBBox(el: CanvasElement): BBox {
  if ((el.type === 'line' || el.type === 'fill') && el.points && el.points.length >= 4) {
    const xs: number[] = [];
    const ys: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < el.points.length; i += 2) {
      xs.push(el.points[i]);
      ys.push(el.points[i + 1]);
    }
    const minX = Math.min(...xs);
    const minY = Math.min(...ys);
    const maxX = Math.max(...xs);
    const maxY = Math.max(...ys);
    return { x: el.x + minX, y: el.y + minY, w: maxX - minX, h: maxY - minY };
  }
  return { x: el.x, y: el.y, w: el.width, h: el.height };
}

export function hitShapeEl(el: CanvasElement, px: number, py: number): boolean {
  if (el.type === 'shape') {
    if (px < el.x || py < el.y || px > el.x + el.width || py > el.y + el.height) return false;
    if (el.shape === 'circle') {
      const cx = el.x + el.width / 2;
      const cy = el.y + el.height / 2;
      const r = Math.min(el.width, el.height) / 2;
      return Math.hypot(px - cx, py - cy) <= r;
    }
    return true;
  }
  if (el.type === 'fill' && el.points && el.points.length >= 6) {
    const pts = el.points;
    const n = pts.length / 2;
    let inside = false;
    for (let i = 0, j = n - 1; i < n; j = i++) {
      const xi = el.x + pts[i * 2];
      const yi = el.y + pts[i * 2 + 1];
      const xj = el.x + pts[j * 2];
      const yj = el.y + pts[j * 2 + 1];
      const intersect =
        yi > py !== yj > py && px < ((xj - xi) * (py - yi)) / (yj - yi + 0.000001) + xi;
      if (intersect) inside = !inside;
    }
    return inside;
  }
  return false;
}

export function findElementAt(slide: Slide, x: number, y: number): CanvasElement | null {
  for (let i = slide.elements.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const el = slide.elements[i];
    if (el.type === 'line') {
      const pts = el.points || [0, el.height / 2, el.width, el.height / 2];
      const xs: number[] = [];
      const ys: number[] = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < pts.length; j += 2) {
        xs.push(el.x + pts[j]);
        ys.push(el.y + pts[j + 1]);
      }
      const bx = Math.min(...xs);
      const by = Math.min(...ys);
      const bw = Math.max(...xs) - bx;
      const bh = Math.max(...ys) - by;
      if (x >= bx - 6 && x <= bx + bw + 6 && y >= by - 6 && y <= by + bh + 6) return el;
      continue;
    }
    if (x >= el.x && x <= el.x + el.width && y >= el.y && y <= el.y + el.height) return el;
  }
  return null;
}

export const gridRound = (v: number): number => Math.round(v / GRID_SIZE) * GRID_SIZE;

/* ============================================================
   Р Р°Р±РѕС‚Р° СЃ РёР·РѕР±СЂР°Р¶РµРЅРёСЏРјРё: СѓРґР°Р»РµРЅРёРµ РѕРґРЅРѕС‚РѕРЅРЅРѕРіРѕ С„РѕРЅР° (chroma-key),
   РІС‹С‡РёСЃР»РµРЅРёРµ СЂР°Р·РјРµСЂРѕРІ РїРѕРґ РІСЃС‚Р°РІРєСѓ.
   ============================================================ */

export interface TransparentOptions {
  tolerance?: number;
  keyColor?: string | 'auto';
  maxSize?: number;
}

const hexToRgb = (hex: string): { r: number; g: number; b: number } => {
  const m = hex.replace('#', '').match(/.{2}/g);
  if (!m || m.length < 3) return { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255 };
  return {
    r: parseInt(m[0], 16),
    g: parseInt(m[1], 16),
    b: parseInt(m[2], 16),
  };
};

export function loadImage(src: string): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const img = new Image();
    img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    img.onload = () => resolve(img);
    img.onerror = (e) => reject(e);
    img.src = src;
  });
}

export async function makeImageTransparent(
  src: string,
  options: TransparentOptions = {},
): Promise<string> {
  const { tolerance = 30, keyColor = 'auto', maxSize = 2048 } = options;

  const img = await loadImage(src);

  let w = img.naturalWidth || img.width;
  let h = img.naturalHeight || img.height;
  const k = Math.min(1, maxSize / Math.max(w, h));
  w = Math.max(1, Math.round(w * k));
  h = Math.max(1, Math.round(h * k));

  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = w;
  canvas.height = h;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
  if (!ctx) return src;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
  ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);

  let data: ImageData;
  try {
    data = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h);
  } catch {
    return src;
  }
  const px = data.data;

  let kr: number, kg: number, kb: number;
  if (keyColor === 'auto') {
    const idxs = [
      0,
      (w - 1) * 4,
      (h - 1) * w * 4,
      ((h - 1) * w + (w - 1)) * 4,
    ];
    let r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
    for (const i of idxs) {
      r += px[i];
      g += px[i + 1];
      b += px[i + 2];
    }
    kr = r / 4;
    kg = g / 4;
    kb = b / 4;
  } else {
    const rgb = hexToRgb(keyColor);
    kr = rgb.r;
    kg = rgb.g;
    kb = rgb.b;
  }

  const tol = tolerance;
  const tol2 = tol * tol * 3;
  const softEdge2 = tol2 * 4;

  for (let i = 0; i < px.length; i += 4) {
    const dr = px[i] - kr;
    const dg = px[i + 1] - kg;
    const db = px[i + 2] - kb;
    const dist2 = dr * dr + dg * dg + db * db;

    if (dist2 <= tol2) {
      px[i + 3] = 0;
    } else if (dist2 < softEdge2) {
      const d = Math.sqrt(dist2);
      const t = (d - tol) / tol;
      px[i + 3] = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(px[i + 3] * t)));
    }
  }

  ctx.putImageData(data, 0, 0);
  return canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
}

export function fitImageSize(
  naturalW: number,
  naturalH: number,
  slideW: number,
  slideH: number,
  maxRatio = 0.6,
): { width: number; height: number } {
  const maxW = Math.max(40, slideW * maxRatio);
  const maxH = Math.max(40, slideH * maxRatio);
  const k = Math.min(1, maxW / naturalW, maxH / naturalH);
  return {
    width: Math.max(20, Math.round(naturalW * k)),
    height: Math.max(20, Math.round(naturalH * k)),
  };
}

export interface PolylinePoint {
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

/** Р Р°Р·Р±РѕСЂ РїР»РѕСЃРєРѕРіРѕ РјР°СЃСЃРёРІР° [x1, y1, x2, y2, ...] РІ РјР°СЃСЃРёРІ С‚РѕС‡РµРє. */
export function parsePoints(flat: number[] | undefined): PolylinePoint[] {
  if (!flat || flat.length < 4) return [];
  const out: PolylinePoint[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i + 1 < flat.length; i += 2) {
    out.push({ x: flat[i], y: flat[i + 1] });
  }
  return out;
}

/** РЎРµСЂРёР°Р»РёР·Р°С†РёСЏ РјР°СЃСЃРёРІР° С‚РѕС‡РµРє РІ РїР»РѕСЃРєРёР№ РјР°СЃСЃРёРІ. */
export function serializePoints(pts: PolylinePoint[]): number[] {
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (const p of pts) out.push(p.x, p.y);
  return out;
}

/**
 * РќР°Р№С‚Рё Р±Р»РёР¶Р°Р№С€РёР№ СЃРµРіРјРµРЅС‚ Рє С‚РѕС‡РєРµ (px, py).
 * Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ РёРЅРґРµРєСЃ СЃРµРіРјРµРЅС‚Р°, РїР°СЂР°РјРµС‚СЂ t (0..1) РЅР° РЅС‘Рј,
 * СЂР°СЃСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёРµ РґРѕ СЃРµРіРјРµРЅС‚Р° Рё РєРѕРѕСЂРґРёРЅР°С‚С‹ РїСЂРѕРµРєС†РёРё.
 */
export function findNearestSegment(
  points: PolylinePoint[],
  px: number,
  py: number,
): { segmentIndex: number; t: number; distance: number; pointX: number; pointY: number } {
  let best = {
    segmentIndex: 0, t: 0, distance: Infinity, pointX: 0, pointY: 0,
  };
  for (let i = 0; i + 1 < points.length; i++) {
    const a = points[i];
    const b = points[i + 1];
    const dx = b.x - a.x;
    const dy = b.y - a.y;
    const len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy || 1;
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((px - a.x) * dx + (py - a.y) * dy) / len2));
    const qx = a.x + t * dx;
    const qy = a.y + t * dy;
    const d = Math.hypot(px - qx, py - qy);
    if (d < best.distance) {
      best = { segmentIndex: i, t, distance: d, pointX: qx, pointY: qy };
    }
  }
  return best;
}

/**
 * Р’СЃС‚Р°РІРёС‚СЊ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ РІ Р±Р»РёР¶Р°Р№С€РёР№ СЃРµРіРјРµРЅС‚.
 *  - snapRadius вЂ” РЅРµ РґСѓР±Р»РёСЂРѕРІР°С‚СЊ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ, РµСЃР»Рё РєР»РёРє РїРѕРїР°Р» РїРѕС‡С‚Рё РЅР° СЃСѓС‰РµСЃС‚РІСѓСЋС‰СѓСЋ.
 *  - Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ РЅРѕРІС‹Р№ РјР°СЃСЃРёРІ; РµСЃР»Рё РёР·РјРµРЅРµРЅРёР№ РЅРµС‚, РІРµСЂРЅС‘С‚ РёСЃС…РѕРґРЅС‹Р№.
 */
export function insertPoint(
  points: PolylinePoint[],
  px: number,
  py: number,
  snapRadius = 5,
): PolylinePoint[] {
  for (const p of points) {
    if (Math.hypot(p.x - px, p.y - py) < snapRadius) return points;
  }

  const { segmentIndex, pointX, pointY } = findNearestSegment(points, px, py);
  const next = points.slice();
  next.splice(segmentIndex + 1, 0, { x: Math.round(pointX), y: Math.round(pointY) });
  return next;
}

/** РЈРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ РїРѕ РёРЅРґРµРєСЃСѓ. РњРёРЅРёРјСѓРј 2 С‚РѕС‡РєРё РґРѕР»Р¶РЅРѕ РѕСЃС‚Р°С‚СЊСЃСЏ. */
export function removePoint(points: PolylinePoint[], index: number): PolylinePoint[] {
  if (points.length <= 2) return points;
  const next = points.slice();
  next.splice(index, 1);
  return next;
}

/** РњР°СЃС€С‚Р°Р±РёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРёРµ С‚РѕС‡РµРє РѕС‚РЅРѕСЃРёС‚РµР»СЊРЅРѕ С‚РѕС‡РєРё РїСЂРёРІСЏР·РєРё (РІ С‚РµС… Р¶Рµ РєРѕРѕСЂРґРёРЅР°С‚Р°С…). */
export function scalePoints(
  points: PolylinePoint[],
  sx: number,
  sy: number,
  ox = 0,
  oy = 0,
): PolylinePoint[] {
  return points.map((p) => ({
    x: (p.x - ox) * sx + ox,
    y: (p.y - oy) * sy + oy,
  }));
}

/** BBox РЅР°Р±РѕСЂР° С‚РѕС‡РµРє. */
export function getPointsBBox(points: PolylinePoint[]): {
  minX: number; minY: number; maxX: number; maxY: number;
  width: number; height: number;
} {
  if (!points.length) {
    return { minX: 0, minY: 0, maxX: 0, maxY: 0, width: 0, height: 0 };
  }
  let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
  for (const p of points) {
    if (p.x < minX) minX = p.x;
    if (p.y < minY) minY = p.y;
    if (p.x > maxX) maxX = p.x;
    if (p.y > maxY) maxY = p.y;
  }
  return { minX, minY, maxX, maxY, width: maxX - minX, height: maxY - minY };
}

/** Р“Р°СЂР°РЅС‚РёСЂСѓРµС‚ РјРёРЅРёРјСѓРј 2 С‚РѕС‡РєРё: РµСЃР»Рё РїСЂРёС€С‘Р» РїСѓСЃС‚РѕР№ РјР°СЃСЃРёРІ вЂ” РІРµСЂРЅС‘С‚ РіРѕСЂРёР·РѕРЅС‚Р°Р»СЊ. */
export function ensureMinimalPoints(
  flat: number[] | undefined,
  width: number,
  height: number,
): number[] {
  if (flat && flat.length >= 4) return flat;
  return [0, height / 2, width, height / 2];
}

import type { DataRoot } from '../types';

export function resolveSample(data: DataRoot[], path: string): string | null {
  if (!path) return null;
  const clean = path.replace(/\[\d+\]/g, '');
  const parts = clean.split('.');
  const rootName = parts.shift();
  if (!rootName) return null;
  const root = data.find((d) => d.name === rootName);
  if (!root) return null;

  let fields = root.fields;
  let current: any = null;
  for (const p of parts) {
    current = fields.find((f) => f.name === p);
    if (!current) return null;
    fields = current.children || [];
  }
  return current ? current.sample : null;
}

import type { TextRun, PositionedRun, LayoutResult } from './types';

const PARAGRAPH_GAP_PX = 8;

export function layoutRuns(
  runs: TextRun[],
  maxWidth: number,
  lineHeightCoef: number,
): LayoutResult {
  if (!runs.length || maxWidth <= 0) {
    return { lines: [], totalHeight: 0, lineHeight: 0 };
  }

  let baseFontSize = 16;
  let baseFontFamily = 'Arial';
  for (const run of runs) {
    if (run.fontSize) baseFontSize = run.fontSize;
    if (run.fontFamily) baseFontFamily = run.fontFamily;
  }

  const tokens = tokenize(runs, baseFontSize, baseFontFamily);
  const paragraphGap = PARAGRAPH_GAP_PX;

  const lines: PositionedRun[][] = [];
  let currentLine: PositionedRun[] = [];
  let currentLineMaxFontSize = 0;
  let cursorX = 0;
  let cursorY = 0;
  let pendingNewlines = 0;

  /* Р’РµРґСѓС‰РёРµ \n РїРµСЂРµРґ РїРµСЂРІС‹Рј С‚РµРєСЃС‚РѕРј. РџСЂРёРјРµРЅСЏРµС‚СЃСЏ РћР”РРќ СЂР°Р·
     РїСЂРё РїРµСЂРІРѕРј pushToken: СЃРґРІРёРіР°РµС‚ РІРµСЃСЊ Р±Р»РѕРє РІРЅРёР·. */
  let leadingGapY = 0;

  const flushLine = () => {
    if (!currentLine.length) return;
    lines.push(currentLine);

    const lh = Math.max(
      currentLineMaxFontSize,
      Math.round(currentLineMaxFontSize * lineHeightCoef),
    );
    cursorY += lh;
    cursorX = 0;
    currentLine = [];
    currentLineMaxFontSize = 0;
  };

  /**
   * pendingNewlines = 2 в†’ РѕРґРёРЅ Р°Р±Р·Р°С† (gap).
   * pendingNewlines = 4 в†’ Р°Р±Р·Р°С† + РїСѓСЃС‚Р°СЏ СЃС‚СЂРѕРєР°.
   * pendingNewlines = 6 в†’ Р°Р±Р·Р°С† + 2 РїСѓСЃС‚С‹Рµ СЃС‚СЂРѕРєРё.
   *
   * Р•СЃР»Рё РµС‰С‘ РЅРёС‡РµРіРѕ РЅРµ РЅР°СЂРёСЃРѕРІР°РЅРѕ вЂ” СЌС‚Рѕ Р’Р•Р”РЈР©РР• РїСѓСЃС‚С‹Рµ Р°Р±Р·Р°С†С‹,
   * СЃРѕС…СЂР°РЅСЏРµРј РёС… РєР°Рє leadingGapY.
   */
  const applyPendingNewlines = (isEnd: boolean) => {
    if (pendingNewlines === 0) return;

    const approxLh = Math.round(baseFontSize * lineHeightCoef);

    if (lines.length === 0 && currentLine.length === 0) {
      /* Р•С‰С‘ РЅРёС‡РµРіРѕ РЅРµ СЂРёСЃРѕРІР°Р»Рё. */
      if (!isEnd) {
        const pairs = Math.floor(pendingNewlines / 2);
        if (pairs > 0) {
          leadingGapY += paragraphGap;
          for (let p = 1; p < pairs; p++) {
            leadingGapY += approxLh + paragraphGap;
          }
        } else {
          /* РћРґРёРЅРѕС‡РЅС‹Р№ \n РІ СЃР°РјРѕРј РЅР°С‡Р°Р»Рµ вЂ” РѕРґРЅР° РїСѓСЃС‚Р°СЏ СЃС‚СЂРѕРєР°. */
          leadingGapY += approxLh;
        }
      }
      pendingNewlines = 0;
      return;
    }

    flushLine();

    if (!isEnd) {
      const pairs = Math.floor(pendingNewlines / 2);
      if (pairs > 0) {
        cursorY += paragraphGap;
        for (let p = 1; p < pairs; p++) {
          cursorY += approxLh + paragraphGap;
        }
      }
    }
    pendingNewlines = 0;
  };

  const pushToken = (tk: Token, text: string, width: number) => {
    /* РџРµСЂРІС‹Р№ С‚РѕРєРµРЅ вЂ” РїСЂРёРјРµРЅСЏРµРј РІРµРґСѓС‰РёР№ РѕС‚СЃС‚СѓРї. */
    if (leadingGapY > 0 && currentLine.length === 0 && lines.length === 0) {
      cursorY += leadingGapY;
      leadingGapY = 0;
    }
    if (tk.fsize > currentLineMaxFontSize) currentLineMaxFontSize = tk.fsize;
    currentLine.push({
      text,
      bold: tk.bold,
      italic: tk.italic,
      underline: tk.underline,
      strike: tk.strike,
      color: tk.color,
      bgColor: tk.bgColor,
      href: tk.href,
      fontSize: tk.fsize,
      fontFamily: tk.ffamily,
      x: cursorX,
      y: cursorY,
      width,
      actualFontSize: tk.fsize,
    });
    cursorX += width;
  };

  for (const tk of tokens) {
    if (tk.text === '\n') {
      pendingNewlines++;
      continue;
    }

    const isSpace = /^\s+$/.test(tk.text);
    if (isSpace && cursorX === 0 && pendingNewlines === 0) continue;

    applyPendingNewlines(false);

    if (cursorX + tk.width <= maxWidth) {
      pushToken(tk, tk.text, tk.width);
      continue;
    }

    if (cursorX > 0) flushLine();

    if (isSpace) continue;

    if (tk.width > maxWidth) {
      const chars = Array.from(tk.text);
      let chunk = '';
      let chunkWidth = 0;

      for (const ch of chars) {
        const cw = measureText(ch, tk.fsize, tk.ffamily, tk.style);
        if (chunkWidth + cw > maxWidth && chunk.length > 0) {
          pushToken(tk, chunk, chunkWidth);
          flushLine();
          chunk = ch;
          chunkWidth = cw;
        } else {
          chunk += ch;
          chunkWidth += cw;
        }
      }

      if (chunk.length) pushToken(tk, chunk, chunkWidth);
      continue;
    }

    pushToken(tk, tk.text, tk.width);
  }

  applyPendingNewlines(true);
  flushLine();

  let totalHeight = 0;
  for (const line of lines) {
    for (const r of line) {
      const bottom = r.y + Math.max(r.actualFontSize, r.actualFontSize * lineHeightCoef);
      if (bottom > totalHeight) totalHeight = bottom;
    }
  }

  return {
    lines,
    totalHeight,
    lineHeight: 0,
  };
}

/* ============================================================ */

function tokenize(
  runs: TextRun[],
  baseFontSize: number,
  baseFontFamily: string,
): Token[] {
  const tokens: Token[] = [];

  for (const run of runs) {
    const fs = run.fontSize ?? baseFontSize;
    const ff = run.fontFamily ?? baseFontFamily;
    const style =
      run.bold && run.italic ? 'italic bold'
      : run.bold ? 'bold'
      : run.italic ? 'italic'
      : 'normal';

    for (const part of run.text.split(/(\n)/)) {
      if (part === '') continue;
      if (part === '\n') {
        tokens.push({ ...run, text: '\n', width: 0, fsize: fs, ffamily: ff, style });
        continue;
      }
      for (const w of part.split(/(\s+)/)) {
        if (w === '') continue;
        tokens.push({
          ...run,
          text: w,
          width: measureText(w, fs, ff, style),
          fsize: fs,
          ffamily: ff,
          style,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  return tokens;
}

/* ============================================================
   РР·РјРµСЂРµРЅРёРµ С€РёСЂРёРЅС‹ С‚РµРєСЃС‚Р° С‡РµСЂРµР· offscreen canvas.
   ============================================================ */

let measureCtx: CanvasRenderingContext2D | null | undefined;

function getCtx(): CanvasRenderingContext2D | null {
  if (measureCtx === undefined) {
    measureCtx =
      typeof document !== 'undefined'
        ? document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d')
        : null;
  }
  return measureCtx;
}

export function measureText(
  text: string,
  fontSize: number,
  fontFamily: string,
  fontStyle: string,
): number {
  const ctx = getCtx();
  if (!ctx) return text.length * fontSize * 0.55;
  const style = fontStyle || 'normal';
  ctx.font = `${style} ${fontSize}px ${fontFamily}, Arial, sans-serif`;
  return ctx.measureText(text).width;
}

import type { BaseStyle, RichBlock } from '../types';
import { parseHtmlToRuns } from './runs';
import { parseTableEl } from './table';

/* ============================================================
   HTML в†’ RichBlock[]  (С‚РµРєСЃС‚ + С‚Р°Р±Р»РёС†С‹ РІРµСЂС…РЅРµРіРѕ СѓСЂРѕРІРЅСЏ)
   ============================================================ */

export function parseHtmlToBlocks(html: string, base: BaseStyle): RichBlock[] {
  if (!html) return [];
  if (typeof DOMParser === 'undefined') {
    const runs = parseHtmlToRuns(html, base);
    return runs.length ? [{ kind: 'text', runs }] : [];
  }

  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
  return parseNodesToBlocks(doc.body.childNodes, base);
}

/**
 * Р Р°Р·Р±РѕСЂ СЃРѕРґРµСЂР¶РёРјРѕРіРѕ СЏС‡РµР№РєРё С‚Р°Р±Р»РёС†С‹.
 *
 * Р’РђР–РќРћ: РїСѓСЃС‚С‹Рµ <p></p> РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРё СЏС‡РµР№РєРё вЂ” СЌС‚Рѕ РѕСЃРѕР·РЅР°РЅРЅС‹Р№ РІРёР·СѓР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№
 * СЂР°Р·РґРµР»РёС‚РµР»СЊ (РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЊ РЅР°Р¶Р°Р» Enter РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРё С‚РµРєСЃС‚Р°). РС… РЅРµР»СЊР·СЏ
 * СѓРґР°Р»СЏС‚СЊ. РЈРґР°Р»СЏРµРј С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РїСѓСЃС‚С‹Рµ <p> РЅР° РЎРђРњР«РҐ РљР РђРЇРҐ СЏС‡РµР№РєРё вЂ”
 * РѕРЅРё РґР°СЋС‚ Р»РёС€РЅРёР№ РѕС‚СЃС‚СѓРї СЃРІРµСЂС…Сѓ/СЃРЅРёР·Сѓ.
 */
export function parseCellBlocks(cellEl: HTMLElement, base: BaseStyle): RichBlock[] {
  const clone = cellEl.cloneNode(true) as HTMLElement;

  /* РЎРЅРёРјР°РµРј РїСѓСЃС‚С‹Рµ <p> С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РїРѕ РєСЂР°СЏРј вЂ” СЃРІРµСЂС…Сѓ Рё СЃРЅРёР·Сѓ. */
  const directPs = Array.from(clone.querySelectorAll(':scope > p')) as HTMLElement[];

  while (directPs.length) {
    const p = directPs[0];
    if (p.textContent?.trim() || p.querySelector('br, table')) break;
    p.remove();
    directPs.shift();
  }
  while (directPs.length) {
    const p = directPs[directPs.length - 1];
    if (p.textContent?.trim() || p.querySelector('br, table')) break;
    p.remove();
    directPs.pop();
  }

  /* Р’РµРґСѓС‰РёРµ/Р·Р°РјС‹РєР°СЋС‰РёРµ <br> РІ СЏС‡РµР№РєРµ вЂ” СѓР±РёСЂР°РµРј. */
  while (clone.firstChild && (clone.firstChild as Element).nodeName === 'BR') {
    clone.removeChild(clone.firstChild);
  }
  while (clone.lastChild && (clone.lastChild as Element).nodeName === 'BR') {
    clone.removeChild(clone.lastChild);
  }

  return parseNodesToBlocks(clone.childNodes, base);
}

/* ============================================================
   Р’РЅСѓС‚СЂРµРЅРЅРµРµ
   ============================================================ */

const CONTAINER_TAGS = new Set([
  'div', 'section', 'article', 'main', 'aside', 'figure',
  'blockquote', 'header', 'footer', 'nav', 'span',
]);

function parseNodesToBlocks(
  nodes: NodeListOf<ChildNode> | ChildNode[],
  base: BaseStyle,
): RichBlock[] {
  const blocks: RichBlock[] = [];
  let pendingHtml = '';

  const flushText = () => {
    if (!pendingHtml.trim()) { pendingHtml = ''; return; }
    const runs = parseHtmlToRuns(pendingHtml, base);
    if (runs.length) blocks.push({ kind: 'text', runs });
    pendingHtml = '';
  };

  const visit = (node: Node) => {
    if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
      pendingHtml += (node.textContent ?? '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
      return;
    }
    if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
      return;
    }

    const el = node as HTMLElement;
    const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();

    if (tag === 'table') {
      flushText();
      try {
        const data = parseTableEl(el, base, parseCellBlocks);
        if (data && data.cells.length) {
          blocks.push({ kind: 'table', data });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('[richText] parseTableEl failed:', err);
        const runs = parseHtmlToRuns(el.textContent ?? '', base);
        if (runs.length) blocks.push({ kind: 'text', runs });
      }
      return;
    }

    if (CONTAINER_TAGS.has(tag) && el.querySelector('table')) {
      for (const child of Array.from(el.childNodes)) {
        visit(child);
      }
      return;
    }

    pendingHtml += el.outerHTML;
  };

  for (const node of Array.from(nodes)) {
    visit(node);
  }
  flushText();

  return blocks;
}
