import type { TextRun, BaseStyle } from '../types';

/* ============================================================
   HTML в†’ TextRun[]

   Р’РђР–РќРћ:
   - Р’РµРґСѓС‰РёРµ Рё РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРµРЅРЅРёРµ РїСѓСЃС‚С‹Рµ Р°Р±Р·Р°С†С‹ РЎРћРҐР РђРќРЇР®РўРЎРЇ РєР°Рє '\n\n'.
     РС… РїРѕС‚РѕРј РѕР±СЂР°Р±Р°С‚С‹РІР°РµС‚ layoutRuns РєР°Рє leading gap / gap РјРµР¶РґСѓ
     Р°Р±Р·Р°С†Р°РјРё. Р‘РµР· СЌС‚РѕРіРѕ Enter РІ СЂРµРґР°РєС‚РѕСЂРµ РІРёР·СѓР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ В«С‚РµСЂСЏР»СЃСЏВ».
   - РћР±СЂРµР·Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ РјР°РєСЃРёРјСѓРј РћР”РРќ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€Р°СЋС‰РёР№ '\n\n' вЂ” СЌС‚Рѕ
     С‚РµС…РЅРёС‡РµСЃРєР°СЏ РїСѓСЃС‚Р°СЏ СЃС‚СЂРѕРєР° РїРѕСЃР»Рµ РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅРµРіРѕ Р°Р±Р·Р°С†Р°.
     Р’СЃС‘, С‡С‚Рѕ Р±РѕР»СЊС€Рµ, вЂ” РѕСЃРѕР·РЅР°РЅРЅС‹Рµ РїСѓСЃС‚С‹Рµ Р°Р±Р·Р°С†С‹.
   ============================================================ */

export function parseHtmlToRuns(html: string, base: BaseStyle): TextRun[] {
  if (!html) return [];
  if (typeof DOMParser === 'undefined') {
    return [{ ...baseToRun(base), text: html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '') }];
  }

  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
  const runs: TextRun[] = [];

  const pushLine = (style: Partial<TextRun>) => {
    if (runs.length && runs[runs.length - 1].text.endsWith('\n')) return;
    runs.push({ ...baseToRun(base), ...style, text: '\n' });
  };

  /**
   * РџР°СЂР°РіСЂР°С„РЅС‹Р№ СЂР°Р·СЂС‹РІ. force=true вЂ” РґР»СЏ РїСѓСЃС‚РѕРіРѕ Р±Р»РѕРєР°
   * (<p></p> / <p><br></p>): РґРѕР±Р°РІР»СЏРµРј '\n\n' РґР°Р¶Рµ РµСЃР»Рё
   * РїСЂРµРґС‹РґСѓС‰РёР№ СѓР¶Рµ РЅР° '\n\n'. Р­С‚Рѕ СЃРѕС…СЂР°РЅСЏРµС‚ В«РґС‹СЂРєРёВ» РјРµР¶РґСѓ
   * Р°Р±Р·Р°С†Р°РјРё, РєРѕС‚РѕСЂС‹Рµ РёРЅР°С‡Рµ СЃС…Р»РѕРїС‹РІР°СЋС‚СЃСЏ.
   */
  const pushParagraphBreak = (style: Partial<TextRun>, force = false) => {
    const last = runs[runs.length - 1];
    if (!force) {
      if (last && last.text.endsWith('\n\n')) return;
      if (last && last.text.endsWith('\n')) {
        runs.push({ ...baseToRun(base), ...style, text: '\n' });
        return;
      }
    }
    runs.push({ ...baseToRun(base), ...style, text: '\n\n' });
  };

  const makeListMarker = (depth: number, ordered: boolean, index: number): string => {
    const indent = '      '.repeat(Math.max(0, depth));
    const bullet = ordered ? `${index + 1}. ` : 'вЂў ';
    return indent + bullet;
  };

  function walk(node: Node, style: Partial<TextRun>, listDepth = 0) {
    if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
      const text = node.textContent || '';
      if (text) runs.push({ ...baseToRun(base), ...style, text });
      return;
    }
    if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return;

    const el = node as HTMLElement;
    const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();

    if (tag === 'br') {
      pushLine(style);
      return;
    }
    if (tag === 'table') return;

    /* ---------- РЎРїРёСЃРєРё: ul / ol ---------- */
    if (tag === 'ul' || tag === 'ol') {
      const ordered = tag === 'ol';
      const liList = Array.from(el.children).filter(
        (c) => (c as HTMLElement).tagName.toLowerCase() === 'li',
      );
      liList.forEach((li, idx) => {
        const marker = makeListMarker(listDepth, ordered, idx);
        runs.push({ ...baseToRun(base), ...style, text: marker });

        li.childNodes.forEach((child) => {
          if (child.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
            const ct = (child as HTMLElement).tagName.toLowerCase();
            if (ct === 'p') {
              child.childNodes.forEach((c) => walk(c, style, listDepth));
              return;
            }
            if (ct === 'ul' || ct === 'ol') {
              pushLine(style);
              walk(child, style, listDepth + 1);
              return;
            }
          }
          walk(child, style, listDepth);
        });

        pushLine(style);
      });
      return;
    }

    /* ---------- Р—Р°РіРѕР»РѕРІРєРё ---------- */
    const next: Partial<TextRun> = { ...style };
    const baseFontSize = base.fontSize || 16;
    if (tag === 'h1') { next.fontSize = Math.round(baseFontSize * 1.75); next.bold = true; }
    else if (tag === 'h2') { next.fontSize = Math.round(baseFontSize * 1.4); next.bold = true; }
    else if (tag === 'h3') { next.fontSize = Math.round(baseFontSize * 1.15); next.bold = true; }

    /* ---------- РРЅР»Р°Р№РЅ-СЃС‚РёР»Рё С‚РµРіР°РјРё ---------- */
    if (tag === 'b' || tag === 'strong') next.bold = true;
    if (tag === 'i' || tag === 'em') next.italic = true;
    if (tag === 'u') next.underline = true;
    if (tag === 's' || tag === 'strike' || tag === 'del') next.strike = true;

    if (tag === 'a') {
      const href = el.getAttribute('href') || '';
      if (href) next.href = href;
      next.underline = true;
      if (!next.color) next.color = '#2563eb';
    }
    if (tag === 'mark') {
      const bg = el.style.backgroundColor || el.getAttribute('data-color');
      if (bg) next.bgColor = bg;
    }

    /* ---------- РРЅР»Р°Р№РЅ-СЃС‚РёР»Рё С‡РµСЂРµР· style="..." ---------- */
    const s = el.style;
    if (s) {
      if (s.color) next.color = s.color;
      if (s.backgroundColor) next.bgColor = s.backgroundColor;
      if (s.fontSize) {
        const n = parseFloat(s.fontSize);
        if (!Number.isNaN(n) && n > 0) next.fontSize = n;
      }
      if (s.fontFamily) {
        next.fontFamily = s.fontFamily.replace(/["']/g, '').split(',')[0].trim();
      }
      const fw = s.fontWeight;
      if (fw === 'bold' || (fw && parseInt(fw, 10) >= 600)) next.bold = true;
      if (s.fontStyle === 'italic') next.italic = true;
      const td = s.textDecoration || '';
      if (td.includes('underline')) next.underline = true;
      if (td.includes('line-through')) next.strike = true;
    }

    const isBlock = tag === 'p' || tag === 'div' || tag === 'h1' || tag === 'h2' || tag === 'h3';

    if (isBlock) {
      /* <p></p> Рё <p><br></p> СЃС‡РёС‚Р°СЋС‚СЃСЏ РїСѓСЃС‚С‹РјРё вЂ” РґР»СЏ РЅРёС…
         РїР°СЂР°РіСЂР°С„РЅС‹Р№ СЂР°Р·СЂС‹РІ РґРѕР±Р°РІР»СЏРµРј РїСЂРёРЅСѓРґРёС‚РµР»СЊРЅРѕ, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹
         СЃС…Р»РѕРїС‹РІР°РЅРёРµ РЅРµ СЃСЉРµР»Рѕ РїСѓСЃС‚СѓСЋ СЃС‚СЂРѕРєСѓ. */
      const wasEmpty = !(el.textContent || '').trim();

      el.childNodes.forEach((child) => walk(child, next, listDepth));
      pushParagraphBreak(style, wasEmpty);
      return;
    }

    el.childNodes.forEach((child) => walk(child, next, listDepth));
  }

  walk(doc.body, {});

  /* Р’РµРґСѓС‰РёРµ \n РќР• РѕР±СЂРµР·Р°РµРј вЂ” РѕРЅРё РґР°СЋС‚ РѕС‚СЃС‚СѓРї СЃРІРµСЂС…Сѓ Р±Р»РѕРєР°,
     РµСЃР»Рё РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЊ РѕСЃС‚Р°РІРёР» РїСѓСЃС‚С‹Рµ Р°Р±Р·Р°С†С‹ РїРµСЂРµРґ С‚РµРєСЃС‚РѕРј. */

  /* Trailing вЂ” РјР°РєСЃРёРјСѓРј РѕРґРёРЅ \n\n (С‚РµС…РЅРёС‡РµСЃРєРёР№). */
  if (runs.length) {
    const last = runs[runs.length - 1];
    if (last.text === '\n\n' || last.text === '\n') runs.pop();
  }

  return runs;
}

/* ============================================================ */

export function baseToRun(base: BaseStyle): Omit<TextRun, 'text'> {
  return {
    bold: base.fontStyle.includes('bold'),
    italic: base.fontStyle.includes('italic'),
    underline: base.textDecoration.includes('underline'),
    strike: base.textDecoration.includes('line-through'),
    color: base.fill,
    fontSize: base.fontSize,
    fontFamily: base.fontFamily,
  };
}

import type {
  BaseStyle,
  CellAlign,
  CellVerticalAlign,
  RichTableCell,
  RichTableCellPadding,
  RichTableData,
  RichBlock,
} from '../types';

export type ParseCellBlocksFn = (cellEl: HTMLElement, base: BaseStyle) => RichBlock[];

export function parseTableEl(
  table: HTMLElement,
  base: BaseStyle,
  parseCellBlocks: ParseCellBlocksFn,
): RichTableData | null {
  if (!table) return null;

  const trList = Array.from(
    table.querySelectorAll(
      ':scope > thead > tr, :scope > tbody > tr, :scope > tfoot > tr, :scope > tr',
    ),
  );

  const cells: RichTableCell[] = [];
  const grid: (RichTableCell | null)[][] = [];

  const ensureRow = (r: number) => { while (grid.length <= r) grid.push([]); };
  const isOccupied = (r: number, c: number): boolean => {
    const row = grid[r];
    if (!row) return false;
    return row[c] !== undefined && row[c] !== null;
  };

  trList.forEach((tr, r) => {
    ensureRow(r);
    let c = 0;
    while (isOccupied(r, c)) c++;

    const cellEls = Array.from(tr.childNodes).filter(
      (ch): ch is HTMLElement =>
        ch.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE &&
        ((ch as HTMLElement).tagName.toLowerCase() === 'td' ||
          (ch as HTMLElement).tagName.toLowerCase() === 'th'),
    );

    for (const cellEl of cellEls) {
      while (isOccupied(r, c)) c++;

      const colspan = Math.max(1, parseInt(cellEl.getAttribute('colspan') || '1', 10) || 1);
      const rowspan = Math.max(1, parseInt(cellEl.getAttribute('rowspan') || '1', 10) || 1);
      const isHeader = cellEl.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'th';

      const cell: RichTableCell = {
        blocks: parseCellBlocks(cellEl, base),
        isHeader,
        colspan,
        rowspan,
        rowIndex: r,
        colIndex: c,
        rawWidths: parseRawWidths(cellEl),
        bgColor: cellEl.style.backgroundColor || undefined,
        borderColor: cellEl.style.borderColor || undefined,
        borderWidth: parseFloatOrUndef(cellEl.style.borderWidth),
        borderStyle: cellEl.style.borderStyle || undefined,
        padding: parsePadding(cellEl),
        align: readCellAlign(cellEl, isHeader),
        verticalAlign: readCellVerticalAlign(cellEl),
      };
      cells.push(cell);

      for (let rr = 0; rr < rowspan; rr++) {
        ensureRow(r + rr);
        for (let cc = 0; cc < colspan; cc++) {
          grid[r + rr][c + cc] = cell;
        }
      }
      c += colspan;
    }
  });

  let colCount = 0;
  for (const row of grid) {
    if (!row) continue;
    for (let i = row.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (row[i] !== undefined && row[i] !== null) {
        if (i + 1 > colCount) colCount = i + 1;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  if (colCount === 0) colCount = 1;

  const colWidths = resolveColWidths(table, cells, colCount);

  /* ============================================================
     [table-debug] Р’Р Р•РњР•РќРќР«Р™ Р›РћР“. РЈРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ РїРѕСЃР»Рµ РґРёР°РіРЅРѕСЃС‚РёРєРё.
     ============================================================ */
  try {
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
    console.group('[table-debug]');

    const colgroup = findColgroup(table);
    if (colgroup) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.log('colgroup cols:', Array.from(colgroup.children).map(
        (c: any, i) => `${i}: width="${c.style?.width}" minWidth="${c.style?.minWidth}" attrWidth="${c.getAttribute('width')}"`
      ));
    } else {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.log('colgroup: РѕС‚СЃСѓС‚СЃС‚РІСѓРµС‚');
    }

    // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
    console.log('cells:', cells.map(c =>
      `[${c.rowIndex},${c.colIndex}] ${c.isHeader ? 'th' : 'td'} ` +
      `colspan=${c.colspan} rawWidths=[${c.rawWidths ? c.rawWidths.join(',') : 'null'}]`
    ));

    // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
    console.log('resolved colWidths:', colWidths);

    // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
    console.groupEnd();
  } catch (e) {
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
    console.warn('[table-debug] failed', e);
  }

  return { cells, rowCount: grid.length, colCount, colWidths };
}

/* ============================================================
   Р’С‹СЂР°РІРЅРёРІР°РЅРёРµ
   ============================================================ */

const ALIGN_VALUES: CellAlign[] = ['left', 'center', 'right', 'justify'];

function normalizeAlign(v: string | undefined): CellAlign | null {
  const s = (v || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (s === 'start') return 'left';
  if (s === 'end') return 'right';
  if (ALIGN_VALUES.includes(s as CellAlign)) return s as CellAlign;
  return null;
}

function readCellAlign(cellEl: HTMLElement, _isHeader: boolean): CellAlign {
  const onCell = normalizeAlign(cellEl.style.textAlign);
  if (onCell) return onCell;

  const firstBlock = cellEl.querySelector(
    ':scope > p, :scope > h1, :scope > h2, :scope > h3, :scope > div, :scope > blockquote, :scope > li',
  ) as HTMLElement | null;
  if (firstBlock) {
    const fromBlock = normalizeAlign(firstBlock.style.textAlign);
    if (fromBlock) return fromBlock;
  }

  const anyAligned = cellEl.querySelector('[style*="text-align"]') as HTMLElement | null;
  if (anyAligned) {
    const fromAny = normalizeAlign(anyAligned.style.textAlign);
    if (fromAny) return fromAny;
  }

  return 'left';
}

function readCellVerticalAlign(cellEl: HTMLElement): CellVerticalAlign {
  const onCell = (cellEl.style.verticalAlign || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (onCell === 'middle' || onCell === 'center') return 'middle';
  if (onCell === 'bottom') return 'bottom';
  if (onCell === 'top' || onCell === 'baseline') return 'top';

  const firstBlock = cellEl.firstElementChild as HTMLElement | null;
  if (firstBlock) {
    const v = (firstBlock.style.verticalAlign || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (v === 'middle' || v === 'center') return 'middle';
    if (v === 'bottom') return 'bottom';
  }

  return 'top';
}

/* ============================================================
   РЁРёСЂРёРЅС‹ РєРѕР»РѕРЅРѕРє. 0 = auto, > 0 = С„РёРєСЃРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРЅР°СЏ С€РёСЂРёРЅР° РІ px.

   РСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРєРё РґР°РЅРЅС‹С… (С‡С‚Рѕ СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ РїРёС€РµС‚ TipTap/ProseMirror):

     <td colwidth="128">              в†ђ В«РєРѕР»РѕРЅРєР° 128pxВ»    вњ… РёСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРє РёСЃС‚РёРЅС‹
     <col style="width: 128px;">      в†ђ С‚Рѕ Р¶Рµ СЃР°РјРѕРµ, РґСѓР±Р»РёСЂСѓРµС‚СЃСЏ
     <col style="min-width: 25px;">   в†ђ В«РјРёРЅРёРјСѓРј 25pxВ»     вќЊ РќР• С€РёСЂРёРЅР°

   РџСЂРёРѕСЂРёС‚РµС‚:
     1) colwidth РЅР° <td>              (ProseMirror)
     2) <colgroup><col style="width">
     3) attr width РЅР° <td>
   ============================================================ */

function resolveColWidths(
  table: HTMLElement,
  cells: RichTableCell[],
  colCount: number,
): number[] | null {
  const fromCells = readCellWidths(cells, colCount);
  if (fromCells) return fromCells;

  const fromColgroup = readColgroup(table, colCount);
  if (fromColgroup && fromColgroup.hasRealWidth) {
    return fromColgroup.widths;
  }

  if (fromColgroup) return fromColgroup.widths;

  return null;
}

function findColgroup(table: HTMLElement): Element | null {
  for (const child of Array.from(table.children)) {
    if (child.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'colgroup') return child;
  }
  return null;
}

function readColgroup(
  table: HTMLElement,
  colCount: number,
): { widths: number[]; hasRealWidth: boolean } | null {
  const colgroup = findColgroup(table);
  if (!colgroup) return null;

  const colEls = Array.from(colgroup.children).filter(
    (c) => c.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'col',
  ) as HTMLElement[];
  if (colEls.length !== colCount) return null;

  const widths: number[] = new Array(colCount).fill(0);
  let hasRealWidth = false;

  colEls.forEach((colEl, i) => {
    const w = parseFloat(colEl.style.width);
    const aw = parseFloat(colEl.getAttribute('width') || '');

    if (!Number.isNaN(w) && w > 0) {
      widths[i] = w;
      hasRealWidth = true;
    } else if (!Number.isNaN(aw) && aw > 0) {
      widths[i] = aw;
      hasRealWidth = true;
    }
  });

  return { widths, hasRealWidth };
}

function readCellWidths(cells: RichTableCell[], colCount: number): number[] | null {
  const widths: number[] = new Array(colCount).fill(0);
  let any = false;

  for (const cell of cells) {
    if (!cell.rawWidths || !cell.rawWidths.length) continue;

    if (cell.rawWidths.length === cell.colspan) {
      for (let i = 0; i < cell.colspan; i++) {
        const col = cell.colIndex + i;
        if (col < colCount && widths[col] === 0) {
          widths[col] = cell.rawWidths[i];
          any = true;
        }
      }
    } else if (cell.rawWidths.length === 1) {
      if (widths[cell.colIndex] === 0) {
        widths[cell.colIndex] = cell.rawWidths[0];
        any = true;
      }
    }
  }

  return any ? widths : null;
}

/* ============================================================
   РҐРµР»РїРµСЂС‹
   ============================================================ */

function parseFloatOrUndef(v: string | null | undefined): number | undefined {
  if (!v) return undefined;
  const n = parseFloat(v);
  return Number.isNaN(n) ? undefined : n;
}

export function parsePadding(el: HTMLElement): RichTableCellPadding | undefined {
  const s = el.style;
  if (!s) return undefined;

  const top = parseFloat(s.paddingTop);
  const right = parseFloat(s.paddingRight);
  const bottom = parseFloat(s.paddingBottom);
  const left = parseFloat(s.paddingLeft);
  const anySide = [top, right, bottom, left].some((n) => !Number.isNaN(n));

  let p: RichTableCellPadding | null = null;
  if (anySide) {
    p = {
      top: Number.isNaN(top) ? 0 : top,
      right: Number.isNaN(right) ? 0 : right,
      bottom: Number.isNaN(bottom) ? 0 : bottom,
      left: Number.isNaN(left) ? 0 : left,
    };
  }

  const shorthand = s.padding;
  if (shorthand) {
    const parts = shorthand.trim().split(/\s+/).map((x) => parseFloat(x) || 0);
    if (parts.length === 1) p = { top: parts[0], right: parts[0], bottom: parts[0], left: parts[0] };
    else if (parts.length === 2) p = { top: parts[0], right: parts[1], bottom: parts[0], left: parts[1] };
    else if (parts.length === 3) p = { top: parts[0], right: parts[1], bottom: parts[2], left: parts[1] };
    else if (parts.length >= 4) p = { top: parts[0], right: parts[1], bottom: parts[2], left: parts[3] };
  }

  return p ?? undefined;
}

function parseRawWidths(cellEl: HTMLElement): number[] | null {
  /* 1) colwidth РЅР° <td> вЂ” РѕСЃРЅРѕРІРЅРѕР№ РёСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРє РѕС‚ ProseMirror. */
  const fromAttr = cellEl.getAttribute('colwidth');
  if (fromAttr && fromAttr !== 'null') {
    const arr = fromAttr
      .split(',')
      .map((x) => parseFloat(x.trim()))
      .filter((n) => !Number.isNaN(n) && n > 0);
    if (arr.length) return arr;
  }

  /* 2) style.width вЂ” РґР»СЏ HTML, РІСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅРѕРіРѕ РёР· РІРЅРµС€РЅРёС… РёСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРєРѕРІ
        Рё РґР»СЏ С€Р°Р±Р»РѕРЅРѕРІ, РіРґРµ СЏ Р·Р°РґР°СЋ С€РёСЂРёРЅС‹ РІ style. */
  const sw = cellEl.style?.width;
  if (sw) {
    const n = parseFloat(sw);
    if (!Number.isNaN(n) && n > 0) return [n];
  }

  return null;
}

/* ============================================================
   Fallback: plain text в†’ HTML РґР»СЏ РµРґРёРЅРѕРѕР±СЂР°Р·РЅРѕРіРѕ РїР°СЂСЃРёРЅРіР°.
   ============================================================ */

export function plainToHtml(text: string): string {
  const esc = (text || '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
  return `<p>${esc.replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</p>`;
}

import type { StampShapeItem, StampTextItem } from '../../types';
import { uid } from '../uid';

const shape = (
  o: Partial<StampShapeItem> & { kind: StampShapeItem['kind'] },
): StampShapeItem => ({
  id: uid(),
  x: 0, y: 0, width: 100, height: 100,
  rotation: 0, cornerRadius: 0,
  stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 1, dash: 'solid',
  fill: undefined,
  ...o,
});

const text = (
  o: Partial<StampTextItem> & { text: string; mode: 'straight' | 'arc' },
): StampTextItem => ({
  id: uid(),
  x: 0, y: 0, width: 200, align: 'center',
  arcCx: 100, arcCy: 100, arcRadius: 60,
  arcStartDeg: -90, arcEndDeg: 90, arcFlip: false,
  arcOffset: 6, arcSpanDeg: 140,
  fontSize: 12, fontFamily: 'Arial', fontStyle: 'normal',
  textDecoration: '', fill: INK,
  ...o,
});

/**
 * Anchor-Р·Р°Р»РёРІРєР°: РїРѕР»РЅРѕСЃС‚СЊСЋ РїРѕРІС‚РѕСЂСЏРµС‚ РіРµРѕРјРµС‚СЂРёСЋ С†РµР»РµРІРѕРіРѕ РєРѕРЅС‚РµР№РЅРµСЂР°.
 * bbox = РІРµСЃСЊ С€С‚Р°РјРї, seed Р·Р°РґР°С‘С‚СЃСЏ РІ РґРѕР»СЏС… РѕС‚ bbox РєРѕРЅС‚РµР№РЅРµСЂР°.
 */
function anchorFill(
  container: StampShapeItem,
  color: string,
  anchorLocal: { x: number; y: number },
  stampW: number,
  stampH: number,
  name = 'Р—Р°Р»РёРІРєР°',
): StampShapeItem {
  return {
    id: uid(),
    kind: 'fill',
    x: 0, y: 0,
    width: stampW, height: stampH,
    rotation: 0,
    cornerRadius: 0,
    stroke: '', strokeWidth: 0, dash: 'solid',
    fill: color,
    name,
    fillTargetShapeId: container.id,
    fillAnchorLocal: anchorLocal,
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   QR-Р·Р°РіР»СѓС€РєР° вЂ” РєРІР°РґСЂР°С‚ СЃ РїР°С‚С‚РµСЂРЅРѕРј
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

function qrSvg(seed = 1): string {
  /* РџСЂРѕСЃС‚РѕР№ РїСЃРµРІРґРѕ-QR: 8x8 СЃРµС‚РєР°, РґРµС‚РµСЂРјРёРЅРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРЅС‹Р№ РїРѕ seed */
  const cells: string[] = [];
  const size = 100;
  const n = 8;
  const cellSize = size / n;

  /* РџСЃРµРІРґРѕСЃР»СѓС‡Р°Р№РЅС‹Р№ РґРµС‚РµСЂРјРёРЅРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРЅС‹Р№ РіРµРЅРµСЂР°С‚РѕСЂ */
  let state = seed * 9301 + 49297;
  const rnd = () => {
    state = (state * 9301 + 49297) % 233280;
    return state / 233280;
  };

  for (let y = 0; y < n; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < n; x++) {
      /* РЈРіР»РѕРІС‹Рµ РјР°СЂРєРµСЂС‹ (РєР°Рє РІ РЅР°СЃС‚РѕСЏС‰РµРј QR) */
      const isCorner =
        (x < 3 && y < 3) ||
        (x >= n - 3 && y < 3) ||
        (x < 3 && y >= n - 3);
      /* Р’РЅСѓС‚СЂРё СѓРіР»РѕРІС‹С… РјР°СЂРєРµСЂРѕРІ вЂ” С‚РѕС‡РЅС‹Р№ СЂРёСЃСѓРЅРѕРє */
      const inCornerFrame =
        (x === 0 || x === 2 || y === 0 || y === 2) && x < 3 && y < 3;
      const innerCorner = x === 1 && y === 1 && false;

      if (isCorner) {
        if (inCornerFrame || innerCorner) {
          cells.push(
            `<rect x="${x * cellSize}" y="${y * cellSize}" width="${cellSize}" height="${cellSize}" fill="${INK}"/>`,
          );
        } else if (x === 1 && y === 1) {
          cells.push(
            `<rect x="${x * cellSize}" y="${y * cellSize}" width="${cellSize}" height="${cellSize}" fill="${INK}"/>`,
          );
        }
      } else if (rnd() > 0.5) {
        cells.push(
          `<rect x="${x * cellSize}" y="${y * cellSize}" width="${cellSize}" height="${cellSize}" fill="${INK}"/>`,
        );
      }
    }
  }

  return `
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <rect width="100" height="100" fill="${WHITE}"/>
  ${cells.join('')}
</svg>`;
}

   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

</svg>`;

/* ============================================================
   РљРѕРґРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРёРµ SVG РІ data URL
   ============================================================ */

function svgToDataUrl(svg: string): string {
  const cleaned = svg.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  /* encodeURIComponent вЂ” РЅР°РґС‘Р¶РЅРµРµ base64 РґР»СЏ РёРЅР»Р°Р№РЅ SVG */
  return `data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(cleaned)}`;
}

/* ============================================================
   Р¤Р°Р±СЂРёРєРё
   ============================================================ */

const shape = (
  o: Partial<StampShapeItem> & { kind: StampShapeItem['kind'] },
): StampShapeItem => ({
  id: uid(),
  x: 0, y: 0, width: 100, height: 100,
  rotation: 0, cornerRadius: 0,
  stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 1, dash: 'solid',
  fill: undefined,
  ...o,
});

const text = (
  o: Partial<StampTextItem> & { text: string; mode: 'straight' | 'arc' },
): StampTextItem => ({
  id: uid(),
  x: 0, y: 0, width: 200, align: 'center',
  arcCx: 100, arcCy: 100, arcRadius: 60,
  arcStartDeg: -90, arcEndDeg: 90, arcFlip: false,
  arcOffset: 6, arcSpanDeg: 140,
  fontSize: 12, fontFamily: 'Arial', fontStyle: 'normal',
  textDecoration: '', fill: INK,
  ...o,
});

const image = (
  src: string,
  x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number,
  name = 'РР·РѕР±СЂР°Р¶РµРЅРёРµ',
): StampImageItem => ({
  id: uid(),
  src,
  x, y, width: w, height: h,
  rotation: 0,
  fit: 'contain',
  name,
});

export type { PlacementMode };

export interface FactoryContext {
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  selectedId: string | null;
  selectedType: 'shape' | 'text' | 'image' | null;
  stampW: number;
  stampH: number;
  placementMode: PlacementMode;
}

const KIND_DEFAULTS: Record<StampShapeKind, { w: number; h: number; corner: number }> = {
  circle:   { w: 140, h: 140, corner: 0 },
  ellipse:  { w: 160, h: 160, corner: 0 },
  rect:     { w: 160, h: 100, corner: 12 },
  triangle: { w: 140, h: 120, corner: 0 },
  line:     { w: 160, h: 20,  corner: 0 },
  fill:     { w: 0,   h: 0,   corner: 0 },
};

function resolveHost(ctx: FactoryContext): StampShapeItem | null {
  if (ctx.selectedType !== 'shape' || !ctx.selectedId) return null;
  return ctx.shapes.find((s) => s.id === ctx.selectedId) || null;
}

export function createShape(kind: StampShapeKind, ctx: FactoryContext): StampShapeItem {
  const strategy = getShapeStrategy(kind);
  const def = strategy.defaultSize;
  const host = resolveHost(ctx);
  const geom = computeNewShapeGeometry(
    host, def.w, def.h, ctx.stampW, ctx.stampH, ctx.placementMode, 12,
  );
  const normalized = strategy.normalizeGeometry(geom);

  const shape: StampShapeItem = {
    id: uid(), kind,
    x: normalized.x, y: normalized.y,
    width: normalized.width, height: normalized.height,
    rotation: 0,
    cornerRadius: def.corner,
    stroke: '#1a1a1a',
    strokeWidth: 1,
    dash: 'solid',
  };
  if (kind === 'line') shape.points = [0, normalized.height / 2, normalized.width, normalized.height / 2];
  return shape;
}

export function createStraightText(ctx: FactoryContext): StampTextItem {
  const host = resolveHost(ctx);
  const w = 180, h = 24;
  const pos = host
    ? { x: host.x + (host.width - w) / 2, y: host.y + (host.height - h) / 2 }
    : { x: (ctx.stampW - w) / 2, y: (ctx.stampH - h) / 2 };

  return {
    id: uid(), text: 'РњРѕР№ С‚РµРєСЃС‚', mode: 'straight',
    x: Math.round(pos.x), y: Math.round(pos.y), width: w, align: 'center',
    arcCx: ctx.stampW / 2, arcCy: ctx.stampH / 2, arcRadius: 60,
    arcStartDeg: -30, arcEndDeg: 30, arcFlip: false,
    arcOffset: DEFAULT_ARC_OFFSET,
    arcSpanDeg: DEFAULT_ARC_SPAN_DEG,
    fontSize: 14, fontFamily: 'Arial', fontStyle: 'normal',
    textDecoration: '', fill: '#1a1a1a',
  };
}

export function createArcText(ctx: FactoryContext): StampTextItem {
  let host = resolveHost(ctx);
  if (!host) host = findHostShape(ctx.stampW / 2, ctx.stampH / 2, '', ctx.shapes);

  const fakeHost: StampShapeItem = host || {
    id: 'fake', kind: 'ellipse',
    x: 0, y: 0, width: ctx.stampW, height: ctx.stampH,
    rotation: 0, cornerRadius: 0, stroke: '', strokeWidth: 0, dash: 'solid',
  };

  const params = computeArcParams(

  return {

export function createFillSubtract(
  shapes: StampShapeItem[],
  selectedId: string | null,
): StampShapeItem | null {
  let outer = selectedId
    ? shapes.find((s) => s.id === selectedId && s.kind !== 'fill') || null
    : null;

  if (!outer) {
    const candidates = shapes.filter(
      (s) => s.kind !== 'fill' && !s.hidden && s.kind !== 'line',
    );
    if (!candidates.length) return null;
    outer = candidates.reduce((a, b) =>
      a.width * a.height >= b.width * b.height ? a : b,
    );
  }

  const ox = outer.x, oy = outer.y, ow = outer.width, oh = outer.height;
  const holeIds: string[] = [];
  for (const s of shapes) {
    if (s.id === outer.id || s.kind === 'fill' || s.kind === 'line') continue;
    if (s.hidden) continue;
    const cx = s.x + s.width / 2, cy = s.y + s.height / 2;
    if (cx >= ox && cx <= ox + ow && cy >= oy && cy <= oy + oh) holeIds.push(s.id);
  }

  return {
    id: uid(), kind: 'fill',
    x: ox, y: oy, width: ow, height: oh,
    rotation: 0, cornerRadius: 0,
    stroke: '', strokeWidth: 0, dash: 'solid',
    fill: '#bfdbfe',
    name: 'Р’С‹С‡РёС‚Р°РЅРёРµ',
    fillMode: 'subtract',
    fillOuterId: outer.id,
    fillHoleIds: holeIds,
  };
}

export function createFillIntersect(
  shapes: StampShapeItem[],
  selectedId: string | null,
): StampShapeItem | null {
  let a = selectedId
    ? shapes.find((s) => s.id === selectedId && s.kind !== 'fill') || null
    : null;

  if (!a) {
    const candidates = shapes.filter(
      (s) => s.kind !== 'fill' && !s.hidden && s.kind !== 'line',
    );
    if (candidates.length < 2) return null;
    a = candidates[0];
  }

  const others = shapes.filter(
    (s) => s.id !== a!.id && s.kind !== 'fill' && !s.hidden && s.kind !== 'line',
  );
  if (!others.length) return null;

  const interArea = (p: StampShapeItem, q: StampShapeItem) => {
    const x1 = Math.max(p.x, q.x), y1 = Math.max(p.y, q.y);
    const x2 = Math.min(p.x + p.width, q.x + q.width);
    const y2 = Math.min(p.y + p.height, q.y + q.height);
    return Math.max(0, x2 - x1) * Math.max(0, y2 - y1);
  };

  let b = others[0];
  let best = interArea(a, b);
  for (const o of others) {
    const v = interArea(a, o);
    if (v > best) { best = v; b = o; }
  }

  const minX = Math.min(a.x, b.x), minY = Math.min(a.y, b.y);
  const maxX = Math.max(a.x + a.width, b.x + b.width);
  const maxY = Math.max(a.y + a.height, b.y + b.height);

  return {
    id: uid(), kind: 'fill',
    x: minX, y: minY,
    width: Math.max(1, maxX - minX),
    height: Math.max(1, maxY - minY),
    rotation: 0, cornerRadius: 0,
    stroke: '', strokeWidth: 0, dash: 'solid',
    fill: '#fca5a5',
    name: 'РџРµСЂРµСЃРµС‡РµРЅРёРµ',
    fillMode: 'intersect',
    fillOuterId: a.id,
    fillHoleIds: [b.id],
  };
}

export function createFillBetween(
  outer: StampShapeItem,
  holes: StampShapeItem[],
  color: string,
  name = 'Р—Р°Р»РёРІРєР° РѕР±Р»Р°СЃС‚Рё',
): StampShapeItem {
  return {
    id: uid(), kind: 'fill',
    x: outer.x, y: outer.y,
    width: Math.max(1, outer.width),
    height: Math.max(1, outer.height),
    rotation: 0, cornerRadius: 0,
    stroke: '', strokeWidth: 0, dash: 'solid',
    fill: color,
    name,
    fillMode: 'subtract',
    fillOuterId: outer.id,
    fillHoleIds: holes.map((h) => h.id),
  };
}

import type { StampShapeItem, StampFillMode } from '../../types';
import { getShapeStrategy } from './shapes/registry';

export function shapeToPath2D(s: StampShapeItem): Path2D {
  return getShapeStrategy(s.kind).toPath(s);
}

export interface FillParticipants {
  outer: StampShapeItem;
  holes: StampShapeItem[];
  mode: StampFillMode;
}

export function paintFill(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  { outer, holes, mode }: FillParticipants,
  color: string,
): void {
  const all = [outer, ...holes];
  const minX = Math.min(...all.map((p) => p.x));
  const minY = Math.min(...all.map((p) => p.y));
  const maxX = Math.max(...all.map((p) => p.x + p.width));
  const maxY = Math.max(...all.map((p) => p.y + p.height));

  ctx.save();
  if (mode === 'intersect' && holes.length > 0) {
    ctx.clip(shapeToPath2D(outer));
    for (const h of holes) ctx.clip(shapeToPath2D(h));
  } else {
    const combined = new Path2D();
    combined.addPath(shapeToPath2D(outer));
    for (const h of holes) combined.addPath(shapeToPath2D(h));
    ctx.clip(combined, 'evenodd');
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillRect(minX, minY, maxX - minX, maxY - minY);
  ctx.restore();
}

import type { StampShapeItem } from '../../../types';

export const DEFAULT_ARC_SPAN_DEG = 320;
export const MIN_ARC_SPAN_DEG = 20;
export const MAX_ARC_SPAN_DEG = 350;
export const DEFAULT_ARC_OFFSET = 6;

export interface ArcParams {
  arcCx: number;
  arcCy: number;
  arcRadius: number;
  /* Р­Р»Р»РёРїС‚РёС‡РµСЃРєРёРµ СЂР°РґРёСѓСЃС‹, РµСЃР»Рё РґСѓРіР° РЅРµ РєСЂСѓРіРѕРІР°СЏ. */
  arcRx?: number;
  arcRy?: number;
  arcStartDeg: number;
  arcEndDeg: number;
  arcFlip: boolean;
}

function arcRadiusFor(
  host: StampShapeItem,
  fontSize: number,
  isOutside: boolean,
  arcOffset: number,
): number {
  const baseR = Math.min(host.width, host.height) / 2;
  const safeOffset = Math.max(0, arcOffset);
  if (isOutside) return baseR + safeOffset;
  return Math.max(fontSize * 0.8, baseR - safeOffset);
}

function resolveSpanDeg(
  fontSize: number,
  textLength: number,
  radius: number,
  explicitSpan?: number,
): number {
  if (explicitSpan !== undefined && explicitSpan > 0) {
    return Math.min(MAX_ARC_SPAN_DEG, Math.max(MIN_ARC_SPAN_DEG, explicitSpan));
  }
  const charWidth = fontSize * 0.6;
  const textWidth = Math.max(charWidth, textLength * charWidth);
  const raw = (textWidth / Math.max(1, radius)) * (180 / Math.PI);
  return Math.min(MAX_ARC_SPAN_DEG, Math.max(MIN_ARC_SPAN_DEG, raw));
}

export function computeArcParams(
  host: StampShapeItem,
  fontSize: number,
  textLength: number,
  isTop: boolean,
  ringOffset = 0,
  arcOffset = DEFAULT_ARC_OFFSET,
  arcSpanDeg = DEFAULT_ARC_SPAN_DEG,
): ArcParams {
  const cx = host.x + host.width / 2;
  const cy = host.y + host.height / 2;
  const radius = arcRadiusFor(host, fontSize, false, arcOffset) - ringOffset * 12;

  const span = resolveSpanDeg(fontSize, textLength, radius, arcSpanDeg);
  const half = span / 2;

  if (isTop) {
    return {
      arcCx: cx, arcCy: cy, arcRadius: radius,
      arcStartDeg: -90 - half,
      arcEndDeg: -90 + half,
      arcFlip: false,
    };
  }
  return {
    arcCx: cx, arcCy: cy, arcRadius: radius,
    arcStartDeg: 90 + half,
    arcEndDeg: 90 - half,
    arcFlip: true,
  };
}

export function computeArcParamsForAngle(
  host: StampShapeItem,
  angleRad: number,
  fontSize: number,
  isOutside: boolean,
  spanDeg: number,
  arcOffset: number = DEFAULT_ARC_OFFSET,
): ArcParams {
  const cx = host.x + host.width / 2;
  const cy = host.y + host.height / 2;
  const radius = arcRadiusFor(host, fontSize, isOutside, arcOffset);

  const centerDeg = (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;
  const isTop = Math.sin(angleRad) < 0;
  const clampedSpan = Math.min(MAX_ARC_SPAN_DEG, Math.max(MIN_ARC_SPAN_DEG, spanDeg));
  const half = clampedSpan / 2;

  const startDeg = isTop ? centerDeg - half : centerDeg + half;
  const endDeg = isTop ? centerDeg + half : centerDeg - half;

  return {
    arcCx: cx,
    arcCy: cy,
    arcRadius: radius,
    arcStartDeg: startDeg,
    arcEndDeg: endDeg,
    arcFlip: !isTop,
  };
}

export interface ArcBBox {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

/**
 * bbox РґР»СЏ arc-С‚РµРєСЃС‚Р°.
 *
 * Р”Р»СЏ РєСЂСѓРіР° вЂ” СЃС‚Р°СЂР°СЏ Р»РѕРіРёРєР° (radius РёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµС‚СЃСЏ РґР»СЏ РѕР±РѕРёС… РѕСЃРµР№).
 * Р”Р»СЏ СЌР»Р»РёРїСЃР° вЂ” РєРѕРѕСЂРґРёРЅР°С‚С‹ С‚РѕС‡РµРє СЃС‡РёС‚Р°СЋС‚СЃСЏ РїРѕ rx Рё ry РѕС‚РґРµР»СЊРЅРѕ.
 */
export function arcTextBBox(t: {
  text: string;
  arcCx: number; arcCy: number;
  arcRadius: number;
  arcRx?: number;
  arcRy?: number;
  arcStartDeg: number; arcEndDeg: number;
  fontSize: number;
}): ArcBBox {
  const rx = t.arcRx ?? t.arcRadius;
  const ry = t.arcRy ?? t.arcRadius;

  const chars = t.text.split('');
  if (chars.length === 0) {
    return { x: t.arcCx - 20, y: t.arcCy - 20, width: 40, height: 40 };
  }
  const start = (t.arcStartDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const end = (t.arcEndDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const step = chars.length > 1 ? (end - start) / (chars.length - 1) : 0;

  let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
  chars.forEach((_, i) => {
    const a = start + i * step;
    const x = t.arcCx + Math.cos(a) * rx;
    const y = t.arcCy + Math.sin(a) * ry;
    if (x < minX) minX = x;
    if (y < minY) minY = y;
    if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
    if (y > maxY) maxY = y;
  });
  const pad = t.fontSize;
  return {
    x: minX - pad, y: minY - pad,
    width: (maxX - minX) + pad * 2,
    height: (maxY - minY) + pad * 2,
  };
}

import type { StampShapeItem } from '../../../types';

export interface Edge {
  x1: number; y1: number;
  x2: number; y2: number;
  len: number;
  dirX: number; dirY: number;
}

export function makeEdge(ax: number, ay: number, bx: number, by: number): Edge {
  const dx = bx - ax;
  const dy = by - ay;
  const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
  return { x1: ax, y1: ay, x2: bx, y2: by, len, dirX: dx / len, dirY: dy / len };
}

/** signedOffset > 0 вЂ” РІРЅСѓС‚СЂСЊ, < 0 вЂ” СЃРЅР°СЂСѓР¶Рё. */
export function buildRectEdges(w: number, h: number, signedOffset: number): Edge[] {
  const x1 = signedOffset, y1 = signedOffset;
  const x2 = w - signedOffset, y2 = h - signedOffset;
  return [
    makeEdge(x1, y1, x2, y1),
    makeEdge(x2, y1, x2, y2),
    makeEdge(x2, y2, x1, y2),
    makeEdge(x1, y2, x1, y1),
  ];
}

/** signedOffset > 0 вЂ” РІРЅСѓС‚СЂСЊ (Рє С†РµРЅС‚СЂРѕРёРґСѓ), < 0 вЂ” РЅР°СЂСѓР¶Сѓ. */
export function buildTriangleEdges(w: number, h: number, signedOffset: number): Edge[] {
  const cx = w / 2, cy = h / 2;
  const verts: [number, number][] = [[cx, 0], [w, h], [0, h]];
  const shrunk = verts.map(([x, y]) => {
    const dx = x - cx, dy = y - cy;
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    const k = (dist - signedOffset) / dist;
    return [cx + dx * k, cy + dy * k] as [number, number];
  });
  return [
    makeEdge(shrunk[0][0], shrunk[0][1], shrunk[1][0], shrunk[1][1]),
    makeEdge(shrunk[1][0], shrunk[1][1], shrunk[2][0], shrunk[2][1]),
    makeEdge(shrunk[2][0], shrunk[2][1], shrunk[0][0], shrunk[0][1]),
  ];
}

export function buildPerimeterEdges(s: StampShapeItem, signedOffset: number): Edge[] {
  if (s.kind === 'rect') return buildRectEdges(s.width, s.height, signedOffset);
  if (s.kind === 'triangle') return buildTriangleEdges(s.width, s.height, signedOffset);
  return [];
}

import type { StampShapeItem } from '../../../types';
import { buildTriangleEdges } from './edges';
import { isPointInTriangle, pointToSegmentDistance } from './math';

export function shapeContainsPoint(s: StampShapeItem, px: number, py: number): boolean {
  if (px < s.x || px > s.x + s.width) return false;
  if (py < s.y || py > s.y + s.height) return false;
  if (s.kind === 'circle' || s.kind === 'ellipse') {
    const cx = s.x + s.width / 2;
    const cy = s.y + s.height / 2;
    const rx = s.width / 2;
    const ry = s.height / 2;
    const dx = (px - cx) / Math.max(1e-6, rx);
    const dy = (py - cy) / Math.max(1e-6, ry);
    return dx * dx + dy * dy <= 1;
  }
  if (s.kind === 'triangle') {
    return isPointInTriangle(
      px - s.x, py - s.y,
      [s.width / 2, 0], [s.width, s.height], [0, s.height],
    );
  }
  return true;
}

export function distanceToPerimeter(s: StampShapeItem, px: number, py: number): number {
  const cx = s.x + s.width / 2;
  const cy = s.y + s.height / 2;
  const rx = s.width / 2;
  const ry = s.height / 2;
  const dx = px - cx;
  const dy = py - cy;

  if (s.kind === 'circle' || s.kind === 'ellipse') {
    const angle = Math.atan2(dy / Math.max(1e-6, ry), dx / Math.max(1e-6, rx));
    const ex = cx + rx * Math.cos(angle);
    const ey = cy + ry * Math.sin(angle);
    return Math.hypot(px - ex, py - ey);
  }
  if (s.kind === 'triangle') {
    const edges = buildTriangleEdges(s.width, s.height, 0);
    let best = Infinity;
    for (const e of edges) {
      const d = pointToSegmentDistance(px - s.x, py - s.y, e.x1, e.y1, e.x2, e.y2).distance;
      if (d < best) best = d;
    }
    return best;
  }
  return Math.min(
    Math.abs(px - s.x), Math.abs(px - (s.x + s.width)),
    Math.abs(py - s.y), Math.abs(py - (s.y + s.height)),
  );
}

export interface FindShapeResult {
  host: StampShapeItem;
  angleRad: number;
  isOutside: boolean;
}

export function findSnapTarget(
  px: number, py: number,
  excludeId: string,
  shapes: StampShapeItem[],
  maxDistance?: number,
): FindShapeResult | null {
  let best: StampShapeItem | null = null;
  let bestDist = Infinity;

  for (const s of shapes) {
    if (s.id === excludeId || s.hidden) continue;
    if (s.kind === 'line' || s.kind === 'fill') continue;
    if (s.width < 30 || s.height < 30) continue;

    const cx = s.x + s.width / 2;
    const cy = s.y + s.height / 2;
    const d = Math.hypot(px - cx, py - cy);
    if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; best = s; }
  }

  if (!best) return null;

  const cx = best.x + best.width / 2;
  const cy = best.y + best.height / 2;
  const rHost = Math.min(best.width, best.height) / 2;
  if (maxDistance !== undefined && bestDist > rHost + maxDistance) return null;

  return {
    host: best,
    angleRad: Math.atan2(py - cy, px - cx),
    isOutside: !shapeContainsPoint(best, px, py),
  };
}

export function findNearestShapeByCursor(
  px: number, py: number,
  shapes: StampShapeItem[],
  maxDistance = 260,
): FindShapeResult | null {
  let best: StampShapeItem | null = null;
  let bestDist = Infinity;

  for (const s of shapes) {
    if (s.hidden || s.kind === 'line' || s.kind === 'fill') continue;
    if (s.width < 20 || s.height < 20) continue;

    const d = distanceToPerimeter(s, px, py);
    if (d > maxDistance) continue;
    if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; best = s; }
  }

  if (!best) return null;
  const cx = best.x + best.width / 2;
  const cy = best.y + best.height / 2;
  return {
    host: best,
    angleRad: Math.atan2(py - cy, px - cx),
    isOutside: !shapeContainsPoint(best, px, py),
  };
}

export function findHostShape(
  px: number, py: number,
  excludeId: string, shapes: StampShapeItem[],
): StampShapeItem | null {
  const t = findSnapTarget(px, py, excludeId, shapes);
  return t ? t.host : null;
}

/** РЎР°РјР°СЏ РјР°Р»РµРЅСЊРєР°СЏ РїРѕ РїР»РѕС‰Р°РґРё С„РёРіСѓСЂР°, С‡РµР№ bbox СЃРѕРґРµСЂР¶РёС‚ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ. */
export function findContainingShape(
  cx: number, cy: number,
  excludeId: string,
  shapes: StampShapeItem[],
): StampShapeItem | null {
  let best: StampShapeItem | null = null;
  let bestArea = Infinity;

  for (const s of shapes) {
    if (s.id === excludeId || s.hidden) continue;
    if (s.kind === 'line' || s.kind === 'fill') continue;
    if (cx < s.x || cx > s.x + s.width) continue;
    if (cy < s.y || cy > s.y + s.height) continue;

    const area = Math.max(1, s.width * s.height);
    if (area < bestArea) { bestArea = area; best = s; }
  }
  return best;
}

/**
 * Р’СЃРµ С„РёРіСѓСЂС‹ (РЅРµ line/fill), СЃРѕРґРµСЂР¶Р°С‰РёРµ С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ P.
 * РџРѕСЂСЏРґРѕРє вЂ” РєР°Рє РІ РјР°СЃСЃРёРІРµ shapes (РѕРЅ Р¶Рµ z-order).
 */
export function findShapesContaining(
  px: number, py: number,
  shapes: StampShapeItem[],
): StampShapeItem[] {
  return shapes.filter((s) =>
    s.kind !== 'line' && s.kind !== 'fill'
    && !s.hidden
    && shapeContainsPoint(s, px, py),
  );
}

export function clamp(v: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v));
}

export function isPointInTriangle(
  px: number, py: number,
  a: [number, number], b: [number, number], c: [number, number],
): boolean {
  const sign = (p1: [number, number], p2: [number, number], p3: [number, number]) =>
    (p1[0] - p3[0]) * (p2[1] - p3[1]) - (p2[0] - p3[0]) * (p1[1] - p3[1]);
  const d1 = sign([px, py], a, b);
  const d2 = sign([px, py], b, c);
  const d3 = sign([px, py], c, a);
  const hasNeg = d1 < 0 || d2 < 0 || d3 < 0;
  const hasPos = d1 > 0 || d2 > 0 || d3 > 0;
  return !(hasNeg && hasPos);
}

export interface SegmentDistanceResult {
  distance: number;
  t: number;
  qx: number;
  qy: number;
}

export function pointToSegmentDistance(
  px: number, py: number,
  ax: number, ay: number, bx: number, by: number,
): SegmentDistanceResult {
  const ex = bx - ax;
  const ey = by - ay;
  const lenSq = ex * ex + ey * ey || 1;
  const t = clamp(((px - ax) * ex + (py - ay) * ey) / lenSq, 0, 1);
  const qx = ax + t * ex;
  const qy = ay + t * ey;
  return { distance: Math.hypot(px - qx, py - qy), t, qx, qy };
}

import type { StampShapeItem } from '../../../types';
import { buildRectEdges, buildTriangleEdges, type Edge } from './edges';
import { pointToSegmentDistance } from './math';

function pointOnTrianglePerimeter(
  w: number, h: number, signedOffset: number, angleRad: number,
): [number, number] {
  const edges = buildTriangleEdges(w, h, signedOffset);
  const cx = w / 2, cy = h / 2;
  const cos = Math.cos(angleRad), sin = Math.sin(angleRad);
  let bestT = Infinity;
  let bestPt: [number, number] = [cx, cy];
  for (const e of edges) {
    const ex = e.x2 - e.x1, ey = e.y2 - e.y1;
    const det = cos * (-ey) - (-ex) * sin;
    if (Math.abs(det) < 1e-9) continue;
    const b1 = e.x1 - cx, b2 = e.y1 - cy;
    const t = (b1 * (-ey) - (-ex) * b2) / det;
    const s = (cos * b2 - sin * b1) / det;
    if (t > 0 && s >= 0 && s <= 1 && t < bestT) {
      bestT = t;
      bestPt = [cx + t * cos, cy + t * sin];
    }
  }
  return bestPt;
}

export function pointOnHostPerimeter(
  host: StampShapeItem,
  signedOffset: number,
  angleRad: number,
): [number, number] {
  const cx = host.width / 2, cy = host.height / 2;

  if (host.kind === 'rect') {
    const dxHalf = Math.max(1, host.width / 2 - signedOffset);
    const dyHalf = Math.max(1, host.height / 2 - signedOffset);
    const cos = Math.cos(angleRad), sin = Math.sin(angleRad);
    const t = Math.min(
      dxHalf / Math.max(Math.abs(cos), 1e-9),
      dyHalf / Math.max(Math.abs(sin), 1e-9),
    );
    return [cx + cos * t, cy + sin * t];
  }
  if (host.kind === 'triangle') {
    return pointOnTrianglePerimeter(host.width, host.height, signedOffset, angleRad);
  }
  const r = Math.max(1, Math.min(host.width, host.height) / 2 - signedOffset);
  return [cx + Math.cos(angleRad) * r, cy + Math.sin(angleRad) * r];
}

export function closestPointOnHostPerimeter(
  host: StampShapeItem,
  signedOffset: number,
  px: number, py: number,
): [number, number] {
  const lx = px - host.x;
  const ly = py - host.y;

  if (host.kind === 'rect') {
    const x1 = signedOffset, y1 = signedOffset;
    const x2 = host.width - signedOffset, y2 = host.height - signedOffset;
    const edges: [number, number, number, number][] = [
      [x1, y1, x2, y1], [x2, y1, x2, y2],
      [x2, y2, x1, y2], [x1, y2, x1, y1],
    ];
    let best = Infinity;
    let bp: [number, number] = [x1, y1];
    for (const [ax, ay, bx, by] of edges) {
      const r = pointToSegmentDistance(lx, ly, ax, ay, bx, by);
      if (r.distance < best) { best = r.distance; bp = [r.qx, r.qy]; }
    }
    return [host.x + bp[0], host.y + bp[1]];
  }

  if (host.kind === 'triangle') {
    const edges = buildTriangleEdges(host.width, host.height, signedOffset);
    let best = Infinity;
    let bp: [number, number] = [0, 0];
    for (const e of edges) {
      const r = pointToSegmentDistance(lx, ly, e.x1, e.y1, e.x2, e.y2);
      if (r.distance < best) { best = r.distance; bp = [r.qx, r.qy]; }
    }
    return [host.x + bp[0], host.y + bp[1]];
  }

  const cx = host.x + host.width / 2;
  const cy = host.y + host.height / 2;
  const r = Math.max(1, Math.min(host.width, host.height) / 2 - signedOffset);
  const angle = Math.atan2(py - cy, px - cx);
  return [cx + r * Math.cos(angle), cy + r * Math.sin(angle)];
}

export interface PerimeterTextOptions {
  host: StampShapeItem;
  arcOffset: number;
  isOutside: boolean;
  centerDeg: number;
  text: string;
  fontSize: number;
  fontFamily: string;
  fontStyle: string;
  fill: string;
}

function findPerimeterPosition(edges: Edge[], tx: number, ty: number): number {
  let bestDist = Infinity;
  let bestPos = 0;
  let cum = 0;
  for (const e of edges) {
    const r = pointToSegmentDistance(tx, ty, e.x1, e.y1, e.x2, e.y2);
    if (r.distance < bestDist) {
      bestDist = r.distance;
      bestPos = cum + Math.hypot(r.qx - e.x1, r.qy - e.y1);
    }
    cum += e.len;
  }
  return bestPos;
}

function findEdgeAt(edges: Edge[], L: number): { edge: Edge | null; posOnEdge: number } {
  const total = edges.reduce((s, e) => s + e.len, 0);
  if (total <= 0) return { edge: null, posOnEdge: 0 };
  const wrapL = ((L % total) + total) % total;
  let cum = 0;
  for (const e of edges) {
    if (wrapL >= cum && wrapL < cum + e.len) return { edge: e, posOnEdge: wrapL - cum };
    cum += e.len;
  }
  const last = edges[edges.length - 1];
  return { edge: last, posOnEdge: last.len };
}

export function drawPerimeterText(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  opts: PerimeterTextOptions,
): void {
  const {
    host, arcOffset, isOutside, centerDeg,
    text, fontSize, fontFamily, fontStyle, fill,
  } = opts;
  if (!text) return;

  const fontParts: string[] = [];
  if (fontStyle.includes('italic')) fontParts.push('italic');
  if (fontStyle.includes('bold')) fontParts.push('bold');
  fontParts.push(`${fontSize}px`, `${fontFamily}, Arial, sans-serif`);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.font = fontParts.join(' ');
  ctx.fillStyle = fill;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  const signed = isOutside ? -Math.max(0, arcOffset) : Math.max(0, arcOffset);
  const edges = host.kind === 'rect'
    ? buildRectEdges(host.width, host.height, signed)
    : buildTriangleEdges(host.width, host.height, signed);

  if (edges.reduce((s, e) => s + e.len, 0) <= 1) { ctx.restore(); return; }

  const chars = Array.from(text);
  const widths = chars.map((ch) => Math.max(fontSize * 0.3, ctx.measureText(ch).width));
  const totalTextLen = widths.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

  const centerRad = (centerDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const [tx, ty] = pointOnHostPerimeter(host, signed, centerRad);
  const centerPos = findPerimeterPosition(edges, tx, ty);
  let cursor = centerPos - totalTextLen / 2;

  for (let i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
    const mid = cursor + widths[i] / 2;
    const { edge, posOnEdge } = findEdgeAt(edges, mid);
    if (edge) {
      const px = edge.x1 + edge.dirX * posOnEdge;
      const py = edge.y1 + edge.dirY * posOnEdge;
      const angle = Math.atan2(edge.dirY, edge.dirX);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(px, py);
      ctx.rotate(angle);
      ctx.fillText(chars[i], 0, 0);
      ctx.restore();
    }
    cursor += widths[i];
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

import type { StampShapeItem } from '../../../types';

export const SNAP_TO_GRID = 10;
export const SNAP_THRESHOLD = 6;
export const GRID_SNAP_DIST = 2;

export function snapPosition(
  x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number,
  excludeId: string, shapes: StampShapeItem[],
  canvasW: number, canvasH: number, enableSnap: boolean,
): { x: number; y: number } {
  if (!enableSnap) return { x: Math.round(x), y: Math.round(y) };

  let fx = x, fy = y;

  const gridX = Math.round(x / SNAP_TO_GRID) * SNAP_TO_GRID;
  const gridY = Math.round(y / SNAP_TO_GRID) * SNAP_TO_GRID;
  if (Math.abs(gridX - x) <= GRID_SNAP_DIST) fx = gridX;
  if (Math.abs(gridY - y) <= GRID_SNAP_DIST) fy = gridY;

  const cx = canvasW / 2, cy = canvasH / 2;
  if (Math.abs((fx + w / 2) - cx) <= SNAP_THRESHOLD) fx = cx - w / 2;
  if (Math.abs((fy + h / 2) - cy) <= SNAP_THRESHOLD) fy = cy - h / 2;

  for (const s of shapes) {
    if (s.id === excludeId || s.hidden) continue;
    if (s.kind === 'line') continue;
    const pts = [
      { x: s.x, y: s.y },
      { x: s.x + s.width / 2, y: s.y + s.height / 2 },
      { x: s.x + s.width, y: s.y + s.height },
      { x: s.x + s.width, y: s.y },
      { x: s.x, y: s.y + s.height },
    ];
    for (const p of pts) {
      if (Math.abs(fx - p.x) <= SNAP_THRESHOLD) fx = p.x;
      if (Math.abs(fy - p.y) <= SNAP_THRESHOLD) fy = p.y;
      if (Math.abs((fx + w / 2) - p.x) <= SNAP_THRESHOLD) fx = p.x - w / 2;
      if (Math.abs((fy + h / 2) - p.y) <= SNAP_THRESHOLD) fy = p.y - h / 2;
    }
  }
  return { x: Math.round(fx), y: Math.round(fy) };
}

export interface HostCenterSnapResult {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  snappedX: boolean;
  snappedY: boolean;
}

/** Р¦РµРЅС‚СЂРёСЂСѓРµС‚ С„РёРіСѓСЂСѓ РѕС‚РЅРѕСЃРёС‚РµР»СЊРЅРѕ host СЃ Р°РґР°РїС‚РёРІРЅС‹Рј РїРѕСЂРѕРіРѕРј. */
export function snapToHostCenter(
  x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number,
  host: StampShapeItem | null,
  thresholdOverride?: number,
): HostCenterSnapResult {
  if (!host) return { x, y, snappedX: false, snappedY: false };

  const threshold = thresholdOverride ?? Math.max(30, Math.min(w, h) * 0.4);
  const hCx = host.x + host.width / 2;
  const hCy = host.y + host.height / 2;
  const cx = x + w / 2;
  const cy = y + h / 2;

  const snappedX = Math.abs(cx - hCx) <= threshold;
  const snappedY = Math.abs(cy - hCy) <= threshold;

  return {
    x: snappedX ? hCx - w / 2 : x,
    y: snappedY ? hCy - h / 2 : y,
    snappedX, snappedY,
  };
}

export type PlacementMode = 'inside' | 'outside' | 'next';

export function computeNewShapeGeometry(
  host: StampShapeItem | null,
  baseW: number, baseH: number,
  canvasW: number, canvasH: number,
  mode: PlacementMode,
  padding = 12,
): { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number } {
  if (!host) {
    return {
      x: Math.round((canvasW - baseW) / 2),
      y: Math.round((canvasH - baseH) / 2),
      width: baseW, height: baseH,
    };
  }

  const hostCx = host.x + host.width / 2;
  const hostCy = host.y + host.height / 2;

  if (mode === 'inside') {
    const scale = 0.6;
    const w = Math.round(host.width * scale);
    const h = Math.round(host.height * scale);
    return { x: Math.round(hostCx - w / 2), y: Math.round(hostCy - h / 2), width: w, height: h };
  }

  if (mode === 'outside') {
    const w = Math.round(host.width + padding * 2);
    const h = Math.round(host.height + padding * 2);
    return { x: Math.round(hostCx - w / 2), y: Math.round(hostCy - h / 2), width: w, height: h };
  }

  return {
    x: Math.round(host.x + host.width + padding),
    y: Math.round(host.y),
    width: baseW, height: baseH,
  };
}

export function loadCustomStamps(): StampTemplate[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const arr = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [];
  } catch { return []; }
}

export function saveCustomStamps(stamps: StampTemplate[]): void {
  try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(stamps)); } catch { /* ignore */ }
}

const BUILTIN_IDS = new Set<string>([
  ...BUILTIN_STAMPS.map((s) => s.id),
  ...BANKING_STAMPS.map((s) => s.id),
  ...BANKING_STAMPS_FILLED.map((s) => s.id),
  ...SERVICE_STAMPS.map((s) => s.id),
  ...SPECIAL_STAMPS.map((s) => s.id),
  ...BANKING_STAMPS_WITH_IMAGES.map((s) => s.id),
]);
export function isBuiltinStamp(id: string): boolean {
  return BUILTIN_IDS.has(id);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   РџСѓР±Р»РёС‡РЅС‹Р№ РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРї
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

export function getAllStamps(): StampTemplate[] {
  const banking = BANKING_STAMPS.map((s) => ({ ...s, banking: true }));
  const bankingFilled = BANKING_STAMPS_FILLED.map((s) => ({ ...s, banking: true }));
  const services = SERVICE_STAMPS.map((s) => ({ ...s, banking: true }));
  const specials = SPECIAL_STAMPS.map((s) => ({ ...s, banking: true }));
  const withImages = BANKING_STAMPS_WITH_IMAGES.map((s) => ({ ...s, banking: true }));
  return [
    ...BUILTIN_STAMPS,
    ...banking,
    ...bankingFilled,
    ...services,
    ...specials,
    ...withImages,
    ...loadCustomStamps(),
  ];
}

export function addCustomStamp(t: StampTemplate): void {
  const list = loadCustomStamps();
  list.push({ ...t, custom: true, banking: false });
  saveCustomStamps(list);
}

export function removeCustomStamp(id: string): void {
  const list = loadCustomStamps().filter((s) => s.id !== id);
  saveCustomStamps(list);
}

export function updateCustomStamp(id: string, patch: Partial<StampTemplate>): void {
  const list = loadCustomStamps();
  const idx = list.findIndex((s) => s.id === id);
  if (idx < 0) return;
  list[idx] = { ...list[idx], ...patch };
  saveCustomStamps(list);
}

   РЎРѕР·РґР°РЅРёРµ РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЊСЃРєРѕР№ РєРѕРїРёРё РёР· РІСЃС‚СЂРѕРµРЅРЅРѕРіРѕ.

   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

export function forkStampAsCustom(source: StampTemplate): StampTemplate {
  const copy: StampTemplate = {
    ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(source)),
    id: `custom-${Date.now()}`,
    name: `${source.name} (РјРѕСЏ)`,
    custom: true,
    banking: false,
  };
  /* РЎРІРµР¶РёРµ id РґР»СЏ РІР»РѕР¶РµРЅРЅС‹С… СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚РѕРІ вЂ” С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ СЃР»СѓС‡Р°Р№РЅРѕ РЅРµ
     Р·Р°РґРµС‚СЊ РѕР±С‰РёРµ СЃСЃС‹Р»РєРё, РµСЃР»Рё С‡С‚Рѕ-С‚Рѕ РіРґРµ-С‚Рѕ РєСЌС€РёСЂСѓРµС‚СЃСЏ. */
  copy.shapes = copy.shapes.map((s) => ({ ...s, id: uid() }));
  copy.texts = copy.texts.map((t) => ({ ...t, id: uid() }));
  copy.images = (copy.images || []).map((im) => ({ ...im, id: uid() }));
  return copy;
}

import type { StampShapeItem } from '../../types';
import { getShapeStrategy } from './shapes/registry';

const SCALE = 4;
const BORDER_THRESHOLD = 200;
const MIN_AREA = 16;
const MAX_AREA_RATIO = 0.85;

const LBL_NONE    = 0;
const LBL_INSIDE  = 1;
const LBL_OUTSIDE = 2;
const LBL_NEUTRAL = 3;

export interface FillSpec {
  px: number;
  py: number;
  color: string;
  /* Р¦РµР»РµРІР°СЏ С„РёРіСѓСЂР°. Р•СЃР»Рё null вЂ” РѕР±СЂР°Р±Р°С‚С‹РІР°РµРј РєР°Рє legacy-Р·Р°Р»РёРІРєСѓ. */
  target: StampShapeItem | null;
}

export interface CompositeFillOptions {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  fills: FillSpec[];
}

/* ============================================================
   РўСЂР°СЃСЃРёСЂРѕРІРєР° РєРѕРЅС‚СѓСЂР° вЂ” РєР°Рє РІ ShapeViews.
   ============================================================ */

function traceShapePath(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, s: StampShapeItem): void {
  ctx.beginPath();
  const { x, y, width: w, height: h } = s;

  if (s.kind === 'rect') {
    const r = Math.max(0, Math.min(s.cornerRadius || 0, w / 2, h / 2));
    if (r > 0) {
      ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
      ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r, r);
      ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
      ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h, r);
      ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
      ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r, r);
      ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
      ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + r, y, r);
      ctx.closePath();
    } else {
      ctx.rect(x, y, w, h);
    }
    return;
  }

  if (s.kind === 'circle' || s.kind === 'ellipse') {
    const cx = x + w / 2;
    const cy = y + h / 2;
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, Math.max(1, w / 2), Math.max(1, h / 2), 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    return;
  }

  if (s.kind === 'triangle') {
    ctx.moveTo(x + w / 2, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + h);
    ctx.closePath();
    return;
  }

  if (s.kind === 'line') {
    const pts = s.points || [0, h / 2, w, h / 2];
    if (pts.length >= 4) {
      ctx.moveTo(x + pts[0], y + pts[1]);
      for (let i = 2; i + 1 < pts.length; i += 2) {
        ctx.lineTo(x + pts[i], y + pts[i + 1]);
      }
    }
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   РњР°СЃРєР° С†РµР»РµРІРѕР№ С„РёРіСѓСЂС‹.
   1 вЂ” РїРёРєСЃРµР»СЊ РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРё С„РёРіСѓСЂС‹, 0 вЂ” СЃРЅР°СЂСѓР¶Рё.
   ============================================================ */

function buildTargetMask(
  W: number, H: number,
  target: StampShapeItem,
): Uint8Array {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  if (!ctx) return new Uint8Array(W * H);

  ctx.scale(SCALE, SCALE);

  let path: Path2D;
  try {
    path = getShapeStrategy(target.kind).toPath(target);
  } catch {
    return new Uint8Array(W * H);
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.fill(path);

  const img = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, W, H);
  const data = img.data;
  const mask = new Uint8Array(W * H);
  for (let i = 0; i < mask.length; i++) {
    if (data[i * 4 + 3] > 128) mask[i] = 1;
  }
  return mask;
}

/* ============================================================
   Flood fill РїРѕ СЃРІРµС‚Р»С‹Рј РїРёРєСЃРµР»СЏРј СЃ РѕРїС†РёРѕРЅР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Рј РѕРіСЂР°РЅРёС‡РµРЅРёРµРј
   РїРѕ target-РјР°СЃРєРµ.
   ============================================================ */

function floodFillLightFromSeed(
  data: Uint8ClampedArray,
  labels: Uint8Array,
  W: number, H: number,
  seedIdx: number, tag: number,
  targetMask: Uint8Array | null,
): boolean {
  if (targetMask && !targetMask[seedIdx]) return false;

  const stack: number[] = [seedIdx];
  let touchesBorder = false;

  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const i = stack.pop()!;
    if (labels[i] !== LBL_NONE) continue;
    if (targetMask && !targetMask[i]) continue;

    const p = i * 4;
    if ((data[p] + data[p + 1] + data[p + 2]) / 3 < BORDER_THRESHOLD) continue;

    labels[i] = tag;
    const x = i % W;
    const y = (i - x) / W;
    if (x === 0 || y === 0 || x === W - 1 || y === H - 1) touchesBorder = true;

    if (x > 0)     stack.push(i - 1);
    if (x < W - 1) stack.push(i + 1);
    if (y > 0)     stack.push(i - W);
    if (y < H - 1) stack.push(i + W);
  }
  return !touchesBorder;
}

function floodFillLightFromMany(
  data: Uint8ClampedArray,
  labels: Uint8Array,
  W: number, H: number,
  seedIdxs: number[], tag: number,
): void {
  const stack = seedIdxs.slice();
  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const i = stack.pop()!;
    if (labels[i] !== LBL_NONE) continue;
    const p = i * 4;
    if ((data[p] + data[p + 1] + data[p + 2]) / 3 < BORDER_THRESHOLD) continue;

    labels[i] = tag;
    const x = i % W;
    const y = (i - x) / W;
    if (x > 0)     stack.push(i - 1);
    if (x < W - 1) stack.push(i + 1);
    if (y > 0)     stack.push(i - W);
    if (y < H - 1) stack.push(i + W);
  }
}

function markNeutralWhiteRegions(
  data: Uint8ClampedArray, labels: Uint8Array,
): void {
  for (let i = 0; i < labels.length; i++) {
    if (labels[i] !== LBL_NONE) continue;
    const p = i * 4;
    if ((data[p] + data[p + 1] + data[p + 2]) / 3 >= BORDER_THRESHOLD) {
      labels[i] = LBL_NEUTRAL;
    }
  }
}

function watershedByDistance(
  data: Uint8ClampedArray, labels: Uint8Array,
  W: number, H: number,
): void {
  const total = W * H;
  const di = new Int32Array(total).fill(-1);
  const dout = new Int32Array(total).fill(-1);

  const bfs = (dist: Int32Array, from: number) => {
    const q: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) if (labels[i] === from) { dist[i] = 0; q.push(i); }
    let h = 0;
    while (h < q.length) {
      const i = q[h++];
      const d = dist[i];
      const x = i % W;
      const y = (i - x) / W;
      const tryN = (ni: number) => {
        if (ni < 0 || ni >= total) return;
        if (dist[ni] !== -1) return;
        if (labels[ni] !== LBL_NONE) return;
        const p = ni * 4;
        if ((data[p] + data[p + 1] + data[p + 2]) / 3 >= BORDER_THRESHOLD) return;
        dist[ni] = d + 1;
        q.push(ni);
      };
      if (x > 0)     tryN(i - 1);
      if (x < W - 1) tryN(i + 1);
      if (y > 0)     tryN(i - W);
      if (y < H - 1) tryN(i + W);
    }
  };

  bfs(di, LBL_INSIDE);
  bfs(dout, LBL_OUTSIDE);

  for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
    if (labels[i] !== LBL_NONE) continue;
    const a = di[i];
    const b = dout[i];
    if (a === -1 && b === -1) continue;
    if (a === -1)  { labels[i] = LBL_OUTSIDE; continue; }
    if (b === -1)  { labels[i] = LBL_INSIDE;  continue; }
    labels[i] = a <= b ? LBL_INSIDE : LBL_OUTSIDE;
  }
}

function findNearbyLightPixel(
  data: Uint8ClampedArray, W: number, H: number,
  cx: number, cy: number, maxR: number,
  targetMask: Uint8Array | null,
): number | null {
  const test = (i: number) => {
    if (targetMask && !targetMask[i]) return false;
    const p = i * 4;
    return (data[p] + data[p + 1] + data[p + 2]) / 3 >= BORDER_THRESHOLD;
  };
  const start = cy * W + cx;
  if (test(start)) return start;

  for (let r = 1; r <= maxR; r++) {
    for (let dy = -r; dy <= r; dy++) {
      for (let dx = -r; dx <= r; dx++) {
        if (Math.abs(dx) !== r && Math.abs(dy) !== r) continue;
        const x = cx + dx;
        const y = cy + dy;
        if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= W || y >= H) continue;
        const i = y * W + x;
        if (test(i)) return i;
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/* ============================================================
   РњР°СЃРєР° РѕРґРЅРѕР№ Р·Р°Р»РёРІРєРё.
   ============================================================ */

function computeMaskForFill(
  data: Uint8ClampedArray,
  W: number, H: number,
  px: number, py: number,
  target: StampShapeItem | null,
): Uint8Array | null {
  const ax = Math.floor(px * SCALE);
  const ay = Math.floor(py * SCALE);
  if (ax < 0 || ay < 0 || ax >= W || ay >= H) return null;

  const targetMask = target ? buildTargetMask(W, H, target) : null;

  const start = findNearbyLightPixel(data, W, H, ax, ay, 8, targetMask);
  if (start === null) return null;

  const labels = new Uint8Array(W * H);

  /* Р•СЃР»Рё РµСЃС‚СЊ target вЂ” РІСЃС‘ РІРЅРµ target СЃСЂР°Р·Сѓ РїРѕРјРµС‡Р°РµРј OUTSIDE */
  if (targetMask) {
    for (let i = 0; i < labels.length; i++) {
      if (!targetMask[i]) labels[i] = LBL_OUTSIDE;
    }
  }

  const closed = floodFillLightFromSeed(
    data, labels, W, H, start, LBL_INSIDE, targetMask,
  );
  if (!closed) return null;

  /* Р‘РµР· target вЂ” СЃС‚Р°СЂС‹Р№ СЃРїРѕСЃРѕР±: OUTSIDE РѕС‚ РіСЂР°РЅРёС† РєР°РЅРІС‹ */
  if (!targetMask) {
    const seeds: number[] = [];
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) { seeds.push(x); seeds.push((H - 1) * W + x); }
    for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) { seeds.push(y * W); seeds.push(y * W + W - 1); }
    floodFillLightFromMany(data, labels, W, H, seeds, LBL_OUTSIDE);
  }

  markNeutralWhiteRegions(data, labels);
  watershedByDistance(data, labels, W, H);

  const mask = new Uint8Array(W * H);
  let count = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < labels.length; i++) {
    if (labels[i] === LBL_INSIDE) { mask[i] = 1; count++; }
  }
  if (count < MIN_AREA * SCALE * SCALE) return null;
  if (count > W * H * MAX_AREA_RATIO) return null;
  return mask;
}

/* ============================================================
   Р“Р»Р°РІРЅР°СЏ С„СѓРЅРєС†РёСЏ
   ============================================================ */

export function rasterizeCompositeFills(
  opts: CompositeFillOptions,
): string | null {
  const { width, height, shapes, fills } = opts;

  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return null;
  if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return null;
  if (!fills.length) return null;

  const W = width * SCALE;
  const H = height * SCALE;

  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
  if (!ctx) return null;

  ctx.scale(SCALE, SCALE);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  for (const s of shapes) {
    if (s.hidden) continue;
    if (s.kind === 'fill') continue;
    traceShapePath(ctx, s);
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2 / SCALE, s.strokeWidth || 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  const img = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, W, H);
  const data = img.data;

  const resultR = new Uint8ClampedArray(W * H);
  const resultG = new Uint8ClampedArray(W * H);
  const resultB = new Uint8ClampedArray(W * H);
  const resultA = new Uint8Array(W * H);

  for (const fill of fills) {
    const mask = computeMaskForFill(data, W, H, fill.px, fill.py, fill.target);
    if (!mask) continue;

    const [cr, cg, cb] = hexToRgb(fill.color);

    for (let i = 0; i < mask.length; i++) {
      if (mask[i]) {
        resultR[i] = cr;
        resultG[i] = cg;
        resultB[i] = cb;
        resultA[i] = 255;
      }
    }
  }

  let anyPainted = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < W * H; i++) {
    const p = i * 4;
    if (resultA[i]) {
      data[p]     = resultR[i];
      data[p + 1] = resultG[i];
      data[p + 2] = resultB[i];
      data[p + 3] = 255;
      anyPainted = true;
    } else {
      data[p + 3] = 0;
    }
  }

  if (!anyPainted) return null;

  ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
  ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
  return canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
}

function hexToRgb(hex: string): [number, number, number] {
  const m = hex.replace('#', '').match(/.{2}/g);
  if (!m || m.length < 3) return [0, 0, 0];
  return [parseInt(m[0], 16), parseInt(m[1], 16), parseInt(m[2], 16)];
}

export interface ArcTextParams {
  text: string;
  cx: number;
  cy: number;
  radius: number;
  radiusX?: number;
  radiusY?: number;
  startDeg: number;
  endDeg: number;
  flip: boolean;
  font: string;
  fill: string;
}

/* ============================================================
   РЈС‚РёР»РёС‚С‹ РґР»СЏ СЌР»Р»РёРїСЃР°
   ============================================================ */

/**
 * Р”Р»РёРЅР° СЌР»Р»РёРїС‚РёС‡РµСЃРєРѕР№ РґСѓРіРё РѕС‚ СѓРіР»Р° a0 РґРѕ СѓРіР»Р° a1.
 * Р§РёСЃР»РµРЅРЅРѕРµ РёРЅС‚РµРіСЂРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРёРµ РјРµС‚РѕРґРѕРј РЎРёРјРїСЃРѕРЅР° РїРѕ 64 С€Р°РіР°Рј.
 * РСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµС‚СЃСЏ РґР»СЏ СЂР°РІРЅРѕРјРµСЂРЅРѕР№ СЂР°СЃСЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІРєРё Р±СѓРєРІ РїРѕ РґР»РёРЅРµ.
 */
function ellipseArcLength(
  rx: number, ry: number,
  a0: number, a1: number,
): number {
  const N = 64;
  const h = (a1 - a0) / N;
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
    const a = a0 + i * h;
    const speed = Math.hypot(rx * Math.sin(a), ry * Math.cos(a));
    const w = (i === 0 || i === N) ? 1 : (i % 2 === 0 ? 2 : 4);
    sum += w * speed;
  }
  return Math.abs((h / 3) * sum);
}

/**
 * РќР°Р№С‚Рё СѓРіРѕР» a С‚Р°РєРѕР№, С‡С‚Рѕ РґР»РёРЅР° РґСѓРіРё РѕС‚ startDeg РґРѕ a
 * СЂР°РІРЅР° target (РґРѕР»Рё РѕС‚ РїРѕР»РЅРѕР№ РґР»РёРЅС‹ 0..1).
 * Р‘РёРЅР°СЂРЅС‹Р№ РїРѕРёСЃРє.
 */
function angleAtArcFraction(
  rx: number, ry: number,
  aStart: number, aEnd: number,
  fraction: number,
): number {
  const total = ellipseArcLength(rx, ry, aStart, aEnd);
  if (total === 0) return aStart;
  const target = total * fraction;

  let lo = 0, hi = 1;
  for (let it = 0; it < 40; it++) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
    const a = aStart + (aEnd - aStart) * mid;
    const len = ellipseArcLength(rx, ry, aStart, a);
    if (len < target) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
  }
  return aStart + (aEnd - aStart) * (lo + hi) / 2;
}

/* ============================================================
   РћС‚СЂРёСЃРѕРІРєР° С‚РµРєСЃС‚Р° РїРѕ СЌР»Р»РёРїС‚РёС‡РµСЃРєРѕР№ РґСѓРіРµ
   ============================================================ */

/**
 * РўРµРєСЃС‚ Р»РѕР¶РёС‚СЃСЏ РІРґРѕР»СЊ СЌР»Р»РёРїСЃР° СЃ СЂР°РґРёСѓСЃР°РјРё (rx, ry).
 *
 * РџСЂР°РІРёР»Р°:
 *  - Р”Р»СЏ РєСЂСѓРіР° (rx == ry) РїРѕРІРµРґРµРЅРёРµ СЃРѕРІРїР°РґР°РµС‚ СЃ РєР»Р°СЃСЃРёС‡РµСЃРєРёРј.
 *  - Р‘СѓРєРІС‹ СЂР°СЃРїСЂРµРґРµР»РµРЅС‹ Р РђР’РќРћРњР•Р РќРћ РџРћ Р”Р›РРќР• Р”РЈР“Р, Р° РЅРµ РїРѕ СѓРіР»Сѓ.
 *  - РљР°Р¶РґР°СЏ Р±СѓРєРІР° РѕСЂРёРµРЅС‚РёСЂРѕРІР°РЅР° РїРѕ РєР°СЃР°С‚РµР»СЊРЅРѕР№ Рє СЌР»Р»РёРїСЃСѓ
 *    (В«РІРµСЂС…В» Р±СѓРєРІС‹ СЃРјРѕС‚СЂРёС‚ РЅР°СЂСѓР¶Сѓ РѕС‚ С†РµРЅС‚СЂР°).
 *  - Р—РЅР°С‡РµРЅРёРµ flip РёРіРЅРѕСЂРёСЂСѓРµС‚СЃСЏ: РїРѕР»РѕР¶РµРЅРёРµ СѓР¶Рµ Р·Р°РґР°РЅРѕ СѓРіР»Р°РјРё
 *    startDeg/endDeg, Р° РЅР°РїСЂР°РІР»РµРЅРёРµ С‡С‚РµРЅРёСЏ вЂ” РїРѕСЂСЏРґРєРѕРј Р±СѓРєРІ.
 */
export function drawArcText(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, p: ArcTextParams): void {
  if (!p.text) return;

  const rx = p.radiusX ?? p.radius;
  const ry = p.radiusY ?? p.radius;
  if (!rx || !ry) return;

  const startRad = (p.startDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const endRad = (p.endDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const chars = Array.from(p.text);
  const n = chars.length;
  if (n === 0) return;

  /* РџРѕР»РЅР°СЏ РґР»РёРЅР° РґСѓРіРё вЂ” РґР»СЏ СЂР°РІРЅРѕРјРµСЂРЅРѕРіРѕ СЂР°СЃРїСЂРµРґРµР»РµРЅРёСЏ */
  const totalLen = ellipseArcLength(rx, ry, startRad, endRad);
  if (totalLen === 0) return;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.font = p.font;
  ctx.fillStyle = p.fill;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const ch = chars[i];
    if (ch === ' ' || ch === '\t' || ch === '\n') continue;

    /* Р”РѕР»СЏ РѕС‚ РЅР°С‡Р°Р»Р° РґРѕ Р¦Р•РќРўР Рђ СЌС‚РѕР№ Р±СѓРєРІС‹ */
    const fraction = n > 1 ? (i + 0.5) / n : 0.5;
    const a = angleAtArcFraction(rx, ry, startRad, endRad, fraction);

    const cosA = Math.cos(a);
    const sinA = Math.sin(a);
    const x = p.cx + cosA * rx;
    const y = p.cy + sinA * ry;

    /* РљР°СЃР°С‚РµР»СЊРЅР°СЏ Рє СЌР»Р»РёРїСЃСѓ: d/da (rxВ·cos a, ryВ·sin a) = (-rxВ·sin a, ryВ·cos a) */
    const tx = -rx * sinA;
    const ty = ry * cosA;
    const rot = Math.atan2(ty, tx);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.rotate(rot);
    ctx.fillText(ch, 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

import type { StampShapeKind } from '../../../types';
import type { ShapeStrategy } from './types';
import {
  rectStrategy, circleStrategy, ellipseStrategy,
  triangleStrategy, lineStrategy, fillStrategy,
} from './strategies';

const ALL: ShapeStrategy[] = [
  rectStrategy, circleStrategy, ellipseStrategy,
  triangleStrategy, lineStrategy, fillStrategy,
];

const registry = new Map<StampShapeKind, ShapeStrategy>();
for (const s of ALL) registry.set(s.kind, s);

export function getShapeStrategy(kind: StampShapeKind): ShapeStrategy {
  const s = registry.get(kind);
  if (!s) throw new Error(`[stamps] no strategy for kind="${kind}"`);
  return s;
}

export function getAllStrategies(): readonly ShapeStrategy[] {
  return ALL;
}

FILE: lib\stamps\shapes\strategies.ts
SIZE: 6643 bytes

import type { StampShapeItem } from '../../../types';
import type { ShapeStrategy, TransformInput, TransformOutput, Geometry } from './types';
import { findContainingShape, snapToHostCenter } from '../geometry';

/* ============================================================
   Path builders
   ============================================================ */

function buildRectPath(s: StampShapeItem): Path2D {
  const p = new Path2D();
  const { x, y, width: w, height: h } = s;
  const r = Math.max(0, s.cornerRadius || 0);
  const rr = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
  if (rr > 0) {
    p.moveTo(x + rr, y);
    p.lineTo(x + w - rr, y);
    p.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + rr, rr);
    p.lineTo(x + w, y + h - rr);
    p.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - rr, y + h, rr);
    p.lineTo(x + rr, y + h);
    p.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - rr, rr);
    p.lineTo(x, y + rr);
    p.arcTo(x, y, x + rr, y, rr);
    p.closePath();
  } else {
    p.rect(x, y, w, h);
  }
  return p;
}

function buildEllipsePath(s: StampShapeItem): Path2D {
  const p = new Path2D();
  const cx = s.x + s.width / 2;
  const cy = s.y + s.height / 2;
  p.ellipse(cx, cy, Math.max(1, s.width / 2), Math.max(1, s.height / 2), 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  return p;
}

function buildCirclePath(s: StampShapeItem): Path2D {
  const p = new Path2D();
  const cx = s.x + s.width / 2;
  const cy = s.y + s.height / 2;
  const r = Math.max(1, Math.min(s.width, s.height) / 2);
  p.ellipse(cx, cy, r, r, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  return p;
}

function buildTrianglePath(s: StampShapeItem): Path2D {
  const p = new Path2D();
  const { x, y, width: w, height: h } = s;
  p.moveTo(x + w / 2, y);
  p.lineTo(x + w, y + h);
  p.lineTo(x, y + h);
  p.closePath();
  return p;
}

/* ============================================================
   РћР±С‰Р°СЏ С‚СЂР°РЅСЃС„РѕСЂРјР°С†РёСЏ РґР»СЏ closed-С„РёРіСѓСЂ
   ============================================================ */

interface TransformOpts {
  keepSquare?: boolean;
  noRotation?: boolean;
  noResize?: boolean;
}

function applyShapeTransform(input: TransformInput, opts: TransformOpts): TransformOutput {
  const { shape: s, nodeX, nodeY, nodeRotation, scaleX, scaleY, ctrl, shapes } = input;

  if (opts.noResize) {
    let nx = Math.round(nodeX - s.width / 2);
    let ny = Math.round(nodeY - s.height / 2);
    if (!ctrl) {
      const host = findContainingShape(nx + s.width / 2, ny + s.height / 2, s.id, shapes);
      const cs = snapToHostCenter(nx, ny, s.width, s.height, host);
      nx = Math.round(cs.x);
      ny = Math.round(cs.y);
    }
    return {
      patch: { x: nx, y: ny, rotation: opts.noRotation ? 0 : Math.round(nodeRotation) },
      resetScale: true,
    };
  }

  const rawW = Math.max(8, s.width * scaleX);
  const rawH = Math.max(8, s.height * scaleY);
  const fw = opts.keepSquare ? Math.max(rawW, rawH) : rawW;
  const fh = opts.keepSquare ? Math.max(rawW, rawH) : rawH;

  let nx = Math.round(nodeX - fw / 2);
  let ny = Math.round(nodeY - fh / 2);

  if (!ctrl) {
    const host = findContainingShape(nx + fw / 2, ny + fh / 2, s.id, shapes);
    const cs = snapToHostCenter(nx, ny, fw, fh, host);
    nx = Math.round(cs.x);
    ny = Math.round(cs.y);
  }

  return {
    patch: {
      x: nx, y: ny,
      rotation: Math.round(nodeRotation),
      width: Math.round(fw),
      height: Math.round(fh),
    },
    resetScale: true,
  };
}

/* ============================================================
   РЎС‚СЂР°С‚РµРіРёРё
   ============================================================ */

export const rectStrategy: ShapeStrategy = {
  kind: 'rect',
  defaultSize: { w: 160, h: 100, corner: 12 },
  normalizeGeometry: (g: Geometry) => g,
  toPath: buildRectPath,
  applyTransform: (i) => applyShapeTransform(i, {}),
};

export const circleStrategy: ShapeStrategy = {
  kind: 'circle',
  defaultSize: { w: 140, h: 140, corner: 0 },
  normalizeGeometry: (g: Geometry) => {
    const side = Math.min(g.width, g.height);
    return { ...g, width: side, height: side };
  },
  toPath: buildCirclePath,
  applyTransform: (i) => applyShapeTransform(i, { keepSquare: true }),
};

export const ellipseStrategy: ShapeStrategy = {
  kind: 'ellipse',
  defaultSize: { w: 160, h: 160, corner: 0 },
  normalizeGeometry: (g: Geometry) => g,
  toPath: buildEllipsePath,
  applyTransform: (i) => applyShapeTransform(i, {}),
};

export const triangleStrategy: ShapeStrategy = {
  kind: 'triangle',
  defaultSize: { w: 140, h: 120, corner: 0 },
  normalizeGeometry: (g: Geometry) => g,
  toPath: buildTrianglePath,
  applyTransform: (i) => applyShapeTransform(i, {}),
};

export const lineStrategy: ShapeStrategy = {
  kind: 'line',
  defaultSize: { w: 160, h: 20, corner: 0 },
  normalizeGeometry: (g: Geometry) => g,
  toPath: () => new Path2D(),
  applyTransform: (i) => {
    const { shape: s, nodeX, nodeY, nodeRotation, scaleX, scaleY, ctrl, shapes } = i;

    const w = Math.max(1, s.width);
    const h = Math.max(1, s.height);

    const kx = scaleX;
    const ky = scaleY;

    const srcPoints = (s.points && s.points.length >= 4)
      ? s.points
      : [0, h / 2, w, h / 2];

    const scaledPoints = srcPoints.map((v, idx) =>
      idx % 2 === 0 ? v * kx : v * ky,
    );

    let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
    for (let k = 0; k < scaledPoints.length; k += 2) {
      const px = scaledPoints[k];
      const py = scaledPoints[k + 1];
      if (px < minX) minX = px;
      if (py < minY) minY = py;
      if (px > maxX) maxX = px;
      if (py > maxY) maxY = py;
    }
    const newW = Math.max(8, maxX - minX);
    const newH = Math.max(8, maxY - minY);

    let nx = Math.round(nodeX - newW / 2);
    let ny = Math.round(nodeY - newH / 2);

    if (!ctrl) {
      const host = findContainingShape(nx + newW / 2, ny + newH / 2, s.id, shapes);
      const cs = snapToHostCenter(nx, ny, newW, newH, host);
      nx = Math.round(cs.x);
      ny = Math.round(cs.y);
    }

    return {
      patch: {
        x: nx,
        y: ny,
        rotation: Math.round(nodeRotation),
        width: newW,
        height: newH,
        points: scaledPoints.map((v) => Math.round(v)),
      },
      resetScale: true,
    };
  },
};

export const fillStrategy: ShapeStrategy = {
  kind: 'fill',
  defaultSize: { w: 0, h: 0, corner: 0 },
  normalizeGeometry: (g: Geometry) => g,
  toPath: () => new Path2D(),
  applyTransform: () => ({ patch: {}, resetScale: false }),
};
