/**
 * Connectors Hook - Presentation Layer
 * Handle connector creation and management
 */

import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { Slide } from '../../domain/entities/Slide';
import type { CanvasElement, ConnectorElement, AnchorSide } from '../../shared/types';
import { generateId } from '../../shared/utils/id';

export interface ConnectorDraft {
  fromId: string;
  fromAnchor: AnchorSide;
  toX: number;
  toY: number;
  hoverTargetId?: string;
  hoverAnchor?: AnchorSide;
}

interface UseConnectorsOptions {
  slide: Slide | null;
  addElement: (element: CanvasElement) => void;
  removeElement: (id: string) => void;
}

export interface UseConnectorsReturn {
  draft: ConnectorDraft | null;
  startDraft: (fromId: string, fromAnchor: AnchorSide, x: number, y: number) => void;
  moveDraft: (x: number, y: number) => void;
  commitDraft: () => void;
  cancelDraft: () => void;
  findNearestAnchor: (x: number, y: number) => { elementId: string; anchor: AnchorSide } | null;
}

const ANCHOR_OFFSET = 8;

export function useConnectors(options: UseConnectorsOptions): UseConnectorsReturn {
  const { slide, addElement } = options;
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<ConnectorDraft | null>(null);

  const getAnchorPosition = useCallback((
    element: CanvasElement,
    anchor: AnchorSide
  ): { x: number; y: number } => {
    const cx = element.x + element.width / 2;
    const cy = element.y + element.height / 2;

    switch (anchor) {
      case 'top':
        return { x: cx, y: element.y - ANCHOR_OFFSET };
      case 'right':
        return { x: element.x + element.width + ANCHOR_OFFSET, y: cy };
      case 'bottom':
        return { x: cx, y: element.y + element.height + ANCHOR_OFFSET };
      case 'left':
        return { x: element.x - ANCHOR_OFFSET, y: cy };
    }
  }, []);

  const findNearestAnchor = useCallback((
    x: number,
    y: number
  ): { elementId: string; anchor: AnchorSide } | null => {
    if (!slide) return null;

    let nearest: { elementId: string; anchor: AnchorSide; dist: number } | null = null;

    for (const el of slide.elements) {
      // Skip connectors and fills
      if (el.type === 'connector' || el.type === 'fill') continue;

      const anchors: AnchorSide[] = ['top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left'];
      
      for (const anchor of anchors) {
        const pos = getAnchorPosition(el, anchor);
        const dist = Math.hypot(pos.x - x, pos.y - y);
        
        if (dist < 30 && (!nearest || dist < nearest.dist)) {
          nearest = { elementId: el.id, anchor, dist };
        }
      }
    }

    return nearest ? { elementId: nearest.elementId, anchor: nearest.anchor } : null;
  }, [slide, getAnchorPosition]);

  const startDraft = useCallback((
    fromId: string,
    fromAnchor: AnchorSide,
    x: number,
    y: number
  ) => {
    setDraft({
      fromId,
      fromAnchor,
      toX: x,
      toY: y,
    });
  }, []);

  const moveDraft = useCallback((x: number, y: number) => {
    if (!draft) return;

    const nearest = findNearestAnchor(x, y);
    
    setDraft({
      ...draft,
      toX: x,
      toY: y,
      hoverTargetId: nearest?.elementId,
      hoverAnchor: nearest?.anchor,
    });
  }, [draft, findNearestAnchor]);

  const commitDraft = useCallback(() => {
    if (!draft || !slide) return;

    // Don't create if no target
    if (!draft.hoverTargetId || !draft.hoverAnchor) {
      setDraft(null);
      return;
    }

    // Don't connect to self
    if (draft.fromId === draft.hoverTargetId) {
      setDraft(null);
      return;
    }

    const connector: ConnectorElement = {
      id: generateId(),
      type: 'connector',
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      width: 0,
      height: 0,
      rotation: 0,
      fromId: draft.fromId,
      fromAnchor: draft.fromAnchor,
      toId: draft.hoverTargetId,
      toAnchor: draft.hoverAnchor,
      stroke: '#374151',
      strokeWidth: 2,
      dash: 'solid',
      isArrow: true,
      routing: 'straight',
    };

    addElement(connector);
    setDraft(null);
  }, [draft, slide, addElement]);

  const cancelDraft = useCallback(() => {
    setDraft(null);
  }, []);

  return {
    draft,
    startDraft,
    moveDraft,
    commitDraft,
    cancelDraft,
    findNearestAnchor,
  };
}

/**
 * Fill Mode Hook - Presentation Layer
 * Handles fill polygon creation and shape filling
 */

import { useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import type { Slide } from '../../domain/entities/Slide';
import type { CanvasElement, FillElement } from '../../shared/types';
import { generateId } from '../../shared/utils/id';

interface UseFillModeOptions {
  slide: Slide | null;
  addElement: (element: CanvasElement) => void;
  updateElement: (id: string, patch: Partial<CanvasElement>) => void;
}

export interface UseFillModeReturn {
  isActive: boolean;
  color: string;
  points: readonly number[];
  activate: () => void;
  deactivate: () => void;
  setColor: (color: string) => void;
  handleClick: (pointerPos: { x: number; y: number }) => boolean;
  closePolygon: () => void;
  cancel: () => void;
  reset: () => void;
}

/**
 * Check if point hits a shape element
 */
function hitShapeElement(el: CanvasElement, px: number, py: number): boolean {
  // Shape element hit test
  if (el.type === 'shape') {
    if (px < el.x || py < el.y || px > el.x + el.width || py > el.y + el.height) {
      return false;
    }
    if (el.shape === 'circle') {
      const cx = el.x + el.width / 2;
      const cy = el.y + el.height / 2;
      const r = Math.min(el.width, el.height) / 2;
      return Math.hypot(px - cx, py - cy) <= r;
    }
    return true;
  }

  // Fill element hit test (point-in-polygon)
  if (el.type === 'fill' && el.points && el.points.length >= 6) {
    const pts = el.points;
    const n = pts.length / 2;
    let inside = false;

    for (let i = 0, j = n - 1; i < n; j = i++) {
      const xi = el.x + pts[i * 2];
      const yi = el.y + pts[i * 2 + 1];
      const xj = el.x + pts[j * 2];
      const yj = el.y + pts[j * 2 + 1];

      const intersect =
        yi > py !== yj > py &&
        px < ((xj - xi) * (py - yi)) / (yj - yi + 0.000001) + xi;

      if (intersect) inside = !inside;
    }
    return inside;
  }

  return false;
}

/**
 * Find shape element at position
 */
function findShapeAt(
  slide: Slide | null,
  x: number,
  y: number
): CanvasElement | null {
  if (!slide) return null;
  
  for (let i = slide.elements.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const el = slide.elements[i];
    if (hitShapeElement(el, x, y)) {
      return el;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

export function useFillMode(options: UseFillModeOptions): UseFillModeReturn {
  const { slide, addElement, updateElement } = options;

  const [isActive, setIsActive] = useState(false);
  const [color, setColor] = useState('#fbbf24');
  const [points, setPoints] = useState<number[]>([]);

  const activate = useCallback(() => {
    setIsActive(true);
  }, []);

  const deactivate = useCallback(() => {
    setIsActive(false);
    setPoints([]);
  }, []);

  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    setPoints([]);
  }, []);

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    setIsActive(false);
    setPoints([]);
    setColor('#fbbf24');
  }, []);

  const handleClick = useCallback((pointerPos: { x: number; y: number }): boolean => {
    if (!isActive) return false;

    const target = findShapeAt(slide, pointerPos.x, pointerPos.y);

    // If clicked on shape/fill - fill it
    if (target && (target.type === 'shape' || target.type === 'fill')) {
      updateElement(target.id, { fill: color });
      return true;
    }

    // Otherwise add point to polygon
    setPoints((prev) => [...prev, pointerPos.x, pointerPos.y]);
    return true;
  }, [isActive, color, slide, updateElement]);

  const closePolygon = useCallback(() => {
    if (points.length < 6) {
      setPoints([]);
      return;
    }

    // Calculate bounding box
    const xs: number[] = [];
    const ys: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i += 2) {
      xs.push(points[i]);
      ys.push(points[i + 1]);
    }

    const minX = Math.min(...xs);
    const minY = Math.min(...ys);
    const maxX = Math.max(...xs);
    const maxY = Math.max(...ys);

    // Convert to relative coordinates
    const relativePoints = points.map((v, i) =>
      i % 2 === 0 ? v - minX : v - minY
    );

    const fillElement: FillElement = {
      id: generateId(),
      type: 'fill',
      x: minX,
      y: minY,
      width: Math.max(1, maxX - minX),
      height: Math.max(1, maxY - minY),
      rotation: 0,
      points: relativePoints,
      fill: color,
      stroke: '',
      strokeWidth: 0,
      opacity: 1,
    };

    addElement(fillElement);
    setPoints([]);
  }, [points, color, addElement]);

  return {
    isActive,
    color,
    points,
    activate,
    deactivate,
    setColor,
    handleClick,
    closePolygon,
    cancel,
    reset,
  };
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { StampShapeItem } from '../../shared/types';
import type { FillSpec } from '../../lib/stamps/rasterFill';

interface WorkerResult {
  key: string;
  url: string | null;
}

export function useFillWorker() {
  const workerRef = useRef<Worker | null>(null);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<WorkerResult | null>(null);
  const pendingKeyRef = useRef<string>('');
  const seqRef = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const worker = new Worker(
      new URL('../../workers/fillWorker.ts', import.meta.url),
      { type: 'module' },
    );

    worker.onmessage = (e: MessageEvent<{ seq: number; url: string | null }>) => {
      if (e.data.seq !== seqRef.current) return;
      setResult({ key: pendingKeyRef.current, url: e.data.url });
    };

    worker.onerror = (err) => {
      console.error('[fillWorker] error', err);
    };

    workerRef.current = worker;
    return () => {
      worker.terminate();
      workerRef.current = null;
    };
  }, []);

  const rasterize = useCallback(
    (
      key: string,
      width: number,
      height: number,
      shapes: StampShapeItem[],
      fills: FillSpec[],
    ) => {
      const worker = workerRef.current;
      if (!worker) return;

      const seq = ++seqRef.current;
      pendingKeyRef.current = key;

      worker.postMessage({ seq, width, height, shapes, fills });
    },
    [],
  );

  return { result, rasterize };
}

/**
 * History hook - Presentation Layer
 * Undo/redo functionality with Immer
 */

import { useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { produce } from 'immer';
import type { Slide } from '../../domain/entities/Slide';
import { MAX_HISTORY } from '../../shared/constants';

export interface HistoryEntry {
  readonly slides: Slide[];
  readonly activeSlideId: string | null;
}

export interface UseHistoryReturn {
  canUndo: boolean;
  canRedo: boolean;
  push: (slides: Slide[], activeSlideId: string | null) => void;
  undo: () => HistoryEntry | null;
  redo: () => HistoryEntry | null;
  reset: () => void;
}

export function useHistory(): UseHistoryReturn {
  const [entries, setEntries] = useState<HistoryEntry[]>([]);
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(-1);
  const lastCommittedRef = useRef<Slide[] | null>(null);

  const push = useCallback(
    (slides: Slide[], activeSlideId: string | null) => {
      const last = lastCommittedRef.current;

      // Skip if same reference
      if (last === slides) return;

      // Structural sharing with Immer
      const snapshot = last
        ? produce(last, (draft) => {
            if (draft.length !== slides.length) {
              draft.length = slides.length;
            }
            for (let i = 0; i < slides.length; i++) {
              if (draft[i] !== slides[i]) draft[i] = slides[i];
            }
          })
        : slides;

      lastCommittedRef.current = snapshot;

      setEntries((prev) => {
        const trimmed = prev.slice(0, index + 1);
        trimmed.push({ slides: snapshot, activeSlideId });
        while (trimmed.length > MAX_HISTORY) trimmed.shift();
        return trimmed;
      });

      setIndex((prev) => {
        const next = prev + 1;
        return next >= MAX_HISTORY ? MAX_HISTORY - 1 : next;
      });
    },
    [index]
  );

  const undo = useCallback((): HistoryEntry | null => {
    if (index <= 0) return null;
    const prev = entries[index - 1];
    lastCommittedRef.current = prev.slides;
    setIndex(index - 1);
    return prev;
  }, [entries, index]);

  const redo = useCallback((): HistoryEntry | null => {
    if (index >= entries.length - 1) return null;
    const next = entries[index + 1];
    lastCommittedRef.current = next.slides;
    setIndex(index + 1);
    return next;
  }, [entries, index]);

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    setEntries([]);
    setIndex(-1);
    lastCommittedRef.current = null;
  }, []);

  return {
    canUndo: index > 0,
    canRedo: index < entries.length - 1,
    push,
    undo,
    redo,
    reset,
  };
}

/**
 * Import/Export Hook - Presentation Layer
 * Handle file operations
 */

import { useCallback } from 'react';
import type { Slide } from '../../domain/entities/Slide';
import type { DataRoot } from '../../shared/types';

interface ExportData {
  version: string;
  slides: Slide[];
  data: DataRoot[];
}

export function useIO() {
  const exportJSON = useCallback((slides: Slide[], data: DataRoot[]) => {
    const exportData: ExportData = {
      version: '2.0',
      slides,
      data,
    };

    const json = JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2);
    const blob = new Blob([json], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `ticket-editor-${Date.now()}.json`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, []);

  const importJSON = useCallback((
    file: File,
    onSuccess: (slides: Slide[], data: DataRoot[]) => void,
    onError: (error: string) => void
  ) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      try {
        const content = e.target?.result as string;
        const data = JSON.parse(content);
        
        // Validate structure
        if (!data.slides || !Array.isArray(data.slides)) {
          throw new Error('Invalid file format: missing slides');
        }
        
        // Migrate if needed
        const version = data.version || '1.0';
        const slides = migrateSlides(data.slides, version);
        const dataRoots = data.data || [];
        
        onSuccess(slides, dataRoots);
      } catch (err) {
        onError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to import file');
      }
    };
    
    reader.onerror = () => {
      onError('Failed to read file');
    };
    
    reader.readAsText(file);
  }, []);

  const exportSVG = useCallback((slide: Slide) => {
    // Generate SVG from slide
    const svg = generateSVG(slide);
    const blob = new Blob([svg], { type: 'image/svg+xml' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `slide-${slide.name}-${Date.now()}.svg`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, []);

  const exportServerSVG = useCallback(async (
    slides: Slide[],
    onSuccess: () => void,
    onError: (error: string) => void
  ) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/export/svg', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ slides }),
      });
      
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Server export failed');
      }
      
      const blob = await response.blob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `export-${Date.now()}.svg`;
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
      onSuccess();
    } catch (err) {
      onError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Export failed');
    }
  }, []);

  const exportServerPDF = useCallback(async (
    slides: Slide[],
    onSuccess: () => void,
    onError: (error: string) => void
  ) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/export/pdf', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ slides }),
      });
      
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Server export failed');
      }
      
      const blob = await response.blob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `export-${Date.now()}.pdf`;
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
      onSuccess();
    } catch (err) {
      onError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Export failed');
    }
  }, []);

  return {
    exportJSON,
    importJSON,
    exportSVG,
    exportServerSVG,
    exportServerPDF,
  };
}

// Migration helpers
function migrateSlides(slides: unknown[], version: string): Slide[] {
  // Simple migration - in real app would have complex logic
  if (version === '1.0') {
    // Migrate from v1.0 to v2.0
    return slides.map((slide: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
      ...slide,
      elements: (slide.elements as unknown[] || []).map((el: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
        ...el,
        rotation: el.rotation || 0,
      })),
    })) as Slide[];
  }
  
  return slides as Slide[];
}

// SVG generation
function generateSVG(slide: Slide): string {
  const elements = slide.elements.map((el) => {
    switch (el.type) {
      case 'rect':
      case 'shape':
        return `<rect x="${el.x}" y="${el.y}" width="${el.width}" height="${el.height}" fill="${(el as { fill?: string }).fill || 'none'}" />`;
      case 'text':
        return `<text x="${el.x}" y="${el.y + (el as { fontSize?: number }).fontSize || 16}">${(el as { text?: string }).text || ''}</text>`;
      default:
        return '';
    }
  }).join('\n');

  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg width="${slide.width}" height="${slide.height}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="${slide.background}" />
  ${elements}
</svg>`;
}

/**
 * Selection hook - Presentation Layer
 * Manages element selection state
 */

import { useState, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import type { CanvasElement } from '../../shared/types';

export interface UseSelectionReturn {
  selectedIds: readonly string[];
  selectedId: string | null;
  selectedElements: CanvasElement[];
  isSelected: (id: string) => boolean;
  select: (id: string, multi?: boolean) => void;
  selectMany: (ids: string[]) => void;
  clearSelection: () => void;
  toggleSelection: (id: string) => void;
}

export function useSelection(elements: CanvasElement[]): UseSelectionReturn {
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const selectedId = useMemo(() => selectedIds[0] ?? null, [selectedIds]);

  const selectedElements = useMemo(() => {
    return elements.filter((el) => selectedIds.includes(el.id));
  }, [elements, selectedIds]);

  const isSelected = useCallback(
    (id: string) => selectedIds.includes(id),
    [selectedIds]
  );

  const select = useCallback((id: string, multi = false) => {
    setSelectedIds((prev) => {
      if (!multi) return [id];
      return prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...prev, id];
    });
  }, []);

  const selectMany = useCallback((ids: string[]) => {
    setSelectedIds(ids);
  }, []);

  const clearSelection = useCallback(() => {
    setSelectedIds([]);
  }, []);

  const toggleSelection = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setSelectedIds((prev) =>
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  }, []);

  return {
    selectedIds,
    selectedId,
    selectedElements,
    isSelected,
    select,
    selectMany,
    clearSelection,
    toggleSelection,
  };
}

/**
 * React hook for slides - Presentation Layer
 * Clean interface for components
 */

import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Slide } from '../../domain/entities/Slide';
import { slideStore, useSlideStore, useActiveSlide } from '../../infrastructure/store/SlideStoreImpl';
import { createSlideUseCases } from '../../application/use-cases/SlideUseCases';
import type { DocFormat, Orientation, CanvasElement } from '../../shared/types';

const useCases = createSlideUseCases(slideStore);

export interface UseSlidesReturn {
  // State
  slides: Slide[];
  activeSlide: Slide | null;
  activeSlideId: string | null;

  // Actions
  addSlide: () => Slide;
  removeSlide: (id: string) => void;
  duplicateSlide: (id: string) => Slide | null;
  setActiveSlide: (id: string) => void;
  changeFormat: (format: DocFormat) => void;
  changeOrientation: (orientation: Orientation) => void;
  changeCustomSize: (width: number, height: number) => void;

  // Element actions
  addElement: (element: CanvasElement) => void;
  updateElement: (elementId: string, patch: Partial<CanvasElement>) => void;
  removeElement: (elementId: string) => void;
  moveElementLayer: (elementId: string, direction: 1 | -1) => void;
}

export function useSlides(): UseSlidesReturn {
  const state = useSlideStore();
  const activeSlide = useActiveSlide();

  const slides = useMemo(() => state.slides, [state.slides]);
  const activeSlideId = useMemo(() => state.activeSlideId, [state.activeSlideId]);

  const addSlide = useCallback(() => {
    return useCases.createSlide({
      format: activeSlide?.format,
      orientation: activeSlide?.orientation,
    });
  }, [activeSlide]);

  const removeSlide = useCallback((id: string) => {
    useCases.removeSlide(id);
  }, []);

  const duplicateSlide = useCallback((id: string) => {
    return useCases.duplicateSlide(id);
  }, []);

  const setActiveSlide = useCallback((id: string) => {
    useCases.setActiveSlide(id);
  }, []);

  const changeFormat = useCallback((format: DocFormat) => {
    if (!activeSlide) return;
    useCases.changeFormat(activeSlide.id, format);
  }, [activeSlide]);

  const changeOrientation = useCallback((orientation: Orientation) => {
    if (!activeSlide) return;
    useCases.changeOrientation(activeSlide.id, orientation);
  }, [activeSlide]);

  const changeCustomSize = useCallback((width: number, height: number) => {
    if (!activeSlide) return;
    activeSlide.changeFormat('custom', { w: width, h: height });
    slideStore.updateSlide(activeSlide.id, activeSlide);
  }, [activeSlide]);

  const addElement = useCallback((element: CanvasElement) => {
    if (!activeSlide) return;
    useCases.addElement(activeSlide.id, element);
  }, [activeSlide]);

  const updateElement = useCallback((elementId: string, patch: Partial<CanvasElement>) => {
    if (!activeSlide) return;
    useCases.updateElement({
      slideId: activeSlide.id,
      elementId,
      patch,
    });
  }, [activeSlide]);

  const removeElement = useCallback((elementId: string) => {
    if (!activeSlide) return;
    useCases.removeElement(activeSlide.id, elementId);
  }, [activeSlide]);

  const moveElementLayer = useCallback((elementId: string, direction: 1 | -1) => {
    if (!activeSlide) return;
    useCases.moveElementLayer(activeSlide.id, elementId, direction);
  }, [activeSlide]);

  return {
    slides,
    activeSlide,
    activeSlideId,
    addSlide,
    removeSlide,
    duplicateSlide,
    setActiveSlide,
    changeFormat,
    changeOrientation,
    changeCustomSize,
    addElement,
    updateElement,
    removeElement,
    moveElementLayer,
  };
}

/**
 * Stamp Fill Mode Hook - Presentation Layer
 * Handle fill creation in stamp editor
 */

import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { StampShapeItem, StampTextItem, StampImageItem } from '../../shared/types';
import { findShapesContaining } from '../../lib/stamps/geometry';
import { generateId } from '../../shared/utils/id';

interface UseStampFillModeOptions {
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  texts: StampTextItem[];
  images: StampImageItem[];
  width: number;
  height: number;
  commit: (s: StampShapeItem[], t: StampTextItem[], i: StampImageItem[]) => void;
  select: (id: string | null, type: 'shape' | 'text' | 'image') => void;
}

export interface UseStampFillModeReturn {
  fillMode: boolean;
  setFillMode: (v: boolean) => void;
  fillColor: string;
  setFillColor: (v: string) => void;
  handleCanvasClick: (px: number, py: number) => void;
}

export function useStampFillMode({
  shapes, texts, images, width, height,
  commit, select,
}: UseStampFillModeOptions): UseStampFillModeReturn {
  const [fillMode, setFillMode] = useState(false);
  const [fillColor, setFillColor] = useState('#fbbf24');

  const handleCanvasClick = useCallback((px: number, py: number) => {
    if (!fillMode) return;

    const containing = findShapesContaining(px, py, shapes);
    if (containing.length === 0) return;

    // Smallest containing shape = target
    const target = containing.reduce((a, b) =>
      a.width * a.height <= b.width * b.height ? a : b,
    );

    // Local anchor coordinates (0..1)
    const localX = (px - target.x) / Math.max(1, target.width);
    const localY = (py - target.y) / Math.max(1, target.height);

    const fill: StampShapeItem = {
      id: generateId(),
      kind: 'fill',
      x: 0, y: 0,
      width, height,
      rotation: 0,
      cornerRadius: 0,
      stroke: '', strokeWidth: 0, dash: 'solid',
      fill: fillColor,
      fillTargetShapeId: target.id,
      fillAnchorLocal: { x: localX, y: localY },
      name: 'Р—Р°Р»РёРІРєР° РѕР±Р»Р°СЃС‚Рё',
    };
    commit([...shapes, fill], texts, images);
    select(fill.id, 'shape');
    setFillMode(false);
  }, [fillMode, fillColor, shapes, texts, images, width, height, commit, select]);

  return {
    fillMode, setFillMode,
    fillColor, setFillColor,
    handleCanvasClick,
  };
}

/**
 * Editor Context Provider - Presentation Layer
 * Provides editor state to child components
 */

import React, { createContext, useContext, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { UseSlidesReturn } from '../hooks/useSlides';
import type { UseSelectionReturn } from '../hooks/useSelection';
import type { UseHistoryReturn } from '../hooks/useHistory';

interface EditorContextValue {
  slides: UseSlidesReturn;
  selection: UseSelectionReturn;
  history: UseHistoryReturn;
}

const EditorContext = createContext<EditorContextValue | null>(null);

interface EditorProviderProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  slides: UseSlidesReturn;
  selection: UseSelectionReturn;
  history: UseHistoryReturn;
}

export const EditorProvider: React.FC<EditorProviderProps> = ({
  children,
  slides,
  selection,
  history,
}) => {
  const value = React.useMemo(
    () => ({
      slides,
      selection,
      history,
    }),
    [slides, selection, history]
  );

  return (
    <EditorContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </EditorContext.Provider>
  );
};

export function useEditorContext(): EditorContextValue {
  const context = useContext(EditorContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useEditorContext must be used within EditorProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

// Convenience hooks
export function useSlidesContext(): UseSlidesReturn {
  return useEditorContext().slides;
}

export function useSelectionContext(): UseSelectionReturn {
  return useEditorContext().selection;
}

export function useHistoryContext(): UseHistoryReturn {
  return useEditorContext().history;
}

import React, { useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useEditor, EditorContent } from '@tiptap/react';
import { buildEditorExtensions } from './components/richText/extensions';
import { RichTextToolbar } from './components/richText/RichTextToolbar';

interface Props {
  initialHtml: string;
  fontSize: number;
  fontFamily: string;
  fill: string;
  align: string;
  /** вњ… РРЅС‚РµСЂР»РёРЅСЊСЏР¶ СЌР»РµРјРµРЅС‚Р° (РЅР°РїСЂРёРјРµСЂ, 1.2) вЂ” СЃРёРЅС…СЂРѕРЅРёР·РёСЂСѓРµРј СЃ РєР°РЅРІР°СЃРѕРј */
  lineHeight?: number;
  /** вњ… РћС‚СЃС‚СѓРї РјРµР¶РґСѓ Р°Р±Р·Р°С†Р°РјРё (РІ px) вЂ” СЃРёРЅС…СЂРѕРЅРёР·РёСЂСѓРµРј СЃ РєР°РЅРІР°СЃРѕРј */
  blockGap?: number;
  width: number;
  minHeight: number;
  onChange: (html: string, text: string) => void;
  onCommit: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export const RichTextEditor: React.FC<Props> = ({
  initialHtml,
  fontSize,
  fontFamily,
  fill,
  align,
  lineHeight = 1.2,
  blockGap = 8,
  width,
  minHeight,
  onChange,
  onCommit,
  onCancel,
}) => {
  const editor = useEditor({
    extensions: buildEditorExtensions(align),
    content: initialHtml || '<p></p>',
    autofocus: 'end',
    onUpdate: ({ editor }) => onChange(editor.getHTML(), editor.getText()),
    onBlur: ({ editor }) => {
      try { editor.view.dispatch(editor.state.tr); } catch { /* noop */ }
      onChange(editor.getHTML(), editor.getText());
    },
    editorProps: {
      attributes: {
        spellcheck: 'true',
        style: [
          `font-size:${fontSize}px`,
          `font-family:${fontFamily}, Arial, sans-serif`,
          `color:${fill}`,
          `line-height:${lineHeight}`,
          `--block-gap:${blockGap}px`,
        ].join(';') + ';',
      },
    },
  });

  const contentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  /* РЈРЅРёС‡С‚РѕР¶Р°РµРј СЂРµРґР°РєС‚РѕСЂ РїСЂРё СЂР°Р·РјРѕРЅС‚РёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРёРё */
  useEffect(() => () => { editor?.destroy(); }, [editor]);

  /* Р¤РѕРєСѓСЃРёСЂСѓРµРј ProseMirror РїСЂРё РјРѕРЅС‚РёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРёРё вЂ” С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ Ctrl+A СЃСЂР°Р·Сѓ СЂР°Р±РѕС‚Р°Р» РІ СЂРµРґР°РєС‚РѕСЂРµ */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!editor) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      try { editor.commands.focus('end'); } catch { /* noop */ }
    }, 0);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [editor]);

  /* Р¤РѕСЂСЃРёСЂСѓРµРј РїСЂРёРјРµРЅРµРЅРёРµ view-СЃРѕСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёСЏ Рє РґРѕРєСѓРјРµРЅС‚Сѓ РїРµСЂРµРґ С„РёРєСЃР°С†РёРµР№ html */
  const flushAndGetHtml = useCallback(() => {
    if (!editor) return { html: '', text: '' };
    try { editor.view.dispatch(editor.state.tr); } catch { /* noop */ }
    return { html: editor.getHTML(), text: editor.getText() };
  }, [editor]);

  const handleCommit = useCallback(() => {
    const { html, text } = flushAndGetHtml();
    onChange(html, text);
    setTimeout(onCommit, 0);
  }, [flushAndGetHtml, onChange, onCommit]);

  /* Р›СЋР±РѕР№ РєР»РёРє РІРЅСѓС‚СЂРё РѕР±Р»Р°СЃС‚Рё СЂРµРґР°РєС‚РёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРёСЏ РїРµСЂРµРІРѕРґРёС‚ С„РѕРєСѓСЃ РІ ProseMirror */
  const handleContentMouseDown = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
    const isInToolbar = target.closest('.rt-toolbar');
    if (isInToolbar) return;
    if (target.closest('.ProseMirror')) return;
    if (!editor) return;
    setTimeout(() => {
      try { editor.commands.focus(); } catch { /* noop */ }
    }, 0);
  }, [editor]);

  if (!editor) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="rt-editor"
      style={{ width, minHeight }}
      onMouseDown={handleContentMouseDown}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        /* Escape / Ctrl+Enter вЂ” РЅРµ РјРµС€Р°РµРј Ctrl+A Рё РѕСЃС‚Р°Р»СЊРЅРѕРјСѓ РЅР°С‚РёРІРЅРѕРјСѓ РїРѕРІРµРґРµРЅРёСЋ */
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          e.preventDefault();
          onCancel();
          return;
        }
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) {
          e.preventDefault();
          handleCommit();
          return;
        }
        /* Ctrl+A РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµС…РІР°С‚С‹РІР°РµРј вЂ” ProseMirror СЃР°Рј РѕР±СЂР°Р±РѕС‚Р°РµС‚ */
      }}
    >
      <RichTextToolbar
        editor={editor}
        fallbackFontFamily={fontFamily}
        fallbackFontSize={fontSize}
        fallbackColor={fill}
      />
      <div className="rt-content" ref={contentRef}>
        <EditorContent editor={editor} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

   Р±РµР·РѕРїР°СЃРЅРѕСЃС‚Рё. Р’ РёС‚РѕРіРµ РІРјРµСЃС‚Рѕ QR-РєРѕРґРѕРІ Рё Р»РѕРіРѕС‚РёРїРѕРІ РїРѕРєР°Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ

   Р РµС€РµРЅРёРµ: РїРµСЂРµРґ РѕС‚РїСЂР°РІРєРѕР№ РЅР° Р±СЌРєРµРЅРґ РїСЂРѕР№С‚РёСЃСЊ РїРѕ СЃР»Р°Р№РґСѓ Рё
   Р·Р°РјРµРЅРёС‚СЊ РІСЃРµ http(s):// РЅР° data:image/...;base64,...
   РўРѕРіРґР° SVG СЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІРёС‚СЃСЏ СЃР°РјРѕРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РѕС‡РЅС‹Рј С„Р°Р№Р»РѕРј.
   ============================================================ */

const REMOTE_URL_RE = /^https?:\/\//i;

function isRemoteUrl(url: unknown): url is string {
  return typeof url === 'string' && REMOTE_URL_RE.test(url);
}

function blobToDataUrl(blob: Blob): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
    reader.onerror = reject;
    reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
  });
}

async function toDataUrl(url: string): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { mode: 'cors' });
    if (!res.ok) return url;
    const blob = await res.blob();
    return await blobToDataUrl(blob);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[embedImages] failed to fetch', url, e);
    return url;
  }
}

/**
 * Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ РіР»СѓР±РѕРєСѓСЋ РєРѕРїРёСЋ СЃР»Р°Р№РґР°, РІ РєРѕС‚РѕСЂРѕР№ РІСЃРµ РІРЅРµС€РЅРёРµ
 * РєР°СЂС‚РёРЅРєРё Р·Р°РјРµРЅРµРЅС‹ РЅР° data URL. РћСЂРёРіРёРЅР°Р» РЅРµ РјСѓС‚РёСЂСѓРµС‚СЃСЏ.
 */
export async function embedImagesInSlide(slide: any): Promise<any> {
  const copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(slide));

  if (isRemoteUrl(copy.backgroundImage)) {
    copy.backgroundImage = await toDataUrl(copy.backgroundImage);
  }

  if (Array.isArray(copy.elements)) {
    for (const el of copy.elements) {
      if (el?.type === 'image' && isRemoteUrl(el.src)) {
        el.src = await toDataUrl(el.src);
      }

      if (el?.type === 'placeholder'
          && el.fieldType === 'image'
          && isRemoteUrl(el.sample)) {
        el.sample = await toDataUrl(el.sample);
      }

      if (el?.type === 'stamp' && Array.isArray(el.images)) {
        for (const im of el.images) {
          if (isRemoteUrl(im?.src)) {
            im.src = await toDataUrl(im.src);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return copy;
}

import type { CanvasElement, Slide } from '../types';
import { SNAP_THRESHOLD } from '../types';
import { gridRound } from '../lib/geometry';

export interface SnapResult {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  v: number[];
  h: number[];
}

export function computeSnap(
  el: CanvasElement,
  x: number,
  y: number,
  slide: Slide,
  showGrid: boolean,
): SnapResult {
  const v: number[] = [];
  const h: number[] = [];
  const bw = el.width;
  const bh = el.height;
  const xs: { v: number; d: number; guide: number }[] = [];
  const ys: { v: number; d: number; guide: number }[] = [];

  if (showGrid) {
    const gx = gridRound(x);
    const gy = gridRound(y);
    xs.push({ v: gx, d: Math.abs(x - gx), guide: gx });
    ys.push({ v: gy, d: Math.abs(y - gy), guide: gy });
  }

  const cx = x + bw / 2;
  const cy = y + bh / 2;
  const stageW = slide.width;
  const stageH = slide.height;

  xs.push({ v: stageW / 2 - bw / 2, d: Math.abs(cx - stageW / 2), guide: stageW / 2 });
  xs.push({ v: 0, d: Math.abs(x), guide: 0 });
  xs.push({ v: stageW - bw, d: Math.abs(x + bw - stageW), guide: stageW });

  const pad = slide.padding;
  xs.push({ v: pad.left, d: Math.abs(x - pad.left), guide: pad.left });
  xs.push({ v: stageW - pad.right - bw, d: Math.abs(x + bw - (stageW - pad.right)), guide: stageW - pad.right });

  ys.push({ v: pad.top, d: Math.abs(y - pad.top), guide: pad.top });
  ys.push({ v: stageH - pad.bottom - bh, d: Math.abs(y + bh - (stageH - pad.bottom)), guide: stageH - pad.bottom });
  ys.push({ v: stageH / 2 - bh / 2, d: Math.abs(cy - stageH / 2), guide: stageH / 2 });
  ys.push({ v: 0, d: Math.abs(y), guide: 0 });
  ys.push({ v: stageH - bh, d: Math.abs(y + bh - stageH), guide: stageH });

  for (const other of slide.elements) {
    if (other.id === el.id) continue;
    const oL = other.x;
    const oR = other.x + other.width;
    const oC = other.x + other.width / 2;
    const oT = other.y;
    const oB = other.y + other.height;
    const oM = other.y + other.height / 2;
    const l = x;
    const r = x + bw;
    const c = x + bw / 2;
    const t = y;
    const b = y + bh;
    const m = y + bh / 2;

    xs.push({ v: oL, d: Math.abs(l - oL), guide: oL });
    xs.push({ v: oR - bw, d: Math.abs(r - oR), guide: oR });
    xs.push({ v: oC - bw / 2, d: Math.abs(c - oC), guide: oC });
    ys.push({ v: oT, d: Math.abs(t - oT), guide: oT });
    ys.push({ v: oB - bh, d: Math.abs(b - oB), guide: oB });
    ys.push({ v: oM - bh / 2, d: Math.abs(m - oM), guide: oM });
  }

  const bestX = xs.reduce((a, b) => (b.d < a.d ? b : a), xs[0]);
  const bestY = ys.reduce((a, b) => (b.d < a.d ? b : a), ys[0]);
  if (bestX && bestX.d < SNAP_THRESHOLD) { x = bestX.v; v.push(bestX.guide); }
  if (bestY && bestY.d < SNAP_THRESHOLD) { y = bestY.v; h.push(bestY.guide); }

  return { x, y, v, h };
}

import type { Slide } from '../../types';
import { getSvgSerializers } from '../../lib/elements/registry';

export function buildSvg(slide: Slide): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  parts.push(
    `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" width="${slide.width}" height="${slide.height}" viewBox="0 0 ${slide.width} ${slide.height}">`
  );

  if (slide.backgroundImage) {
    parts.push(
      `<image href="${slide.backgroundImage}" x="0" y="0" width="${slide.width}" height="${slide.height}" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>`
    );
  } else {
    parts.push(`<rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="${slide.background}"/>`);
  }

  const serializers = getSvgSerializers();
  const lookup = new Map(serializers.map((s) => [s.type, s.toSvg]));

  const fills = slide.elements.filter((el) => el.type === 'fill');
  if (fills.length) {
    parts.push('<g opacity="0.6">');
    const fillToSvg = lookup.get('fill');
    if (fillToSvg) for (const el of fills) parts.push(fillToSvg(el, { allElements: slide.elements }));
    parts.push('</g>');
  }

  const connToSvg = lookup.get('connector');
  if (connToSvg) {
    for (const el of slide.elements) {
      if (el.type === 'connector') parts.push(connToSvg(el, { allElements: slide.elements }));
    }
  }

  for (const el of slide.elements) {
    if (el.type === 'fill') continue;
    if (el.type === 'connector') continue;
    const toSvg = lookup.get(el.type);
    if (toSvg) parts.push(toSvg(el, { allElements: slide.elements }));
  }

  parts.push('</svg>');
  return parts.join('\n');
}

import type { CanvasElement, ConnectorElement } from '../../types';
import { routeConnector, midpointOfPath, resolveConnectorEnds } from '../../lib/connectors';
import { escape } from './helpers';

export function connectorToSvg(el: ConnectorElement, allElements: CanvasElement[]): string {
  const { from, to } = resolveConnectorEnds(el, allElements);
  if (!from || !to) return '';

  const points = routeConnector(from, el.fromAnchor, to, el.toAnchor, el.routing);
  const dash =
    el.dash === 'dashed' ? '10,6'
    : el.dash === 'dotted' ? '2,5'
    : el.dash === 'dashdot' ? '10,5,2,5'
    : el.dash === 'longdash' ? '20,8'
    : '';
  const dashAttr = dash ? ` stroke-dasharray="${dash}"` : '';
  const pts = points.join(',');

  let arrow = '';
  if (el.isArrow) {
    const n = points.length;
    const x1 = points[n - 4], y1 = points[n - 3];
    const x2 = points[n - 2], y2 = points[n - 1];
    const angle = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
    const len = 12;
    const spread = 0.45;
    arrow = `<polyline points="${x2 + len * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI - spread)},${y2 + len * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI - spread)} ${x2},${y2} ${x2 + len * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI + spread)},${y2 + len * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI + spread)}" fill="none" stroke="${el.stroke}" stroke-width="${el.strokeWidth}" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`;
  }

  let label = '';
  if (el.label) {
    const m = midpointOfPath(points);
    label = `<text x="${m.x + (el.labelOffsetX || 0)}" y="${m.y + (el.labelOffsetY || 0)}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central" font-size="${el.labelFontSize || 12}" fill="${el.labelFill || el.stroke}" font-family="Arial">${escape(el.label)}</text>`;
  }

  return `<g><polyline points="${pts}" fill="none" stroke="${el.stroke}" stroke-width="${el.strokeWidth}"${dashAttr} stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>${arrow}${label}</g>`;
}

import type { DashType } from '../../types';

export const escape = (s: string): string =>
  s.replace(/[<>&'"]/g, (c) =>
    ({ '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '&': '&amp;', "'": '&apos;', '"': '&quot;' }[c]!),
  );

export const dashSvg = (d: DashType): string =>
  d === 'solid'
    ? ''
    : ` stroke-dasharray="${
        d === 'dashed' ? '10,6'
        : d === 'dotted' ? '2,5'
        : d === 'dashdot' ? '10,5,2,5'
        : '20,8'
      }"`;

export const fontFamilyAttr = (f?: string): string => {
  const name = f || 'Arial';
  return name.includes(' ') ? `'${name}'` : name;
};

export function wrapLines(
  text: string,
  maxWidth: number,
  fontSize: number,
  fontFamily: string,
  fontStyle: string,
): string[] {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return text.split('\n');
  const ctx = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
  if (!ctx) return text.split('\n');
  const weight = fontStyle.includes('bold') ? 'bold' : 'normal';
  const italic = fontStyle.includes('italic') ? 'italic' : 'normal';
  ctx.font = `${italic} ${weight} ${fontSize}px ${fontFamily}, Arial, sans-serif`;
  const measure = (s: string) => ctx.measureText(s).width;
  const result: string[] = [];

  for (const paragraph of text.split('\n')) {
    if (paragraph === '') { result.push(''); continue; }
    const parts = paragraph.split(/(\s+)/);
    let line = '';
    for (const part of parts) {
      const candidate = line + part;
      if (measure(candidate) <= maxWidth) { line = candidate; continue; }
      if (line.length) { result.push(line.replace(/\s+$/, '')); line = ''; }
      if (/^\s+$/.test(part)) continue;
      if (measure(part) <= maxWidth) { line = part; continue; }
      let chunk = '';
      for (const ch of part) {
        if (measure(chunk + ch) > maxWidth && chunk.length > 0) {
          result.push(chunk);
          chunk = ch;
        } else {
          chunk += ch;
        }
      }
      line = chunk;
    }
    if (line.length) result.push(line.replace(/\s+$/, ''));
    else if (parts.length === 0) result.push('');
  }
  return result.length ? result : [''];
}

interface VAlignInput {
  y: number;
  height: number;
  verticalAlign?: 'top' | 'middle' | 'bottom';
  padding?: { top: number; bottom: number };
}

export function calcStartY(el: VAlignInput, linesCount: number, lineHeight: number): number {
  const pad = el.padding || { top: 0, bottom: 0 };
  const totalH = linesCount * lineHeight;
  const va = el.verticalAlign || 'top';
  if (va === 'middle') return el.y + (el.height - totalH) / 2;
  if (va === 'bottom') return el.y + el.height - pad.bottom - totalH;
  return el.y + pad.top;
}

export function lineToSvg(el: LineElement): string {
  const points = el.points && el.points.length >= 4
    ? el.points
    : [0, el.height / 2, el.width, el.height / 2];
  const tr = `transform="translate(${el.x},${el.y}) rotate(${el.rotation})"`;
  const pts = points.join(',');
  let arrow = '';

    const n = points.length;
    const x1 = points[n - 4], y1 = points[n - 3];

import type { PlaceholderElement } from '../../types';
import { escape, wrapLines, calcStartY, fontFamilyAttr } from './helpers';

export function placeholderToSvg(el: PlaceholderElement): string {
  const pad = el.padding || { top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0 };
  const innerW = Math.max(10, el.width - pad.left - pad.right);
  const fs = el.fontStyle.includes('bold') ? 'bold' : 'normal';
  const fst = el.fontStyle.includes('italic') ? 'italic' : 'normal';
  const anchor = el.align === 'center' ? 'middle' : el.align === 'right' ? 'end' : 'start';
  const tx = el.x + pad.left + (el.align === 'center' ? innerW / 2 : el.align === 'right' ? innerW : 0);
  const tr = `transform="rotate(${el.rotation},${el.x},${el.y})"`;
  const bg = el.background && el.background !== 'transparent'
    ? `<rect x="${el.x}" y="${el.y}" width="${el.width}" height="${el.height}" fill="${el.background}"/>`
    : '';

  if (el.fieldType === 'image') {
    const src = el.sample || `{{${el.fieldPath}}}`;
    return `<g ${tr}>${bg}<image href="${escape(src)}" x="${el.x + pad.left}" y="${el.y + pad.top}" width="${innerW}" height="${Math.max(10, el.height - pad.top - pad.bottom)}" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></g>`;
  }

  const displayText = el.sample || `{{${el.fieldPath}}}`;
  const lines = wrapLines(displayText, innerW, el.fontSize, el.fontFamily, el.fontStyle);
  const lineHeight = el.fontSize * (el.lineHeight || 1.2);
  const startY = calcStartY(el, lines.length, lineHeight);
  const linesSvg = lines.map((ln, i) =>
    `<text x="${tx}" y="${startY + i * lineHeight}" dominant-baseline="text-before-edge" font-size="${el.fontSize}" font-family="${fontFamilyAttr(el.fontFamily)}" font-weight="${fs}" font-style="${fst}" fill="${el.fill}" text-anchor="${anchor}">${escape(ln)}</text>`
  ).join('');
  return `<g ${tr}>${bg}${linesSvg}</g>`;
}

import type { ShapeElement } from '../../types';
import { escape } from './helpers';

export function shapeToSvg(el: ShapeElement): string {
  const fillAttr = el.fill === 'transparent' ? 'none' : el.fill;
  const tr = `transform="rotate(${el.rotation},${el.x},${el.y})"`;
  const r = el.radius || 0;
  const parts: string[] = [];

  if (el.shape === 'rect' || el.shape === 'roundRect') {
    parts.push(
      `<rect x="${el.x}" y="${el.y}" width="${el.width}" height="${el.height}" rx="${r}" ry="${r}" fill="${fillAttr}" stroke="${el.stroke}" stroke-width="${el.strokeWidth}" ${tr}/>`
    );
  } else if (el.shape === 'circle') {
    parts.push(
      `<ellipse cx="${el.x + el.width / 2}" cy="${el.y + el.height / 2}" rx="${el.width / 2}" ry="${el.height / 2}" fill="${fillAttr}" stroke="${el.stroke}" stroke-width="${el.strokeWidth}" ${tr}/>`
    );
  } else if (el.shape === 'triangle') {
    parts.push(
      `<polygon points="${el.x + el.width / 2},${el.y} ${el.x + el.width},${el.y + el.height} ${el.x},${el.y + el.height}" fill="${fillAttr}" stroke="${el.stroke}" stroke-width="${el.strokeWidth}" ${tr}/>`
    );
  }

  if (el.text) {
    parts.push(
      `<text x="${el.x + el.width / 2}" y="${el.y + el.height / 2}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central" font-size="${el.fontSize}" fill="${el.textFill}" ${tr}>${escape(el.text)}</text>`
    );
  }
  return parts.join('');
}

import type { StampElement } from '../../../types';
import { escape, dashSvg, fontFamilyAttr } from '../helpers';

export function legacyStampToSvg(el: StampElement): string {
  const sw = el.strokeWidth || 3;
  const isw = el.innerStrokeWidth || 1;
  const c = el.stampColor || '#1a1a1a';
  const cx = el.width / 2, cy = el.height / 2;
  const t = `transform="translate(${el.x},${el.y}) rotate(${el.rotation},${cx},${cy})"`;
  let body = '';

  if (el.shape === 'circle') {
    const r = Math.min(el.width, el.height) / 2;
    body = `<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r - 4}" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${sw}"${dashSvg(el.strokeDash || 'solid')}/>`;
    if (el.showInner) body += `<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r - 20}" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${isw}"${dashSvg(el.innerStrokeDash || 'solid')}/>`;
  } else if (el.shape === 'oval') {
    body = `<ellipse cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" rx="${el.width / 2 - 4}" ry="${el.height / 2 - 4}" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${sw}"${dashSvg(el.strokeDash || 'solid')}/>`;
    if (el.showInner) body += `<ellipse cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" rx="${el.width / 2 - 20}" ry="${el.height / 2 - 20}" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${isw}"${dashSvg(el.innerStrokeDash || 'solid')}/>`;
  } else if (el.shape === 'rect') {
    body = `<rect x="4" y="4" width="${el.width - 8}" height="${el.height - 8}" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${sw}"${dashSvg(el.strokeDash || 'solid')}/>`;
    if (el.showInner) body += `<rect x="16" y="16" width="${el.width - 32}" height="${el.height - 32}" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${isw}"${dashSvg(el.innerStrokeDash || 'solid')}/>`;
  } else {
    body = `<polygon points="${cx},4 ${el.width - 4},${el.height - 4} 4,${el.height - 4}" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${sw}" stroke-linejoin="round"${dashSvg(el.strokeDash || 'solid')}/>`;
    if (el.showInner) body += `<polygon points="${cx},20 ${el.width - 20},${el.height - 20} 20,${el.height - 20}" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${isw}" stroke-linejoin="round"${dashSvg(el.innerStrokeDash || 'solid')}/>`;
  }

  const topSize = el.topFontSize || 14;
  const centerSize = el.centerFontSize || 20;
  const bottomSize = el.bottomFontSize || 12;
  const topBold = (el.topFontStyle || '').includes('bold') ? 'bold' : 'normal';
  const topItalic = (el.topFontStyle || '').includes('italic') ? 'italic' : 'normal';
  const centerBold = (el.centerFontStyle || '').includes('bold') ? 'bold' : 'normal';
  const centerItalic = (el.centerFontStyle || '').includes('italic') ? 'italic' : 'normal';
  const botBold = (el.bottomFontStyle || '').includes('bold') ? 'bold' : 'normal';
  const botItalic = (el.bottomFontStyle || '').includes('italic') ? 'italic' : 'normal';

  const idSafe = `s${el.id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}`;
  let topText = '', botText = '', defs = '';

  if (el.shape === 'circle' || el.shape === 'oval') {
    const r = Math.min(el.width, el.height) / 2 - 32;
    const aT1 = 1.15 * Math.PI, aT2 = 1.85 * Math.PI;
    const t1x = cx + r * Math.cos(aT1), t1y = cy + r * Math.sin(aT1);
    const t2x = cx + r * Math.cos(aT2), t2y = cy + r * Math.sin(aT2);
    const topPath = `M ${t1x} ${t1y} A ${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${t2x} ${t2y}`;
    const aB1 = 0.85 * Math.PI, aB2 = 0.15 * Math.PI;
    const b1x = cx + r * Math.cos(aB1), b1y = cy + r * Math.sin(aB1);
    const b2x = cx + r * Math.cos(aB2), b2y = cy + r * Math.sin(aB2);
    const botPath = `M ${b1x} ${b1y} A ${r} ${r} 0 0 0 ${b2x} ${b2y}`;
    const topId = `${idSafe}-top`, botId = `${idSafe}-bot`;
    defs = `<defs><path id="${topId}" d="${topPath}" fill="none"/><path id="${botId}" d="${botPath}" fill="none"/></defs>`;
    topText = `<text font-size="${topSize}" fill="${el.topColor || c}" font-family="${fontFamilyAttr(el.topFontFamily)}" font-weight="${topBold}" font-style="${topItalic}"><textPath href="#${topId}" xlink:href="#${topId}" startOffset="50%" text-anchor="middle">${escape(el.topText || '')}</textPath></text>`;
    botText = `<text font-size="${bottomSize}" fill="${el.bottomColor || c}" font-family="${fontFamilyAttr(el.bottomFontFamily)}" font-weight="${botBold}" font-style="${botItalic}"><textPath href="#${botId}" xlink:href="#${botId}" startOffset="50%" text-anchor="middle">${escape(el.bottomText || '')}</textPath></text>`;
  } else {
    const topY = el.shape === 'rect' ? 32 : 42;
    const botY = el.shape === 'rect' ? el.height - 20 : el.height - 24;
    topText = `<text x="${cx}" y="${topY}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="${topSize}" fill="${el.topColor || c}" font-family="${fontFamilyAttr(el.topFontFamily)}" font-weight="${topBold}" font-style="${topItalic}">${escape(el.topText || '')}</text>`;
    botText = `<text x="${cx}" y="${botY}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="${bottomSize}" fill="${el.bottomColor || c}" font-family="${fontFamilyAttr(el.bottomFontFamily)}" font-weight="${botBold}" font-style="${botItalic}">${escape(el.bottomText || '')}</text>`;
  }

  const centerText = `<text x="${cx}" y="${cy}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central" font-size="${centerSize}" fill="${el.centerColor || c}" font-family="${fontFamilyAttr(el.centerFontFamily)}" font-weight="${centerBold}" font-style="${centerItalic}">${escape(el.centerText || '')}</text>`;
  const imagesSvg = (el.images || [])
    .filter((im) => !im.hidden)
    .map((im) => `<image href="${escape(im.src)}" x="${im.x}" y="${im.y}" width="${im.width}" height="${im.height}" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/>`)
    .join('');

  return `<g ${t}>${defs}${body}${imagesSvg}${topText}${centerText}${botText}</g>`;
}

import type { StampShapeItem } from '../../../types';
import { escape } from '../helpers';

export function stampShapeToSvg(s: StampShapeItem): string {
  if (s.hidden) return '';
  const centerX = s.x + s.width / 2;
  const centerY = s.y + s.height / 2;
  const rotateAttr = s.rotation ? ` transform="rotate(${s.rotation} ${centerX} ${centerY})"` : '';
  const stroke = s.stroke ? ` stroke="${escape(s.stroke)}"` : '';
  const strokeW = s.strokeWidth != null ? ` stroke-width="${s.strokeWidth}"` : '';
  const fill = s.fill ? ` fill="${escape(s.fill)}"` : ' fill="none"';
  const dash = (() => {
    if (!s.dash || s.dash === 'solid') return '';
    const arr = s.dash === 'dashed' ? '10,6' : s.dash === 'dotted' ? '2,5' : s.dash === 'dashdot' ? '10,5,2,5' : '20,8';
    return ` stroke-dasharray="${arr}"`;
  })();

  switch (s.kind) {
    case 'rect':
      return `<rect x="${s.x}" y="${s.y}" width="${s.width}" height="${s.height}" rx="${s.cornerRadius || 0}"${fill}${stroke}${strokeW}${dash}${rotateAttr}/>`;
    case 'circle':
    case 'ellipse': {
      const rx = s.kind === 'circle' ? Math.min(s.width, s.height) / 2 : s.width / 2;
      const ry = s.kind === 'circle' ? Math.min(s.width, s.height) / 2 : s.height / 2;
      return `<ellipse cx="${centerX}" cy="${centerY}" rx="${rx}" ry="${ry}"${fill}${stroke}${strokeW}${dash}${rotateAttr}/>`;
    }
    case 'triangle':
      return `<polygon points="${s.x + s.width / 2},${s.y} ${s.x + s.width},${s.y + s.height} ${s.x},${s.y + s.height}"${fill}${stroke}${strokeW}${dash}${rotateAttr}/>`;
    case 'line': {
      const pts = s.points && s.points.length >= 4 ? s.points : [0, s.height / 2, s.width, s.height / 2];
      return `<polyline points="${pts.join(',')}" fill="none"${stroke}${strokeW}${dash} transform="translate(${s.x},${s.y})${s.rotation ? ` rotate(${s.rotation})` : ''}"/>`;
    }
    case 'fill':
      return '';
    default:
      return '';
  }
}

import type { StampElement } from '../../../types';
import { escape } from '../helpers';
import { stampShapeToSvg } from './shapeToSvg';
import { stampTextToSvg } from './textToSvg';
import { legacyStampToSvg } from './legacyStampToSvg';

export function stampToSvg(el: StampElement): string {
  if (el.shapes && el.texts) return newModelStampToSvg(el);
  return legacyStampToSvg(el);
}

function newModelStampToSvg(el: StampElement): string {
  const parts: string[] = [`<g transform="translate(${el.x},${el.y})">`];

  for (const s of el.shapes || []) {
    if (s.kind !== 'fill') continue;
    parts.push(stampShapeToSvg(s));
  }
  for (const s of el.shapes || []) {
    if (s.kind === 'fill') continue;
    parts.push(stampShapeToSvg(s));
  }
  for (const im of el.images || []) {
    if (im.hidden) continue;
    const preserve = im.fit === 'cover' ? 'xMidYMid slice' : im.fit === 'fill' ? 'none' : 'xMidYMid meet';
    const rot = im.rotation ? ` transform="rotate(${im.rotation} ${im.x + im.width / 2} ${im.y + im.height / 2})"` : '';
    parts.push(`<image href="${escape(im.src)}" xlink:href="${escape(im.src)}" x="${im.x}" y="${im.y}" width="${im.width}" height="${im.height}" preserveAspectRatio="${preserve}"${rot}/>`);
  }
  for (const t of el.texts || []) parts.push(stampTextToSvg(t));
  parts.push('</g>');
  return parts.join('');
}

import type { StampTextItem } from '../../../types';
import { escape } from '../helpers';

export function stampTextToSvg(t: StampTextItem): string {
  if (t.hidden) return '';
  const isBold = (t.fontStyle || '').includes('bold');
  const isItalic = (t.fontStyle || '').includes('italic');
  const decoration = t.textDecoration || '';
  const anchor = t.align === 'center' ? 'middle' : t.align === 'right' ? 'end' : 'start';

  if (t.mode === 'straight') {
    const x = t.align === 'center' ? t.x + t.width / 2 : t.align === 'right' ? t.x + t.width : t.x;
    return `<text x="${x}" y="${t.y + t.fontSize}" font-size="${t.fontSize}" font-family="${escape(t.fontFamily)}" font-weight="${isBold ? 'bold' : 'normal'}" ${isItalic ? 'font-style="italic"' : ''} ${decoration ? `text-decoration="${decoration}"` : ''} fill="${escape(t.fill)}" text-anchor="${anchor}">${escape(t.text)}</text>`;
  }

  const rx = t.arcRx ?? t.arcRadius;
  const ry = t.arcRy ?? t.arcRadius;
  const start = (t.arcStartDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const end = (t.arcEndDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const sx = t.arcCx + rx * Math.cos(start);
  const sy = t.arcCy + ry * Math.sin(start);
  const ex = t.arcCx + rx * Math.cos(end);
  const ey = t.arcCy + ry * Math.sin(end);
  const largeArc = Math.abs(end - start) > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
  const sweep = end > start ? 1 : 0;
  const pathId = `arc-${t.id}`;
  const d = `M ${sx} ${sy} A ${rx} ${ry} 0 ${largeArc} ${sweep} ${ex} ${ey}`;

  return `<defs><path id="${pathId}" d="${d}" fill="none"/></defs><text font-size="${t.fontSize}" font-family="${escape(t.fontFamily)}" font-weight="${isBold ? 'bold' : 'normal'}" ${isItalic ? 'font-style="italic"' : ''} fill="${escape(t.fill)}"><textPath href="#${pathId}" xlink:href="#${pathId}" startOffset="50%" text-anchor="middle">${escape(t.text)}</textPath></text>`;
}

import type { TableElement } from '../../types';
import { escape } from './helpers';

export function tableToSvg(el: TableElement): string {
  const cw = el.width / el.cols;
  const ch = el.height / el.rows;
  const tr = `transform="rotate(${el.rotation},${el.x},${el.y})"`;
  const parts: string[] = [`<g ${tr}>`];
  for (let r = 0; r < el.rows; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < el.cols; c++) {
      const bg = r === 0 ? el.headerBg : '#fff';
      parts.push(
        `<rect x="${el.x + c * cw}" y="${el.y + r * ch}" width="${cw}" height="${ch}" fill="${bg}" stroke="${el.borderColor}" stroke-width="1"/>`
      );
      const txt = el.data[r]?.[c] ?? '';
      if (txt) {
        parts.push(
          `<text x="${el.x + c * cw + 6}" y="${el.y + r * ch + el.fontSize}" font-size="${el.fontSize}" fill="#111">${escape(txt)}</text>`
        );
      }
    }
  }
  parts.push('</g>');
  return parts.join('');
}

import type { TextElement } from '../../types';
import { escape, wrapLines, calcStartY, fontFamilyAttr } from './helpers';

export function textToSvg(el: TextElement): string {
  const pad = el.padding || { top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0 };
  const innerW = Math.max(10, el.width - pad.left - pad.right);
  const fs = el.fontStyle.includes('bold') ? 'bold' : 'normal';
  const fst = el.fontStyle.includes('italic') ? 'italic' : 'normal';
  const anchor = el.align === 'center' ? 'middle' : el.align === 'right' ? 'end' : 'start';
  const tx = el.x + pad.left + (el.align === 'center' ? innerW / 2 : el.align === 'right' ? innerW : 0);
  const bg = el.background && el.background !== 'transparent'
    ? `<rect x="${el.x}" y="${el.y}" width="${el.width}" height="${el.height}" fill="${el.background}"/>`
    : '';
  const tr = `transform="rotate(${el.rotation},${el.x},${el.y})"`;
  const lines = wrapLines(el.text, innerW, el.fontSize, el.fontFamily, el.fontStyle);
  const lineHeight = el.fontSize * (el.lineHeight || 1.2);
  const startY = calcStartY(el, lines.length, lineHeight);
  const textSvg = lines.map((ln, i) =>
    `<text x="${tx}" y="${startY + i * lineHeight}" ` +
    `dominant-baseline="text-before-edge" ` +
    `font-size="${el.fontSize}" font-family="${fontFamilyAttr(el.fontFamily)}" ` +
    `font-weight="${fs}" font-style="${fst}" text-decoration="${el.textDecoration}" ` +
    `fill="${el.fill}" text-anchor="${anchor}">${escape(ln)}</text>`
  ).join('');
  return `<g ${tr}>${bg}${textSvg}</g>`;
}

/**
 * ID generation utilities
 */

let counter = 0;

/**
 * Generate unique ID
 */
export function generateId(): string {
  const timestamp = Date.now().toString(36);
  const random = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8);
  const count = (counter++).toString(36);
  return `${timestamp}-${random}-${count}`;
}

/**
 * Generate ID with prefix
 */
export function generateIdWithPrefix(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}-${generateId()}`;
}

/**
 * Check if string is valid ID
 */
export function isValidId(id: string): boolean {
  return typeof id === 'string' && id.length > 0;
}

import React from 'react';
import { Group, Rect } from 'react-konva';
import type { StampElement } from './types';
import { StampRenderer } from './components/stamps/StampRenderer';
import { StampLegacy } from './components/stamps/StampLegacy';

type Zone = 'top' | 'center' | 'bottom';

interface Props {
  el: StampElement;
  onSelect: (e?: any) => void;
  onUpdate: (patch: Partial<StampElement>) => void;
  onDblClick?: (zone: Zone, e?: any) => void;
  onDragStart?: (e: any) => void;
  onDragMove?: (e: any) => void;
  onDragEnd?: (e: any) => void;
  onContextMenu?: (e: any) => void;
  isEditingZone?: Zone | null;
}

export const Stamp: React.FC<Props> = (props) => {
  const { el } = props;

  /* РќРѕРІР°СЏ РјРѕРґРµР»СЊ вЂ” РЅР°СЂРёСЃРѕРІР°РЅРЅС‹Рµ С€С‚Р°РјРїС‹. */
  if (el.shapes && el.texts) {
    return (
      <Group
        id={el.id}
        name="element"
        x={el.x} y={el.y} rotation={el.rotation}
        draggable
        onMouseDown={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; props.onSelect(e); }}
        onTap={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; props.onSelect(e); }}
        onDblClick={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; props.onDblClick?.('center', e); }}
        onDblTap={(e) => { e.cancelBubble = true; props.onDblClick?.('center', e); }}
        onDragStart={props.onDragStart}
        onDragMove={props.onDragMove}
        onDragEnd={(e) => {
          props.onUpdate({ x: e.target.x(), y: e.target.y() });
          props.onDragEnd?.(e);
        }}
        onContextMenu={props.onContextMenu}
        onTransformEnd={(e) => {
          const n = e.target;
          const sx = n.scaleX(), sy = n.scaleY();
          n.scaleX(1); n.scaleY(1);
          props.onUpdate({
            x: n.x(), y: n.y(), rotation: n.rotation(),
            width: Math.max(40, el.width * sx),
            height: Math.max(40, el.height * sy),
          });
        }}
      >
        {/* РќРµРІРёРґРёРјР°СЏ hit-РѕР±Р»Р°СЃС‚СЊ РЅР° РІРµСЃСЊ bbox вЂ” Р»РѕРІРёС‚ РєР»РёРєРё, drag Рё dblclick */}
        <Rect
          x={0} y={0}
          width={Math.max(1, el.width)}
          height={Math.max(1, el.height)}
          fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.001)"
          listening={true}
        />

        <StampRenderer
          width={el.width}
          height={el.height}
          shapes={el.shapes}
          texts={el.texts}
          images={el.images}
        />
      </Group>
    );
  }

  /* Legacy вЂ” СЃС‚Р°СЂР°СЏ РјРѕРґРµР»СЊ. */
  return <StampLegacy {...props} />;
};

FILE: TableCellInput.tsx

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

interface Props {
  value: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  onCommit: (v: string) => void;
}

export const TableCellInput: React.FC<Props> = ({ value, placeholder, onCommit }) => {
  const [v, setV] = useState(value);

  useEffect(() => { setV(value); }, [value]);

  return (
    <input
      value={v}
      placeholder={placeholder}
      style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}
      onChange={(e) => setV(e.target.value)}
      onBlur={() => onCommit(v)}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
          onCommit(v);
          (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
        }
      }}
    />
  );
};

/**
 * Р¤СѓС‚РµСЂ, РїСЂРёРІСЏР·Р°РЅРЅС‹Р№ Рє РѕР±Р»Р°СЃС‚Рё РїРµС‡Р°С‚Рё СЃР»Р°Р№РґР°.
 *   x      = padding.left
 *   width  = slideW - padding.left - padding.right
 *   y      = slideH - padding.bottom - height
 *
 * РџРѕР»СЏ x/y/width РІ `o` РёРіРЅРѕСЂРёСЂСѓСЋС‚СЃСЏ вЂ” РѕРЅРё РІС‹С‡РёСЃР»СЏСЋС‚СЃСЏ.
 */
export function makeFooterInPrintArea(
  slideW: number,
  slideH: number,
  padding: { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number },
  o: Partial<FooterElement> = {},
): FooterElement {
  const height = o.height ?? 40;
  const { x: _x, y: _y, width: _w, ...rest } = o;
  return {
    id: uid(), type: 'footer',
    x: padding.left,
    y: slideH - padding.bottom - height,
    width: Math.max(0, slideW - padding.left - padding.right),
    height,
    rotation: 0,
    text: 'РћРћРћ В«РљРѕРјРїР°РЅРёСЏВ» В· www.example.com',
    fill: '#ffffff', bgColor: '#1e293b', fontSize: 12,
    ...rest,
  };
}

import React from 'react';

interface Props {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  fontSize: number;
  fontFamily: string;
  fontStyle: string;
  textDecoration: string;
  fill: string;
  align: string;
  onChange: (patch: any) => void;
  onCommit: () => void;
}

const FONTS = ['Arial', 'Times New Roman', 'Courier New', 'Georgia', 'Verdana', 'Comic Sans MS'];
const SIZES = [8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 48, 64, 72];

export const TextToolbar: React.FC<Props> = ({
  x, y, fontSize, fontFamily, fontStyle, textDecoration, fill, align,
  onChange, onCommit,
}) => {
  const isBold = fontStyle.includes('bold');
  const isItalic = fontStyle.includes('italic');
  const isUnderline = textDecoration === 'underline';

  const toggleBold = () => {
    const parts = fontStyle.split(' ').filter(Boolean);
    const idx = parts.indexOf('bold');
    if (idx >= 0) parts.splice(idx, 1); else parts.push('bold');
    onChange({ fontStyle: parts.join(' ') || 'normal' });
  };
  const toggleItalic = () => {
    const parts = fontStyle.split(' ').filter(Boolean);
    const idx = parts.indexOf('italic');
    if (idx >= 0) parts.splice(idx, 1); else parts.push('italic');
    onChange({ fontStyle: parts.join(' ') || 'normal' });
  };
  const toggleUnderline = () => {
    onChange({ textDecoration: isUnderline ? '' : 'underline' });
  };

  // РўРѕР»СЊРєРѕ РґР»СЏ РєРЅРѕРїРѕРє: СЃРѕС…СЂР°РЅСЏРµС‚ С„РѕРєСѓСЃ textarea.
  // РќР° select Рё color РќР• РІРµС€Р°РµРј, РёРЅР°С‡Рµ Р±СЂР°СѓР·РµСЂ РЅРµ РѕС‚РєСЂРѕРµС‚ РёС….
  const keepFocus = (e: React.MouseEvent) => e.preventDefault();

  // РћР±С‰РёР№ РєРѕРЅС‚РµР№РЅРµСЂ Р»РѕРІРёС‚ mousedown, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РєР»РёРє РїРѕ С‚СѓР»Р±Р°СЂСѓ РЅРµ РєРѕРјРјРёС‚РёР» СЂРµРґР°РєС‚РѕСЂ.
  const stopBubble = (e: React.MouseEvent) => e.stopPropagation();

  return (
    <div
      className="text-toolbar"
      style={{ left: x, top: y }}
      onMouseDown={stopBubble}
    >
      <select
        value={fontFamily}
        onChange={(e) => onChange({ fontFamily: e.target.value })}
        className="tt-select"
        title="РЁСЂРёС„С‚"
      >
        {FONTS.map((f) => <option key={f} value={f}>{f}</option>)}
      </select>

      <select
        value={Math.round(fontSize)}
        onChange={(e) => onChange({ fontSize: +e.target.value })}
        className="tt-select tt-size"
        title="Р Р°Р·РјРµСЂ"
      >
        {SIZES.map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
      </select>

      <div className="tt-group">
        <button type="button" onMouseDown={keepFocus}
          className={isBold ? 'active' : ''} onClick={toggleBold} title="Р–РёСЂРЅС‹Р№">
          <b>B</b>
        </button>
        <button type="button" onMouseDown={keepFocus}
          className={isItalic ? 'active' : ''} onClick={toggleItalic} title="РљСѓСЂСЃРёРІ">
          <i>I</i>
        </button>
        <button type="button" onMouseDown={keepFocus}
          className={isUnderline ? 'active' : ''} onClick={toggleUnderline} title="РџРѕРґС‡С‘СЂРєРЅСѓС‚С‹Р№">
          <u>U</u>
        </button>
      </div>

      <input
        type="color"
        value={fill}
        onChange={(e) => onChange({ fill: e.target.value })}
        className="tt-color"
        title="Р¦РІРµС‚"
      />

      <div className="tt-group">
        <button type="button" onMouseDown={keepFocus}
          className={align === 'left' ? 'active' : ''}
          onClick={() => onChange({ align: 'left' })} title="Р’Р»РµРІРѕ">в¬…</button>

          onClick={() => onChange({ align: 'right' })} title="Р’РїСЂР°РІРѕ">вћЎ</button>

export const FORMATS: Record<DocFormat, { label: string; portrait: { w: number; h: number } }> = {
  a4:     { label: 'A4 (210Г—297 РјРј)',    portrait: { w: 794,  h: 1123 } },
  a5:     { label: 'A5 (148Г—210 РјРј)',    portrait: { w: 559,  h: 794  } },
  a6:     { label: 'A6 (105Г—148 РјРј)',    portrait: { w: 397,  h: 559  } },
  letter: { label: 'Letter (216Г—279 РјРј)',portrait: { w: 816,  h: 1056 } },
  ticket: { label: 'Р‘РёР»РµС‚ (200Г—80 РјРј)',  portrait: { w: 302,  h: 756  } },
  card:   { label: 'Р’РёР·РёС‚РєР° (90Г—50 РјРј)', portrait: { w: 189,  h: 340  } },
  custom: { label: 'РЎРІРѕР№ СЂР°Р·РјРµСЂ',        portrait: { w: 794,  h: 1123 } },
};

export const getFormatSize = (
  format: DocFormat,
  orientation: Orientation,
  custom?: { w: number; h: number },
): { w: number; h: number } => {
  let base = FORMATS[format].portrait;
  if (format === 'custom' && custom) base = custom;
  return orientation === 'portrait'
    ? { w: base.w, h: base.h }
    : { w: base.h, h: base.w };
};

/// <reference lib="webworker" />
import { rasterizeCompositeFills, type FillSpec } from '../lib/stamps/rasterFill';
import type { StampShapeItem } from '../types';

interface Request {
  seq: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  shapes: StampShapeItem[];
  fills: FillSpec[];
}

self.onmessage = (e: MessageEvent<Request>) => {
  const { seq, width, height, shapes, fills } = e.data;
  try {
    const url = rasterizeCompositeFills({ width, height, shapes, fills });
    self.postMessage({ seq, url });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[fillWorker] rasterize failed', err);
    self.postMessage({ seq, url: null });
  }
};
